name: Blue Dream
description: Bred from DJ Short’s Blueberry and the infamous Super Silver Haze strain, Blue Dream is a potent old-school that stands the test of time and has been growing in popularity since its creation back in 2003 in California, where it became one of the most popular strains on the West Coast, and eventually, all around the globe. This strain presents a moderately difficult strain to grow, so some knowledge is required to maximize its production and quality. Also, indoor growers beware as Blue Dream plants can grow up to 6ft (150 cm) in height. This sativa-dominant strain offers low THC content of around 18% with 1% CBD on average. Users describe the high as an immediate energetic sensation that gets you completely focused and incites creativity while a wave of relaxation leaves your whole body almost numb and pain-free. The potent, well-defined effects make it an ideal strain for medical patients battling against symptoms of chronic stress, nausea, sleep insomnia, and mild cases of depression. Blue Dream is a great choice for those with a sweet tooth out there who like to indulge in sweet, fruity, and doughy terpene profiles as this strain offers delicious flavors of sweet sugary berry pie with an earthy, citrusy, slightly skunky background.

name: OG Kush
description: OG Kush (Emerald Triangle x Hindu Kush) channels the Florida legend told by Origins TK, where a Hindu Kush brought back from Amsterdam pollinated an Emerald Triangle female and sparked a lineage that would define modern OGs. This indica-leaning hybrid grows with thick, bract-stacked spears and a heavy sugar coat, throwing lime-to-olive flowers banded by burnt-orange pistils. The nose hits classic OG registers: diesel first, then lemon zest over pine and warm earth, powered by a terpene trio of myrcene, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene. Typical THC sits in the 18-26% window with trace CBD, delivering a fast on-ramp to relaxed, euphoric clarity and an easygoing, happy mood. In the garden, plants stay medium in stature roughly 90 cm indoors and up to 180 cm outside yet fill out predictably, finishing in about 56-63 days. Expect medium yields around 450 g/m2 inside and near 600 g per plant in sun, with dense, resin-rich colas that cure into pungent, gassy nuggets. Myrcene leads the bouquet, with limonene brightness and peppery beta-caryophyllene anchoring a long, resinous finish. As a sibling to Triangle Kush in spirit and story, this OG cut preserves the Florida-to-California bridge that made "OG" a byword for gas and grit, while Emerald Triangle roots keep the profile deep, forested, and unmistakably Kush. Credit: Origins TK.

name: Dante's Inferno
description: Dante’s Inferno is an Indica-dominant variety created by crossing the Devil Driver and Oreoz through a collaboration between Clearwater Genetics and Tiki Madman. This is considered a top-shelf strain, meaning that it needs special care. As such, it’s not recommended for beginners as it requires perfectly controlled environmental conditions and feedings to thrive. This Indica-dominant variety is well-known for its pastry-like flavor of sweet strawberries dipped in cream with a nutty cookie dough overtone. With THC levels ranging from 27 to 29%, this strain can be considered part of the new era of cannabis strains that are both more potent and more flavorful. Thanks to the thorough selection process dedicated to breeding this strain, the effects are felt almost immediately and will spread throughout your entire body very quickly- you will feel very relaxed yet focused, talkative, and happy. As the effect progresses, the heady effects may turn sedative, leaving you sleepy until you eventually doze off.

name: Goat Milk
description: Goat Milk, also known as G.O.A.T. Milk, is a medical-grade hybrid with evenly balanced genetics, a high average THC content of 23%, and CBD levels at 2%. This amazing cultivar was achieved by crossbreeding Cereal Milk and Georgia Pie. Growers should be aware that these tall and moderately challenging plants are high yielders, producing up to 600g/m² following around 70 days of flowering. Preventing mold by keeping humidity levels stable and below average is crucial, next to pruning and topping due to their tall stature. Flavor-wise, Goat Milk delivers a sweet and nutty flavor profile with berries taking most of the attention, and the aroma complements this rather subtly. The Goat Milk high is fast-hitting and Sativa-driven at first, with energetic effects causing mental stimulation, motivation, and arousal. The accompanying physical relaxation is mildly sedative and deep enough to put you completely at ease for hours on end. Due to its potency and these balanced effects, Goat Milk is often hailed by medical patients using it to alleviate cramps, stress, and chronic fatigue.

name: Tropical Mule
description: Raw Genetics Tropical Mule leads with a lively burst of lemon-candy aromatics, then settles into creamy dessert notes laced with classic Z candy-gas. Bred by Raw Genetics from Gelonade and Zikigai, this hybrid grows tall and vigorous with strong lateral branching and dense, trichome-crusted flowers that flash silver under trim. In the garden it is straightforward to manage, responding well to topping and light training, and typically finishes in 60–65 days with large, eye-catching colas and a notable wash of resin. Expect bright flavor on the inhale (citrus, tropical fruit, soft vanilla-sugar) and a smooth, confectionary finish. A terpene profile commonly expresses limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene, echoing its citrus-forward, candy-cream lineage. The effect lands clean and upbeat at first—uplifted, creative, and attentive—before a light, calming body tone rounds off the edges without heaviness. Phenotype-dependent potency can be high with generally low CBD, and yields are strong for both flower and resin-focused work. If you are chasing modern candy profiles with actual performance in the room, Tropical Mule captures Gelonade’s zesty gelato character and Zikigai’s saturated Z sweetness in a single, dependable package, carrying the unmistakable signature of its breeder. Indoors or outside, plants stack uniform spears with minimal leaf, making trimming efficient and bag appeal immediate.

Plants grow medium in height with sturdy branching and dense, resin-stacked colas that ripen in roughly 60–65 days. Expect excellent trichome coverage and strong wash potential. The nose bursts with lemon zest, sweet vanilla cream, and sugary fruit over faint earth and fuel; the taste echoes cherry-limeade layered with classic dessert gas. Reported specs place it around 40% indica and 60% sativa with THC commonly 20–25% and CBD under 1%. Effects arrive as a clear, euphoric lift and creative focus that taper into an easy, happy calm without heavy sedation. Indoors, light training and a moderate feed schedule return medium yields—about 400–500 g/m²—while well-run outdoor plants can push near 700 g each. Limonene and myrcene frequently lead the terpene profile. Lineage explains the appeal: Trop Cherry (Trop Cherry x Georgia Pie) brings creamy gas structure, color, and vigor; Original Z—an F1 Original Z line inbred to intensify candy—turns the dial on fruit-candy aromatics. For collectors chasing loud, layered flavor with reliable garden manners, Platinum Paloma delivers. Balanced potency meets standout bag appeal in a truly photogenic cultivar.

In many rooms the terp mix presents as limonene/caryophyllene with supporting myrcene, translating to bright top notes, soft spice, and a lingering dessert finish. The experience typically opens with a creative, cheerful lift and easy sociability before settling into relaxed, body-loosening calm. Indoors or out, Fire Dancer is straightforward to manage, finishing in about 55–65 days with impressive yields and heavy resin that suit both jar-ready flower and solventless work. Its dessert intensity and sturdy structure trace to the parents pedigree: triple-inbred Runtz stacked through Sugar Titz, plus Apple Fritter and Strawberries & Cream F2 in the Rainbow Berries line. Crafted by Raw Genetics, Fire Dancer is a modern candy-gelato hybrid tuned for punchy flavor, reliable performance, and photogenic, frost-laden buds.

If your palate lives between cream-sugar and gas-pedal, Stuffed Blue Cherry reads like a greatest-hits remix of its parents—familiar and fresh, flavorful and photogenic, from first sniff to last puff.

Aromas translate cleanly to flavor from first spark.

This 50/50 hybrid grows with vigor and notably large bracts, stacking dense, frosted colas that flash forest green with lavender streaks. Its aroma opens with sweet cream and citrus over an earthy-pine baseline, and the flavor follows with dessert-like sweetness and a subtle soapy-clean finish. Typical lab results place THC in the 15–25% range while CBD stays low, letting the terpene trio of myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene set the tone: relaxed but buoyant, gently uplifting, and conducive to a focused, creative groove. Indoors, expect a straightforward cycle of roughly 8–9 weeks; trained canopies reward with around 650 g/m², while outdoor plants in favorable climates can top roughly 1100 g each by early October. Structure is medium in height with sturdy lateral branching, making it adaptable to most environments. Bred and released by LIT Farms, Milk Bath delivers showpiece resin coverage and a crowd-pleasing profile that marries confectionery fruit and cream to crisp citrus. If you favor modern dessert genetics with balance and bag appeal, this one lives up to its name.

name: SKO
description: SKO from California Seedbank is a modern indica-leaning hybrid built from Triangle Kush, Donny Burger crossed with StrawGuavaLarry, released only as feminized seed for growers chasing resin-first plants. The bouquet lands squarely in the gas lane—sharp, astringent fuel wrapped in a creamy StrawGuava layer—with occasional phenotypes pushing a bright pineapple-fuel top note. Plants express compact, branching structure with dense, greasy flowers that wash well; SKO was selected for “dumpers,” so solventless makers can expect vivid returns. Indoors it finishes quickly in roughly 8–9 weeks (about 56–63 days), stacking lime-to-olive colas sugared in trichomes. On the palate, expect pungent, creamy, and tropical tones in equal measure, underpinned by terpene profiles commonly associated with beta‑caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. While the breeder lists it simply as an indica hybrid, the overall experience trends balanced: heavy-lidded calm without muting a buoyant mood—equally suited to slow-roll weekends or late creative sessions. Yield is phenotype- and environment-dependent, but OG and Burger ancestry typically reward attentive lighting and airflow with chunky tops and plenty of productive secondary sites. Credit California Seedbank for the cross; the pairing of Triangle Kush/Donny Burger and StrawGuavaLarry gives SKO its pungent depth, creamy-tropical lift, and quick, production-friendly bloom. Expect compact internodes, vigorous rooting, and an easy trim thanks to a high calyx-to-leaf ratio.

name: Strawberry OOZE
description: Strawberry OOZE by California Seedbank drips with nostalgic candy terps and gassy depth. Bred by crossing Skunk House's Modified Banana x Zkittlez with StrawGuavaLarry, this feminized indica hybrid marries creamy banana and rainbow-sweet fruit to OG-driven structure and fuel. Expect a head-turning bouquet that reads sweet and fruity up front, then slides into diesel with tropical guava accents; the profile suggests a limonene-myrcene-caryophyllene triad with supporting notes of pinene. Plants typically display medium internodes and sturdy, OG-like branching that stack dense, resin-glossed flowers. Indoors, most phenotypes finish in 8-9 weeks (roughly 56-63 days), rewarding careful dialing with sticky, easy-to-trim colas. Larry influence keeps the frame tidy, while the ModifiedBanana side pushes trichome coverage and color; the Skittlez infusion brightens the finish. On the palate, thick fuel rides over candy and soft citrus, with a lingering sweet-diesel aftertaste. The experience leans happy and relaxed yet buoyant, delivering that uplifted, feel-good glow without sacrificing depth. Growers can anticipate straightforward, hash-friendly resin and a balanced, indica-hybrid vigor suited to a variety of training styles. California Seedbank conceived and releases Strawberry OOZE as a house selection; it is offered as feminized seed for collectors seeking a flavorful, fast-finishing modern hybrid that wears its lineage proudly: ModifiedBanana/Skittlez x StrawGuavaLarry genetics.

name: Orange Prism
description: Orange Prism from Symbiotic Genetics is a vibrant sativa-dominant hybrid built on Rainbow Belts × Mimosa V6. The strain combines the sweet Z-terpenes of Rainbow Belts with the energetic orange-cherry character of Mimosa V6. In the grow, plants show medium vigor, strong branching, and dense, resinous colas that often flash lime to violet hues. Flowering takes 8–9 weeks. The aroma features fresh orange zest, sparkling citrus, and soft grape candy. Flavor is bright: orange zest, sweet citrus, and fruity depth. Terpenes are led by limonene, supported by myrcene and caryophyllene. Effects hit quickly: clear euphoria, creativity, and focus, then gently transition into calm relaxation. Potency is high — 24–30% THC with minimal CBD. Under lights, phenotypes stay manageable with basic canopy work; outdoors, a late dry season preserves maximum resin. Orange Prism is an expressive, sticky strain with a bold orange character and balanced high: refreshing, flavorful, and visually striking.

name: Watermelon Marker
description: Watermelon Marker distills the summer slice nostalgia of its name into a modern, terp driven hybrid. Bred by First Class Genetics by pairing Bolo Runtz with Seed Junky's Permanent Marker, this cultivar blends dessert fruit candy with a clean line of diesel. The nose opens with juicy watermelon candy and sweet florals before settling into diesel laced undertones; the palate stays creamy and smooth, letting the fruity sweetness linger while a faint, sharp marker note flickers on the exhale. In testing from one Michigan release, flower reached about 27.5% THC, and lab terpene data highlighted bright limonene supported by calming linalool and spicy beta-caryophyllene, a trio that mirrors the strain's playful yet composed character. Structure tends to be densely frosted and sticky, showing the Runtz side's bag appeal with occasional purple mottling inherited through Permanent Marker, itself honored as a major award winner in 2023. Effects arrive in balanced waves: uplifting and happy at the start, then smoothly relaxing without heaviness, a comfortable groove for creative headspace or laid-back social time. Collectors appreciate Watermelon Marker as a flavorful cross that honors both parents while carving out a distinct, candy gas signature that is easy to recognize on a crowded shelf.

Indoors, Cherry Cadillac typically completes in 8–9 weeks (about 56–63 days) and rewards attentive growers with high yields; a moderate skill set and basic training are enough to maximize secondary sites. The effect profile leans soothing and buoyant: a quick lift of euphoria and happiness settles into a relaxed body cadence suited for winding down without heavy fog. While lab results vary by producer, batches are generally THC‑forward with negligible CBD, and the terpene spectrum frequently emphasizes caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool. Flavor carries through from the nose—cherry‑candy upfront, a creamy mid‑palate, and a gassy finish. Bred in Humboldt County by CHAnetics, Cherry Cadillac honors its parents: Cadillac Rainbow contributes resin‑laden heft and color, while Cherry Runtz polishes the profile with bright fruit and confectionary charm. Expect medium stature indoors and balanced performance outdoors when conditions are stable.

Growers prize its big‑yield potential and hash‑friendly resin, while flowers still hit the classic “candy gas” profile in the jar. Effects start bright and euphoric then settle into a focused, balanced stone with an occasional psychedelic edge, reflecting the blend carried forward from Don Carlos and Grape Menthol. Morphology tends toward medium‑tall, vigorously branching plants that color up when nights run cool. While lab numbers vary by environment, Candy Hustle was developed and tested for high potency, keeping pace with modern top‑shelf expectations. For those chasing loud flavor, standout bag appeal, and serious production without excess fuss, Candy Hustle delivers — a polished Humboldt Seed Company original with lineage you can taste.

The look leans opulent—deep greens and occasional purples buried under heavy trichome armor — yet the nose is playful: gas and vanilla wafers over a pastry-shop sweetness with a faint refinery echo. The flavor tracks the aroma with petrol on the inhale and a sweet-cookie expansion on the exhale. In HSC testing Hyper Za routinely pushes very high potency, with an average THC around 35%, and it dumps resin, making solventless hash production notably strong. Its enormous bracts and minimal leaf make for an easy manicure and excellent bag appeal. Growers will appreciate the combination of resilience, easy management, and genuinely heavy yields that make tents and fields look dialed without extra fuss. Effects land fast and assertive, trending euphoric and happy before settling into a deep, relaxing body glow. As a candy-gassy centerpiece that finishes fast and fills jars, Hyper Za carries Humboldt Seed Company’s signature polish from seed to cure.

Structure is dense and photogenic, with flower expressing dark lavender interiors once milled. As Moon Valley’s first homegrown creation, Neon Panther captures the brand’s hash‑maker ethos—clean inputs, meticulous selection, and resin that shines—while honoring its parents: Pink Runtz’s candy shop charm and Super Boof’s punchy citrus power shape a distinct, memorable house flavor.

The flavor mirrors the aroma—a cool, creamy mint on the inhale that evolves toward roasted nuts and tangy gas on the exhale. Effects begin with a bright, euphoric lift before settling into a deep, body-centered calm that loosens the day’s knots without pinning you to the couch. Resin output is notably heavy, making this cultivar a natural for hash and rosin work. Triple Mints XXL captures modern dessert genetics in a space-saving, high-yield package authored by Sensi Seeds. With high THC potential and naturally low CBD, it rewards easy-to-moderate handling, thriving in SOG, tolerating light SCROG, and responding well to lollipopping.

name: Dirty Mimosa

Visually, calyxes stack into eye-catching spires that can flash fall colors late. Typical experiences are relaxed and euphoric with an uplifted edge, echoing the calm focus that made the line a favorite for both flower and hash. Yields run moderate when dialed in, and finish times reflect its OG lineage rather than extended sativa windows. Potency trends high with minimal CBD, and the effect profile leans euphoric, happy, and thoroughly relaxing - an unmistakable OG attitude without the muddiness. Head Rush preserves OG lineage while Platinum OG adds weight and sheen, making it a connoisseur’s keeper cut as well as a reliable production choice. If you’re chasing real-deal OG nuance with contemporary vigor, this cross brings it home.

description: Block Party by THC Design brings a festive hybrid energy to the room, uniting Super Sherb and Blockberry into a well-balanced 50/50 cross. Expect a vivid nose where pepper and clove spark over a diesel-and-wood backbone, a profile driven by a trio of dominant terpenes—caryophyllene for spice, limonene for lift, and humulene for a dry, woody echo. Its potency typically lands around 24.5% THC with trace CBD near 0.11%, yielding a smooth onset that brightens into euphoric, creative focus before settling into an easy, relaxed finish without heavy couchlock. In the garden, Block Party shows compact indoor stature (often under four feet) and medium-dense calyx stacking that responds well to topping and low-stress training. Flowering wraps in about 9–11 weeks, and dialed-in indoor canopies can reach roughly 510 g/m2, while sun-grown plants may push near 539 g per plant by mid- to late October in favorable climates. The smoke follows the aroma—peppery and gassy up front with a clean, woody fade—making this selection a versatile companion for music, conversation, or winding down after work. Bred and released by THC Design, it is a modern hybrid built for good company.

name: Mendo OG

Batch results commonly land in the mid-20s for THC (about 24–27%) with trace CBD, translating to a swift, full-body calm and an easy, contented mood that often drifts toward sleepy. The buds glint with thick trichome coverage and occasional purples from the Mendo side, while the OGKB influence deepens the kushy backbone and finish. Winner of multiple cups under THC Designs banner, this cultivar balances modern potency with an unfussy, cooperative morphology, making it a reliable pick for growers and a flavorful, soothing standby for connoisseurs who appreciate classic Mendocino character refined for todays shelves.

name: Kush Envy
description: Kush Envy from THC Design is an indica-leaning hybrid built from Jealousy, Animal Mints, and Bubba Kush, a curated cut sourced from Seed Junky Genetics. Expect a bright citrus entry and pine through-line underpinned by earthy, toasted coffee tones, a flavor ensemble led by limonene with support from beta-caryophyllene, linalool, and pinene. Lab results for this batch report roughly 30.1% total THC with ~0% CBD, translating to a deep, enveloping potency that arrives with a slower-than-typical kush onset before settling into steady, euphoric calm. Buds grow dense and resinous on a compact frame with tight internodes and heavy trichome coverage; indoors, attentive runs generally finish in about 56-63 days and reward a careful dry and cure with shimmering frost and room-filling aroma. On the palate, zesty citrus sparks the first pull, pine and woods carry the mid-palate, and a subtle mocha finish lingers on the exhale. The effect profile leans relaxed, happy, and quietly euphoric while maintaining a clear, content headspace ideal for unhurried evenings. Expect compact, easy-to-trim colas and a smooth, clean burn that preserves its citrus-pine bouquet from grinder to final draw. Bridging modern dessert-gas lineage with classic kush earth, Kush Envy showcases Seed Junky pedigree filtered through THC Design's meticulous indoor craft.

name: Vanilla Brulee
description: Vanilla Brulee from THC Design is an indica-leaning cross that brings together Gelato 33 and Wedding Pie, a pairing that explains its dessert-like personality from the first grind. Expect a bright orange-and-vanilla opening wrapped in floral tones of lavender, then a faint spice that nods to its caryophyllene-heavy terpene profile, supported by limonene and linalool. Dense, frosty flowers show the Gelato side in their purple flecks and the Wedding Pie lineage in their weighty, resinous calyxes. Lab lots often clock total THC around the high-twenties with negligible CBD, translating to a calm, euphoric body feel and a steady lift in mood that tapers into easy relaxation without heaviness. Indoors, medium-stature plants respond well to topping and canopy control, finishing in about 8 to 9 weeks with high yields; outdoors they maintain a compact frame and reward attentive feeding with bulky, sugar-dusted colas. This cut traces back to Seed Junky Genetics, and it smells and tastes like its name: smooth cream, citrus zest, and a soft floral fade. If you appreciate modern dessert hybrids with structure and staying power, Vanilla Brulee delivers a polished expression of its parents while keeping the profile unmistakably THC Design.

name: Monkey Milk
description: Monkey Milk from Bodhi Seeds churns classic and cream into one heady hybrid. Built by pairing the vintage Midwest legend Monkey Paw with Bodhi’s dessert‑leaning Strawberry Milk, it marries skunky citrus zest to velvety notes of vanilla and honey. Expect a lively, sativa‑styled lift from the Monkey Paw side—bright, talkative, and clear—tempered by Strawberry Milk’s smooth, OG‑rooted body ease for an overall happy, relaxed, and gently uplifted profile. In the garden, Monkey Milk typically stretches a bit at the flip, forming sturdy, well‑spaced branches and dense, resin‑frosted spears. Indoors most phenotypes finish around nine weeks (about 60–63 days), while outdoor runs are ready as autumn settles, with yields that trend medium to high when canopy light is managed and support is in place. Aromas open with skunk and citrus peel before settling into sweet bakery tones; the flavor follows with creamy vanilla over a faint diesel‑herbal backdrop. Credit for this creamy crossover goes to Bodhi Seeds, whose milk line is known for powdered‑milk perfume and strong visual appeal. Growers hunting for keepers will find a versatile hybrid with classic lineage, modern bag appeal, and the kind of balanced effect that plays well from first test bowl to full‑room selection.

name: Island Cream
description: Island Cream from Bodhi Seeds adds a splash of tropic clarity to classic dessert genetics. Built by pairing the island-leaning mother Mana with Strawberry Milk, the cultivar opens with sunny citrus and soapy-linen top notes before sliding into ripe strawberry, vanilla cream, and faint candy. Expect a balanced hybrid frame with moderate stretch, sturdy laterals, and dense, resin-flecked calyxes that finish with good bag appeal. Indoor heights trend medium, with stout, sugar-coated colas that trim easily and cure to a glossy pastel-green sparkle. Most phenos flower in about 63–84 days indoors and return medium yields; outdoor runs in temperate zones finish early to mid October. Typical dominant terpenes show as limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene, reinforcing lemon-zest brightness over a sweet, creamy base. Effects tend to be cheerful and composed rather than racy: an uplifted, happy onset that settles into an easy, relaxed cruise, with just enough focus for conversation or creativity. While potency will vary by selection, Island Cream generally reads as a THC-forward hybrid with minimal CBD, inherited from Strawberry Milk’s OG-influenced side. Growers looking for a straightforward, moderately tall plant with memorable aroma and a clean, modern flavor profile will find Island Cream a rewarding hunt. Parents: Mana x Strawberry Milk. Breeder: Bodhi Seeds.

name: Green Lantern
description: Meet Green Lantern, a heavily Sativa-dominant hybrid with THC levels averaging 22%. This equally potent and delicious strain was achieved through crossbreeding Green Crack and White Rhino. These visually pleasing ladies reach medium heights and are moderately challenging to grow, but seeds can be hard to come by. These high yielders can produce up to 500g/m², following an average flowering cycle of 60 days. The Green Lantern flavor profile is complex and intense. Expect lots of pine and citrus, infused with pepper and a lingering pungency. As expected from an almost entirely Sativa-driven cultivar, the high will leave consumers in an uplifted state with lots of focus and creativity to tackle any task at hand. This ideal daytime strain will get you up and moving on days that you need some extra motivation to start working on your to-do list. Due to these energizing and long-lasting effects, Green Lantern has become a sought-after strain amongst medical patients suffering from chronic stress, pain, and bipolar disorder.

name: Purple Ink
description: Purple Ink from Umami Seed Co melds the fiery spice of Chile Verde with the funky candy essence of Zuchi, refined by Limecai's exotic berry-lime punch to yield a contemporary hybrid bursting with saturated flavor and striking visuals. The scent erupts with effervescent grape soda and fizzy Fun Dip notes, underpinned by subtle tropical fruit and faint gas; key terpenes like limonene, myrcene, and linalool drive the bright, mouth-coating grape profile that lingers from jar to exhale. This is an indica-dominant hybrid (approximately 60-70% indica / 30-40% sativa, based on parent leans), with THC levels typically testing in the low-to-mid 20s from similar Umami lines, often 22–26% THC and negligible CBD; parent strains suggest potent batches reaching 24%+. Effects onset uplifting and cerebral - euphoric, focused, and sociable - before melting into deep physical relaxation ideal for evening unwind without heavy sedation. Expect medium plants with controlled stretch (around 1.5–2x in flower), forming dense, spear-like colas that stack heavily from base to tip, cloaked in greasy trichomes and sugar leaves that curl dramatically late in bloom. Buds transition early to deep purples and near-black shades, accented by vibrant orange pistils and phenotypes that wash to vivid purple hash. Indoors, it matures in about 60-70 days under optimized conditions, offering medium to high yields (around 450-600 g/m² with proper canopy management like topping or SCROG); outdoors, it finishes by early October with resin-packed buds suited for solventless extracts due to trichome density and terp retention. Robust structure and easy trimming cure to an inky, glossy finish with exceptional bag appeal. Credit Umami Seed Co for fusing Chile Verde's heat with Zuchi's zest and Limeçai's depth: a photogenic, flavor-saturated cultivar that evokes berry candy effervescence alongside the potency and aesthetics modern growers crave

name: Blue Zparkle

Effects start euphoric and uplifting with clear-headed energy, then ease into smooth body relaxation without full sedation. Expect medium plants with moderate stretch (1.5–2x in flower), yielding dense, frosty colas coated in heavy trichomes that shimmer under light, often showing blue-purple hues with bright orange pistils. Indoors, it finishes in roughly 8–9 weeks (based on parent averages), delivering medium-high yields (450–550 g/m² possible); outdoors, it matures by early October with resin-rich buds great for solventless work. Credit Gooniez and Tedz Budz for blending Blue Zushi's exotic depth with Rainbow Zkittlez's fruity pop: a visually striking, high-octane cultivar that delivers berry-candy bliss alongside modern potency and appeal.

name: Zakuro

Limonene leads the bouquet, with beta-caryophyllene and linalool rounding the edges into a sweet, spicy, faintly floral finish. On the palate, it leans citrus, tropical, and sweet. Expect an upbeat onset that feels clean and creative before settling into a comfortable, happy glow; the wash of energy comes from the Tropicanna side, while the Guava cut adds density, color, and resin. Plants show a medium stature with strong lateral branching and colorful calyx stacks, finishing in roughly 8-10 weeks indoors. Yields land in the middle of the pack but resin coverage is generous, making Zakuro a compelling pick for flavor-driven flower and hash alike. THC typically sits high with minimal CBD. Named for the Japanese word for pomegranate, Zakuro presents gemstone hues and sticky, candy-coated bag appeal. Bred by Bloom Seed Co, and built on the award-winning Tropicanna Cookies lineage, it is a bright, modern expression for growers and connoisseurs who chase sunshine in the terp profile. Expect balanced internode spacing, easy training, and stout, trichome-heavy colas that cure to loud jars.

Plants show sturdy branching and resin-soaked, medium-dense flowers; indoors they remain medium in stature, stretching taller outdoors. Growers report medium difficulty, a sweet spot for topping and light defoliation, and a 63–77 day bloom that really sweetens after day 60. Yields track medium-to-high—about 500 g/m2 under lights and up to 700 g per plant outside when dialed. name: Jelly Cake

The ride opens with an uplifting, euphoric lift before easing into a deeply relaxed, dessert-smooth glide; some phenos lean more sedative toward the close. Flavor mirrors aroma: sweet and creamy up front, tropical and berry-bright through the middle, and softly vanilla on the finish. Designed by Barneys Farm, Jelly Cake blends modern bag appeal with practical performance, rewarding growers who favor rich, candy-forward profiles without sacrificing structure, resin, or timing. Expect medium difficulty overall and a tidy canopy after light defoliation and simple training.

name: Luxuria
description: Luxuria from In House Genetics lives up to its decadent name. This photoperiod hybrid pairs Double Kush Breath with the breeder’s flagship Platinum, fusing power and polish into a single selection. Angel Cake cut of OOKB (OGKB × Secret Weapon) worked with OGKB v2.1, while Platinum descends from UW Hashplant × Permafrost S1, a true 100% indica prized for thick frost and structure. Expect dense, highly resinous colas on a compact, well-branched frame, easy to top and stack. Typical flowering wraps in roughly 56–65 days, delivering medium yields that cure into gleaming, sugar-coated buds made for extraction. The experience opens with an upbeat, euphoric lift before settling into calm, contented body relaxation; most growers report low CBD and potent, high-THC results. Caryophyllene, myrcene, and farnesene commonly dominate, shaping the fuel-forward palate and tranquil finish. For collectors who love Platinum’s glitz but crave heavier Kush breath notes, Luxuria offers a balanced, indulgent expression of both parents, crafted by In House Genetics for resin, bag appeal, and repeatable performance.

name: Slurrbanger
description: Slurrbanger by In House Genetics merges the Headbanger with the candy-gas Slurricane 44. On the palate it tracks the nose: diesel, grape, and citrus riding over a grounding earthy funk, finishing clean and persistent. The experience uplifts the head before settling into a calm, centered body ease, often described as euphoric, relaxed, and pleasantly focused without muddiness. Slurrbanger's pedigree is transparent in the jar and in the garden: Headbanger brings the cerebral snap and fuel, while Slurricane 44 layers in purple hues, creamy berry tones, and that signature sticky finish. Expect medium height outdoors with the potential to stretch high in warm climates, sturdy lateral branching, and heavy trichome coverage that makes trimming efficient. For those chasing rich, gassy grape profiles in a compact 8-9 week window, Slurrbanger delivers with authority.

Indoors, attentive growers typically see a finish around 60 to 70 days, with above-average yields when canopy management and airflow are dialed. Buds cure to dense, shimmering spears that press well and showcase the cultivar's resin priorities. THC expression trends high for the category, while CBD remains trace. Gasquake's name hints at seismic intensity and that is exactly the experience: big nose, glossy frost, and a polished, pungent, euphoric glide that lands softly into contented ease. If your hunt favors pungent fuel with modern bag appeal, this In House original belongs on the short list.

Growers often note manageable vigor, standout bag appeal, and strong wash potential in fresh-frozen runs.

By uniting two pillars behind modern glue aromas, King Kong honors lineage while offering modern bag appeal and reliable performance for growers seeking sour fuel with a smooth, confectionary twist. Bud morphology trends to chunky, sugar-crusted spears that cure rock-hard and shine under trichome glare.

The effect arrives as an easy, euphoric calm that loosens the body while keeping the head steady and creative, settling into a relaxed, contented focus. Expect medium‑height plants with sturdy lateral branching and stacked calyxes dusted in frost, finishing in about 56–63 days. Indoors, its tidy frame stacks dense, silvery colas that trim with ease, and outdoors it tends to wrap up by mid to late September. In the jar, the aroma leans sweet and earthy with playful top notes of candied grapefruit, cool mint, and iced tea with lemon, backed by tarragon and a whisper of sweet chem. On the palate those citrus-mint tea tones carry through, while a terpene ensemble led by myrcene, caryophyllene, and terpinolene shapes the profile. The effect is a balanced head high that settles into a cheerful, relaxed, and gently uplifted mood without heavy sedation — true to its cookie heritage. Growers appreciate the straightforward routine: 8–9 weeks of flower, easy handling, and crowd-pleasing yields for a plant sized right for indoor canopies or discreet outdoor spots. If you love the classic cookie vibe with brighter citrus accents and modern vigor, NOX Cookies is a polished, production-ready take on a beloved lineage.

The aroma hits like its name suggests: sweet, nutty cream layered over citrus-lime zest and faint diesel, with limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool prominent. Flavors follow with roasted-nut richness, a bright citrus snap, and a gassy tail. Effects balance quick mood lift and body ease — euphoric, relaxed, and gently uplifted — without losing clarity. Plants stay medium indoors and stretch taller outside; yields are high under dialed feed and light. Credit to GTR Seeds (Oregon CBD) for engineering the seedless triploid format that helps preserve flower quality in pollen-heavy regions. For connoisseurs who chase nose-first profiles, Olfactory Overload lives up to its name from jar pop to last exhale, every time.

name: Bubbas Revenge
description: Named for its bruiser backbone and calm, grounded feel, Bubbas Revenge (Oregon CBD) leans into the old-school charm of its suspected parents, Bubba Kush and AVL. The nose leads with coffee and cocoa earthiness brightened by a citrus snap; on the tongue it stays savory and smooth as beta-caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene take the lead. Typical Type III chemistry keeps THC compliant below 0.3% while CBD routinely lands around the mid-teens (12-19%), making the overall vibe deeply relaxed, happy, and pleasantly sleepy without edge. Indoors, trained plants return about 350 g/m2; in the field, well-established specimens can push near 500 g per plant with steady feed and airflow. Growers rate the difficulty as medium: it likes consistent light intensity, moderate nitrogen, and dehumidification late flower to preserve weight and bag appeal. Fans reach for Bubbas Revenge when they want the soothing body presence of Bubba tempered by Remedy's clear head, and its classic kush finish of coffee, earth, and pepper keeps each session unmistakably nostalgic. Developed for compliant fields and terpene-rich bouquets, it performs equally well in full sun or controlled rooms, rewarding attentive trellising with uniform tops.

Expect medium stature, strong branching, and a cooperative trim thanks to tight calyx stacking.

If you have been seeking a faithful skunk vibe tuned for modern production, this cross hits the mark. Structure is hybrid-leaning and medium height, with simple training.

Growers typically rate difficulty medium thanks to Haze stretch and feed sensitivity, but the cultivar responds well to topping, SCROG, and adequate airflow to curb humidity during late bloom.

The effect profile ignites fast: bright, energetic, and creative, then settles into an airy, uplifted clarity that still leaves room for a relaxed, full-body presence. Phenotypically, Lava Flower grows into tight, grape-shaped buds with excellent bag appeal and a stick-to-fingers cure. While exact cultivation specs are proprietary, the Northern Lights influence shows in the resin density, while the Chem 91 side fuels the pungent, petroleum-forward bouquet. For connoisseurs seeking modern potency without sacrificing classic character, Lava Flower delivers a clean, focused spark with unmistakable gas and citrus. Expect pronounced diesel, lemon, and lime to linger long after the exhale, a signature of its chem-forward roots.

name: Gas Monkey
description: Meet Gas Monkey, a potent Indica-dominant hybrid packing average THC contents of around 24%. It was made by crossbreeding Gas OG with Grease Monkey. The flowering cycle takes about 62 days, and yields are abundant with up to 450g/m² of outstanding nugs. These ladies thrive well in both indoor and outdoor settings. The Gas Monkey aroma is intense, to say the least: imagine extreme pungency with skunk, diesel, and wet earth. The flavor follows the same astonishing profile and lingers for a long time. Expect a strong and mentally uplifting high with euphoric thoughts that will quickly banish all negativity from your mind. This relaxing sensation then soon spreads to your body, causing lethargy and a pleasant sense of being sedated. Due to its potency and these Indica-dominated effects, Gas Monkey has become a beloved strain with medical patients seeking relief from spasms, nausea, and depression.

Crack a dried flower and a sweet-and-earthy rush lifts out first, quickly chased by citrus peel and a faint diesel twang; on the palate it leans sweet, citrusy, and earthy in equal measure. Caryophyllene and limonene steer the bouquet with supporting notes of linalool/humulene, while THC commonly pushes past the mid-20s and CBD stays low. Effects arrive bright and buoyant — an upbeat, uplifted headspace — before easing into a calm, happy body glow that never feels leaden. Medium-stature plants thrive with light training and finish reliably in about 8–9 weeks indoors (some phenotypes reaching 9–10), rewarding dialed-in rooms with up to 450 g/m²; outdoors, expect roughly 500–600 g per plant at full maturity. Bred by Cookies Seed Bank, Dirty Diana blends speed, bag appeal, and a dessert-gas flavor set into a purple-forward frame — an expressive, photogenic cultivar that delivers both show and substance. Growers report easy trimming and a vigorous vegetative pace with strong resistance.

Expect a citrus-peel snap over sweet, candy-gas with a cool mint finish, driven by a terpene trio of limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene. A sturdy, indica-leaning hybrid, plants stay medium indoors yet stretch confidently outside, stacking dense, sugar-frosted colas that show the Blue Zushi sparkle and the Sherbet vigor. In dialed rooms, flowering wraps in roughly 63–70 days, and yields can impress — around 600 g/m² inside and up to 800 g per plant outdoors — while potency typically lands between 20–28% THC with trace CBD. The ride opens euphoric and uplifted before easing into a calm, body-forward glide that stays clear enough for conversation. Aromatics lean citrus-mint and tropical candy with a subtle diesel backbone, making it as memorable in the jar as it is in the tray. Credit the family craft: Crockett Family Farms captures Blue Zushi’s modern appeal and welds it to their proven Sherbet diesel backbone for a connoisseur-grade, garden-ready expression.

In the jar and on the palate, Zour Kosher lands between comfort and sparkle: an elevating, euphoric onset evolves into a contented, body-forward calm while moods stay bright and conversation-friendly. Yields are generous indoors or out, responding well to topping and light training. Bred by Crockett Family Farms, the team behind many fruit-forward standouts, Zour Kosher reads like a greatest-hits remix for growers and extractors who want gassy zest without giving up the kush core. Expect vigorous resin production that washes well and a tidy trim thanks to its kush-heavy structure.

Growers note tidy internodes, quick rooting, and a forgiving feed range.

On the palate it stays bright and fuel forward with citrus zest and conifer, reflecting a terpene profile dominated by limonene, beta caryophyllene, and alpha pinene. Effects arrive vivid and upbeat – euphoric, happy, and gently energizing – before settling into a focused, clear headspace that showcases the strain's OG roots. The cross harnesses SFV OG’s gas-and-pine intensity and Superboof’s citrus-forward depth into a balanced, any-hour profile that feels both nostalgic and current. BeanFiendz’s curation shines here — a straightforward, no-gimmick combo that rewards tidy canopies with glistening, lime-to-olive colas and a finish that lingers long after the jar is closed.

Crack a jar and expect gassy top notes with a creamy, sweet undercurrent; on the palate it moves from tropical and sweet to a clean chem tang. The high arrives in two acts: a bright, heady lift that sharpens the senses and lifts the mood, followed by an easygoing, body-centered calm that settles without pinning you to the couch. Phenotypes that lean Chem 91/Chem D tend to push louder fuel, while Banana Z expressions show plusher sweetness and a dessert-like finish. Dense, sugar-frosted colas and a vigorous hybrid frame make Banana Dog D a photogenic cultivar for connoisseurs of both gas and fruit. If you love legacy chem funk but want a silkier, more tropical twist, this Chemdog creation delivers a balanced, euphoric ride with relaxed, happy vibes — and a room-filling bouquet that lingers long after the grinder’s empty. Rooted in Massachusetts under the Smash Hits banner, Banana Dog D honors the source while pushing the profile into crowd-pleasing territory.

name: Cujo

Potency trends THC-forward with low CBD, echoing the parents profiles, while morphology stays consistent: very large, social room-fillers that reward canopy control. The overall experience trends social and talkative with a bright, creative edge, while the Gelato/Lemon Maraschino lineage layers dessert-sweet fruitiness and crackling fuel. The result is a modern hybrid with head-turning funk, eye-catching morphology, and potency to match its size, exactly the kind of statement cultivar Swamp Boys Seeds are known for. name: Razbarian

Terpene expression tends to center on caryophyllene (spice), backed by limonene (citrus) and linalool (sweet floral), which explains the sweet-tart nose, gentle pepper, and polished finish. If you prize candy-forward flavor with a subtle gas finish and tidy, medium-height morphology, this Cherry Pie Runtz x Bebesita cross delivers exactly that, true to the selection ethos of Pheno Addicts. name: Uncle Doobie's Sour Diesel BX 1.5
description: Sour Diesel Bx1.5 (Aficionado) distills the cult aura of classic Sour Diesel into a finely tuned backcross built for connoisseurs. Aficionado Seed Collection crossed the famed Sour Diesel A‑Cut with a Fire On The Mountain, tightening phenotypic spread while magnifying that unmistakable fuel-and-citrus punch. Expect a mostly sativa architecture with assertive stretch that stacks elongated, lime-green calyxes dusted in frost. Aromas lead with piercing diesel and skunky citrus, underpinned by earthy Chem grit; on the palate, tart citrus and tank-fume notes linger. Reported THC often lands around 21–25%, delivering a brisk, clear lift that feels energetic, focused, and distinctly old‑school Sour. Dominant terpenes commonly found in keeper selections include limonene, beta‑caryophyllene, and myrcene, with occasional pinene accents sharpening the edges. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in about 70 days; a smart trellis and light training help manage the sativa push and encourage uniform colas. While yield depends on dial‑in and canopy control, the line was selected to combine authentic Sour character with modern consistency. Credit for this heirloom‑minded curation goes to Aficionado Seed Collection and their Uncle Doobie’s BX program, which preserves the electric clarity and room‑filling nose that made Sour Diesel a legend.

Crack a jar and it hits with straight diesel before bright lemon slices through, landing on an earthy skunky echo. Caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene and a thread of pinene color the bouquet. Expect energetic, uplifted, creative headroom with a tidy, mobile body feel. Indoors most phenotypes wrap in about 70 days, with a range of roughly 63-77, and yields trend high when tops are supported. Potency lands between 21-25% THC with minimal CBD, and resin heads suit both flower and hash work. On the palate and in the room, BX 2.5 reads as jet fuel with lemon zest, and the experience matches: energetic, uplifted, creative headroom with a tidy, mobile body feel. Crafted by Uncle Doobie and released under the Aficionado banner, this installment of the BX program pays faithful homage to Sour's lineage while adding vigor and modern production chops.

name: Uncle Doobie’s Sour Animal
description: Sour Animal F2 by Aficionado Seeds is Uncle Doobie’s boutique rework of SEER415’s 2009 Animal Cookies crossed to a Sour Diesel backcross line (BX2.5), then taken to F2 to widen the phenotypic window while locking in the gas. Expect Sour D vigor with tighter Cookie stacking: calyx-heavy, golf-ball-to-spear flowers that cure to dense, resin-glossed nuggets with a faint OG-leaning sheen. The nose is unapologetically fuel-forward - sharp sour petrol riding over sweet cream, caramel, and toffee - translating to a palate that stays gassy yet confectionary. Caryophyllene leads the terp ensemble, with limonene brightening the sour top note and myrcene grounding the finish. An indica-leaning hybrid around 60/40, it typically tests in the 20-28% THC range with <1% CBD, delivering a euphoric, uplifted entry that settles into an easy-bodied, relaxed glide. Flowering wraps in about 56-70 days, and the line was selected for high production with improved structure over straight Diesel, sticky colas, and wash-friendly resin. Most phenos reach a medium stature and respond well to shaping, showing moderate stretch and balanced internodes. Released in a limited drop curated by Uncle Doobie and the Aficionado team, Sour Animal F2 distills classic Sour attitude into a denser, sweeter, modern expression while honoring both parents.

name: Uncle Doobies Gas-Gpt
description: Gas-GPT from Aficionado Seed Collection is a straight-shot fuel bomb bred in the Uncle Doobie line by pairing GMO with 30 Year Dog. The latter blends Chem 91 and Chem Fuego, with Chem Fuego itself built from Sourband and Chemdog 91 Bx3, so everything points squarely at old-school dogbud funk and modern gas. Aromas erupt as high-octane diesel over earthy hash and warm pepper; on the palate, expect dense diesel with an herbal, spicy finish. Caryophyllene leads the terp lineup, with limonene and myrcene filling in the bright top and grounding base notes. Plants show medium-to-large frames, sturdy branching, and heavy, resin-caked colas that stack hard. Indoors, most phenos wrap in 63-77 days (about 9-11 weeks) and can deliver high yields when given simple support. Effects tilt indica-dominant: an upbeat euphoria and easy happiness crest into deep, body-centered calm without muting the diesel character. THC levels trend robust while CBD remains trace (typically under 1%), keeping the profile firmly potency-first. Released as regular seed, Gas-GPT rewards a focused hunt for phenos that scream race fuel. If your tastes live in the GMO lane, this Aficionado creation captures that lineage with clarity, output, and unapologetic loudness. Expect dark green buds, bright orange hairs, and staggering frost that telegraphs its bag appeal.

On the palate, Pure Animal hits diesel-citrus first and resolves to an OG-style, hashy earth. Reported THC typically ranges around 22–28% with CBD under 1%, delivering a quick lift into clear, upbeat euphoria before settling into a calm, contented relaxation. The effect profile skews happy, euphoric, and unwound without heavy couchlock, making it a versatile, connoisseur-grade expression of classic West Coast gas. Bred as a limited-release selection, Pure Animal pays homage to two pillars of modern cannabis: the heavy-resin, golf-ball morphology of Pure Kush and the electric, room-filling bouquet of proper Sour Diesel. For growers and pheno-hunters alike, it’s a polished, old-meets-new showcase signed by Aficionado Seeds.

Reported effects balance an upbeat, euphoric lift with a steady, body-calming drift that often leaves moods relaxed, happy, and quietly uplifted. Indoors, Shotti behaves like a classic photoperiod hybrid, maturing in a standard flowering window and rewarding dialed-in environments with terpene-loud colas; outdoors, warm days and cool nights push color and sheen. THC potential is high and CBD minimal, varying by phenotype and cultivation. Bred in Northern California by Aficionado Seeds, Shotti reads like a candy-gas manifesto, Gelato and Biscotti power polished by Sherbet backcrossing, tuned for growers and flavor hunters who prize striking color, bold aromatics, and confident performance.

For growers and tastemakers hunting a faithful "gas" showcase with commercial punch, Hollywood Ghost wears its pedigree proudly while earning its own marquee status.

Gardeners find it cooperative under training, with moderate feeding and airflow keeping the chunky flowers crisp through late bloom. Credit to Robin Hood Seeds for distilling the dessert-meets-gas contrast into a single, striking cultivar—Black Hole bends flavor and frost toward a dense, luminous center that lingers pleasantly after each grind.

Born from such a legendary lineage, Gary Sherbet carries unmistakable Cookies DNA yet shines with its own sherbet-bright identity. Crafted by Fast Buds for growers who want confectionary terps without sacrificing structure, it is a vivid, modern hybrid that looks as frosty as it tastes. Expect medium-height plants, solid bag appeal, and a terpene profile that lingers long after the last exhale.

Growers report sturdy branching, dense calyx stacking, and an easy trim thanks to heavy trichome coverage; most phenotypes prefer steady airflow and moderate nutrition, rewarding dialed canopies with glistening colas and a terpene profile often led by limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene. Expect a modern dessert-meets-citrus expression that sits squarely in the hybrid pocket: a bright, focused lift tapering to a relaxed, grounded finish. As part of the -C line, it spotlights Square One's citrus vector while preserving cookie density and resin, a neat pick for flavor-driven collectors and anyone mapping orange-fuel phenos.

Growers will find the cultivar cooperative: moderate feeding, predictable stretch, and a canopy that responds well to trellising. THC levels trend high with trace CBD, but expression will vary by environment and phenotype - another reason this cross is fun to explore.

Whether you are chasing standout jar appeal or a daytime-friendly creative spark, Watermelon Dream distills the uplifting clarity of Blue Dream with the succulent, confectionery punch of Watermelon Zkittlez into a single, high-output cultivar that feels both familiar and new. Medium stature and tidy internodes make training straightforward and canopies easy to manage.

Growers can anticipate medium difficulty: straightforward feeding, attentive canopy management, and dehumidification late in bloom to protect the strain’s high-density morphology. A vivid, dessert-gas expression true to its Miracle Candy x Kimchi pedigree.

name: Shobu

The experience trends upbeat and grounded-euphoric, uplifted, and ultimately relaxed-making the most of dense, resin-frosted flowers that stay compact on medium-height frames. Growers can expect a fast indoor cycle of roughly 8 weeks, with well-managed canopies returning medium yields and striking purple hues as nights cool. While formal lab ranges vary by lot, Shobu's potency leans high with negligible CBD, echoing its parents' reputations. Expect caryophyllene-led spice supported by limonene brightness and a soft myrcene cushion. Shobu honors PCG's house style: vivid color, modern candy terps, and versatile resin suitable for both flower and hash. NYCZ x Kimchi makes this cross more than a novelty-it's a cohesive, flavor-first expression with real production legs.

name: Bogarts
description: Bogarts by Purple City Genetics folds the Moroccan-inspired El Krem ethos into a candy-sweet hash plant. Bred from Casa Blanca — an internal selection combining Carbon Fiber with Moroccan Peaches — and Forbidden Blueprint ((Forbidden Fruit × Watermelon Zkittlez) × Blueprint), this indica‑leaning hybrid pushes trichome density and preserves flavor from flower to fresh-frozen. name: Lucky Grapes
description: Lucky Grapes steps in with velvet confidence, trailing a ribbon of crushed berries and sugared gas. Bred by Genetic Designer, this indulgent hybrid unites SPIRIT × GRAPES II, dialing in a lush 70% indica / 30% sativa balance that leans into body-rich comfort without dimming the mind. The aroma opens like a grape cellar cracked at dusk—ripe concord, fermented sweetness, and a backdraft of creamy fuel. On the palate, it lands thick and expressive: dark grape jam, candied berries, and a smooth, gassy finish that lingers on the lips. Terpenes skew toward myrcene and limonene with a subtle hum of caryophyllene, shaping both flavor and effect. With THC levels in the 22–26% range and CBD below 1%, Lucky Grapes delivers a rounded, immersive high. Recreationally, it’s a late-day companion: social in the opening act, introspective as it settles. Medically, it’s often sought for stress relief, anxiety reduction, mild pain management, and sleep support. Cultivation is approachable but not careless—moderate difficulty, with a preference for stable feeding and good airflow to manage its dense structure. It responds well to light training and rewards attentive growers with striking bag appeal and terp depth. As the experience tapers, expect a few familiar shadows: dry mouth, dry eyes, and in higher doses, mild dizziness or couch-heavy lethargy. Still, for those chasing modern grape expression with a polished, resin-rich finish, Lucky Grapes plays its hand with style and weight.

Recreationally, it’s a late-evening indulgence, perfect for unwinding, zoning into music or film, or easing into sleep. Dense buds call for proper airflow and humidity control, while moderate feeding and light defoliation help maximize yield and resin production. In return, growers get standout bag appeal and a terp profile that leans unapologetically rich. Negative effects may include dry mouth, dry eyes, and in stronger doses, sedation, dizziness, or mild mental fog. For those chasing dessert-heavy profiles with a knockout body finish, Cookie Killer lives up to its name—smooth on the entry, devastating on the exit.

It responds well to topping and benefits from a stable environment, rewarding patience with unique terpene expression and striking visual appeal. Negative effects may include dry mouth, dry eyes, and in higher doses, slight anxiety or restlessness, especially for those sensitive to sativa-leaning profiles. For seekers of something less conventional—where citrus spice meets golden haze—Golden Child lives up to its name, offering a high that feels both elevated and timeless.

name: Egyptian Orange
description: Egyptian Orange doesn’t rush—it flashes bright, then lingers, like citrus oil caught in warm air. From Purple City Genetics, this cross of Tangieberto × Egyptian Gold leans 65% sativa / 35% indica, and it shows in both structure and effect. Expect a taller plant indoors—120–170 cm—with an open frame that stretches early, then settles into long, resin-lined colas. Limonene and terpinolene lead, with a faint pine lift in the background. At 21–25% THC and CBD under 1%, the effect arrives quickly. There’s a distinct mental lift—clear, energized, a little electric—before it evens out into a light, functional body calm. It’s not heavy; it moves. That makes it a natural daytime option, whether for focus, conversation, or just staying in motion. Medically, it’s often leaned on for stress, fatigue, and mood support, with enough body relief to take the edge off minor aches. Growers will find it moderate in difficulty—not demanding, but it benefits from guidance. Topping or trellising helps manage height, and its open structure makes it more forgiving when it comes to humidity. Push it too far, though, and the edges show: dry mouth, dry eyes, and occasionally a touch of anxiety or jitteriness if the dose climbs. Still, for those chasing a sharper citrus profile with a classic, almost nostalgic backbone, Egyptian Orange lands clean, bright, and confidently modern.

name: Tropical Blueprint
description: There’s a moment with Tropical Blueprint where the sweetness feels almost too easy—sun-warmed fruit, soft, inviting—then it pivots, revealing structure beneath the surface. This is Purple City Genetics working with contrast, pairing Strawguava × Forbidden Blueprint into a finely tuned 55% sativa / 45% indica hybrid that doesn’t settle into a single lane for long. The smoke tells the story in fragments. First, guava nectar and ripe strawberry, lush and slightly creamy. Then a shift—citrus zest, a flicker of fermented funk, and a dry, gassy tail that tightens the whole profile. Indoors, it rises to about 100–140 cm, not overly aggressive but eager enough to reward a guiding hand. A bit of topping, a loose trellis, and it opens up—light moves through, buds stack clean. After 60–67 days, expect 450–550 g/m² of dense, resin-rich flowers that feel as sharp visually as they do aromatically. Potency sits in the 22–26% THC range, with CBD below 1%, and the effect doesn’t rush. It builds—a light, social lift at first, clear and conversational, then gradually eases into a calm that settles behind the eyes and across the shoulders. Not sedating, not overly bright—just balanced enough to stretch across an afternoon into evening. Therapeutically, it’s often leaned on for stress, mood regulation, and low-grade physical tension. It’s not a difficult cultivar, but it does ask for awareness—moderate difficulty, mostly in keeping humidity in check around those tight flowers. Overindulgence can blur the edges: dry mouth, dry eyes, a hint of mental fog or unease if pushed too far. Tropical Blueprint isn’t about impact alone—it’s about progression. Sweet to sharp, light to grounded, simple to layered.

It’s composed, layered, and quietly expansive—more of a slow unfolding than a sudden burst.

description: Bred by Fast Buds, Sundae Frost Auto marries Frostbanger Auto F4, the powerhouse that took The Strongest Autoflower title at the Autoflower World Cup, with Mephisto Genetics' Sundae Thumper, a Best Hybrid winner at the American Autoflower Cup. Expect strong, "dessert gas" aromatics: sweet cream and ripe fruit up front with a fresh, spicy edge that lingers. Plants typically reach 60-100 cm and reward dialed-in rooms with 450-600 g/m2 indoors (80-250 g/plant outdoors). Two phenos pop during testing, one staying bright green, the other flashing darker, inky foliage, yet both keep the same terp spectrum and visual frost. With THC testing up to 30% and CBD under 1%, Sundae Frost Auto delivers a polished, modern profile: an upbeat, euphoric lift that opens into a calm, body-centered relaxation without losing clarity. Uniform structure, quick turnaround, and heavy varnish make it a versatile production cultivar and a bag-appeal magnet. Credit to Fast Buds for the slick F1 autoflower work and to Mephisto's Sundae Thumper for the creamy, confectionary backbone that completes this high-resin pairing.

name: Cauldron
description: Cauldron by Wizard Trees Genetics fuses D-Lish with Black Magic to conjure a resin-soaked hybrid designed for bag appeal and balance. In flower, it piles up pronounced calyxes into tight, bouquet-like clusters that finish in deep purples and even near-black leaves under a heavy white crust of trichomes, giving the buds a velvety sheen. Two primary expressions show up during selection: some phenos stay a bit squatter while others stretch to a medium-tall frame, but lateral branching stays moderate and easy to manage. The nose leans candy-dessert sweet with a sharp diesel backend, echoing its lineage and carrying through the grind. The effects deliver intense euphoria, profound body relaxation, and balanced uplifting mood. Cauldron is straightforward to grow, finishing in roughly 8 to 9 weeks with yields that run above average and a uniform line that rewards canopy planning and light penetration. While exact THC and CBD figures are not disclosed, the cultivar is known for dense, calyx-forward flowers and thick resin coverage suited for showcase jars and flavorful flower. Credited to Wizard Trees Genetics, Cauldron channels the dark allure of Black Magic with the playful sweetness of D-Lish, delivering color, structure, and aroma in equal measure for growers and enthusiasts seeking a well-rounded, modern hybrid. Expect medium plant height, easy trimming, and dense, well-formed colas across most phenotypes.

name: Black Orchard
description: Black Orchard is a boutique hybrid from Wizard Trees that marries Crunch Berries with the house cut Black Magic, blending dessert-forward fruit and cream with dense, gassy depth. The nose opens with sweet berry, vanilla cream, and faint citrus before a darker ribbon of peppered fuel and earthy resin takes over. On the palate, expect berry custard layered with diesel and a touch of pine. Plants show tight, resin-lacquered calyxes with occasional violet flecks from Black Magic, stacking into low-growing or medium-tall bushes that finish in 56-63 days. Yields are mid-range but visually striking, with heavy trichome coverage ideal for hash work. Effects come on euphoric and creative, settling into a relaxed, head-forward calm; typical batches lean high-THC with minimal CBD. Caryophyllene leads the terpene chorus, with limonene and myrcene supporting the candy-gas profile. Growers report straightforward management indoors, medium vigor, and strong bag appeal when dialed. As a cross of Crunch Berries and Black Magic, Black Orchard keeps the cereal-berry charm while sharpening it with weight, gas, and color unique to Wizard Trees' breeding. Fans chasing modern candy intertwined with real power will find Black Orchard equal parts pretty and potent, a connoisseur selection that rewards careful cultivation and slow appreciation.

name: Lion Strength S1
description: Lion Strength S1 carries Capulator's tribute to his late father into a garden-ready, sativa-leaning line with real backbone. Selected from a standout Super Lemon Haze #17 mother and worked from his SLH x MAC project, the S1 keeps the brick-solid structure MAC is famous for while pushing bright lemon-candy aromatics from the Haze side. Plants stay medium and stocky with assertive lateral branching that rarely needs support; resin coverage is heavy, bag appeal high, and aromas range from buttered lemon and sweet cream to incense with occasional black-cherry hints on MAC-leaning phenos. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in 56-63 days, and skilled runs can reach up to 900 g/m2; expect reliable vigor and an easy cultivation curve that rewards both production and quality. On the palate it lands as lemon, cream, and citrus zest, finishing clean. The effect arrives quickly – clear, uplifting, and happy – gliding through a medium-length arc without a harsh comedown. Credit goes to Capulator for the lineage: Super Lemon Haze (SLH #17) crossed to a MAC male selected for its near-MAC 1 expression, then selfed to create this stable S1. For growers chasing a luminous lemon profile with modern structure and yield, Lion Strength S1 roars with purpose. Its dense, glistening colas stack neatly, inviting both hand-trim and hash work.

name: Mango Dream
description: Mango Dream marries the sun-ripe sweetness of Mango with the lucid uplift of Blue Dream, producing a sativa-leaning hybrid that smells like a fruit stand after rain. Cracking a jar reveals waves of mango and bright pineapple over a peppery edge, a profile typically led by myrcene with limonene and beta-caryophyllene in support. Most batches test in the mid range, with THC commonly around the high teens (roughly 11–23% across reports) and trace CBD, delivering an upbeat, clear-headed mood that feels euphoric, focused, and genuinely happy. In the garden, Mango Dream tends to medium stature with flexible branches and lime-green, resin-dusted colas that finish in about 56–70 days; outdoors it prefers warmth and rewards attentive growers with moderate yields, often maturing by mid-October. While the original breeder remains unconfirmed, the lineage is widely cited as Mango x Blue Dream, and several producers have released their own takes on the cut. Expect medium output rather than sheer volume, but an expressive bouquet that lingers long after the grind. If your senses chase tropical candy with a zesty snap and a breezy, sociable high, Mango Dream lives up to its name without drifting into couch-lock.

name: Orange Apricot MAC
description: Orange Apricot MAC bridges citrus sparkle and cookie cream in a vividly resinous hybrid from Capulator. By pairing Orange Apricot (Apricot Helix x Orange Juice Bud) with his famed MAC (Alien Cookies F2 x Miracle), this cultivar leans upbeat yet balanced, throwing dense, lime-to-olive colas frosted in thick trichomes and set off by vivid orange pistils. Crack the jar and you get a wave of fresh orange peel and sunripe apricot over creamy dough and a light diesel twang; on the palate that profile stays true, driven by a terpene trio of limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene. Reported THC varies widely with environment and selection, commonly landing from the high teens into the high 20s, while CBD remains trace (around 0-0.1%). In effect it tends to lift and focus without losing MAC's easy body ease: creative, focused, and notably uplifted. Plants show moderate stretch and a medium stature with sturdy lateral branching; indoors they finish in about 63-70 days of flower, rewarding attentive dialing with a solid, medium yield of glinty, sugar-coated buds. For collectors, Orange Apricot MAC captures the best of Cap's candy-citrus meets creamy-funk lineage in a single, photogenic package. Expect glossy calyx stacking, tight internodes, and eye-catching bag appeal that reflects its connoisseur pedigree and careful selection.

name: Rainbow Rush
description: Rainbow Rush is Solfire Gardens' tropical dessert of a hybrid, spun from Rainbow Guava and the in-house heavyweight Udder Madness. Expect the candy-guava bouquet to open with sweet berry and vanilla cream, then settle into a deeper, resin-heavy finish; its aroma and flavor are steered by caryophyllene, humulene, and terpineol. With THC typically in the 20-24% lane and trace CBD (<1%), this 70/30 indica-leaning cross balances buoyant, creative headspace with clear focus and an easy, uplifted mood. Plants show compact, 3-4 foot frames that like to stretch sideways, stacking tidy, sugar-frosted colas and showing occasional purple hues as they ripen. Indoors, dialed growers can pull up to 650 g/m2; outdoors, sturdy, well-fed plants have been reported around 1200 g each. Flowering wraps in roughly 56-63 days, making Rainbow Rush an approachable production hybrid that still flashes boutique bag appeal. Crafted and released by Solfire Gardens, Rainbow Rush blends modern sweet-shop terps with workhorse structure for a harvest that looks vivid, trims quickly, and smokes with bright, feel-good precision.

name: Perma Fried
description: Perma Fried is Seed Junky Genetics tropical gas mashup of Hawaiian Rain and Permanent Marker, distilled by craft growers into dense, frosty colas that flash deep greens and violet highlights. Crack the bag and a breeze of island fruit rolls out: pineapple, mango, and citrus, before peppered petrol and fresh marker funk take over, a profile powered by limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool. On the palate those notes land sweet, zesty, and lightly spicy with a gassy exhale, echoing its lineage: Hawaiian Rain adds sunlit tropical lift while Permanent Marker stamps in floral gassy depth and heavyweight resin. Expect an indica leaning, grounded high that settles the body while keeping the mind composed and creative, with a steady focus that lingers. Plants show a compact, hybrid frame with stacked, trichome glazed spears; indoors they typically flower in about 55 to 70 days and return medium yields when dialed in. Lab tested flower has been reported in the upper 20s to low 30s for THC, with CBD generally trace to about 1 percent. Most phenos finish compact to medium height with strong lateral branching, staying true to parents Hawaiian Rain x Permanent Marker and to Seed Junkys modern flavor-first ethos.

name: Blu OG
description: Blu OG from Jungle Boys pairs the candy-funk of Blu Frootz with the classic power of 06 OG, yielding a hybrid that smells like a fruit stand parked beside an OG gas pump. Cracking a jar releases sweet grape and tangy citrus layered over funky cheese and pungent fuel, a profile driven by a terpene stack led by myrcene, beta-caryophyllene, and limonene, with supporting hits of humulene, bisabolol, linalool, and pinene. The flowers show OG-leaning structure — dense, frosty, and spear-tipped — with lime to forest-green calyxes and thick, sugary trichomes. First pulls land an alert, focused lift and a clean, energetic headspace, soon balanced by a calm, gently relaxing body tone that keeps things clear rather than couch-bound. It is a THC-dominant cultivar with CBD typically present only in trace amounts, letting the terp ensemble do the talking. Garden lineage is straightforward: Blu Frootz (Blue Cheese x Sex on the Beach x Candy Cake) brings sticky berry-dessert notes and color, while 06 OG contributes pine-citrus gas and that unmistakable OG backbone. Crafted by Jungle Boys, Blu OG captures their Florida program’s modern fruit-meets-fuel style in a single, loud jar — bright, gassy, and purpose-built for anyone who appreciates flavor that hits as hard as it smells.

name: Giraffe Puzzy
description: Doja Exclusive’s Giraffe Puzzy strides in on long legs of candy brightness and cookie funk, the result of a collaboration with Seed Junky Genetics that pairs Z with Animal Cookies BX2. Crack the jar and a rush of fruit-salad sweetness and floral candy rises first, quickly layered by earthy cookie dough and a sharp, sour grapefruit twist. Lime‑green, conical buds with muted orange pistils glint under a dusting of pale trichome heads; they break with a satisfying snap, leaving resinous fingers that hint at the ride ahead. A terpene stack led by caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene frames the profile: peppery warmth, soft floral hops, and citrus lift in equal measure. Effects land fast but friendly — an upbeat, euphoric headspace settles into calm, unhurried body ease, keeping the mood buoyant rather than heavy. Recent batches hover around the mid‑20s for THC with negligible CBD, matching the cultivar’s assertive yet polished character. Growers describe medium stature, Z‑leaning structure, and moderate returns when dialed, true to its lineage. Giraffe Puzzy stands as a vivid snapshot of modern California breeding - sweet, loud, and impeccably curated - while tipping its cap to the parents that made it possible: Z and Animal Cookies BX2, guided by Seed Junky Genetics and finished by Doja Exclusive. In 2026 this strain grown by Angel City took multiple California Zalympix awards including Best Overall, Best Tasting, Best Z / Z Hybrid Industry Awards as well as two first places as Best Overall and Best Tasting and a third place in Best Terps in Public Competition.

name: Dalai Sorbet
description: Dalai Sorbet from Robin Hood Seeds threads dessert-leaning Nana Sorbet (Sunset Sherbet x Banana Butter Cups) into the landrace-steeped backbone of Double Dalai F5 ([Hindu Kush x Burmese] x [Purple Pakistani Chitral x Kashmir Landrace]). Expect a confident, modern hybrid that stacks dense, frosty colas on a sturdy, medium-tall frame, with indoors plants topping around 1.2 m and stretching taller under sun. The nose opens with tropical cream and citrus peel, then folds into faint kushy spice; limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene typically lead the terpene mix. On the palate it reads sweet and creamy with bright tropical edges and a subtle fuel echo. Effects arrive in an uplifting, euphoric wave that settles into a relaxed, contented calm without losing clarity, reflecting its roughly 55/45 indica-sativa balance. Flowering wraps in about 56-63 days, rewarding dialed-in rooms with approximately 450-550 g/m2 and vigorous outdoor specimens that can crest a kilogram per plant when conditions cooperate. THC commonly lands in the mid-20s with trace CBD. Built from Nana Sorbet's dessert profile and Double Dalai's stabilized vigor and color potential, Dalai Sorbet is a flavorful, resin-forward selection that honors its parents while carving a distinct, high-appeal niche. Growers report easy training, strong branching, and reliable bud density across keeper phenos.

name: Kiwi Sours
description: Kiwi Sours from Alien Genetics stitches together candy-bright lineage with layered depth: Bubblebelts (Rainbow Belts V3 x Tahoe Alien Bubblegum) meets MoonArc (Moonbow 112 IX x Alien Rock Candy). In flower, it leans compact yet vigorous, forming medium-height, well-branched plants that stack dense, frosted calyxes with an eye-catching pink-silver cast. The nose and palate echo its name: zesty lemon-lime and tart kiwi over classic bubblegum sweetness, with a faint kushy gas running underneath. Expect a clean, functional lift on the first inhale that opens into a focused, happy groove and a gently easing body, a profile often associated with a limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool terpene trio. Indoors it typically finishes in 56–63 days (about 8–9 weeks), rewarding dialed canopies with medium yields and excellent bag appeal. While THC content depends on cut and environment, selections tend to land in the mid-to-high range with negligible CBD, emphasizing vivid flavor and resin over raw numbers. Kiwi Sours also serves as a showcase for Alien Genetics craft: the Rainbow Belts V3 influence brings candied citrus and bubblegum, while MoonArc layers extra lime-candy perfume and structure. A modern, tart-candy hybrid built for connoisseurs who prize both aroma and finish. Bred by Alien Genetics, it shines for flavor-first selections.

name: Kiwi Velvet Lime
description: Kiwi Velvet Lime stitches together a resin-forward Black Lime Reserve S1 washer selection with a vivid Red Velvet S1, then pushes the tropical dial with Kiwi Sours from Alien Genetics. Expect electric citrus-lime and candy-guava overtones with sweet tropical accents, underpinned by peppery spice and pine inherited from Black Lime Reserve (an Aficionado Seeds classic with Emerald Cup pedigree) and dessert notes from Grandiflora's Red Velvet (Lemon Cherry Gelato x Pina Acai). Growers report medium stature and strong lateral branching, stacking dense, triangular colas that take well to training and wash cleanly; indoors it typically finishes in about 56-63 days, with medium yields that favor quality resin. Dominant terpenes tend toward limonene and caryophyllene with pinene or myrcene secondary, explaining the bright fruit-zest nose, gentle body comfort, and clear, upbeat head. Potency will vary by selection, but the parents routinely test in the high-teen to mid-20% THC with trace CBD. On the palate: lime zest, tropical candy, and a smooth, creamy sweetness. Effects: happy and uplifted at the outset, settling into a calm, relaxed cruise without heavy drag; occasional phenos show an energetic focus from Kiwi Sours' Archive/Alien lineage. If you prize flavor-forward hybrids that rinse well and cure into shimmering green-and-violet nugs, Kiwi Velvet Lime delivers a modern profile grounded in storied genetics.
