These high yielders can produce harvests ranging up to 525g/m² with a short flowering cycle that usually lasts around 9 weeks. The Pistachio flavor profile consists mainly of sweet and creamy notes, accented by diesel and a lingering nuttiness. While the high is fast-hitting and rather intense, it brings a happy experience with laughter and giggles galore, while also putting you in a creative mindset. The accompanying body buzz is mildly sedative and will put you completely at ease after a few hours. These long-lasting effects and its potency make Pistachio a highly sought-after strain amongst medical patients seeking relief from depression, anxiety, pain, and PMS-related symptoms.

name: Frozen Afghan Mintz

In the garden it stacks into a classic Christmas‑tree silhouette, bright lime through mid‑flower and often flushing with cool hues as nights drop. The profile leans diesel, sweet, and distinctly chemmy on the palate, landing first with a vivid, cerebral lift before settling into a deep, body‑forward calm. With a target potency around 24% THC and a balanced morphology that’s resilient and easy to manage, Frozen Afghan Mintz bridges old‑world hashplant grit and new‑school dessert gas in one purposeful line. Credit to G13 Labs for pairing two pillars — GMO Kushmints and Afghani — into a garden‑friendly hybrid that delivers dense structure, quick turnaround, and an unmistakably loud jar appeal.

name: Gas Brake Dip
description: Gas Brake Dip struts like a lowrider through the grow, a Solfire Gardens creation that marries the swagger of Gary Payton with the tropical snap of Bahama Mama. Medium-stature plants with sturdy, upright branching build dense, frosted spears, rewarding a steady trellis and a light early lollipop. In bloom, the room charges with berry syrup, candied citrus, and high‑octane diesel; crack the flowers and a clean sweetness rides beneath the gas. Most phenotypes finish in 63–70 days, stacking evenly and showing late color in cool nights. Yields cruise in the medium lane, but showy resin and bag appeal make every jar feel premium. On the palate, bright fruit leads and gassy depth follows; the mouthfeel is sweet with a peppery sparkle. The experience mirrors the name: an immediate, uplifting launch (gas), a composed, happy cruise (brake), then a calm, relaxed settle (dip) that loosens the shoulders without fogging focus. Terpenes typically spotlight caryophyllene with supporting limonene and a touch of myrcene, while CBD stays minimal and potency trends high for modern dessert‑gas genetics. For growers and connoisseurs chasing equal parts flavor and performance, Gas Brake Dip captures Solfire’s signature candy‑meets‑fuel aesthetic in a balanced, reliable package. Expect medium internode spacing, vigorous lateral growth, and easy trim sessions thanks to tight, resin-laden calyxes.

name: Sinferno

Indoors, most cuts finish around nine weeks (roughly 63 days) and reward light training with medium yields that scale higher in well-dialed rooms. The experience is indica-leaning without lethargy: an upbeat, euphoric lift settles into clear, relaxed focus and a calm body glow, well suited to creative sessions or late-day unwinding. Buds display vivid contrasts - lime to forest greens with purple swirls and thick amber pistils - stacked under a silvery frost that trims easily. While potency varies by phenotype and environment, growers commonly report strong THC with minimal CBD. Bred by Solfire Gardens in the Pacific Northwest, Sinferno distills the breeder's signature bag appeal and stability into a polished seed release.

On the nose and palate, fruit-fizz notes collide with petrol, while the experience trends creative, relaxed, and uplifted without feeling top-heavy. Whether you chase candy, gas, or color, Lil Sumpin Sumpin showcases why Solfire’s breeding program keeps setting the pace: loud terps, fast finish, and showpiece frost from two proven parents.

Expect a balanced 50/50 hybrid structure and vigorous branching that stacks dense, frost-laden flowers showing deep greens and purples. Trimming is friendly thanks to a favorable leaf-to-bud ratio, and cooler late-flower nights can deepen the color. Crafted by Solfire Gardens, Gasserole captures the legacy of its parents in a loud, fruit-meets-fuel chorus that lingers long after the jar is closed.

name: Swolfire

Growers report vigorous early stretch, straightforward feeding, and strong performance in both SOG and SCROG.

name: Gas Goblin
description: Gas Goblin from Solfire Gardens is the kind of hybrid that announces itself before you even open the jar. Bred by Solfire Gardens from Block Monster and Gas Guzzler, this cross funnels candy-coated sweetness into a deep, gassy backbone. Crack a cured nug and the room fills with grape, berry, and diesel; on the palate those notes ride a creamy sweetness before drifting toward a peppery, fuel-tinged finish. In the garden, Gas Goblin typically builds a medium frame with a measured stretch, stacking dense, color-splashed colas that finish in 60-70 days. Expect a caryophyllene-forward terpene profile supported by limonene and myrcene, translating to a calm, happy, and gently uplifted experience. While exact numbers vary by phenotype and cultivation, THC is generally robust and CBD remains trace, keeping the effect modern and punchy without sacrificing clarity. Gas Goblin pays clear homage to its parents: Block Monster contributes structure and confectionary tones, while Gas Guzzler layers in grape-gas and dense resin. For growers and connoisseurs chasing color, aroma, and reliable hybrid vigor from a trusted maker, Gas Goblin hits the sweet spot. Under adequate light and feed, its spear-like tops cure into crisp, easy-to-trim buds.

name: Island Octane

description: Lights Out from Byrd Seed pairs the legendary Northern Lights #5 with JZK #15, a Wonderbrett line that merges Kush Cola and Jealousy. Expect pine and earth up front from the NL5 side, cushioned by soft sweetness and flashes of citrus and toffee from the JZK lineage. The cured nose echoes the parents: conifer, damp soil, and candy-like undertones, while the flavor tracks pine, earthy, and sweet with a lingering herbal finish. On the effects side, Lights Out lands relaxed and happy with an easy body melt and a sleepy edge that reflects NL5's Cup-winning pedigree. JZK #15 adds a modern, balanced lift that keeps the experience rounded rather than one-note. THC levels trend high with minimal CBD, and the morphology stays compact and forgiving, making this cross a nostalgic, terp-rich showcase for Byrd Seed's breeding.

Lab results will vary by grow, but batches commonly test in the mid-to-high 20s for THC with trace CBD. Whether you chase candy-gas flavor, fast turnaround, or jar appeal, Neon delivers a vivid blend of modern OG heft and fruit-forward charm born from Melon OG x GM3 Gak.

name: Nectar
description: Nectar by Karma Genetics channels the modern Fresca line into a vivid, resin-first hybrid. Potency is THC-forward with naturally low CBD, and the wash returns reflect the cultivar’s sticky, high-resin intent. If you appreciate purposeful selections, Nectar reads like a focused study in the Fresca family: expressive fruit, tidy structure, consistent finish, and a flavor arc that lands exactly where the name suggests. Honey Fresca x Fresca Melon — simple on paper, memorable in the room. Careful trimming reveals glittering heads from bract to tip.

name: Plum Paradise

By pairing Zowahh (Zkittlez x Karma Sour D Bx) with Grounded Genetics’ Ozark lineage, Karma Genetics captured a flavorful, extractor-friendly cut that shines as both flower and hash. name: Pineapple Piff
description: Top Dawg Seeds’ Pineapple Piff marries sunlit Pineapple Thai with the incense-heavy haze combo Piff S1 x Mango A5, distilling a bright, sativa-dominant profile into a modern classic. Expect a room-filling bouquet of fresh pineapple and citrus layered over earthy spice and faint cedar incense, a terpene signature that telegraphs its NYC haze lineage. In the garden it stretches vigorously, stacking long, resin-frosted spears; trellising and canopy control are essential. Indoors, flowering typically runs 70–84 days, and dialed-in rooms return medium to high yields; outdoors, tall plants reward a long, dry finish. Together they stack chunky calyxes that cure to deep lime and violet, pushing a nose that opens with sharp fuel and citrus before easing into sugared berry and cream. On the palate it stays true: diesel first, then lemon-zest and jammy berry, finishing smooth. Expect a high that lifts and brightens early, then settles into an even, euphoric calm without losing focus — classic modern hybrid balance. Potency trends high and CBD stays minimal, with terpene drivers that often read as limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene. In the garden, BlueBanger inherits compact, resin-heavy flowers from Sherbanger #22 and Black Magic, suggesting a straightforward indoor run with medium yields when dialed. Bred and released by Wizard Trees, it feels like the brand's candy-gas thesis rendered in one cultivar: loud, layered, and photogenic, with enough octane to satisfy gas chasers and enough confection to please the sweet-tooth crowd. Most phenos lean hybrid, medium in stature, with strong bag appeal.

name: Gravitide

Together they open with a bright nose of sweet candy, citrus peel, and fresh mint, then deepen into creamy gas as the grind releases more of the resin. Expect a lifted, euphoric onset that sharpens mood and focus before settling into an easy, happy calm; the finish feels unhurried and relaxed rather than heavy. Dominant terpenes often show as limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene, reflecting the candy-citrus sparkle and subtle peppery depth behind the minty exhale. Morphology leans toward tight, dark-tinged nugs with glossy heads and confident bag appeal, a visual throughline from both parents. Indoors, most phenotypes from this lineage are comfortable with an eight-to-nine week finish, delivering medium yields that trade sheer mass for high-end resin and layered flavor. Potency trends high with minimal CBD, but Gravitide reads as a balanced hybrid in effect — built for connoisseurs chasing complex candy-gas that evolves from jar to last pull, and proudly authored by Wizard Trees.

name: King Tide

Some circles trace Tide back to Blue Zushi (Zkittlez x Kush Mints), while others call it a select Z phenotype; either way, King Tide amplifies that lineage with a 55/45 indica-leaning hybrid balance and THC that regularly tests in the mid-to-high 20s, with CBD remaining trace. Cracking a jar releases sweet confection and cream layered over a faint diesel tick, thanks to a limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene trio, before the flavor rolls from citrus-candy to silky, gassy finish. Under lights, plants stay short and bushy with tight internodes, heavy trichome coverage, and calyx-forward buds that finish in 56-63 days. Indoors, dialed canopies yield around 550 g/m2; outside, well-fed trees can top 800 g per plant. The ride rises quickly into a happy, euphoric lift that settles into a calm, relaxed glide without sapping clarity. Expect classic candy-shop notes on the nose and a creamy, citrus-kissed exhale that lingers. Bred and released by Wizard Trees, King Tide carries forward the brand's terp-first ethos and meticulous selection work, bottling the tide and letting it crash twice for density, bag appeal, and repeatable performance.

name: Tongue Twister
description: Doja's Tongue Twister spins nostalgic candy and bakery notes into a vivid, modern hybrid. Born from Apple Fritter and Blueberry Mimosa, it opens with bright citrus and berry overtones before easing into a crisp apple-pastry sweetness, the kind of scent some fans describe as 'red sports drink' with a creamy edge. Limonene, alpha-pinene, and beta-caryophyllene lead the terpene chorus, shaping a flavor that bounces between zesty peel, fresh pine, and warm spice. Expect dense, spade-shaped buds dusted in frosty trichomes, threaded with tangerine pistils and occasional lavender hues inherited from its Blue lineage. Typical test results land around 17-20% THC with trace CBD, supporting an experience that starts buoyant and chatty before settling into an easy, happy groove. On the effects scale it skews euphoric, giggly, and uplifted while staying clear enough for creative flights. Selected and released by Doja, Tongue Twister captures the playful side of contemporary dessert-fruit genetics without tipping into heaviness. Whether you're chasing apple-citrus brightness or a balanced, anytime profile, this 50/50 expression wraps it into one tidy package – delivering layered flavor you can smell across the room and a mood that lingers like the last sweet sip. A clean finish lets the tart fruit sparkle long after the jar is closed.

name: Permanent Fumes
description: Permanent Fumes by Seed Junky is a pungent hybrid that marries Permanent Marker and Gello Shotz into a single, indelible profile. Expect a plume of diesel-like marker fumes over dark berry sweetness and a clean menthol snap, with undertones of burnt rubber and earthy leather that linger on the palate. Typical batches clock in around 28.7% THC, with negligible CBD, delivering a heavy onset that quiets the mind before settling into deep, full-body calm and contented euphoria. In the garden, Permanent Fumes tends to express the stout, resin-caked morphology of its Marker lineage while taking on Gello Shotz’s brighter candy notes; most growers see an indoor finish between 63 and 70 days of bloom. While yield depends on environment and training, dense bud structure and copious trichomes make this cross feel satisfyingly productive. Permanent Marker’s meteoric rise and major accolades in 2023 helped set the stage for this follow-up, and it shows: the aroma is loud, the bag appeal striking, and the flavor translates precisely from nose to exhale. Credit to Seed Junky Genetics for blending modern candy-gas with classic fuel in a way that truly lives up to its name. Expect a smooth, lingering finish and satisfying relaxation that marks every session.

name: Choco Latte

Expect medium to high yields around 450 to 550 g per m2 inside and up to 700 g per plant outside, with dense, sugar frosted buds and lively purple flashes. A terpene backbone often led by caryophyllene with limonene and humulene pushes aromas of lemon zest, sweet berries, and a faint nutty mocha over a light fuel edge. Typical potency runs 18 to 26 percent THC with trace CBD under 1 percent, delivering a rounded profile that opens bright and flavorful, then settles into relaxed, sleepy, euphoric vibes. Seed Junky focuses this cross on structure and terp clarity, so jars tend to sparkle and cure cleanly. If you prize creamy citrus flavor, quick indoor turnarounds, and handsome bag appeal, Choco Latte pours out richness in every bowl. Growers note heavy resin ideal for hash and a forgiving feed that rewards steady light, airflow, and timely pruning.

name: Caffeine by Seed Junky

The nose translates directly to flavor, with tropical zest over gassy depth and a faint minty echo from the Blue Zushi side. Effects arrive fast: an electric surge of focus, creative lift, and clean energy that stays organized rather than jittery. Structure leans modern and resin-packed, with dense, angular calyx stacks and heavy frost that press easily into shimmering heads. In gardens, Caffeine behaves like a contemporary hybrid, vigorous in veg and often finishing in roughly nine weeks indoors with solid yields when trellised and well fed. Expect THC-dominant chemistry and minimal CBD; batches vary by producer, but the profile consistently trends citrus-diesel, commonly limonene and caryophyllene forward with support from myrcene. Caffeine credits its punch to the iconic Sour Diesel lineage while Blue Zushi layers confectionery fruit and texture, making this Seed Junky selection a bright, go-getter phenotype for fans of flavor that performs as bold as it smells.

name: Banana Runtz by Barneys Farm
description: Banana Runtz by Barneys Farm is a precision F1 hybrid that marries Runtz with Banana OG, fusing candy-shop brightness with creamy tropical depth. The aroma opens on ripe banana and mixed fruit with a sweet, dessert-like edge, while the flavor carries smooth waves of tropical and sugary notes over a gentle herbal finish. Balanced 50% indica and 50% sativa genetics deliver a buoyant, euphoric lift that soon settles into happy clarity and a calm, comfortable body, an effect profile squarely in the euphoric, happy, and uplifted lane. Indoors, plants stay manageable at about 100–120 cm, forming bushy, uniform canopies that respond well to training; outdoors they can stretch to 150–220 cm. Expect 60–65 days of flowering, with rewarding harvests of around 550 g/m2 inside and up to 700 g per plant outside by early October. THC levels are advertised around 30%, with CBD typically minimal. A terpene ensemble led by limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene underscores the confectionary fruit, hinting at citrus zest, soft earth, and a brush of spice. True to its F1 billing, Banana Runtz shows strong vigor and consistency from seed to jar, showcasing Barneys Farm’s knack for flavorful power bred for modern gardens.

name: The 2019

Indoors, plants average 80-120 cm and finish in 60-65 days, reliably packing out canopies with dense colas; outdoors, they push 140-180 cm and are ready by late October. Potency lands around 25% THC with low CBD, translating to an upbeat onset that sparks creativity and momentum before settling into a smooth, physically relaxing glide. The genetic balance leans sativa (65%) with 35% indica drive, so structure stays manageable while vigor remains unmistakable. Growers will appreciate the uniform branching, easy training, and predictable bloom window, while connoisseurs will note the layered, clean finish that lingers like lemon peel over soft spice. The 2019 captures hybrid vigor without sacrificing personality – a confident, contemporary classic in the making today.

name: Seifuku

In the jar and on the grind it opens with ripe pineapple and mango, then a crisp apple finish; the smoke is soft and velvety, echoing sweet tropical tones without harshness. Plants stay tidy with dense flower set and finish in roughly 63 days indoors, rewarding attentive growers with heavy yields and showpiece bag appeal. On effect, it lands balanced rather than couching – mental clarity stays intact, with a gentle creative lift that brightens conversation and workflow. Genetics are 60% indica to 40% sativa, and phenotypes commonly express the same dessert-fruit terp chorus that defines both parents. Shuga's selection work keeps the structure uniform and resin-first; Umami's influence layers in tropical zest and a touch of diesel depth inherited down the line. For growers chasing vivid flavor, thick frost, and reliable production, Seifuku delivers its promise with polish and personality. Expect vigorous rooting, tight internodes, and an easy trim thanks to high calyx-to-leaf ratios.

name: Night Shade
description: Meet Nightshade, a fascinating hybrid packing heavily Indica-dominant genetics and a high average THC content of 25%. The Nightshade flavor packs an overload of sweet and fruity notes, with a prominent role for freshly picked berries. This potent strain is best suited for evening use, as it will get you utterly relaxed and sleepy in no time. With only happy thoughts and having all negativity expelled from your existence, except a truly blissful high with long-lasting effects and a high probability of couch-lock. These effects and its undeniable potency make Nightshade an ideal strain for experienced medical patients seeking relief from depression, insomnia, and PTSD.

name: Shinigami

Bred by Shuga Seeds in collaboration with Umami Seed Co, it pairs Zonuts (Runtz x Zuchi) with Randylosa (Celosa x Randy Marsh) to create dark, resin-glazed flowers that stretch hard and reward growers with heavy, trichome-rich yields. Expect a gassy-oily nose edged by cooling menthol and a sweet undercurrent, a profile that translates cleanly in jar and press alike. The experience lands fast – bright and euphoric up top before settling into a comfortable, un-heavy calm – making it a favorite for extractors and anyone chasing modern fuel with a twist. Indoors it typically ripens between days 56 and 63; taller phenos can double in height, so plan support early. While testing varies by garden, Shinigami leans high in THC with negligible CBD and thrives under dialed feed and airflow. If you love Runtz-family confection meeting classic gas, this hybrid's lineage speaks for itself: Zonuts on the inhale, Randylosa in the finish, and Shuga's curation throughout. Expect spear-like colas dusted in silver, dense calyx stacks, and a finish that washes exceptionally well. Growers report vigorous veg, a two-times stretch, and consistently heavy harvests under moderate EC.

On the palate, a quick squeeze of lime and pineapple gives way to creamy berry sweetness, finishing tropical and clean. The ride tends to start cheerful and relaxed and can taper into a tranquil, sleepy coast. For growers and flavor seekers alike, this Shuga original sticks the landing. Medium stature suits training, and careful canopy management rewards with stacked, glistening colas.

name: Lithium

Typical lab outcomes put THC around the low-to-mid 20s with trace CBD, and the terpene stack commonly leans limonene, caryophyllene, and linalool - an upbeat trio that frames the experience as happy, relaxed, and gently euphoric without muting focus. Credit to Shuga for slotting the richly textured Cobalt Cream against their Lemon Cherry Celosa: the cross reads modern and indulgent yet purposeful, turning out bag appeal and flavor that carry from grind to exhale. Expect glistening, violet-flecked buds and a smoothly uplifting vibe that lingers long after the last puff.

name: Kaori

In the garden, Kaori is an indica-leaning hybrid that finishes in roughly 55–65 days, rewarding dialed environments with heavy yields of dense, frost-caked colas. The aroma opens with temple-style incense wrapped in ripe fruit, then brightens to lemon-zest top notes; on the grind a soft sweetness rounds the edges without muting the spice. Reported THC commonly lands in the 25–28% window, while CBD remains trace, making Kaori a potent but poised selection. The effect arrives in two acts: an uplifting, euphoric first step clears the head, followed by a composed, body-forward calm that underlines the cultivar’s Waifu heritage. Expect mid-height frames with sturdy laterals that respond well to light training and airflow, and resin coverage that suits both top-shelf flower and solventless work. Credit for the cross goes to Shuga Seeds, whose catalog of Waifu descendants has become a connoisseur niche; Kaori may be the most aromatic of the line, honoring its name — fragrance — with every jar crack.

name: Kimono

On the palate, a satin entry opens into ripe melon and grape-candy tones, before Waifu’s diesel signature lands on the exhale. Compact, resin-glazed buds range from vivid lime to deeper forest greens with cinnamon-brown pistils, while cooler conditions can draw out Waifu-typical purple highlights. Indoors, flowering typically concludes in 55–65 days, with heavy harvests that showcase dense calyx stacking and trichome coverage prized by hash-minded growers. Reported potency is high, with THC commonly in the 25–28% window and negligible CBD. The overall experience reads composed and uplifting yet deeply settling, balancing cheerful headspace with a serene body glow. Released in regular seed form, Kimono rewards attentive selection, faithfully uniting the candied fruit profile of its Umami lineage with Shuga’s creamy, gassy house style into a cohesive, couture expression.

Back To The Future honors its parents and its namesake alike: familiar, forward-looking, and tuned for yield, resin, and unmistakable character.

Under lights, its medium-tall frame responds well to trellising and careful defoliation.

name: Swerve's Purple Indica S1
description: Born from a Pacific Northwest legend, Swerve's Purple Indica S1 by The Cali Connection is a faithful seed version of the prized PNW Purple Indica clone. Produced as a selfed line (Purple Indica x Purple Indica), it preserves the compact, broadleaf indica frame and the brooding, almost ink-black foliage that can wash into deep violet hues late in bloom. Expect a nose that opens with dark grape and field-flowers over an earthy, old-world hash backdrop; the flavor mirrors that profile with jammy grape up front and a soft, herbal finish. Built for connoisseurs who chase clarity without sacrificing depth, Jack Truffle balances drive with composure and wears its pedigree proudly, a vivid handshake between the storied Jack Herer and the luxurious Black Truffle. Expect a clear head, lifted outlook, and steady, purposeful momentum throughout.

Whether you trace it to Biscotti's cookie-and-gas backbone, Sherb's tropical cream, or Cherry Kush's ruby bite, the synergy is the story: a modern West Coast hybrid with old-school gas, bold color, and productivity to match. Buds finish thick and weighty, with crystalline coverage that clings to the grinder and hues that swing from lime to lavender. Expect strong bag appeal, and a terp trail that hangs after the jar is shut.

The buds cure into tight, chunky spears glazed in frost, lime to forest green with orange threads and the occasional violet kiss; smoke lands creamy and smooth, then settles into a heavy, dreamy stone. Effects arrive upbeat and euphoric before deepening into loose, tranquil calm and, for many, drowsy contentment. Exact lab numbers are not yet public as this cultivar rolls out, and CBD is expected to remain minimal; release timing is later in 2026. TurtleTopia is credited to Turtle Pie Co. and reads like a love letter to Northern California flavor trends, marrying Zkittlez-style candy with gassy OG heritage while holding its own as a distinct selection. If you seek a sugary bouquet anchored by depth and weight, this aptly named hybrid turns the dial straight to wonderland.

name: Captain Caveman

Dense, tightly set colas cure into frosted, uniform nugs that keep structure in the grind, shimmering under a heavy trichome coat. Limonene, beta‑caryophyllene, and myrcene frequently headline the terpene ensemble, supporting bright citrus top notes and a cushy, spice‑tinged base. The selection was dialed for production consistency, delivering batches with reliable nug size, strong bag appeal, and a frosty, camera‑ready cure. Expect satisfying, repeatable performance in jars and rooms alike.

name: Party Poppers

The high rises quickly into an upbeat, chatter-ready euphoria before tapering into a calm, relaxed glide that still keeps the mood lifted. Expect limonene to steer the terpene mix, with caryophyllene and myrcene providing gentle spice and soft-earth undertones. In the garden, this selection grows to a compact-to-medium stature with a cooperative structure, showing best as a medium-yielding hybrid that wraps flowering in roughly 56–63 days under attentive indoor conditions. It is a solid intermediate project — responsive to basic training and steady environment management — rewarding growers with sparkling, bag-appeal buds that capture modern dessert-line potency and polish. With LCG and Bluemimosa as parents and Doja’s stamp on the hunt, Party Poppers Doja lands squarely in the contemporary candy-citrus lane, equal parts festive and refined.

name: Z Nerdz

Expect medium–tall plants with a tidy, cooperative structure and dense, purple-streaked flowers that finish in 56–63 days. The bouquet leans confectionery: a rush of grape and mixed berries over clean citrus, underpinned by a subtle funky sweetness that lingers in the dry room and the jar. Reports place THC around 25%, with CBD minimal, so potency is front and center while flavors stay precise. Growers can anticipate medium to high yields when dialed in, helped by sturdy branching that handles training and weight well. A terpene axis of limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene often shows in this cross, reading as bright, spicy, and jammy in equal parts. On the experience side, Z Nerdz trends euphoric and happy at first pull, settling into a polished, body-light relaxation rather than a couch-lock, keeping its hybrid character intact. As the name hints, it is unabashedly candy — yet the Zangria parent adds depth and polish to the classic Z-lane profile from Blue Nerdz. Z Nerdz is a modern, high-end candy cultivar with performance to match its bag appeal. Selected under the Wizard Trees banner, it balances boutique flavor with workhorse vigor.

name: Grand Prixx
description: Grand Prixx charges off the line with candy-gas aromatics and deep, frosted color. Bred by Wizard Trees, this hybrid pairs Monaco with Tea Time. In the jar, expect a sugar-slick bouquet of berry candy over creamy diesel and a subtle earthy echo; on the palate, sweet and diesel notes trade places as limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene lead the terpene pack. Effects arrive in two clean gears: a bright, euphoric lift and a smooth, body-soothing settle that keeps moods high and minds unhurried. Indoors, Grand Prixx reaches medium to tall stature with a manageable canopy and a moderate-to-high stretch, finishing in roughly 56-63 days with medium to high yields of dark, trichome-laden golf balls. Well-run rooms routinely showcase her 25%+ THC potential alongside low CBD. Outdoors, the same stacked buds and midnight coloration turn heads at harvest. Grand Prixx was designed for modern jars and hash presses, but its most memorable moment may be the first crack of the seal: a rush of candy gas that lives up to its name.

name: Chernobyl
description: Chernobyl is an 80% sativa hybrid bred from the original Trainwreck, Trinity, and Jack the Ripper genetics. This strain can pose a moderate challenge for growers due to its significant height and expansive growth during the pre-flowering stretch, requiring not only structural support but also LST and pruning to keep it under control, especially indoors. With up to 19% THC, this strain offers a very sharp and distinctive aroma featuring pungent citrus and lime notes, accompanied by funky tropical hues that are surprisingly sweet. Chernobyl is known for its long-lasting energetic effects that start with a euphoric motivation. It is an excellent choice for daytime use, particularly for those seeking relief from stress or anxiety without feeling sedated. Medically speaking, this strain offers potent appetite-stimulating qualities, which make it a go-to variety for those dealing with appetite loss, anorexia, migraines, and pain.

name: Zero Gravity
description: Zero Gravity by Clearwater Genetics drifts in from Shauncron's breeding bench: a carefully selected union of GMO and Oreoz. The cut expresses dense, cookie-stacked morphology with medium internode spacing and a steady, moderate stretch, finishing in 60 to 70 days. Its aroma lifts like a pressure change before takeoff: garlic fuel and earthy diesel from GMO collide with the cocoa sweetness of Oreoz, while the palate tracks diesel, earth, and a clean bakery sweetness. Dominant terpenes limonene, beta caryophyllene, and myrcene frame the profile with citrus lift, peppery depth, and soft herb. Lab reports on this cultivar often chart high potency, with THC commonly in the mid 20s and standout lots touching 30 percent, while CBD stays under 0.1 percent, a reflection of its resin rich heritage. Under lights, buds marble to deep greens with occasional purple and stack heavily, rewarding tuned rooms with high yields. Effects tend to feel relaxed and euphoric without losing a buoyant, happy headspace; true to the name, it is a weightless float rather than a crash. Zero Gravity's parentage also anchors Clearwater favorites like Deep Space and Astronaut Status, but here the star is the original cross itself, credited to Clearwater Genetics and selector Shauncron.

In the garden this indica-leaning hybrid stays medium in stature and vigor, stacking dense golf-ball flowers with purple marbling and a heavy, sparkling frost. Expect a straightforward run of roughly 56–65 days indoors and medium yields; plants respond well to topping and SCROG, rewarding care with bag appeal that screams "Z" candy. The Lemon Cherry Gelato parent lends density and color, while the Zkittlez side amplifies sweetness and terp intensity for that unmistakable rainbow finish. Curated by Backpackboyz—often seen in collaboration drops—the cut is built for aroma chasers who also value clean structure and consistent performance. Growers note tight internodes, easy trimming, and a forgiving, medium difficulty curve.

name: Kiwi Raspberry

While potency varies by cut, Kiwi Raspberry is typically THC-dominant with minimal measured CBD. Growers report medium height and straightforward management in controlled rooms; ample airflow near late bloom helps these thick colas finish clean. Bred by Alien Genetics, this cross captures modern fruit-and-gas appeal while preserving classic sour character, delivering lively flavor and dependable structure.

Indoors, flowering reliably wraps in 56–60 days; Kiwi Sours leaners tend to finish earlier, while the deeper berry expressions take a few days more. Effects trend upbeat, happy, and gently relaxing. As with most contemporary dessert hybrids, THC generally runs high with minimal CBD, though exact figures depend on cultivation. A colorful showcase of Alien’s modern candy lineage, Kiwi Lingonberries is bred for both eye appeal and unmistakable flavor.

When burned, the Purple Hindu Kush buds release a sweet and spicy herbal flavor profile, enriched by freshly picked red grapes. The Purple Hindu Kush effects can be described as happiness-inducing and relaxation, causing thorough sedation from head to toe and increasing sleepiness, ideal for winding down after a long and stressful day. Bags crack with sparkle; spear tips flash silver under dense trichomes.

Fans of dessert-forward hybrids will recognize how Big Apple's sherb-kissed fritter lineage steadies the structure while Zkittlez BX1 sharpens the rainbow, and Sour Straws adds tart brightness and stretch. Apple Straws delivers a polished, photogenic finish with everyday reliability - true to Seed Junky's reputation for elite, production-friendly candy gas. Growers note compact, easy training and strong bag appeal from week four onward.

name: Dark Passenger
description: Dark Passenger from 3rd Coast Genetics rides in on unapologetically gassy aromas and moody purple hues, a purposeful match of Tagalongz and Black Truffle. Tagalongz (OOOZE 1.0 x Peanut Butter Breath) brings nutty dessert tones and stout hybrid vigor, while Black Truffle (White Truffle x Pure Michigan) layers dense resin, inky coloration, and that savory musk and garlic edge. The bouquet lands first with citrus-zest spark, then turns nutty and musky before a long diesel finish; on the palate expect citrus, nutty cookie, and thick gas over a faint earthy backdrop. Indoors Dark Passenger typically finishes in 55–65 days, rewarding attentive growers with heavy production that can push about 700 g/m²; outdoors, well-fed plants can top out with very high yields around 1.25 kg per plant by late September to early October. Structure is an indica-leaning hybrid: branching and moderately tall inside, more expansive outside, with dark green fans that can fade nearly black. Most phenos test high in THC with low CBD, and the terpene profile commonly tilts toward caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene. Reported effects trend relaxed and euphoric with a happy center, while some users note classic dry mouth and eyes. A brooding, resin-heavy traveler built for big, loud gardens.

name: Tuxedo
description: Buttoned-up by name but far from stiff, Tuxedo by 3rd Coast Genetics dresses classic dessert-gas genetics in a slick modern cut. Bred from Oreoz 1.0 and Black Truffle, it leans mostly indica and grows like a poised, elongated tree with many lateral branches; leaves start deep green and finish purple-black as flowers ripen. Indoors it typically finishes in 8-9 weeks (about 56-63 days), and under dialed-in conditions it can stack abundant, glistening colas; reported yields reach around 700 g/m2 inside and up to roughly 1,250 g per plant outdoors. The bouquet lands squarely in the creamy-mint and diesel lane with musky undertones, translating on the palate as cool mint, thick cream, and a trailing ribbon of fuel. Lab snapshots collected for the cultivar average about 18% THC with roughly 1% CBD, while the terpene profile often leans toward caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene. On the nose and in the room the frost reads loud, but the vibe stays composed: a relaxed, contented mood with an easy lift rather than sparks and fireworks. Oreoz 1.0 (Cookies & Cream x Secret Weapon) lends the confectionery, resin-rich backbone; Black Truffle (White Truffle x Pure Michigan) threads in darker savor and color. Released as regular seed stock, it is tailored genetics with a neat finish.

name: Stiiicky Grapez
description: Stiiicky Grapez from Maven Genetics lives up to its name the moment you pull apart its resin-soaked colas. A retailer-exclusive limited edition, it merges Prizm and Ambrosia into a vivid, grape-driven expression that leans indica without losing finesse. Tight, polished buds are marbled in deep violet and pale green, then sealed under a dense frost that gives the flower its signature tack. On the nose, candy-sweet concord grape unfurls over bright citrus and a faint line of polished gas; in the bowl, dark grape saturates the palate before gentle baking spice and a clean pine finish sharpen the fruit and linger. Batches have tested around 28.51% THC with about 0.23% CBD, underscoring a plush, terpene-rich profile with real resin depth. The experience trends relaxed, happy, and subtly uplifted, settling the body while keeping the senses engaged. Maven’s meticulous indoor craft shows in the uniform structure, confident color, and glassy trichome coverage that holds up beautifully after the cure. If you speak fluent grape, Stiiicky Grapez is a fluent answer — an artful pairing of Prizm’s modern sheen with Ambrosia’s classic backbone, bred and cultivated by Maven Genetics to spotlight the stickiest side of purple. Expect glossy, tightly wound calyxes, robust bag appeal, and a lingering, candied finish.

name: Dulce De Miel
description: Dulce De Miel by Maven Genetics blends two house favorites — Blue Agape and Honey Lemon Hibiscus — into a confectionary-leaning hybrid that looks as decadent as it smells. Deep violet hues and vivid orange pistils are sealed under a thick sugar of trichomes, and the buds break with compact, candy-like calyxes. The aroma opens on honey and citrus peel, with floral spice and a faint ribbon of gas in the background; on the palate, those notes resolve into sweet lemon, blossom, and gentle spice with a clean, resinous finish. Effects arrive smoothly and evenly: a calm, body-forward relaxation paired with an easy lift that keeps the mood bright and, often, the appetite engaged — think relaxed, happy, and hungry rather than couch‑locked. Batches have tested in the upper‑20s THC with trace CBD around a few tenths of a percent, mirroring the cultivar’s lavish frost. Blue Agape lends color, density, and depth, while Honey Lemon Hibiscus contributes its zesty perfume and lift, making Dulce De Miel feel both indulgent and refreshing. True to Maven’s indoor craft, the cure is glassy and precise, yielding dense flowers that grind fluffy and aromatic. It is a memorable, limited expression from a breeder known for dialed-in, terp-driven crosses.

name: Parisian Kush
description: Parisian Kush by Maven Genetics brings a refined, understated polish to a modern hybrid. Born from FKAFL x Blue Lotus, its buds stack tall and sculptural, saturated in deep violet and inky purple beneath an even lacquer of frost. The aroma opens with cream and restrained sweetness, edged by a delicate floral lift; as the flower breathes, a low, kush-leaning gas surfaces over faint earth. On the palate it stays composed — lightly sweet on the inhale, finishing with a gentle, fuel-kissed grace. The effect profile mirrors the aesthetics: relaxed, pleasant, and unintrusive, with mood visibly lifted and an easy sense of clarity. Expect a balance that reads as relaxed, happy, and uplifted rather than heavy. The terpene story leans toward caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene, echoing Blue Lotus’s gassy depth and the OG-influenced complexity of FKAFL. THC-dominant with minimal CBD, its resin-rich morphology whispers potency without shouting it. Credited to Maven Genetics, Parisian Kush also nods to house history: FKAFL (formerly "French Laundry") is an award-winning cross of L.A. Rouge and The Soap, and Blue Lotus was hand-selected from a dozen phenotypes for its aromatic finesse. Together they yield a polished profile where cream, flowery tones, and refined diesel linger as gracefully as the cultivar’s look.

name: Golden Ticket By Maven
description: Golden Ticket by Maven debuts like a foil-wrapped confection: a shimmering hybrid bred by Maven Genetics from Runtz x Golden Applez. Its dense, trichome-stacked flowers often blush deep violet - a Runtz hallmark - while Golden Applez contributes extra gloss and geometry. Cracking a jar releases berry-candy high notes and vanilla cream, cut with bright citrus and a faint diesel edge; on the palate those layers register as sweet, zesty, and lightly gassy. Under the hood, a terpene trio led by limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene frames the profile and helps steer the ride. Expect a buoyant, euphoric lift and clean focus that settles into calm, contented relaxation - balanced enough for creative detours without heavy sedation. Potency is formidable: batches commonly test around 24–29% THC with negligible CBD. In the garden, Golden Ticket shows sturdy structure, moderate stretch, and a cooperative temperament. Indoors it finishes in about 56–60 days and typically returns a medium yield; expect compact, resinous colas that trim clean. Growers prize its bag appeal, nuanced candy-gas aroma, and consistency across phenotypes. Whether you chase color, aroma, or crystalline frost, this Maven original delivers a polished, modern expression of its elite parents - proof that a well-cut ticket still opens doors. Seasoned hands will note tight internodes and strong lateral branching that reward dialed-in light.

name: Black Sour Truffle
description: Black Sour Truffle from 3rd Coast Genetics marries the jet-fuel zest of Soul Diesel with the inky, dessert-gas swagger of Black Truffle, creating a hybrid that opens bright and finishes deep. Break a nug and a rush of diesel and citrus leaps out first, soon folding into earthy truffle, cracked pepper, and a faint cocoa bitterness. Dense, sugar-frosted buds often flash purple hues from the Truffle side, contrasted by vivid orange pistils and heavy resin. On the palate, expect diesel and citrus to lead while earthy tones round the finish cleanly. Effects tend to arrive quickly with a focused, uplifted headspace and crisp motivation from the diesel lineage, then settle into calm, body-centered ease from the Truffle parent, a balanced arc that moves from creative lift to composed physical ease. Caryophyllene steers the terpene profile, with limonene and myrcene supporting the fuel-and-citrus sparkle over an earthy base. Bred by 3rd Coast Genetics as Soul Diesel x Black Truffle, Black Sour Truffle reflects the brand's Michigan craft pedigree: compact, indoor-friendly structure, glossy trichome coverage, and dependable, medium-to-high yields when dialed in. Expect a flowering window in the familiar modern-hybrid zone and bag appeal to match its name, delivering a polished expression of old-school gas meeting new-school truffle.

name: Glass II

The nose opens earthy and citrus-forward with peppery spice and diesel, often flashing a bright orange rind note; its profile suggests a caryophyllene-limonene core with myrcene and a touch of humulene echoing the Pure Michigan parentage. Effects lean relaxing yet upbeat: a euphoric lift settles into calm focus and contented ease, with the usual dry mouth and dry eyes the most common downsides. While exact chemotype varies by selection, Glass II trends THC-driven with typically low CBD, mirroring both parents' reputations. Bred by 3rd Coast Genetics, Glass II distills MAC V2's polish and Pure Michigan's inky swagger into a productive, terp-rich modern hybrid.

name: Banana Bread by Lumpy's

A 55/45 indica-sativa balance shows up in the experience: fast-relaxing body calm with a clear, upbeat head that trends happy and a touch euphoric before settling deeply relaxed. Dominant terpenes beta-myrcene, d-limonene, and beta-caryophyllene lead the chorus, supporting that sweet-citrus-meets-spice character. Growers will recognize its parentage in the garden. Expect compact, resin-rich colas on medium-stature plants with a straightforward, medium-yielding habit. Indoors, a 56-63 day flowering window is typical, with similar timing outside in temperate climates. Credit to Lumpy's Flowers for composing a modern dessert hybrid that smells like its name and smokes like its lineage, Banana OG's creamy fruit wrapped in Oreoz's dense, frosty structure, served warm from a meticulous NorCal kitchen.

name: Light Blue

Indica-leaning in growth and effect (about 60/40), it builds chunky colas with lime-green calyxes and flaming pistils, and regularly tests in the mid-teens for CBD while remaining Farm Bill–compliant with delta-9 THC below 0.3%. Dominant terpenes limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene drive flavors of citrus peel, orange, and faint fuel, followed by piney depth. Expect notes of orange marmalade, diesel, and a whisper of pine. A sticky, citrus-forward bouquet makes it a connoisseur favorite. Expect a smooth, happy lift that settles into an easy body calm and upbeat focus without heaviness. Indoors, Light Blue flowers in 56–63 days, reaching medium height with sturdy branching; experienced growers see roughly 450 g/m² under strong light, with generous outdoor plants finishing mid-season. Yields are medium to high, and the cultivar responds well to topping and light defoliation to open the canopy. Orange Glaze earned first place for Indoor Hemp Flower at the 2022 Emerald Cup, a nod to Taproot’s selection work and the cross’s sticky bag appeal. Parents: T1 x Kush E1. Bred by Taproot Seed Co.

name: Poison

Indoors, expect 56–70 days of flowering and medium yields near 450 g/m2 with training; outdoors, plants can stretch to about 2.5 m and finish with high yields around 700 g per plant in favorable climates. Because of its vertical vigor, trellis or stakes help keep spears upright late in bloom. Parentage is straightforward: Durban Poison, selected and presented by Blueprint; no disclosed secondary parent. If you are tracking flavor or effect, look for lemon, citrus, and spicy-herbal notes alongside an energetic, euphoric, and uplifted mood. Crafted by Blueprint Cannabis Co, Poison honors a timeless profile while showcasing the brand's clean, vivid expression.

Expect excellent bag appeal and a clean lime-pine exhale that lingers long after the jar is closed.

True to its Skunk #1 heritage (Afghani x Colombian Gold x Acapulco Gold), this IBL is easy to grow, highly uniform, and ideal both for beginners seeking reliability and breeders needing a predictable foundation. Aladdin's Skunk is a timeless, old-school classic meticulously shared by Khalifa Genetics.

Plants express wide morphology: around a third run taller with narrower leaflets, while most stay bushier with oversized calyxes and dense trichome coverage. Hardy and light-feeding, it performs reliably in difficult environments and shows above-average tolerance to heat and cold. Yields are medium to high. No named parents exist - this is a pure landrace rather than a hybrid - so its "lineage" is the Tirah Valley population itself. Lab terpene panels and THC/CBD ranges have not been formally published, reinforcing its value as authentic, living heritage preserved by Khalifa Genetics.

The fern-leaf trait keeps it stealthy early, then the plant floods with large-headed trichomes as the sugar leaves and calyces deepen to violet. Aromas swing from sugared berries to kushy earth with a gassy edge, and the flavor follows with sweet fruit up front and earthy-diesel undertones. Indoors it finishes in about 55-65 days, typically delivering medium to high yields; expect compact, vividly frosted buds that dry to a striking purple sheen. Outdoors, the line shows notable mold hardiness and an easygoing temperament, rewarding basic training and airflow. Despite its visual drama, the effect is straightforward: a quick, cheerful lift that eases into a long, body-first calm, leaving a relaxed, happy afterglow. Height stays medium overall, with responsive topping if you want a wider canopy. Crafted by Khalifa Genetics with Califrosty, Frosty's Purple Freak pairs the potency and structure of Black Kush with Berry Freak's color and perfume for a uniquely freaky, consistently purple finish.

Myrcene leads the terpene profile, shaping a calming, long‑lasting body effect that starts euphoric and content before easing into drowsy tranquility. Growers will find vigorous, uniform plants with a medium stature and excellent response to training. Indoors, Aladdin Kush typically completes bloom in about 9 weeks (approximately 63 days), and outdoors it is ready around the end of September in temperate climates. Yields are notably high, with dense tops that dry to a loud jar note and sticky, resinous texture, making it equally appealing for flower or hash work. Despite its heft, this cultivar remains beginner‑friendly and resilient when run under standard conditions. Potency is tuned toward above‑average THC with low CBD, delivering a terpene‑driven Kush experience anchored by old‑school Aladdin’s Skunk IBL clarity and polished by modern breeding discipline.

Indoor-grown in Los Angeles, Sakura’s hybrid character is guided by a terpene trio often seen in its lineage — caryophyllene for the dank backbone, limonene for bright lift, and linalool for a soft, perfumed finish. Expect THC to land in the low-to-mid 20s, with batches commonly measured around the 22–24% range, translating to a euphoric, mood-forward onset that eases into a relaxed, happy cruise without dulling flavor. Buds stack into tight, frosted calyxes with lilac and lime hues inherited from its dessert-forward parents, while the palate traces sweet blossom, vanilla cream, and a subtle diesel echo on the exhale. In the garden, comparable cuts of its parentage are known to finish in roughly 8–10 weeks with medium yields, and Sakura presents as a similarly manageable, medium-stature hybrid. LA Family Farms’ house touch keeps the expression polished and consistent — an artful balance of confectionary terps and plush, feel-good effects that justify the fan buzz around this modern cherry-blossom namesake.

name: Cinnamon Rolls
description: Lit Farms' Cinnamon Rolls twines dessert DNA into a modern indica-leaning hybrid by pairing Pancakes and Runtz, then dialing sweetness into creamy, candy-shop territory. Expect a bakery bouquet: sweet vanilla and cream on the nose with a light pastry spice, settling into a sugar-glazed finish on the palate. Plants stay medium in stature with strong lateral branching and dense, frosted colas; indoors they typically finish in 65-75 days (about 9-10 weeks) and can stack generously, with reported harvests up to 650 g/m2 inside and as much as 1200 g per plant outdoors. The high arrives bright and buoyant — euphoric, uplifted, and creative — before smoothing into a calm, contented cruise. Cinnamon Rolls expresses a terpene profile often led by caryophyllene, with limonene and myrcene supporting the confectionary tones. While potency varies by phenotype and grow, this cultivar is bred first for saturated flavor and resin. Lit Farms deserves the credit here; Cinnamon Rolls fits their pastry-forward portfolio yet still shows the colorful candy character inherited from Runtz. If you are selecting a keeper, look for the Pancakes-leaning phenos that push buttery vanilla and hold structure late in bloom. For those chasing jar appeal plus yield, this cross delivers both without feeling heavy.

name: Golden Guava
description: Golden Guava from Common Wealth Seed Co blends two modern flavor powerhouses—Strawberry Guava and Grape Sunshine—into a photogenic hybrid bred for bag appeal and resin. Expect a bright, tropical nose where ripe guava, papaya, and candied grape ride over gentle citrus. In the jar and on the grind, those fruit tones widen into a sweet, creamy bouquet, a profile often led by limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene. Plants show thick branching and vigorous structure, stacking dense, frosty colas that suit both indoor tents and outdoor terraces. Most growers report a straightforward run that finishes in about 8–10 weeks (roughly 56–70 days), with medium indoor yields and the potential for bigger numbers outside when light is dialed. On the palate, Golden Guava carries its fruit-candy promise through to the exhale: tropical, grape, and citrus notes linger without harshness. The experience arrives quickly and cleanly—euphoric and uplifted up top, steadied by a calm physical undertow that keeps things comfortable and social. With THC commonly testing high and CBD low, this cultivar emphasizes vivid flavor and energetic clarity rather than softness. Credit for the cross belongs to Common Wealth Seed Co, whose focus on extraction-friendly genetics shines in this sticky, wash-ready selection.

name: Grape Ghost
description: Grape Ghost by Common Wealth Seed Co slips in like a familiar classic with a fresh tint of color. Built from Ghost OG x Grape Sunshine, it marries a revered early-2000s OG Kush clone with a modern, fruit-forward line descended from Secret Lemon and Tallymon. In the garden it shows the Ghost side first: lankier OG posture, firm internodes, and a noticeable stretch at flip that rewards space and canopy control. Indoors or out, plants finish in 56–70 days with medium to high yields of dense, resin-frosted colas. Aroma leads with earthy OG funk and piney undertones before a dark-grape sweetness rises on the finish; the flavor tracks the same path, layering grape, sweet, and soil notes. Expect classically relaxing, euphoric moods with a calm center, an effect profile aligned with OG heritage. THC is typically very high (20%+), while CBD sits low (0–1%), and phenos commonly express an OG-leaning terpene mix that often includes myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. Grape Ghost was selected and released by Common Wealth Seed Co to showcase Ghost OG’s backbone with a subtle purple-fruit accent from Grape Sunshine. Growers who enjoy OG structure with a slightly darker fruit profile will find this cross a satisfying, reliable hybrid that respects the past while tasting unmistakably of the present.

name: Pie Dough x Grape Sunshine
description: Common Wealth Seed Co's Pie Dough x Grape Sunshine is a flavor-first, resin-rich hybrid that pairs Cannarado's Pie Dough with Archive's celebrated Grape Sunshine. The Pie Dough mother layers creamy pastry and vanilla over a sturdy cookie-leaning frame, while the Grape Sunshine donor - Secret Lemon (Lemon Peel x Moonbow) crossed with Tallymon (Banana OG x Dosidos x Papaya) - adds tropical grape candy and a citrus snap prized by hashmakers. Expect medium-height plants with cooperative branching and dense, frost-caked colas; indoors or out, the flowering window lands at 56-70 days and yields run medium to high with tidy canopy management. Aromas fuse ripe grape, lime zest, and warm dough; the palate follows with sweet grape, bright lime, and a soft cream finish. Potency trends high, with THC regularly 20%+ and CBD low (0-1%), delivering a cheerful lift and relaxed, talkative mood that keeps edges smooth without heavy couchlock. Visually, buds can flash lime to soft purple beneath a thick trichome shell - exactly the kind of finish that made the Grape Sunshine cut a darling among solventless producers. Crafted by Common Wealth Seed Co for growers who chase both bag appeal and wash potential, this cross brings modern dessert terps into a sunny, upbeat lane.

name: Piesol
description: Piesol is Common Wealth Seed Co's resin-first hybrid built with Archive Seedbank. Born from Pie Hoe and Grape Sunshine, the latter a clone famed for 9 percent fresh-frozen wash returns, Piesol marries grape candy sweetness with kerosene OG gas. Plants stay medium in height with sturdy lateral branching and stack dense, frosted colas that glisten under trim lights. In the jar, expect a rush of grape fuel, sweet fruit, and earthy spice; on the palate it leans grape diesel with a sugary echo. Indoors most phenotypes finish in 65 to 75 days, delivering above average yields and notably heavy resin heads prized by hashmakers. The experience opens with an easy, balanced lift and creative clarity before settling into a calm, body soothing unwind that remains uplifting rather than dull. Typical batches test at very high THC, commonly 20 percent or more, while CBD stays below 1 percent, letting the terpene blend speak. Caryophyllene leads with peppery warmth, supported by limonene's citrus sparkle and myrcene's soft depth. Released in feminized form, Piesol makes wash friendly gardening straightforward inside or out. For growers chasing purple kissed bag appeal, grape forward terps, and dependable wash numbers in a single cultivar, Piesol shows why the Common Wealth Seed Co and Archive collaboration keeps making noise.

name: Wedlock
description: Wedlock from Common Wealth Seed Co marries the sturdy, dessert-leaning architecture of Wedding Pie with the loud, fruit-driven terpene blast of Grape Sunshine. From the first rub, its bouquet leans hard into ripe grape layered with sweet cream and tropical accents, a profile often steered by caryophyllene and limonene with a whisper of linalool. Plants stay medium in stature but build big, chunky colas that frequently finish with deep purple highlights and a heavy coat of resin - traits that make this hybrid as photogenic as it is hash-friendly. Indoors or out, Wedlock tends to reward attentive growers with medium to high yields after a swift 56-70 day bloom. The effect lands in two acts: an uplifting, euphoric spark that nudges creativity, then a calm, body-forward glide that settles into a relaxed, easy finish. With THC around 23% and typically low CBD, potency sits firmly in the modern sweet spot without sacrificing balance. Flavor carries through true to nose - grape first, then soft sweetness and a silky, creamy tail - echoing both parents while staking its own identity. If you want the grape dial pinned while keeping Wedding Pie's tidy frame, Wedlock delivers that union with confidence. Released as feminized photoperiod seed by Common Wealth Seed Co, it performs in soil or hydro with equal poise.

name: Grape Krush by Common Wealth Seed Co
description: Grape Krush by Common Wealth Seed Co blends two resin-champion parents, Grape Gas and Grape Sunshine, into a vividly aromatic hybrid with a collaborative pedigree that nods to Archive’s celebrated selections. Expect medium-height plants that show a confident stretch into flower, stacking dense, frosted colas whose grape-candy perfume is splashed with tropical juice and a clean diesel snap. Caryophyllene often leads the terpene chorus, with myrcene and linalool rounding out a profile that translates directly from jar to palate: sweet grape up front, exotic fruit in the middle, and a fuel-kissed finish. Indoors or out, Grape Krush is bred with extraction in mind—sticky trichome coverage and wash-friendly structure—yet still pushes medium-to-high flower yields for growers focused on top-shelf buds. Flowering wraps in roughly 64–75 days (about 8–10 weeks). Potency trends high, with THC frequently 20% or above and CBD typically low (around 0–1%), delivering a buoyant, euphoric lift, an easy, relaxed body, and an uplifted, feel-good mood. Credit Common Wealth Seed Co for capturing grape-forward decadence without sacrificing vigor or structure: Grape Krush is a modern purple-leaning hash hybrid that rewards careful training and airflow with shimmering color, voluminous resin, and unmistakable dessert-fuel character.

name: Grape Safari
description: Grape Safari by Common Wealth Seed Co is a fruit forward adventure for cultivators and hash makers. This feminized, photoperiod hybrid pairs Wild Thornberry with Grape Sunshine, two resin drenched parents selected for solventless friendly trichomes. Expect medium height plants with strong lateral branching and dense, frosty flowers that typically finish in about 60 to 70 days. In the room it behaves like a balanced 50 50 hybrid, producing medium to high yields and notably greasy heads that reward careful washing and pressing. True to its name, the nose leads with ripe grape and strawberry tones over a soft, creamy yogurt like backdrop. Most phenotypes keep that dessert like finish, while some lean brighter and tangier. Reports commonly place THC in the mid 20s with minimal CBD, delivering an upbeat, euphoric lift that settles into an easy, relaxed, clarity without heavy couch lock. Visually, Grape Safari shines with sparkling trichome coverage and occasional purple accents, delivering top tier bag appeal. Crafted by Common Wealth Seed Co, the cross distills the best of its parents into a cultivar that is satisfying to grow, richly aromatic in the jar, and engineered for modern resin work, while remaining approachable for well organized home gardens.

name: Caramel Valley
description: Caramel Valley by Tsunami Seeds marries the sharp, fuel‑tinted pine and lemon snap of SFV (San Fernando Valley OG) with the dessert‑leaning creaminess of Caramel Tsunami. The result is an aromatic profile that opens with citrus and conifer, then rolls into sweet vanilla, nutty sugar and a hint of diesel, anchored by a terpene mix commonly led by limonene, myrcene, caryophyllene and pinene. In the garden, Caramel Valley tends to stack like an OG: sturdy stems, dense, resin-caked flowers, and a manageable medium height that suits trellised indoor rooms or sunlit, sheltered patios. Most phenotypes wrap up around eight to nine weeks of bloom, rewarding attentive feeding and airflow with moderate to high yields of glittering, lime-to-forest green colas brushed with amber pistils. On the palate it’s layered and clean—zesty citrus over foresty pine that fades to confectionary sweetness—while the effect profile tracks upbeat and grounded: clear, happy lift up front settling into a smooth, body-forward calm. THC expression skews high with only trace CBD, reflecting its lineage. Built for growers chasing bag appeal and a refined sweet-gas bouquet, Caramel Valley showcases Tsunami Seeds’ knack for pairing classic West Coast structure with modern pastry-shop flavors. Expect strong OG aromas during cure and buds that trim easily yet hold weight.

name: Lemon Tsunami
description: Lemon Tsunami by Tsunami Seed Co rolls modern dessert genetics into a bright, citrus wave. Built from Lemon Cookies and Caramel Tsunami (Butterscotch Pie x Wedding Crasher), it leans indica but keeps a nimble, clear head. Expect a layered bouquet: fresh lemon zest and sugared citrus from Lemon Cookies, creamy caramel and cookie dough from the Tsunami line, and a faint diesel‑pine echo in the finish. Dominant terpenes typically show as limonene with caryophyllene and myrcene. Plants stay medium in stature with a modest stretch, stacking frosty, calyx‑forward colas that finish in about 60 days. Yields are solid and tidy, with resin‑heavy buds that break to a candy‑lemon aroma. The ride opens upbeat and focused before easing into a happy, relaxed, euphoric calm without leaden weight. THC usually lands in the moderate‑to‑high zone while CBD remains low. Credit Tsunami Seed Co.’s selection for fusing the lemon‑sweetness of Lemon Cookies with the creamy body and structure of Caramel Tsunami, itself refined from Butterscotch Pie and Wedding Crasher. For growers and tasters chasing a clean lemon profile anchored to contemporary cookie lineage, Lemon Tsunami offers a balanced, garden‑friendly expression that delivers flavor, frost, and consistency in equal measure. Expect smooth trims and easy training.

name: Ravens Furry
description: Ravens Fury by Tsunami Seed Co. swoops in as an indica-leaning hybrid, born from Ravens Revenge and Animal Tsunami. The pedigree whispers of Pie Hoe and Caramel Tsunami on one side (with Wedding Crasher sweetness in the mix) and Animal Cookies x Caramel Tsunami on the other, stacking dessert-shop terpenes against a classic kush backbone. In the garden, this cultivar tends to build dense, frosted spears with occasional violet flecks, finishing around the 60-day mark under lights and yielding respectably for its structure. Expect a nose that blends grape and vanilla cookie overtones with a grounded, earthy pine, an expression often steered by caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. The flavor follows through, coating the palate in sweet pastry tones before a resin-rich, herbal exhale. Effects lean soothing and euphoric without losing uplift, settling the body while brightening mood and focus. THC typically dominates while CBD stays minimal, keeping the experience assertive but polished. Ravens Fury captures Tsunami's house style - confectionery aromas dialed into sturdy, workable plants - making it a compelling pick for breeders chasing flavor and growers who value consistency. Credit to Tsunami Seed Co. for curating a lineage that reads like a modern greatest hits while still feeling fresh and singular. A poised, glassy finisher for flavor-first gardens.

name: Whole Fruits
description: Whole Fruits distills the candy-forward modern lineage of Apples & Bananas and Lemon Cherry Gelato into a vivid, fruit-syrup bouquet that lives up to its name. Selected and created by Round Table Selections, this hybrid expresses dense, resin-gilded colas that flash lime to deep violet under heavy trichome frost. Cracking a jar releases layers of tropical citrus and ripe fruit - think acai bowl and poolside POG - anchored by an LCG hint of gas. Dominant terpenes typically include myrcene, humulene, and caryophyllene, shaping an upbeat profile that many describe as happy, giggly, and gently energizing. In lab results across batches, THC commonly lands in the low-30s, with observed ranges around 27-37% and CBD near trace (~0.08%). Indoors, plants respond to training with medium vigor and a tidy, cookie-leaning structure, finishing in about 56-63 days. Yields are medium but impressive in bag appeal: tightly stacked, sugar-dusted flowers with bright orange pistils. Whether you chase new-school fruit terps or crave a clean, modern hybrid that cuts through the crowd, Whole Fruits offers a polished take on two of the decade's defining parents — Compound/Cookies' Apples & Bananas and Backpack Boyz' Lemon Cherry Gelato - realized through Fig Farms' meticulous pheno hunting.

name: Orange Juice by Team Elite
description: Orange Juice by Team Elite Genetics splashes out of the jar with the juice-bar zest its name promises. Bred in Orange County, this 80/20 sativa-dominant hybrid pairs Green Crack with Grandma's Cookies x Tangie pheno #3, merging classic daytime drive with confectionary citrus. Expect vivid aromas of fresh-cut orange, sweet rind and tangy citrus, carried by a terpene profile led by beta-myrcene with bright limonene and a pinch of caryophyllene. The effect lands fast and clean: racy cerebral energy, heightened focus and easy creativity that lift mood while a smooth body buzz keeps things composed. Lab results routinely show THC in the mid-to-high 20s (about 25-30%) with only trace CBD below 0.3%, matched to dense, calyx-forward buds frosted in trichomes and laced with neon pistils. Orange Juice's credentials are as bold as its flavor - 2nd Place Sativa Flower at the 2019 High Times Cannabis Cup SoCal and 3rd Place Sativa Flower at the 2019 HT NorCal - underscoring Team Elite Genetics' craft pedigree. On the palate it tastes like a glass of pulpy, just-squeezed orange with a fruity, sweet, juicy finish. For collectors of citrus-forward cultivars, Orange Juice captures Tangie brightness, cookies creaminess and Green Crack's unmistakable snap in a single, award-proven phenotype. Bred by Team Elite Genetics.

name: Cookie Dough by Team Elite
description: Cookie Dough by Team Elite Genetics is a full indica born from Grandma's Cookies and Original Gangster (Elmer's OG). The bouquet is classic OG gas folded into warm bakery notes reminiscent of fresh cookie dough; on the palate, expect pungent diesel, gentle sweetness, and an earthy bassline. Dense, sugar-crusted buds flash dark emerald calyxes with occasional violet hues and a thick carpet of trichomes that hints at formidable potency. Dominant terpenes beta-caryophyllene, beta-myrcene, and alpha-humulene steer the experience toward spicy, herbal depth and a deeply relaxing, body-forward character. The effect rolls in like a weighted blanket, settling the limbs and quieting the tempo while leaving a soft lift of contentment behind. Honored with 3rd place for Indica Flower at the 2019 High Times SoCal Cup, this cut showcases Team Elite's living-soil craft and meticulous curing in a rich, dialed-in expression of OG lineage. Fans of old-school fuel and dessert-forward cultivars will recognize its gassy-doughy throughline from first sniff to final exhale, a steady, satisfying arc that lingers on the tongue and in the room. Expect compact, broad-leaf structure and tight, resin-laden flowers that grind to a fragrant, doughy powder, echoing its name long after the jar is cracked.

name: F3Z
description: F3Z by Capulator brings together the candy-forward Zkittlez and a worked MAC F-3 selection to create a glistening, indica-leaning hybrid with contemporary pedigree. In the jar it leans bright and confectionary - citrus zest over tropical fruity sweetness - then settles into a creamy, almost dessert-like finish, a profile that nods to limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene steering the nose. Plants show medium stature and sturdy branching with dense, heavily frosted colas that reward a dialed environment. Indoors, expect a medium-to-high yields around 400-500 g/m2; outdoors, well-tended plants can top roughly 600 g apiece. F3Z typically completes bloom in 56-70 days, with the last two weeks stacking on a vivid sugar crust and deepening pastels. Potency trends high in the modern lane - often in the low-to-mid 20s THC - with negligible CBD, translating to a polished, mood-brightening lift that stays comfortable as the body eases. The lineage is the star: Zkittlez contributes the rainbow-candy top note and color, while MAC F-3 contributes structure, resin density, and that faint hint of gas underneath the cream. Designed by Capulator for collectors who prize flavor and frost in equal measure, F3Z reads like a curated snapshot of two era-defining lines, rendered with balance and intention. Growers report medium height and a cooperative, moderately demanding cultivation curve.

name: Sapphire Solstice
description: Sapphire Solstice shines as a fruit-forward, indica-dominant hybrid from Doja Seeds, created by crossing Grape Mochi with Papayamosa. The bouquet opens with sweet berries and tropical fruit before a grounding thread of earthy spice appears; on the palate those tones return as berry jam, ripe mango and papaya notes, and a peppery, caryophyllene snap. Myrcene, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene lead the terpene stack, shaping an effect that lifts mood and focus early, then eases into a smooth, tranquil body calm. Plants show a tidy, medium stature with sturdy branching and resin-drenched colas, rewarding careful training with consistently high yields indoors or out. Expect a flowering window of roughly 55-65 days and dense, sugar-coated flowers that broadcast their candy-gelato lineage. In character, Sapphire Solstice marries the dessert richness of Grape Mochi with Papayamosa's bright papaya-mimosa citrus, delivering a modern, candy-tropical profile without overwhelming heaviness. Potency is robust, with THC commonly testing above 25% and reports around 27% on select phenos, putting it in the high range, yet the ride stays balanced: euphoric, creative, and comfortably relaxed rather than couch-locking. For growers and flavor chasers alike, this Doja Seeds release captures the long, golden glow its name promises.

name: Party Wave by Tsunami Seeds
description: Party Wave from Tsunami Seed Co paddles in on a proven cross: Wedding Crasher x Animal Tsunami. Expect dense, cookie-style flowers with lime-to-forest greens and occasional violet flecks, glazed in heavy trichomes. The nose rides a grape-and-vanilla swell from Wedding Crasher before a piney, nutty caramel undertow from Animal Tsunami rolls through; on the palate, grape, vanilla, and pine lead the set. Caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene headline the terpene stack, shaping a profile that feels bright yet grounded. Growers can plan for a vigorous veg and a moderate stretch into flower, with a typical indoor finish around 56-70 days and yields in the medium-to-high lane - roughly 450 g per m2 inside and 600 g per plant outdoors when dialed. The genotype trends indica-leaning hybrid, and data from the parents inform expected potency in the mid-to-high twenties for THC, often 24-31%, with CBD in trace amounts. The effect story blends Wedding Crasher's chatty uplift with Animal Tsunami's smooth body calm, landing in a happy, relaxed, and gently uplifted space. Credited to Tsunami Seed Co, Party Wave offers beach-day sociability backed by composed depth, making it a compelling selection for pheno hunters seeking resinous structure, manageable internode spacing, and reliably loud, dessert-forward aromatics.

name: RumChata

Phenotypes typically show a vigorous early stretch and tight internodal spacing, stacking dense, frost-laden flowers that finish in 56–70 days. Indoors, RumChata rewards training with high yields; outdoors it shows strong apical growth and can run tall when given long summer light. Potency reflects its parentage: THC commonly lands in the low-to-high 20s with negligible CBD, translating to a rounded experience that arrives euphoric, settles into happy clarity, and resolves in deep body calm without flattening sociability. Breeder Tsunami Seed co offers RumChata as regular seed, a nod to selectors seeking structure, resin, and confectionary flavors in one line. In the jar, expect pale emeralds flared with violet, thick white trichomes, and caramel-sugar aromatics that echo its name. A modern hybrid built for flavor and production, RumChata threads dessert notes and depth into a resilient, wash-friendly cultivar. Flower rooms with good airflow highlight its glossy resin and keep colas uniform.

name: The Tank by The TenCo
description: Built for power and polish, The Tank by The TenCo marries Sherbanger and Tenbanger into a balanced hybrid that looks and hits like heavy artillery. Expect dense, bright-to-deep green flowers iced in resin and laced with vivid orange pistils, exuding a sweet-and-sour citrus bouquet over diesel and candy notes. Under the hood, limonene and caryophyllene steer that gassy citrus profile with a sprinkling of dessert sweetness. In the garden, The Tank grows vigorously indoors or out; screen-of-green and thoughtful training amplify already generous yields. Flowering typically wraps in 55 to 75 days, rewarding patient cultivators with stacks of glittering, photogenic colas. Credit goes to The TenCo, a Los Angeles label with a crowded trophy case, for dialing this cross to a 10/10 finish that honors Sherbanger's fuel-rich lineage and Tenbanger's punchy charisma. If you chase connoisseur bag appeal, a tactile frost, and effects that arrive on cue, The Tank delivers a complete package - precision-built for seasoned palates and collectors alike. Expect compact internodes, sturdy lateral branching, and harvests rated high when dialed in.

name: Wazabi by Ten Co
description: Wazabi from The Ten Co is the savory outlier of the Zushi family, a balanced hybrid born from Zkittlez and Kush Mints #10. Cracking a jar releases wasabi-like heat and pepper over a Kush-fueled backbone, then a bright flicker of grapefruit cuts through, finishing with resinous pine. Dominant terpenes caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene steer that profile: caryophyllene drives dry, spicy warmth, limonene adds citrus sparkle, and myrcene grounds it in earthy depth. Expect dense, sugar-dusted colas with lime-to-forest greens and orange pistils - classic Zkittlez structure boosted by Mint genetics. Onset lifts clean and euphoric before settling into an even, relaxing glide; creative focus arrives early, while body ease rolls in and holds. Indoors, Wazabi typically flowers in 56-63 days and yields are steady rather than excessive, rewarding good canopy control with tightly stacked, high-resin buds and vivid bag appeal. Plants trend medium in height and respond well to topping and light defoliation, staying compact yet productive. Bred in-house by The Ten Co, Wazabi channels the Zushi playbook away from candy and into spice, herb, and gas - a modern profile for fans who want depth over dessert without sacrificing potency or polish. Its balanced 50/50 character shows in the ride: uplifted, creative headspace paired with a calm, relaxed body that lingers long after the last exhale.

name: Strawberry Truffle by Detroit Seed Company
description: Born in Detroit’s breeding scene, Strawberry Truffle by Detroit Seed Company marries White Truffle with Red Pop to create a hybrid that wears its lineage on the nose. The effect arrives fast and bright: euphoric, focused, and uplifted, yet clean enough to steer clear of couchlock. Typical THC sits in the low 20s (around 22%) with trace CBD under 1%. Growers can expect medium indoor stature that stretches to tall outdoors, with sturdy lateral branching and thick, silvered colas. Tomahawk takes 70 to 84 days to finish and rewards patience with heavy yields; experienced hands often pull about 600 g per square meter inside and chunky outdoor plants that stack weight. Born from Sour Diesel's heady charge and Biker Kush's OG backbone, this Ten Co pheno channels old school gas with modern bag appeal, a sharp, frosty throwback that wears its lineage proudly.
