name: Triple Dip
description: Triple Dip from Jungle Boys brings two house favorites together, pairing Perfect Triangle (Perfect OG x Triangle Kush Bx1) with 06 OG #12 for a contemporary, OG‑driven hybrid. Bulky, olive buds showcase a classic OG frame—medium internodes, foxtail‑free crowns, and a heavy coat of frost—backing an aroma that layers smooth pine and skunky fuel over a cool menthol finish. Caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene lead a terpene roster that also includes humulene, linalool, bisabolol, and pinene, translating to resinous conifer on the grind and a sour‑gas/mint snap on the exhale. Effects track the profile: steady euphoria and uplifted focus roll into calm, happy relaxation without losing clarity. Florida batches commonly test around 26–29% THC with trace CBD near 0.06–0.07%, reflecting its potency‑first pedigree. In the garden, Triple Dip trends OG in behavior, with moderate stretch, medium height, and a 60–70 day indoor bloom; dialed rooms see medium yields with dense, trichome‑rich flowers. Created by Jungle Boys, Triple Dip reads like a polished love letter to old‑school gas, distilling Perfect Triangle’s pine‑menthol bite and 06 OG’s diesel weight into a clean, modern expression.

name: Chef by Blueprint
description: Chef by Blueprint plates up the candy-forward, gas-kissed personality of Zoap BX1 with a polished, mouth-coating finish that lives up to its name. Selected in-house by Blueprint's breeding and pheno-hunting program, Chef leans hybrid in structure and effect, stacking dense, frosted calyxes that flash lime and violet while orange threads swirl through the trichome gloss. Crack the jar and the room brightens with floral top notes over sweet confection, backed by a modern diesel twang; on the palate those flavors land broad and silky, the kind of fullness Blueprint calls "mouth coating." The high trends social and euphoric with a clear creative lift, a vibe that makes conversation flow without heavy drag. Lab results around 25% THC with trace CBD keep the profile firmly potent yet balanced by terpene richness typical of the Zoap BX1 line. While Chef isn't released as seed, cultivators familiar with Zoap BX1 cuts will recognize a timely finish in the eight-to-nine-week window and a tidy, medium-height canopy that responds well to precise indoor dialing. Equal parts candy and fuel, Chef distills the pedigree of its parent, Zoap BX1, into a refined house cut that showcases Blueprint's exacting craft. Aromas trend bright and clean, with floral-citrus lift riding atop confection and gas.

name: Gravitron
description: Gravitron pulls you into orbit with unapologetic fuel and pepper, a collision of Zero Gravity (GMO x Oreoz) and Motorbreath #15 (Chem D x SFV OG) hand-selected by Shauncron. The nose opens with diesel and earthy spice, then a doughy, garlicky undercurrent from the Zero Gravity side rounds the edges. On the palate it stays gassy and grounded - diesel, earthy, and peppery - before tapering into a clean, lingering finish. Dominant terpenes typically trend toward limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, reinforcing that citrus-snap, herbal depth, and warm bite. Most batches land around 22-24% THC with trace CBD, translating to a fast, weighty onset that settles the body while keeping the mood quietly upbeat. Plants show medium stature and thick, resin-jacketed calyxes; indoors, expect a 70-77 day bloom, stacking best with a steady trellis and moderate EC. Yields are solidly medium with standout bag appeal - frosted OG spears kissed by Zero Gravity's sugar-crystal sheen. In the bowl, Gravitron leans classic and couch-friendly without turning blunt; the glide is relaxed, happy, and eventually unhurriedly sleepy. Built on a pedigree known for punch and polish, this modern hybrid feels purpose-tuned for evening sessions and focused craftsmanship, and its gassy signature makes it easy to spot - long before the jar is open.

name: Neon Mango
description: Neon Mango is a boutique hybrid selected by Florida breeder Shauncron from a canceled pheno-hunt, where Neonz - an OGZ x Z41 cross - met Archive's Lemon Cane. The pairing lives up to its name: ripe mango and lemon-peel aromatics ride out of the jar, backed by faint candy cream and a whisper of fuel. Dense, resin-frosted flowers show lime and forest greens with occasional violet streaks, reflecting the Gelato-leaning Z41 heritage. On the palate, sweet mango leads, brightened by citrus and a touch of sweetness, before resolving into a creamy, gassy finish. Effects tend to start fast with an uplifting, euphoric headspace that keeps spirits high and conversation flowing, then settle into a calm, even body float without heavy couch-lock. Growers can expect medium height and structure with moderate difficulty, thanks to the Dosidos influence tightening up flower formation. Flowering typically finishes in 60-67 days, with medium yields and a terpene profile that often leans limonene and myrcene over a caryophyllene base, echoing the strain's tropical-citrus character. Credit for the selection goes to Shauncron; expect occasional Florida drops under the Cookies banner. Lineage: Neonz (OGZ x Z41) x Lemon Cane. Neon Mango captures exotic dessert-forward "Z" flavors while adding sharpened lemon zest and polish for a modern, crowd-pleasing profile.

name: Jello Biafra
description: Jello Biafra is a regular seed release from Cannarado Genetics that pairs Tropicana with Zkittlez/Zawtz, aiming to blend bright, zesty citrus and orange notes with candy-forward tropical tones and a hint of gas. Expect a 65–70 day flowering window and modern hybrid vigor that reflects its sativa-leaning Tropicana influence balanced by the candy-gas depth of the Zkittlez/Zawtz side. Phenotypes commonly express citrus, orange, and tropical aromas, while effects reported from its parent lines tend to skew uplifting, happy, and energetic, with typical dry-mouth/dry-eye style side notes at higher doses. This cross targets growers and flavor hunters who enjoy vivid terpene expressions without excessively long bloom times, and it fits well in mixed gardens seeking a citrus-candy centerpiece.

name: Grits and Jam
description: Grits and Jam from Turtle Pie Co lives up to its breakfast-table name, pouring out a syrupy bouquet of berry jam over warm cream with an earthy, kush-leaning underpinning. The lineage is kept in-house by the breeder, but the profile tells a story of dessert-forward genetics sharpened with a faint thread of floral gas. Dense, resin-frosted colas show deep forest greens washed in violet with burnt-orange pistils and a sugar-dusted trichome shell. Typical batches test in the high twenties, with THC often around 26–33% and trace CBD below 0.3%, while myrcene, limonene, and linalool lead the terpene chorus. The first inhale lands sweet and bright—berry and vanilla—before easing into creamy earth; the finish lingers with a clean, gassy snap. The effect builds smoothly from an uplifted, euphoric headspace into calm, couch-comfy composure without muting the senses, making music and conversation feel effortless. In the garden, expect a hybrid stance with sturdy lateral branching and heavy resin potential; indoors it rewards careful dialing of environment and feed with standout bag appeal and aromatic intensity. Crafted by Turtle Pie Co, Grits and Jam is the brand’s flavor-first ethos bottled in bud form: indulgent, polished, and unmistakably connoisseur. Expect slow, satisfying burns in the bowl.

name: Sake
description: Sin City Seeds' Sake' blends Apples & Bananas and Blue Power IX2 into a vigorous, indica-leaning hybrid with a 65/35 profile. Expect medium-height plants with strong lateral branching and tight internodes, finishing in 55-65 days. The cross channels A&B's dessert-fruit profile and Blue Power's BP funk, yielding dense, resinous colas that wash well; typical indoor harvests reach 450-750 g/m2 when dialed. The bouquet leans berry-forward with sour kush and earthy accents; ground flowers echo tart apple and ripe banana over kush spice. Effects arrive in two waves: a bright, happy lift and easy focus that melt into calm, body-centered relaxation without full couch-lock. Growers report an easygoing temperament, responsive to topping and SCROG, with consistent medium stature indoors and outdoors. Height and yield make Sake' a practical production choice, while its flavor complexity keeps connoisseurs engaged. Dominant terpenes vary by selection, but caryophyllene and limonene often show alongside a supporting myrcene line, reinforcing the sweet-sour, kushy edge. THC levels depend on phenotype and environment; CBD is typically low. Credit to Sin City Seeds for revisiting Blue Power's legacy within a modern fruit profile--Sake' distills their house style into a compact, high-impact package that is as workable in the room as it is memorable in the jar.

name: Bat Rabies
description: Bred by Duke of Doja and released through Doja Exclusive in collaboration with Higher Vibrations and Doja EK, Bat Rabies is an indica‑leaning hybrid whose name hints at feral intensity. Its three-way lineage—GMO x Zkittlez x 18 Coffins—shows up immediately: diesel‑tinted garlic and earthy umami from GMO, candy‑sweet cream and flowers from Zkittlez, and deeper gas and body from 18 Coffins. The nose is gassy, funky, and rich; the flavor tracks sweet and creamy with floral diesel and a faint sour edge, finishing thick and mouth‑coating. Dense, resin‑caked calyxes stack into tight, medium‑sized buds that sparkle under light. Reported effects start with an airy, euphoric lift and a behind‑the‑eyes tingle before settling into a relaxed, upbeat calm; many describe feeling euphoric, relaxed, and uplifted without losing clarity. Expect a THC‑leaning chemistry with minimal CBD and a terpene drive likely led by caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene. Cultivators note a moderate flowering window and balanced production from vigorous plants with compact internodes, making indoor height management straightforward and outdoor canopies pleasantly orderly. However you encounter it, Bat Rabies distills the savory‑fuel character of GMO and the confectionary brightness of Zkittlez into a unified profile, then deepens the mix with 18 Coffins’ weight—an unmistakable expression from Doja’s circle.

name: Permanent Marker S1
description: Permanent Marker S1 captures the unmistakable personality of the modern classic by selfing a standout cut of Permanent Marker, itself a three-way creation from Biscotti x Jealousy crossed to Sherb Bx1. Expect a vivid bouquet that reads like floral ink over candy and gas: think sweet-and-citrus top notes with a diesel undercurrent and a distinctly soapy, flowery lift. Dominant terpenes commonly include myrcene, limonene, caryophyllene, and linalool, which together shape its loud aroma and layered flavor. This indica-leaning hybrid (roughly 60/40) typically tests in the mid-to-high 20s THC with trace CBD, translating to a euphoric, relaxing, and gently uplifting ride that carries a polished, anytime versatility. In the garden, S1 seeds show medium stature, resin-soaked calyx stacking, and manageable stretch; indoors they thrive on balanced nutrition and stable VPD. Flowering wraps in about 56–70 days, and dialed runs can push high yields around 450–550 g/m² with dense, frost-heavy colas. Outdoor plants mature with a similarly medium profile and rewarding weight per plant. Seed Junky Genetics set the template; Permanent Marker later earned top-shelf acclaim, and this S1 keeps its award-winning character intact while packaging it into a uniform, keeper-hunting seed line perfect for hash or head-stash alike.

name: Aloha Breath
description: Floraganixs Aloha Breath blends island-bright sparkle with frost-heavy poise, born from Truffaloha #2 and Platinum Chimera Breath #16. In the room it starts coy and earthy, then opens to berries and high-octane fuel, a profile that points to a terp stack led by myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene. Plants show average stretch and sturdy branching; calyxes stack tight and quickly sugar over, often finishing with a silver sheen that betrays the lines trichome output. Most growers will see a friendly, cooperative habit and nice, dependable yields across the canopy. Indoors, the flowering window lands right around 65 to 70 days, with phenos clustering near the midpoint. On the nose and palate, expect earthy berries over a diesel hum, carried by a sweet finish. The experience tends to open upbeat and euphoric before settling into a contented calm, a relaxed clarity equally at home with low-key sessions or winding down the day. THC generally leans on the stronger side while CBD remains trace. Aloha Breath keeps the spirit of its parents intact: Truffaloha #2 brings creamy tropical punch and balance, while Platinum Chimera Breath #16 deepens the gas and density. Bred and released by Floraganix as feminized seed, this cross is crafted for growers who prize flavor, frost, and finish.

name: Big Perm
description: Big Perm from Floraganix is the kind of cultivar that fills a room before you even finish breaking it up. Bred as part of the breeder’s Scarface line, it merges Permanent Chimera with Scarface to create a hybrid that balances modern gas with plush fruit. The nose leads with diesel-and-marker ink overtones before slipping into black-cherry liquor and a sweet, funky finish; those flavors translate on the palate as berry, chemical, and fuel notes. Under lights, plants often throw royal-purple accents late in bloom and stack heavy, resin-glossed colas built for solventless pulls. Expect a 65–70 day flowering window and large to XL returns when dialed, with limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool commonly steering the terpene mix. Reported effects lean upbeat and social—energetic, happy, and euphoric at the onset—settling into a calm body glow that keeps the experience composed rather than sleepy. Typical batches test high in THC around the upper-20s, with many reports landing near 27%, while CBD stays negligible. Whether you are chasing flavor, bag appeal, or hashability, Big Perm shows why Floraganix’s selections have a reputation for loud profiles and production-minded structure without the fuss. Growers note Big Perm prefers moderate training, shows a 1.5–2x stretch, and rewards attentive feedings with dense, spear-to-golf-ball tops.

name: Kush n Keyz
description: Floraganix Genetics' Kush 'N Keyz R1 tunes Scarface's diesel-soaked muscle to the finesse of Platinum Chimera Breath #16, unlocking a hybrid that feels both modern and unmistakably kush. Medium in stature yet stocky in build, the plants stack chunky, resin-armored colas whose calyxes glitter like sugar. Crack a jar and the room swings from loud gas and sharp diesel to a sweet, creamy backnote; some tasters catch hints of vanilla and spice from the Platinum side. The first puffs lift with a clean, euphoric snap before the body loosens into relaxed, happy composure, a balance that makes its potency obvious without blaring. In the garden, Kush 'N Keyz R1 finishes in roughly 60-65 days and, when dialed, pushes medium-to-high production with frost that begs for the hash bag. Its terp-forward profile is the star: an assertive gassy-diesel core wrapped in confectionery sweetness, supported by dense, trichome-sheathed flowers that cure to silver-lavender hues. THC dominates while CBD remains minimal, emphasizing vivid flavor and a confident, full-bodied effect. Credit to Floraganix for pairing Scarface with Platinum Chimera Breath #16 so tastefully; Kush 'N Keyz R1 lands like a well-cut key, precise and satisfying, snapping cleanly into the lock. Expect medium height, chunky structure, and resin that seals deals.

name: Juice N Keyz
description: Juice N Keyz from Floraganix Genetics fuses a terpinolene-bright Terple (Hawaiian Punch cut) with the brand’s diesel-drenched Kush n Keyz to deliver a modern hybrid that smells like a splash of sour fuel over caramel-dipped green apples. The bouquet unfolds further as the cure settles, teasing lilac-kush undertones and faint chemical-oil accents borrowed from the Keyz side, while Terple keeps the top notes clean, citrusy, and tropical. Plants tend to stack dense, frosted calyxes on sturdy midsize frames and finish in about 65 days indoors, rewarding attentive training with a tidy, medium yield of resin-heavy buds. Expect an effect profile that starts bright and social—uplifted, happy, focused—and eases into a comfortable, gently relaxing body tone without losing clarity. Typical lab results lean THC-forward with CBD in trace amounts, and the terpene mix often puts terpinolene, limonene, and caryophyllene in the spotlight, with supporting humulene and linalool depending on selection. Growers report moderate difficulty: the cross tolerates common feed schedules, appreciates airflow, and stays manageable in height both inside and out. Whether you are chasing fruit-forward gas in the jar or sticky, crystalline structure on the branch, Juice N Keyz captures the best of its parents in a compact, collectible package.

name: Octane Candy
description: Octane Candy distills the candy-meets-gas wave into a single, loud cultivar. Bred by Floraganix Genetics, its lineage stacks Lemon Cherry Gelato with Runtz, then folds in Deep Fried Banana Truffle to push frosty density, dessert aromatics, and a fuel-laced finish. Dried flowers burst with sweet confection and light cream backed by tropical banana phenos; break a nug and that sugar rush turns toward clean petrol and warm pastry. Plants stay manageable in height yet stack thick colas that glitter under light, often needing a touch of support late in bloom. Indoors, expect generous yields of tight, resin-glazed buds and a surprisingly easy trim. Most phenotypes finish in 60-65 days, hitting a balanced hybrid stride that feels upbeat and content without getting racy. The profile leans modern: candy brightness anchored by soft cream and diesel, with the kind of terp saturation hash lovers chase. While lab numbers vary, Octane Candy typically presents as THC-forward with trace CBD. On the palate it opens sweet, shifts to silky cream, and lands on polished gas, leaving a lingering dessert echo. Bred with care by Floraganix, it rewards attention with aromatic intensity and photogenic, sugar-frosted structure. Expect loud room-filling scent and jar appeal to match.

name: Kool-Aid Sherb
description: Kool-Aid Sherb by Floraganix lives up to its playful name with a punch-bowl nose and candy-glossed resin. This hybrid merges Super Sherb with the Floraganix cut Kush N Keyz #13, stacking tall, vigorous plants that frost hard as flowers mature. Aromas swing from tropical punch to grape, with creamy sherb, confectionary sweetness, and tiny streaks of kerosene. The flavor follows suit: bright grape-tropical upfront, soft dessert tones in the mid, and a whisper of fuel on the finish. Expect an upbeat, happy lift that gradually softens into a smooth, relaxed cruise, making it easygoing yet engaging. Growers can anticipate strong stretch and medium to large yields; the line is noted for XL structure, dense calyxes, and heavy trichome coverage. Indoors it typically finishes in about 65 to 70 days of flower. The terpene spectrum often reads citrus and spice over a sweet base, suggesting limonene and caryophyllene with supporting myrcene. While formal lab ranges vary by producer, modern potency and thick resin make this cultivar attractive for both showpiece flower and extraction. Credit goes to Floraganix for pairing fruit-forward sherb character with Keyz lineage to create a cultivar that smells like a summer drink and looks dipped in sugar. Expect vibrant bag appeal.

name: Sour Keyz
description: Sour Keyz from Floraganix is a boutique hybrid that pairs tropical sparkle with kushy depth. Built as Sour Keyz R1 from Pina Colada and the Floraganix-selected Kush N Keyz #13, it layers sour-berry candy over creamy pina colada tones, with faint edges of fuel and caramel drifting through the finish. Expect vigorous, well-branched plants with improved structure and dense, resin-caked flowers that excel for hash work. Indoors, Sour Keyz typically finishes in 60–65 days and stacks into medium-to-large yields; outdoors, it maintains a compact, manageable profile with notably sticky colas. While cannabinoid levels vary by selection and environment, the cultivar trends THC-forward with trace CBD, and frequently expresses a terpene trio led by limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene to reinforce its citrus, berry, and subtle diesel accents. On the palate, tart fruit lands first, then a soft wave of pineapple-and-cream, before a gentle gas note rounds out the exhale. The effect profile blends an upbeat, euphoric lift from the Pina Colada side with the calm, body-centered ease of Kush N Keyz, settling into a bright, relaxed groove that feels both celebratory and composed. Bred and released in limited fashion by Floraganix, Sour Keyz rewards flavor chasers and extractors alike.

name: Space Fuel by Floraganix
description: Bred by Floraganix, Space Fuel by Floraganix rockets classic gas and dessert profiles into one loud hybrid by pairing Gasonade with Deep Fried Banana Truffle. Expect a room-filling nose that blends sweet fuel and a hint of acetone with creamy cake-and-jam tones, while Gasonade’s citrus-fuel and vanilla layers sharpen the edges. Plants grow uniform and slightly above average in size, stacking dense, resin-drenched colas with standout bag appeal. Indoors, Space Fuel by Floraganix typically finishes around day 65, though select phenotypes can run to 70; the line is known for larger-than-average yields without sacrificing frost or structure. The terpene expression suggests a limonene drive over a base of caryophyllene and myrcene, reading as lemon-zest fuel over creamy pastry and light sour glue. On the palate, the profile stays cohesive—diesel and chemical sparkle up front before a smooth, creamy finish. Effects trend balanced and modern: an uplifting, happy onset that settles into a relaxed, content cruise, avoiding heaviness while keeping the mood buoyant. With its hash-friendly resin coverage and THC-rich potential alongside typically low CBD, Space Fuel by Floraganix rewards careful dry-and-cure work and shines in both jars and presses. Credit to Floraganix for a cross that feels dialed, flavorful, and production-ready.

name: Sugah Stix
description: Sugah Stix from Floraganix Genetics twists candy-shop charm with streetwise gas, a resin-soaked hybrid born from Dip N Stix and Scarface. Expect an immediate waft of sweet diesel layered with a faint sour fizz; the nose translates cleanly to flavor, where sugary notes, a nip of citrus-sour, and a low, gassy hum linger on the palate. Plants stay average in stature with sturdy lateral branching and dense, frost-packed colas that sparkle like powdered sugar, a trait that makes this cultivar a favorite for hash-minded growers. Indoors, Sugah Stix finishes quickly-most phenotypes wrap in 50-65 days-and produces medium to high yields without demanding elite-level technique. The ride is balanced: a bright, euphoric lift up top settles into a smooth, body-loosening calm, keeping mood buoyant and outlook refreshed without heavy couchlock. While cannabinoid numbers vary by cut, CBD remains minimal and THC typically leans high for modern hybrids. The lineage shows in the jar-Dip N Stix lends confection and pace, Scarface tightens structure and depth-delivering a polished, boutique profile that stands out on the tray and in the press. Terpene expression skews sweet-gas with occasional floral edges, and dried buds cure to a silvery lime with vivid orange threads. Expect average height and manageable stretch in most rooms.

name: White Flamingo
description: White Flamingo by Floraganix struts into the garden with boutique swagger, a frost-heavy hybrid bred from Oklahoma Coma #20 and Scarface. Expect striking phenotype range from compact, sticky colas to taller, more sativa-leaning frames, all draped in a shimmering coat of trichomes. In the jar it opens with unapologetic fuel and industrial-chemical notes before rolling into fermenting tropical fruit and candied citrus, a profile that hints at caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene at the helm. On the nose and palate it rides the line between diesel grit and island candy, finishing clean and loud. Indoors, White Flamingo is production-minded, stacking weight with heavy to heavy-plus yields and a finish in roughly 65–70 days; the resin-drenched flowers and consistent structure also make it a natural fit for hash work. Truffle Too contributes brute vigor and gassy density from its Dip N Stix backbone, while Scarface layers in high-octane fuel and a slick tropical twist. The result is a vividly aromatic, visually plush cultivar that balances mood-brightening lift with a relaxing, body-forward glide. For cultivators and extractors alike, White Flamingo delivers boutique character without sacrificing speed, structure, or bag appeal.

name: Bianchetti Buttercream
description: Bianchetti Buttercream is BeLeaf Cannabis's lush, truffle-forward mashup, pairing Truffle Cake with Truffaloha #1. Born from a White Truffle-heavy family tree, this cultivar leans into savory confection: think buttercream frosting whipped through earth and faint garlic, finishing with a silky, creamy sweetness. Plants tend to stretch tall and vigorous, stacking dense, silvered calyxes as bloom progresses; selected phenotypes show notably heavy production alongside the shimmering resin BeLeaf selections are known for. Mid-to-late flower is where the name clicks, as the room fills with a decadent truffle-butter aroma and the flowers crust over in frost. On the palate, expect earthy base notes lifted by butter and cream, with a plush mouthfeel that lingers. Reported effects skew uplifting and contented before settling into a calm, body-forward ease, a profile that reflects its lineage. While not designed as a beginner’s hunt, the payoff for a skilled hand is standout bag appeal and jars that cure into luxurious, bakery-meets-forest funk. For the lineage-minded: Truffle Cake brings White Truffle crossed to Pancakes; Truffaloha #1 marries White Truffle with a Hawaiian Punch cut of Platinum Punch #1. Bred and released by BeLeaf Cannabis, Bianchetti Buttercream celebrates the house’s truffle era with modern dessert polish. Expect tall frames and medium-to-high yields in dialed rooms.

name: BiPolar Paradise R1
description: BiPolar Paradise R1 arrives with the kind of mystique BeLeaf Cannabis builds into many limited releases: a resin-forward hybrid flagged with the R1 tag, indicating a first reversed filial made to lock in a specific look, aroma, and structure. While the breeder has not publicly detailed the exact parentage, the name hints at a meeting of bright, tropical notes and deeper fuel tones, the two poles that often define BeLeaf's most sought-after work. Citrus Pulp is a vibrant showcase of Tahoe Nugz’s selection sense and Klutch’s finish.

name: Milk and Cookies

Growers must know that these aromatic ladies are moderately challenging to grow. They reach tall heights, making pruning and topping highly recommended, and can produce remarkable yields ranging up to 550g/m² with approximately 63 flowering days, on average. The Milk and Cookies flavor is exactly how you’d hope it to be: creamy, nutty, and buttery. The aroma takes it up a notch, adding more complexity through layers of chocolate, cheese, and some faint diesel. Consumers may expect a balanced experience with effects that put you in a happy mood in no time. You’ll probably feel creatively inspired and somewhat euphoric before the body buzz kicks in, leaving you properly sedated and getting sleepier by the minute. These soothing effects and its relatively accessible potency make Mild and Cookies an ideal strain for medical patients seeking relief from cramps, PTSD, depression, and arthritis.

Indoors it finishes in about 56-63 days and rewards attentive growers with moderate yields and uniform, easily trimmed colas. The cut reflects Josh D's long stewardship of OG Kush genetics, delivering that familiar gas-and-grape character in a more daytime-friendly register. Whether you chase its resin sheen or its crisp, clarifying mood, Meltdown captures a venerable lineage refined by a breeder who helped define it.

name: Kockeyed

On the palate, it tracks its ancestry closely—pungent and gassy up front, with bright citrus and dry-pine accents and a lingering candy edge from the RTZ parent. It is a confident, well-balanced expression of two All-Star lines, bred and selected under the guidance of Josh D to satisfy fans who crave new-school fruit without losing the gravitas of real OG. Effect-wise, reports point to a relaxed, happy, uplifted headspace that stays composed rather than couch-locking.

name: Lemon Ice by Tahoe_Nugz

Expect compact, resin-dense flowers and a tidy structure inherited from its dessert-lineage parents, with eye-catching bag appeal and a terpene presence that rewards careful curing. For enthusiasts who crave a clean lemon snap wrapped in creamy sweetness, Lemon Ice offers a polished, modern take on citrus-dessert genetics with clear pedigree and character. Balanced yet bold, it reads hybrid in both demeanor and presentation.

name: Pacific Cool
description: Pacific Cool from Klutch Cannabis is a sativa-leaning hybrid born from Orange 43 and OZK. It greets the senses with tropical lift and bright citrus peels over soft florals before settling into classic notes of dank pine and fresh earth. That interplay carries to the palate: a floral-citrus opening gives way to an old-school, resinous pine core and an earthy finish that lingers. Selected for flavor, this cut consistently highlights limonene, linalool, myrcene, caryophyllene, and pinene, a terpene stack that helps explain its clean, energetic headspace and dialed-in focus. Batches regularly test in the mid-20s, with THC commonly landing between about 21-32% and trace CBD around 0.05-0.07%, while dense, frost-heavy flowers showcase vibrant orange pistils and occasional violet flecks. In the garden, Pacific Cool behaves like a manageable sativa: expect roughly 9-10 weeks of flowering, medium stature indoors (around 3-5 feet when trained), and rewarding, dialed-in harvests near 400-500 g/m2. Klutch's selection emphasizes tight internodes and a trichome-laden finish that make this cross a natural fit for flavorful extracts as well as striking whole flower. Uplifted, focused, and pleasantly energetic without feeling sharp, Pacific Cool channels the best of both parents into a vivid, modern profile with old-school backbone throughout.

name: Purp 43

Expect chunky, trichome-heavy buds with creamy orange pistils and violet flashes, sticky enough to glue up a grinder. Whether you chase flavor, bag appeal, or a balanced hybrid arc, Purp 43 captures the best of both parents while carving out its own purple-tinged signature. Selected by Klutch and authored by Tahoe Nugz, it thrives as boutique flower and flavorful extracts.

If you are drawn to strains that merge bright, zesty top notes with deep, kushy basslines—and enjoy a lineage tracing to OG Raskal and DNA’s citrus classic—Raskal Lemons hits the target with focused flavor and polished execution.

name: Sweet Scoop

Selected and grown with care, Sweet Scoop has become one of the more expressive dessert-leaning takes on modern Z lineage, all while tipping the cap to Fiya Farmer’s craft and the selection work that shaped this cultivar’s color, structure, and confectionary finish. Expect dense, cone-shaped colas that trim clean and cure with a glossy, sugar-crystal sheen.

Bred from pedigreed parents and pheno-worked by Preferred Gardens, D-Lish x Znackz reads like a modern crowd-pleaser: vivid bag appeal, loud aroma, layered flavor, and a balanced, anytime cadence.

The Ocean Fruit side often paints faint purples late in flower, while the Gary Payton structure keeps internodes tight and trichomes heavy. Training is straightforward; a light top and selective defoliation help open the canopy and even out tops for uniform density. Expect sticky trim and a loud, lingering aroma in the jar. Growers note sturdy stems and a forgiving, moderate difficulty.

name: Decibel OG

Powdery mildew resistance and a forgiving temperament make it friendly to manage, while abundant yields keep canopy space productive. If you prize early finishing, resin-rich flowers, and peppery-earth complexity, Amalfi delivers the coast-to-hills balance its name evokes. Expect medium stature, strong lateral branching, and tidy internodes that respond well to light training while preserving the variety's handsome, photogenic bud shape.

name: White Pine
description: White Pine by Huckleberry Hill blends the floral elegance of Whitethorn Rose (WTR) with the foresty punch of Paradise Pine to deliver a terp-forward Humboldt original. Expect an aromatic arc of crisp pine and bright citrus over a soft lavender-rose undertone, a profile often driven by pinene, limonene, and linalool. Plants show vigorous, well-branched structure and an early finish, typically wrapping indoors in about 45–55 days and often ready outdoors by early September. Resin piles on readily, a trait shared with its celebrated WTR parent, making White Pine a reliable choice for flavor-focused extractions. On the palate, conifer and lemon lead into creamy floral tones. The experience opens with a clear, uplifted mood and settles into a relaxed, contented calm without feeling overly heavy. Medium stature and yields match its easygoing nature; keep light cycles steady and let the perfume announce peak ripeness. For growers seeking a compact timeline without sacrificing complexity, White Pine carries the Huckleberry Hill story forward with poise.

name: Day Dreamer
description: Day Dreamer is a hillside homage from Huckleberry Hill Farms, bred by Johnny Casali by pairing their beloved Paradise Punch with Margie's Magic. The result opens like a fruit stand in the forest: tropical fruit-punch candy up front, bright citrus zest around the edges, and a clean ribbon of pine through the finish. Expect a buoyant, creative lift that leans happy and focused before settling into an easy, carefree glide. Plants are vigorous, naturally resilient, and early to ripen; indoors they typically finish in about 50-60 days, while outdoor runs wrap by mid to late September. Dense, resin-glazed flowers and a terpene stack led by terpinolene with supporting limonene and pinene announce themselves in the dry room. Most phenos keep a medium stature and return medium yields, rewarding careful light management with tidy, uniform canopies. While CBD stays low, THC commonly lands in the mid-20% range, carrying Paradise Punch's old-school charm into a more modern, layered profile. Margie's Magic, an award-recognized terpinolene parent, lends its sparkling clarity and evergreen nose, polishing the cross into a cultivar that feels both nostalgic and new. Day Dreamer is a compact, early-finishing performer built for flavorful resin and sun-kissed speed.

name: Paradise Surprise
description: Paradise Surprise is Huckleberry Hill Farms' playful flip of a favorite family recipe: Whitethorn Rose dusting Paradise Punch. With Whitethorn Rose as the pollen donor and Paradise Punch as the receiver, it preserves the lineage's bright, floral-fruit profile while showcasing fresh expressions - often lime-green or royal-purple colas stacked with glassy resin. Expect aromas of berry jam and citrus peel over a soft rose bloom, with flavors that echo those notes in a sweet, zesty finish. Typical batches test in the low-to-mid 20s for THC (about 22-26%), with trace CBD, and an early indoor finish of roughly 7-8 weeks; outdoors it tends to wrap by early to mid September. Growers note moderate stretch, solid branching, and a cooperative temperament, along with powdery mildew resistance and a medium yield. Its terpene ensemble frequently leans toward limonene, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, a nod to the Emerald Cup-winning Whitethorn Rose parentage. On the palate and in the nose, Paradise Surprise delivers a lively, uplifting vibe that many describe as happy, relaxed, and creatively refreshed. Bred by Johnny Casali at Huckleberry Hill Farms in Southern Humboldt, it stands as a celebratory snapshot of the farm's heritage - refining Mom's beloved Paradise Punch line through the award-streaked Whitethorn Rose to create a fast-finishing, terp-saturated cultivar for connoisseurs and hash lovers alike.

name: Dawn Patrol
description: Dawn Patrol wakes like Humboldt at first light, a Huckleberry Hill Farms original that marries Whitethorn Rose with Riddlez to bottle the breeze off the ridgeline in flower form. The Rose contributes its signature floral-lavender lift and citrus sparkle, while Riddlez layers in candy-berry depth; together they exhale a terpene chorus led by limonene, linalool, and caryophyllene. On the palate it moves from sweet rose and berry jam to bright lemon with a gentle spicy finish. Plants show a medium-to-large stretch and sturdy, resin-lacquered spears, finishing early and evenly. Indoors most phenotypes wrap in 8–9 weeks, with slower keepers around 70 days; outdoors they color and set by mid–late September. Yields are confident for a connoisseur cut, commonly 450–600 g/m2 when dialed. Potency sits in the 22–26% THC window with trace CBD, translating to a clean, upbeat onset that feels happy and uplifted before resolving into relaxed, steady focus. Bred by John Casali and the Huckleberry Hill crew, Dawn Patrol carries the same craft lineage that put Whitethorn Rose on podiums, but steers it toward earlier harvests, sticky trichome coverage, and layered flavor meant to shine in both flower jars and solventless presses. Expect compact internodes, vivid purple accents, and a finish that lingers like sunrise on the coast.

name: Zapplez 3.0
description: Zapplez 3.0 from Conscious Genetics and Terphogz continues the London-born Zapplez saga by pairing Zapplez 1.0 with The Original Z. Expect a true 50/50 hybrid with medium stature, stacking dense calyxes that frost early and finish in roughly 56-63 days. The lineage threads sour green-apple brightness from the Zapplez side (itself Blue Zushi x Sour Apple Runtz) through classic candy-sweet Z notes, rounding into a subtle gas on the back end. Aromas translate cleanly to flavor: crisp apple on the inhale, sugared citrus and confectionery sweetness mid-palate, and a light diesel echo on the exhale. Breeder notes frame yields as medium for both flower and hash, with plants happiest under steady canopy control. THC outcomes vary by selection and environment; most phenos aim for high resin and loud terpene expression rather than posted numbers. Effects land balanced and modern — an upbeat mood lift and clear focus drift into a calm, body-soothing finish, avoiding heaviness when dialed and cured well. If you are hunting for a collab that captures "apple meets Z" in a tidy indoor cycle, Zapplez 3.0 carries the concept with precision while tipping the hat to both parents and to Conscious Genetics frost-first selection work. Growers report medium height indoors and straightforward training across most cuts.

name: Shin Kitorah
description: Shin Kitorah from Masonic Seed Co. pairs two terp-heavy parents — Tallymon and Rubiez — into a vivid hybrid that smells like a bazaar of tropical fruit with a faint nutty lift. Expect ripe banana, papaya, and mango tones from the Tallymon side, while Rubiez deepens the candy-fruit perfume and color, finishing the bouquet with a clean, sweet finish. The first tokes are bright and buoyant, and the high tends to land euphoric and happy before melting into a warm, tingly calm that keeps spirits lifted rather than glued to the couch. Growers will find a medium-stature plant with dense, frost-laden colas and a cooperative stretch; indoors and out, Shin Kitorah settles into a 56–70 day flowering window and typically returns medium yields, with 400 g/m2 achievable under dialed-in light. Myrcene, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene steer the profile, shaping its tropical-sweet flavor and tactile buzz, while THC commonly trends toward the stronger end in the parent lines and CBD stays minimal. Whether you chase fruit-forward jars or resin that washes clean, this cross carries the modern dessert lineage forward with confidence. Credit to Masonic Seeds for blending Tallymon’s vacation terps with Rubiez’s vivid candy edge into a single, photogenic cultivar. Expect medium height and easy training, with dense, lime-green buds sparkling under white light.

name: Grapefruit Starburst F2
description: Grapefruit Starburst F2 is Higher Ground Cannas grapefruit-leaning refinement of the famed Starburst 36 line, bred from two internal selections: Starburst 36 #187 and Starburst 36 Male #2. Because SB36 itself descends from Starburst OG x 97 KC36, this F2 carries a citrus-candy nose that bursts from the jarthink fresh grapefruit peel, sugared orange, and a creamy sweet finish. Limonene leads the terpene stack, rounded by myrcene and caryophyllene, translating to a bright, juicy profile in both flower and hash. Expect a clear, hybrid effect that lands uplifted and creative with sociable sparkle rather than couchlock. In 2026, Grapefruit Starburst powered Master Makers to a Gold medal at the California State Fair Cannabis Awards and followed with a podium at the Hashathon Cup, underscoring its resin-rich, wash-friendly trichome heads. Plants show dense, frosty calyx clusters with sandy, easily separated resin; indoors they finish in roughly 56–63 days and can yield generously under dialed irrigation and light, while remaining manageable in height. Typical potency falls in the 15–25% THC range with trace CBD. With candy-sweet citrus, resilient structure, and productive resin, Grapefruit Starburst F2 captures the brightest side of SB36 faithful to its parents and unmistakably Higher Ground.

name: Oasis OG
description: Connected Cannabis Co. crafted Propane Valley with Area 41 #2, distilling an indica-leaning profile built for unhurried nights. The bouquet opens creamy and mildly earthy, then flashes red sour candy, vanilla, and sweet whipped cream; crack the buds and gelato funk rolls out over subtle pine. On the palate, expect smooth sour earth, creamy gas, and a whipped-cream finish that lingers. Dense, tri-colored flowers show lime and deep purple with bright burnt-orange pistils and a heavy frost, a look that mirrors the strain's weighty, calming demeanor. Effects settle low and steady, stacking a deeply relaxing body buzz with a tranquil headspace that suits late sessions and slow evenings. While batches vary, Oasis OG typically leans high in THC with trace CBD, channeling the OG backbone of Propane Valley and the dessert-forward influence of Area 41 #2. Growers report compact, OG-style morphology and vigorous resin production, but the cut is prized more for top-shelf flavor than raw yield. Credit Connected Cannabis Co. for a modern OG that still honors classic gas: Oasis OG is that cool stretch of shade after a long walk, where sweet cream meets pine and everything quiets down. Expect a creamy, gassy bouquet and deeply soothing, evening-leaning effects in every jar.

name: Lemon X
description: Lemon X from Capulator hits the palate like a lemon candy stand wired to a fuel pump, and its pedigree explains why. Built from Super Lemon Haze crossed to Hawaiian Chem, then taken to Caps Frozen Lemons F2, it leans sativa and reads distinctly terpinolene forward, with limonene and myrcene in support. The bouquet opens with sharp citrus peel and candied lemon before a clean chem-diesel undertow; the flavor mirrors that arc with zest up front, a sweet edge mid-palate, and a gassy finish. Buds show lanky, classic haze structure yet bulk into rounded, resin-packed calyx clusters from the Hawaiian Chem side, finishing bright lime green with long orange threads. Typical batches test near 25% THC and minimal CBD, delivering an alert, buoyant profile that trends focused, energetic, and uplifted. In the garden it stretches hard and runs a 70-77 day bloom, often maturing into tall frames with moderate yields and standout frost from the Frozen Lemons line. With Cup-winning SLH heritage and Capulator's modern lemon resin from CFL, Lemon X bridges late-90s haze sparkle and contemporary lemon-fuel punch into one vivid, nostalgic hybrid. Growers note narrow, serrated leaves, vigorous apical growth, and showy trichome coverage that stacks heavily on the bracts.

name: Sugarcane V3
description: Refined for extra sweetness, frost, and structure, Sugar Cane V3 is In House Genetics next iteration of a fan-favorite line, crossing Sugarcane V2 with Platinum. Plants keep an even canopy and moderate stretch before stacking dense, resin-soaked colas that finish in roughly 56–63 days. Aromatically it is dessert-forward: sweet cream and grape candy threaded with a light gas note that deepens in cure. The Platinum influence shows in the silvered calyxes and polished bag appeal; Sugarcane V2 contributes the sugary grape-cream signature and a steadier, more uniform expression. Indoors or outdoors, this medium-height hybrid delivers medium-to-high yields and consistent trichome coverage with a reputation for medium-to-high wash potential, making V3 a reliable pick for both premium flower and solventless. Reported leading terpenes include caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene, aligning with its bright, uplifting head and calm, collected body feel that leaves focus and creativity accessible. Structure is user-friendly: even branching, dense nug stacking, and a manageable frame that responds well to simple support. For growers and flavor chasers seeking a modern, sweeter spin on the Sugar Cane family, V3 lands the brief and honors its pedigree—Sugarcane V2 x Platinum—delivering the frosty finish, grape-cream profile, and tidy 8–9 week timeline that helped make this line a staple.

name: Punk Rock
description: Punk Rock by Ziplock Seeds slams together two statement-making parents - Sade (Purple Churro x Gas Drop) and Black Panther (Cheetah Piss x KY Jealousy) — into a hybrid that grow rooms and jars remember. The nose fires first: high-octane diesel and chem streaks from Sade, layered with ripe-berry sweetness and a faint spiced cream inherited across the line. Black Panther sharpens the mix with lemon-fuel brightness and contemporary bag appeal, a pedigree underscored by its 2024 Caribbean Cup win for Outdoor Flower. On the palate, Punk Rock leans berry-diesel with a creamy glide and light sour snap, finishing clean and loud. Expect a buoyant, euphoric lift with clear, focused momentum that later settles into a smooth, relaxed cadence - more cadence than couch. Plants show strong vigor, stacking resin-heavy colas on supportive frames with moderate lateral growth and notable stretch. In capable hands, it finishes in roughly 9-10 weeks and rewards with heavy yields of frosted, photogenic flower. Morphology trends hybrid: medium height indoors, scaling taller outdoors when given space and sun. Chemically, it is a THC-forward, low-CBD selection tuned for flavor density and trichome output rather than CBD content. Bred and released by Ziplock Seeds, Punk Rock wears its name honestly: bold, fast, and undeniably stage-ready.

name: Panther Blood
description: Panther Blood from Ziplock Seeds runs hot and fast, a sativa-leaning hybrid purpose-bred by pairing Tigers Blood and Black Panther. Tigers Blood brings its Maui True Blood x Gas Drop heritage to the cross, known for heady, upbeat drive, big yields, and an aromatic mix of candy brightness with floral and herbal depth. Black Panther (Cheetah Piss x KY Jealousy) adds lemon-fueled funk, color, and proven bag appeal, having won First Place for Outdoor Flower at the 2024 Caribbean Cup in Santa Maria, Colombia. Expect a tall, vigorous frame with strong lateral growth, stacking long, spearlike colas dusted in resin. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in 9–10 weeks; outdoors, the finish tracks early to mid October in temperate zones. Terpene expression leans myrcene, limonene, and alpha-pinene, often supported by caryophyllene, translating to grapefruit and lemon over diesel and sweet earth. Phenotypes trend energetic, focused, and uplifting before settling into a balanced cruise. With Tigers Blood’s high-yielding drive and the Black Panther line’s punchy potency, Panther Blood rewards attentive canopy management and light penetration, responding well to topping and trellising. Growers report medium-to-high outputs and a clean, modern flavor profile that makes jars leap open. Expect sativa-dominant effects with low CBD and high THC potential inherited from its parents.

name: Aoyuki Banana
description: Aoyuki Banana from In House Genetics pairs the confectionary punch of Divine Banana with the grape-forward frost of Slurricane #44, creating an indica-dominant hybrid that looks snow-dusted even before the cure. Compact, branching plants stack dense, heavy flowers and pour on resin, finishing in roughly 56-63 days indoors with medium to high yields and striking green-to-violet hues. Cracking a jar brings out a dessert profile: ripe tropical banana and cream, vanilla sugar, and berry-grape from the Slurricane side, all lifted by a faint gas. On the palate, the fruit and cream glide over a subtle earthy-OG undercurrent. Expect a deeply relaxing body cadence with a calm, pleasantly balanced head and a touch of euphoria; it unwinds without dulling the senses. The terpene ensemble often leans toward limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, supporting the strain's creamy-tropical aroma while keeping the finish composed and polished. THC potential is high while CBD stays very low, and the blanket of trichomes makes Aoyuki Banana a natural for hash and rosin work. Bred by In House Genetics, this cross honors both parents: Divine Banana contributes the sugary banana-gelato tone and vigor, while Slurricane #44 layers on purple accents, grape candy notes, and that signature, photogenic frost.

name: Permanent Slurkle
description: Permanent Slurkle pairs In House Genetics' Permanent Urkle with their Slurricane #44 selection, yielding a modern purple-leaning hybrid that blends grape-candy gas with creamy dessert notes. From its Permanent Urkle side (Permanent Marker x Purple Urkle) come the bold, nostalgic purple aromatics and a terp backbone often led by caryophyllene, myrcene, and linalool; Slurricane #44 (a standout Dosidos x Purple Punch cut) stacks on thick resin, dense calyxes, and that sweet berry-and-cream finish. Indoors, expect a straightforward photoperiod run finishing about 60–75 days in flower, with moderate yields that reward attentive dialing. The profile leans grape, berry, and cream over a light earthy-gas base, while the high trends relaxing and euphoric with a calm, happy afterglow. Fans of extract-friendly resin and classic purple flavors will find Permanent Slurkle bridges old-school Urkle charm with contemporary bag appeal, all true to the meticulous selection synonymous with In House Genetics.

name: Spraypack
description: Spraypack by Shauncron stitches modern candy gas into a focused, daytime-leaning hybrid born from Neonz and Lemon Cane. Neonz, a selection from OGZ x Z41, brings vivid Z-candy aromatics and supple structure; Lemon Cane (Lemon Peel x Do-Si-Dos) layers bright lemon zest and resin density. On the palate the candy persists early, then pivots to fuel as beta-caryophyllene leads, with limonene and linalool uplift supported by myrcene and humulene. Effects tend to land upbeat and sociable - happy, uplifted, and gently energetic - while staying tidy enough for creative focus. Plants show medium stature and branching, finishing in about 60-67 days with a consistent, medium yield of dense, sticky flowers frosted in silver. Typical lab results in Florida place THC in the low to mid 20s with CBD trace (<0.1%), matching the strain's clean, head-forward profile. Bred and selected by Shauncron and offered in Florida through Cookies, Spraypack captures the sunny, fruit-forward edge of the Neonz line while sharpening it with Lemon Cane's clarity and polish. Expect jars that smell like a freshly cracked candy spray, then settle into smooth gas as sessions progress.

name: Neon Lemon

name: The Baker
description: Blueprint Cannabis Co.'s The Baker stitches classic cookie DNA into a glistening modern hybrid. Bred from GSC Cookies and Triple Platinum Kush, it opens with warm cookie-dough aromatics layered over sweet cream and a light citrus tickle, then settles into dense, sugar-frosted flowers whose resin leaves a distinctly mouth-coating finish. In Blueprint's official lineup, The Baker is presented as a hybrid around 26% THC, with "Cookie Dough," "Baked," and a heavy, dessert-leaning character front and center. One California batch verified at 26.14% THC with 0.23% CBD, while a Florida lot tested near 23.1% THC and about 2.9% total terpenes. Beta-caryophyllene and humulene steer the terpene engine, with limonene and linalool brightening the edges; together they drive an unhurried, contented ride that trends relaxed and happily hungry rather than outright sedative. Its flavor mirrors the aromavanilla buttercream, browned-sugar dough, and a faint peppery echo coating the palate from first crack to the last fragment of crumb. Morphology skews cookie-leaning: chunky, conical spears, tight calyx stacking, and heavy trichome coverage that release a pastry-sweet nose when broken. Framed by its GSC heritage and polished by the Platinum side, The Baker distills Blueprint's house style into a dessert-forward, craft snapshot nostalgic, rich, and decisively modern.

name: Paint Thinner by LIT Farms
description: Paint Thinner by LIT Farms is a mostly indica hybrid built from the high-octane pairing of Gary Payton and Permanent Marker, a mashup that points squarely at dense resin, heavy nose, and modern dessert-gas complexity. The experience trends euphoric and relaxing yet buoyant, often described as an uplift that settles into calm without flattening the mood. While potency can vary by cut and cultivation, the lineage is known for assertive terpene expression and thick trichome coverage, making Paint Thinner attractive for both connoisseurs of gas-forward flavor and hash-minded extraction. With parent stock that has earned wide acclaim on its own, this cross aims to deliver concentrated, solvent-evoking bouquet and balanced hybrid effects in a compact flowering window.

name: Disco Kitty
description: Ziplock Seeds' Disco Kitty pounces out of the jar with a fruit-punch sparkle and a darker, gassy purr, a personality inherited from its parents: Rainbow Zangria (RS54 x Zangria) and Black Panther (Cheetah Piss x KY Jealousy aka Sinful). Ziplock's Black Panther lineage has real pedigree too, taking first for Outdoor Flower at a major Colombian cup in 2024, and it lends Disco Kitty both vigor and bag appeal. Growers will find it cooperative to train, with an indica-leaning 60/40 profile that holds structure under dense frosting. The flavor persists on the palate as sweet grape-citrus candy with a faint diesel echo-playful up front, purposeful underneath--true to its name and crafted with Ziplock's terpene-first breeding ethos. Released as a feminized photoperiod, it performs under mixed light and indoors with minimal fuss.

name: Dragon Tears

In the garden, Dragon Tears carries Rain Drops' vigor and stretch, stacking dense, resinous colas with vivid color and heavy frost. The result is a hybrid that leans bright and buoyant like its Whitethorn Rose parent yet deepens into creamy fruit thanks to Paradise Rose's modern lineage. Expect a vivid bouquet of rose petal, lemon zest, and berry preserves over soft earth, driven by a terpene trio commonly reported in the line—limonene, linalool, and beta‑caryophyllene. In the bowl, sweet citrus and berry lead, while a lingering floral finish perfumes the palate. The experience tends to rise smoothly into happy, euphoric focus before settling into a calm, uplifted clarity, echoing Whitethorn Rose's award‑rich reputation at California's Emerald Cup. Phenotypes often display plush, violet‑tinged calyxes blanketed in glassy trichomes and a resin weight prized for hash work. THC typically lands in a moderate‑to‑high range with minimal CBD, maintaining potency without muting the cultivar's delicate perfume. Outdoors, plants show sturdy, medium stature and a cooperative temperament; indoors, expect similarly manageable structure and a balanced stretch. Bred and cultivated by Huckleberry Hill Farms in Humboldt County, Magnolia Rose captures the farm's multigenerational craft in a fragrant, color‑saturated expression built for connoisseurs of floral, fruit‑forward cannabis.

name: Wild Shotz

The nose hits bright and layered - lime zest and citrus peel from limonene ride over diesel and peppery caryophyllene, with a red-fruit sweetness reminiscent of cherry syrup. On the palate it opens sweet and zesty before settling into a clean gas finish. Typical batches test in the mid-to-high 20s for THC (roughly 24-30%) with trace CBD near 0.1%. Effects arrive briskly: an uplifted, euphoric headspace pairs with a calm, back-seat body ease, making it feel composed rather than couching. Indoors, Wild Shotz is straightforward for an intermediate hand; a light defoliation and canopy control keep the stretch focused. Most phenos finish in about 56-65 days and reward with high yields of dense, trichome-heavy buds. Bred by Seed Junky Genetics and named for its parentage - Gello Shotz x Wild Cherry - Wild Shotz captures the line's hallmark balance of candy brightness and assertive gas in a single, eye-catching cultivar.

Aromatically, Deepwater Cherry opens with ripe cherry and blueberry over tropical fruit, then drifts into incense-laced funk. The profile carries through the cure, and the flavor mirrors the nose with sweet fruit up front and a faint peppery echo on the exhale. Expect a balanced, happy-lifted onset that settles into calm focus and gentle body ease without losing its upbeat glow. Indoors, most phenotypes finish in 63-65 days, rewarding dialed gardens with medium-to-heavy yields and standout bag appeal. Released as feminized photoperiod seeds. For collectors and hunters chasing a clean cherry line wrapped in tropical complexity, Deepwater Cherry captures the best of both parents in a tight, commercially friendly frame.

Effects tend to arc from alert and uplifted into a heavier, blissed-out calm—euphoric yet steady—with THC commonly testing high (mid-20s to about 31%) and only trace CBD. Indoors, trained canopies reward with solid, medium-class yields around 400 g/m²; outdoors in ideal conditions, well-managed plants can push toward 700 g per plant. The Topanga influence helps keep the run manageable, while the Toad Venom resin density brings serious bag appeal. Named parents are Toad Venom and Topanga Canyon, with full credit to Ronin Seeds for the pairing; Snake Charmer is crafted for growers and tastemakers chasing loud gas, citrus snap, and a polished OG finish.

While lab numbers vary by batch, Fugu is typically produced as top‑shelf indoor flower by Teds Budz, emphasizing resin coverage and flavor retention over sheer speed. Crafted and presented by Teds Budz with Eastside Eggroll, Fugu stands out as a distinctive, savory‑sweet entry in their catalog.

Structure is cooperative under topping, with moderate internode spacing and an even canopy that keeps dialing the environment straightforward. Indoors, experienced growers report medium yields around 400 g/m2; outdoors, bushier phenos can stack to similar weight per plant with generous light and airflow. Expect dense, sticky colas that press easily and reek of cherry-fuel funk. Growers typically rate difficulty as medium. If you prize bold flavor, high resin, and a balanced hybrid cadence, Bang Butter earns a top spot in the lineup—a modern Exotic Genetix cross that tastes as rich as its name suggests.

Expect medium-stature plants with sturdy branching, low leaf-to-flower ratios, and dense, resin-caked colas that finish in about 55–65 days. On the nose and palate, sharp Z-candy and citrus sparkle over creamy cookie-dough tones, backed by kushy gas; limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene typically lead the terp parade. In the bowl, Funky Monkey leans calm and creative: a relaxing body glow steadies the frame while an upbeat, focused lift keeps the mood bright and social. Potency is robust, commonly testing around 20–25% THC with trace CBD, and the morphology makes training intuitive for newer growers. Stuffed French Toast contributes structure and a rich, creamy sweetness; Zikigai layers in concentrated Z-candy aromatics and a frosty finish. Together they deliver a cultivar that’s easy to manage, hash-friendly, and memorably flavorful—true to Raw Genetics’ reputation for candy-gas profiles with practical, productive growth.

The Bubba Diagonal buds pack a sweet and fruity flavor profile accented by citrus, skunk, and some earthy notes. Effects-wise, this strain delivers long-lasting happiness and relaxation, exactly what you’d expect from an Indica-driven strain. Pain won’t stand much of a chance after smoking this, and sleepiness will be just around the corner. The soothing effects make Bubba Diagonal an ideal strain for medical patients suffering from insomnia, spasms, and chronic pain. In higher doses, cottonmouth and red, dry eyes are common.

Under ideal hands, this 100% indica can touch 24-25% THC, delivering a heavy, deeply relaxing effect that settles the body while keeping the mood quietly upbeat. Bloom is fast, finishing in 55-60 days, and productivity is emphatic: about 600 g/m2 inside and, in generous conditions, up to 2000 g per plant outdoors. Eleven Roses has also shone on the competition circuit, taking first prize BHO at the 2017 Lanzarote Cannabis Cup among other podiums. Growers appreciate its easy temperament and strong resistance to mold and pests, plus tidy internodes that simplify trimming. If you are seeking a resin-soaked, award-tested indica with rich, fruit-and-earth depth and reliable speed, this cross of Appalachian Kush and Sugar Black Rose more than lives up to its name beautifully.

The ride starts bright and content, then settles into a relaxed, happy focus that keeps conversations flowing without dulling your edge. In the garden, New York Cheesecake is friendly and predictable: 56–70 days to finish, modest stretch, and a medium yield. Indoors, 300–350 g/m² is common under good light; outdoors, well‑grown plants reach roughly 350 g each while remaining discreet in height. If you fancy a tidy, aromatic hybrid with classic pastry‑shop charm and just enough diesel attitude, this cultivar checks every box.

It's commonly used to support chronic pain, arthritis, headaches, and migraines, and it may ease stress, depression, and anxiety. Known for causing sleepiness without crazy couch-lock, Master Kush is also ideal for insomnia or poor sleep. Negative effects tend to be mild, but could include dry eyes, dry mouth, and slight dizziness. Great for growing both indoors and outdoors, Master Kush has a flowering period of 56-63 days, producing dense, gorgeous deeply green buds with vibrant glowing reddish-orange pistils and a thick coat of sparkly trichomes. Resistant to mold and pests, it’s easy to cultivate and will produce high yields when grown correctly.

Harlequin has a moderate content of THC which makes it ideal for daytime use considering its uplifting effects. The high from this plant starts with a cerebral lift that will make you feel creative and focused, ready to tackle any tasks of the day. The body is calm and relaxed without locking you on the couch. Patients and medical cannabis consumers report that this strain has great benefits for relieving pain caused by fibromyalgia, migraines, inflammation, fatigue and arthritis. But be mindful when choosing the dosage as it might give you a headache, nausea or dry eyes in excess. The flavor of Harlequin is fruity and herbal with notes of mango and citrus. The more you smoke, you’ll notice delicious woody hints along with some musky earthiness. Growing Harlequin can be considered quite easy as it doesn’t require complicated steps or technologies to thrive. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments, this plant needs well-draining soil in a Mediterranean climate. Provided all the ideal growing conditions are met, you’ll be rewarded with beautiful buds and a medium yield of 350g/m2 or 500g/plant.

A heavy, soothing body high follows, without the crazy heavy sedation some indica strains are known for. She’s great for experienced indica fans looking for heavy effects that won’t keep them locked to the couch. As far as medical effects, Gabagool could be a great option for relieving fatigue, stress, depression, lack of appetite, nausea, and chronic pain. Growing information is somewhat limited, but she’s generally considered to be a moderately challenging cultivar with growth characteristics of other modern hybrids. Indoors it typically completes in about 60 days of flower, rewarding dialed canopies with heavy, glistening tops that trim quickly. Morphology and performance made this selection a staple in modern breeding rooms, yet as a standalone cultivar it shines for vivid flavor, THC-forward punch, and classic cookie-fueled gas. The high comes on relatively fast, offering a cerebral uplift that sharpens focus, elevates mood and motivation, while offering a light body relaxation that keeps things grounded rather than deeply sedated. Medicinally it is used for alleviating chronic stress, depression or mood swings, fatigue and sometimes chronic pain, since its energizing mental buzz can counter low mood and its mild body effects soothe discomfort. Cultivation is moderately easy for growers with some experience; its tall, slender growth benefits from good lighting, airflow, and attention.

If you chase modern dessert genetics with real depth, this cross delivers both sparkle and substance.

Plants show a high calyx-to-leaf ratio and respond well to training, producing chunky, conical tops with purple marbling and heavy frost. Aromatics linger as sweet tropical marmalade with a creamy, slightly savory echo. Guava Lava stands out as one of 808 Genetics' most memorable Hawaii-bred hybrids.

Credited to Exotic Genetix, this indica-leaning hybrid grows with tight, resin-soaked calyxes that finish in 60 to 70 days, stacking compact colas with a medium stretch and an easy-to-manage, bushy frame. Crack the jar and you get ripe pineapple and bright citrus over cookie-diesel and a pinch of spice; on the tongue it stays sweet and zesty, with diesel lingering. Lab batches regularly clock high-20s THC, with totals spanning roughly 20 to 32 percent, while CBD remains trace at under 0.2 percent. A terpene trio of myrcene, limonene, and linalool leads the bouquet, steering effects toward a calm, happy clarity that lifts mood without couchlock, then settles into a relaxed, gently euphoric cruise. Indoors, expect medium heights and robust yields around 550 g per m2; outdoors, well-fed plants can top 1500 g per plant under strong sun. Visually, dried buds show emeralds and deep purples wrapped in thick frost and amber hairs. For growers and tastemakers chasing modern dessert-gas genetics, Buckin Runtz delivers showpiece bag appeal, dependable structure, and uplifting, feel-good flavor from two modern icons.

name: ZaZa

This Indica-dominant hybrid, with a 70/30 Indica to Sativa ratio, is a cross of Scott's OG and Gas Station Bob that packs a punch with THC levels ranging from 19-21%. Its enticing flavors of lemon, pine, and citrus make each inhale a zesty experience. The strain's potency induces a deep sense of calm and tranquility, often leaving users feeling sleepy and hungry. Medically, ZaZa is often used to alleviate stress, anxiety, and depression. Its strong sedative effects can help manage various other symptoms, making it a popular choice for those seeking relief. The strain's parentage is a bit mysterious, with varying information available, but its powerful effects speak for themselves. Growing ZaZa can be a rewarding experience. It thrives in warm, sunny climates similar to those found in many parts of the southern United States or the Mediterranean region. Its plants are typically bushy and dense, characteristic of its Indica heritage. The strain's heavy yields and high THC content make it a satisfying choice for cultivators looking to harvest potent buds.

name: Blue Lights

Effects to be expected include deep relaxation, a euphoric mindset, possible giggles, and emerging sleepiness that usually leads to couch-lock, while your mind stays remarkably active. Medical use of Blue Lights is best aimed at dealing with chronic or acute stress, insomnia, pain-related issues, and a lack of appetite. Cultivating these amazing ladies demands an experienced grower. They reach medium heights, develop a rather bushy structure, and flower for about 65 to 70 days before producing high yields in the range of 500 g/m². Odor control is highly recommended indoors.

With THC levels of up to 15%, this strain delivers its unmistakable trademark flavor. The Original Z has an extremely fruity aroma, blending tropical citrus fruit notes with a lemony background. The more you smoke, the better the flavor becomes, as the overall sour, lemony notes give place to super sweet, wild berries flavors that linger on the palate for hours after you finish smoking. The effects are just as delightful as the taste. Almost immediately after the first hit, expect a boost of creativity accompanied by a euphoric head buzz that leaves you feeling uplifted. After a few more hits, a deep sense of relaxation will spread through your whole body, washing away all worries and muscle pain. The effects are highly praised for their effectiveness against stress, pain, and insomnia.

It’s known for making users feel focused, relaxed, and happy, with a delightful mix of berry, woody, and sweet flavors. Those who enjoy it describe the experience as smooth and pleasant, great for both recreational fun and various medical needs. Growers appreciate Cherry Bomb for its robust nature and fair yields in a moderate climate. Medicinally, it’s often used to manage pain, gastrointestinal disorders, and arthritis, offering relief with a pleasant, uplifting experience. Whether you're growing it or consuming it, Cherry Bomb delivers a memorable and well-rounded cannabis experience.

name: Alaskan Purple

Expect a sweet-berry bouquet laced with floral tones and a subtle spicy-woody finish, a profile consistent with a myrcene, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene trio. Plants are robust and easy to train, stacking dense, resinous flowers on a broad, branching frame; indoors they typically reach about 120 cm, while outdoor specimens can top 2 m with ease. Flowering completes in roughly 9–11 weeks (about 63–77 days), rewarding patient growers with around 400 g/m2 inside and high outdoor returns that can approach 750 g per plant by early October. THC commonly falls in the 16–24% window with low CBD, delivering a long-lasting, body-forward calm from the Kush side, brightened by a clear, upbeat cerebral lift from the Brazilian sativa. The overall effect trends relaxed, happy, and euphoric without being couch-locked. True to its lineage, Alaskan Purple balances color, perfume, and performance, making it a reliable, high-yielding choice for purple lovers and production-minded gardeners alike—all authored by Seedsman.

name: Hammerhead

The bouquet leans decadent and dank: sweet fruit and honey drizzled over pungent earth with a spicy-herbal edge. Typical lab results cluster around 15 to 20 percent THC with a notable CBD expression compared to many indicas. The effect arrives as a buoyant, happy lift that stays calm and measured, then settles into deep, body-centered ease and a drowsy, content finish. Myrcene leads the terpene chorus, with caryophyllene adding peppery warmth and limonene brightening the aftertaste. Gardeners appreciate its forgiving, easygoing nature and the way the buds compact tightly, silvered by trichomes that speak to its White-line pedigree. Hammerhead captures the stout charm of its parents while delivering a modern, evening-friendly profile.

The flavors follow suit, with a strong earthy and woody taste that's surprisingly smooth on the exhale. Archive lists it as a mostly-indica hybrid; indoor flowering typically finishes around day 60, and the heavy resin content makes it attractive for solventless work. Expect vigorous roots, quick uptake, and strong apical dominance under high-intensity lighting. The effects lean classic OG—relaxed, euphoric, and uplifted—delivered with a clear, pine-fresh edge. While yields depend on selection and training, the combination of long colas and dense OG bud structure offers reliable production with standout bag appeal. For growers and hash makers seeking modern color and washability without losing that old-school gas, Blank Check is a compelling proof of Archive’s careful selection.

The experience opens with an energetic, creative spark and talkative focus before easing into a gently tingly, relaxed body cadence. Growers note sturdy branching and medium indoor, high outdoor stature.

Expect strong vigor and notable stretch at the flip, so give those narrow-leaf boughs space. While no single breeder claims authorship, this heirloom line endures through regional preservation and careful selection, delivering a vivid taste of the subcontinent that feels both timeless and unmistakably alive. Growers often note spear-shaped colas, feathery foliage, and a breezy, incense-tinged exhale.

This strain is impressive in its flavor with strong notes of sweet berry and flowers, followed by hints of melon and bubblegum. The high starts slowly with a cerebral uplift that sparks creativity before relaxing your body without sedating you. The effects are calming and long lasting, so it’s best for afternoon and evening use. Consumers who suffer from conditions such as stress, migraines and insomnia have noticed an improvement in their overall wellbeing. Growing Velvet Krush is relatively easy, the plant grows to a short height, and flowers in around 56 to 65 days indoors. Growers can expect to harvest high yields and rich resinous buds. THC levels are around 20% so it’s a great option for both novice and experienced users.

name: Sour Joker
description: Potent and stimulating, Joker (or Sour Joker) is a beautiful Sativa dominant hybrid born from combining Amnesia Haze and ECSD (East Coast Sour Diesel). This is the perfect strain for those who need a pick me up. Right after the first few hits you’ll feel happy, giggly and unfocused. While the mind will be uplifted and the cerebral effect euphoric, the body will be invigorated and energized. Joker’s high THC content (20% to 28%) is a great aid for those who suffer from depression, insomnia, pain and nausea as it will waver the symptoms and make you feel at ease. However, it’s best to consult a professional as there might be side effects if not consumed cautiously. Sour Joker’s flavor, as per the name, has a strong sour diesel flavor. Delicious hints of spicy lemon and earthiness are accompanied by herbal and pungent notes. The overall hashy and lemony taste make this strain a delightful treat. In terms of appearance, this variety is a true stunner. The plant is decorated with dense and compact green buds, orange pistils and a generous coating of icy trichomes. Joker grows tall and proud in both indoor and outdoor settings. It’s recommended for more experienced growers as training techniques like topping, LST and some pruning are necessary for the highest yields.

This motivating buzz spurs creativity and a sense of overall contentment without any anxiety, making it perfect for artistic endeavors, socializing, or anytime you desire a feel-good high that allows you to remain functionable, fully engaged in what you’re doing, and completely relaxed without any trace of sedation whatsoever. Its aroma contains notes of flowery citrus, cream, and blueberries with a sour fruity flair. With an exceptionally high THC content that averages 32%, Rose Gold Runtz is perfect for any consumer that appreciates a potent and uplifting top-shelf high. Many medical cannabis patients appreciate this strain’s ability to ease stress and depression, while others turn to Rose Gold Runtz for relief from chronic pain and muscle spasms. Common negative effects include dry mouth and dry eyes, and it’s reported to make some users dizzy. Rose Gold Runtz does well both indoors and outside, putting out high yields with a flowering period of around 59 days. It produces stunning buds in gorgeous emerald green hues with thin bright orange pistils and a glimmering layer of resinous trichomes—with an almost jewel-like appearance just like the strain’s name.

The effect blooms quickly into easy euphoria and sunlit good mood, tapering into a calm, body-loosening relax without heavy drag. Growers familiar with the parents will recognize their influence: compact-to-medium stature, dense colas, and dependable, medium-to-high returns when dialed in. Indoors, expect a straightforward cycle of roughly 56–63 days of bloom from comparable lineage, with bright, frosty flowers and a room-filling orange bouquet. Whether you chase nostalgic candy notes or modern citrus-forward profiles, Gummo threads them together with polish - honoring Bubble Gum’s sweetness, sharpening it with Orange Bud’s zest, and presenting it as a cohesive, uplifting experience that’s as pretty in the grinder as it is on the stem.

A relaxed body high follows, creating a calming effect without sedation perfect for relaxing at the end of a long day. Its happy, social vibe allows for easy conversation. Tropic Thunder’s earthy aroma is strikingly similar to its taste, with hints of tropical fruits and rich sage that intensifies the more you smoke. It may cause anxiety or paranoia in individuals sensitive to high THC levels. As its name might suggest, Tropic Thunder grows best in warm, tropical climates. The strain will thrive when cultivated in the correct conditions, flowering in 70-80 days and producing dense, bright green buds accented with yellow, orange, and purple hues and a coat of glistening golden trichomes.

First impressions arrive as a bright lemon-lime burst often likened to citrus soda, underpinned by loamy earth and a crack of black pepper; the bouquet points to a caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene trio steering the experience. Batches are typically high in THC with negligible CBD, and the high tends to open with vivid, cerebral focus before settling into a weightier calm, leaving many feeling happy, uplifted, and engaged. Buds form dense, resin-laden flowers with the tidy structure common to Archive selections. While the breeder keeps the parentage and precise grow specs under wraps, cultivators who have run the cut tend to slot its finish alongside versatile Archive hybrids that wrap in roughly eight to ten weeks and produce dependable, medium yields when dialed. What remains certain is authorship: Eager Beaver comes from the Portland, Oregon masterminds at Archive Seed Bank, a house celebrated for Face Off OG, Dosidos, Moonbow, and Rainbow Beltz. If you favor enigmatic pedigrees that deliver a flavor arc from citrus sparkle to peppered earth, this secretive Archive selection more than earns its playful name.

This glorious head high is met with a soothing, tingly sensation that spreads evenly throughout the body, leading to a deeply relaxed physical high that ends in a state of total sedation.
