This soothing strain has a bright citrus taste that blends flowery flavors with earthy pine. The aroma is similar, with notes of diesel and woody pine that mingle with its floral-like overtones. With THC levels averaging around 19% and deeply calming effects, Paris OG is commonly used by medical cannabis patients to support depression, insomnia, and muscle spasms. It’s also reported to be beneficial for glaucoma and eye pressure. It’s generally well-tolerated, with common side effects including dry mouth, dry eyes, and occasional dizziness. Paris OG is a high-yielding strain with a flowering period of approximately 59 days. It produces huge, sticky bright green buds with occasional purple-hued undertones and orange hairs that are coated in a dense layer of glistening trichomes.

A pinene-led terpene profile threads roasted coffee and fresh pine with bright citrus, echoing its lineage; aromas intensify late in bloom yet remain clean on the palate. Reported THC typically lands between 17–19% with trace CBD below 0.5%, shaping a high that lifts first—clear, energetic and quietly creative—before easing into a calm, grounded finish reminiscent of its indica parent. Growers appreciate the cultivar’s easygoing nature and resilience to mold and common pests, while its medium indoor stature (about 1 m) suits compact spaces. Thai Fantasy captures the focus and sunshine of Thai genetics tempered by Black Domina’s density and speed, delivering reliable harvests and a sophisticated, coffee-and-pine bouquet that lingers long after the jar is opened. Bred for versatility, it thrives in varied climates and rewards attentive feeding and light management.

With up to 23% THC, this strain is commonly chosen by those seeking relief from inflammation, muscle spasms, and pain.

Growers note an easy handling curve and medium plant height, making P41 a practical fit for dialed-in tents or compact rooms.

The Lem OG backbone traces to 87 Pakistani Hashplant crossed with Frisco OG, and this backcross leans sativa in its behavior (about 60/40), stretching outdoors to 8-10 feet with classic OG frame, strong lateral branching, and sturdy petioles. Expect big, repeatable yields and notable powdery mildew resilience; the line is treasured by hash makers for heavy resin dumping. Aromatics center on limonene-dominant citrus peel over diesel and pine, with caryophyllene and myrcene typically rounding the profile. Potency is high THC with trace CBD, delivering a clean uplift that settles into relaxed, happy clarity. In temperate zones it is a mid-to-late October finisher (around October 20 outside), and indoor flowers commonly wrap in roughly eight to nine weeks when well dialed. History looms large here: the Lem OG cut earned Emerald Cup podiums for rosin (2015) and ice water hash (2017), and a Lem OG rosin tincture later took a 2022 placement, cementing the cultivar's reputation. If you seek lemon zest, gas, and production in one dependable package, Lem OG Bx captures the essence of the original while tightening it up for modern gardens.

Reported lab results frequently land between 28–31% THC with trace CBD around 0.07–0.08%, setting the stage for a bright, euphoric lift that mellows into a happy, relaxed cruise without getting overly sedative. Some users mention dry mouth, dry eyes, or slight dizziness at higher servings. While official cultivation specifics have not been published, growers often approach Doppio like its parents: a compact, indoor-friendly plant that can finish in roughly 8–9 weeks with medium yields when dialed in. Flavor carries through from nose to palate—silky cream, sugared fruit, and a clean gas finish—making Doppio a natural pick for fans of connoisseur dessert strains. Bred by Sherbinskis, the cultivar celebrates the lineage that helped define modern West Coast genetics while offering a fresh, flavorful spin on the classics. Expect rich bag appeal: frosted olive-green buds with amber threads and a creamy, lingering aftertaste that echoes the sherbet-and-cookies lineage.

Effects tend to open with clear, upbeat focus and gentle euphoria before easing into a calm, full-body composure that keeps the head clear. Indoors, plants remain medium in stature (roughly 90-110 cm) and typically finish in 60-65 days; yields are generous for a boutique cut - about 500-600 g/m2 - while well-grown outdoor plants can push toward a kilogram each. Expect a terpene chorus led by limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene supporting the citrus-and-cream profile. Flowers appear dense and sugar-coated, with glacier frosting over lime and violet-green. Conceived by the team behind the original Gelato, Airwhon reads like a modern Gelato chapter: polished structure, designer aromatics, and a lively-yet-composed tempo that lingers pleasantly from the first crack of the jar to the last note on the palate.

This strain is quite easy to grow while offering medium to high yields in about 8 to 9 weeks of flowering. It thrives both indoors and outdoors, making it a versatile option for various cultivation setups and growers of all experience levels. The effects of Jokerz Candy offer a relaxing, euphoric high that combines an energetic cerebral buzz with deep body relaxation, making it perfect for unwinding after a long day without overwhelming sedation, allowing you to stay focused, happy, and sociable. For medical use, Jokerz Candy is ideal for those seeking relief from symptoms of chronic pain, anxiety, insomnia, and stress. The flavor profile combines sweet, fruity candy notes with prominent grape and berry flavors, complemented by a skunky, earthy undertone that finishes with a touch of peppery and floral accents that round out the taste.

name: Citrus Cookies Kush
description: Citrus Cookies Kush wraps classic West Coast lineage in a bright, dessert-forward profile. Built from Girl Scout Cookies and OG Kush, this indica-leaning hybrid (about 70/30) layers zesty citrus and lime over sweet cookie dough and gentle earthy. A smooth lift arrives first, leaving you clear and happy, then the body unwinds into deep relaxation and a drowsy finish. Typical flowers test in the low-to-mid 20s for THC (roughly 22-25%) with trace CBD around 0.07%, and an aromatic terpene trio led by limonene, myrcene, and linalool. In the garden, plants stay medium in stature with sturdy laterals and moderate internodal spacing, finishing in 55-60 days indoors. Resin-laden calyxes stack into dense, conical colas that trim cleanly and return a reliable medium yield. Dried buds often show forest-green hues with bright orange pistils and a silvery coat of trichomes. The flavor echoes the jar: bright citrus peel and lime zest up front, sugared-cookie sweetness through the mid, and a tidy earthy finish. Popularized in jars and extracts by The Standard, Citrus Cookies Kush channels its pedigree with poise, pairing the confectionary charm of GSC with the composed, Kush-bred tranquility of OG. For fans of flavorful indica-dominant Cookies lines, it neatly balances mood-lifting sparkle with cozy, couch-friendly calm.

name: Sherbacio Biscotti
description: Sherbacio Biscotti is an indica-dominant hybrid strain, bred from the genetics of Sherbacio and Biscotti, renowned for its mouth-watering dessert-like flavors and THC levels ranging from 18% to 28%. In terms of flavor, Sherbacio Biscotti delivers a delicious dessert-like profile, blending sweet and creamy berry notes with a nutty, earthy background, followed by hints of citrus, cinnamon, and spicy herbals that create a smooth, satisfying experience. This strain is great for growers of all experience levels as it is resilient and relatively easy to cultivate, thriving in various climates and setups while producing medium yields of up to 400 g/m2 indoors and 600 g/plant outdoors within 8 to 9 weeks of flowering. The effects of Sherbacio Biscotti are felt almost immediately, starting with an uplifting, euphoric cerebral buzz that transitions into a relaxing body high that is perfect for daytime creativity, socializing, or evening wind-down without heavy sedation. Medically, Sherbacio Biscotti is ideal for those dealing with stress and anxiety, as well as chronic pain and inflammation.

name: Emerald CBG
description: Emerald CBG is a CBG-forward flower from a Trilogy × Harmony Rose cross at Emerald Spirit Botanicals in Mendocino. Compact and bushy, the plant produces bright-green buds with subtle purple hues and dense calyxes. Typical lab results show ≈14% CBG, ~0.22% THC, and a touch of CBC ~0.38%. The aroma is reminiscent of roasted chamomile tea with mint and cracked black pepper, and the effects are relaxing to the body, promoting mental clarity and focus, while providing mild relief from discomfort (pain). Emerald CBG has earned Gold for Highest CBG at the 2024 California State Fair Cannabis Awards and a 2025 Gold Medal for CBGA expression, reflecting its rare chemistry and careful selection.

name: Midnight Scoop
description: Midnight Scoop blends the dessert-rich depth of Ice Cream Cake with the bright, gassy candy edge of Gassy Taffy, forming a modern indica-dominant hybrid from Symbiotic Genetics designed for evening use. Plants grow to a manageable medium height, producing dense, frost-heavy colas that typically finish in 56–63 days, with strong yield potential when airflow and canopy are properly managed. Aromas open creamy and sweet-vanilla frosting, sugared berries, and soft dough—before shifting toward diesel with a light pine accent. Effects lean relaxing and euphoric, promoting a calm, contented mood without harsh edges, reflecting the potency of both parents while maintaining balance. Structurally, Midnight Scoop is grower-friendly, with moderate internodes, sturdy lateral branching, and resin-packed flowers that respond well to basic trellising.

name: Anomaly
description: Anomaly by Symbiotic Genetics combines the savory-funk of GMO with the candy-gas sweetness of Gassy Taffy, producing an indica-leaning hybrid prized for resin and bag appeal. Plants develop a vigorous, medium-tall frame with strong laterals, stacking spear-shaped colas that frost early, with colors shifting from lime to violet as flowering progresses. The aroma opens with diesel and garlic, followed by ribbons of grape taffy and confectioner’s sugar, grounded by earthy spice. The flavor mirrors the nose, with diesel, grape, and soft sweetness lingering on the palate. Typical lab results place THC in the mid-20s and CBD under 1%, while the effect delivers uplifted euphoria and focused calm, combined with deep body relaxation. Indoor flowering finishes in approximately 63–70 days, with outdoor harvest in early to mid-October. High calyx-to-leaf ratio and abundant trichomes support generous yields-around 600 g/m² indoors and substantial single-plant harvests outdoors.

name: Nilla Wafer
description: Nilla Wafer, aka Vanilla Wafers and most commonly referred to as Wedding Driver, is a balance hybrid created from crossing rich and creamy Wedding Cake with flavorful Sundae Driver. This brilliant cross resulted in cultivar with 23-25% THC that’s known for its delicious dessert-like profile, and smooth, uplifting high. This fan-favorite has a sweet and creamy flavor blending nutty vanilla cookie dough with sugar-coated berries. Her effects make this a fantastic daytime or wake-and-bake strain, starting with an uplifted clarity that’s both calming and focused. This transitions into a motivating and energetic buzz with inspired creativity, making it a great option for staying productive or enjoying a fun, social high. When it comes to medical effects, Nilla Wafer could help patients seeking relief from fatigue, stress, depression, ADD/ADHD, headaches, and migraines. Best for growers with some experience, she has a moderate difficulty. Plants are resilient but susceptible to mold, meaning proper airflow, humidity, and temperature are essential for a successful harvest. Flowering time typically wraps up in 56-70 days. Give her the right care and she’ll reward growers with high yields that can reach over 400g/m2 indoors, and up to 600g/plant or higher outdoors. Buds are colorful and dense, with deep greens hues highlighted with purples and violets along with bright orange pistils for extra pop, coated in an abundance of frosty, milky white trichomes.

She has a pungent flavor that combines sour lemon citrus and loud chemical notes with spicy funky diesel and rich earthy undertones on the exhale. The effects start with a bright and uplifting cerebral euphoric that transitions into a warm and creative energy. A relaxing body high follows, keeping you grounded without heavy sedation or lethargy. When it comes to medical use, Sour OG Chem could help users seeking relief from stress, depression, and chronic pain. This strain has a moderate grow difficulty, producing medium to tall plants that thrive both indoors and outdoors. Flowering time typically wraps up in 49-63 days, where she’ll reward attentive growers with high yields that can reach 600g/m2 indoors and as much as 1100g/plant outdoors with optimal care. Her frosty earthy green buds with vibrant orange pistils are coated thickly with glistening trichome crystals.

The aroma is bright and sugary, led by sweet berries and citrus zest, with a faint diesel note lingering on the finish. Effects unfold in two stages: an uplifted, focused mood up front, followed by a comfortable, body-level relaxation that leaves users calm, content, and ready to unwind. Typical lab results fall around 24–25% THC with negligible CBD. Sometimes referred to as Cranberry Z, this cultivar is valued for its uniformity, terpene expression, and sticky, wash-friendly resin. Cranberry Zkittlez delivers a polished dessert profile with a tart twist, honoring its Z and Sherb–Kush lineage while offering a balanced, visually striking end result.

The flavor mirrors the nose, combining sweet berries, soft citrus, and a touch of kushy richness. Typically THC-dominant with low CBD, the experience delivers a relaxed, euphoric body accompanied by a bright, uplifting mood. Growers appreciate the cooperative structure, tidy internodes, and the way the plant builds dense, frosted tops without demanding excessive care. Indoor or outdoor, Cranberry is easy to manage while rewarding with visually appealing, flavorful buds. This cultivar captures the creamy candy of Sherbert and the berry-gas nuances of Pieface and Kimbo Kush, offering a balanced, connoisseur-grade hybrid that is grower-friendly.

Growing these plants means you’re in for bushy and medium-tall ladies that benefit from pruning and some low-stress training. Bred by Solfire Gardens, Dino-Might is a limited-run hybrid designed for both connoisseur jar appeal and practical production, delivering tropical-citrus sweetness, a ribbon of diesel, and a lively grin that lingers. Training-friendly and easy to trim, it shines in either tent or field.

Potency can be formidable, commonly testing in the high teens to upper twenties in THC (roughly 17–29%) with about 1% CBD. In action, it tends to lift the mood into a happy, occasionally giggly headspace while settling the body into an easy, relaxed groove. Despite its compact structure (often topping out near 0–4 ft), it performs respectably, returning around 400 g/m² indoors and roughly 300 g per plant outdoors when dialed-in. The cross first drew attention in California’s concentrate scene and has since appeared as feminized seed; this entry reflects the Sour Watermelon offered by Crop King Seeds while acknowledging Raw Garden’s role in popularizing the Sour Pinot x Watermelon x Sour Crack lineage.

It won’t take long before an energetic and uplifting buzz lifts your mind until euphoric thoughts are all that remain. Expect a buoyant, modern-hybrid experience: quick, cheerful lift, relaxed body calm, and an easy, contented glide that keeps conversation flowing. Under dialed conditions, yield lands in the comfortable middle or above average, with sparkling bag appeal that cures into sticky, sugar-glass buds. Growers can anticipate moderate difficulty: feed moderately, keep airflow consistent, and plan for a 2x stretch as pistils explode in weeks two through four. Cosmic Howler’s parents do the talking; you’ll recognize Prince’s dessert tones wrapped around Bubba’s structure and Runtz’s sherbet gloss, pulled together by DojoFruit’s juicy brightness. Bred and released by Dojo Seed Co., this cultivar feels custom-tuned for enthusiasts who prize flavor density, clean structure, and a polished, feel-good ride.

name: Pepper Jelly
description: Pepper Jelly from Dojo Seed Co. wraps the bite of Chili Verde (Keylime Pie x Lavender) in the candy-slick glow of Runtz S1, merging peppery heat and bright lime over a sugared backdrop. In the garden, this feminized photoperiod grows stout and branchy with thick, resin-glazed colas; expect a straightforward 60–70 day bloom and notably heavy sets of dense, sticky flowers when dialed in. The nose opens with ground black pepper and herbal spice (a caryophyllene push), quickly chased by limonene-driven lime peel and a linalool whisper of lavender. On the palate it lands sweet, then tingles into zesty, peppered citrus. Effects arrive fast and balanced: an upbeat, euphoric mood lift that settles into easy happiness and clean body calm, with typical THC-forward potency and generally low CBD. Growers report chunky structure and strong apical tops that respond well to light training; yields can be generous indoors or out with good airflow and support late flower. If you chase flavor, Pepper Jelly stands out for its culinary contrast — sweet-meets-savory — and for the way its parents’ characters remain distinct yet harmonious. Created by Dojo Seed Co., it is a modern hybrid that tastes bold, finishes in roughly nine weeks, and stacks weight without sacrificing sparkle.

name: Vader’s Starkiller
description: Rare Dankness Seeds' Vader's Starkiller fuses the award pedigree of Starkiller OG with the doughy, fuel-tinted Pamelina, yielding a hybrid that is both muscular and refined. Expect dense, golf-ball flowers stacking into self-supporting spears, often flashing violet hues beneath a frosty shell of trichomes; some phenotypes appreciate light trellising as they swell. The nose opens with classic OG kush gas layered over bakery sweetness and a hint of pine; on the palate diesel, pine, and subtle sugar notes linger. Reported effects tilt deeply relaxing and serene, drifting toward euphoric calm and easy sleep, while the head stays unhurried. Indoors or out, this cultivar thrives with attentive environment control, rewarding growers with notably high yields after roughly 60-66 days of bloom. While exact lab ranges vary by phenotype, potency commonly lands in the high-THC, low-CBD bracket typical of its lineage; expect caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene to headline the terpene mix. As a nod to heritage, its Starkiller OG parent collected major hardware, including Best Hybrid Flower at the 2016 Colorado Cannabis Cup, while Pamelina contributes structure, color, and a confectionary edge.

name: Trip Sauce
description: Trip Sauce, aka Scott's Lemon G, is a terpene-laden creation from Rare Dankness that splices Scott's OG and Lemon G, then folds Scott's OG back in, for a citrus bomb with OG grit. Expect a nose of lemon zest and sour gas that turns to lemon-candy sweetness on the palate, trailing a faint diesel bite. Plants display OG-leaning morphology with strong apical dominance and thick, sugared calyces; resin coverage is conspicuous and geared toward concentrate makers. Most phenotypes finish in roughly 60 days of flower and reward attentive dialing with solid, sticky harvests. Structure stays manageable indoors, with moderate stretch and straightforward training, while outdoor runs prefer a dry, warm finish. Limonene leads the terpene stack, typically supported by caryophyllene and myrcene for a bright, zesty profile anchored by kushy depth. The high rides a happy, euphoric lift with clear, upbeat focus before settling into a relaxed, contented cruise, an energetic lemon top note balanced by classic OG calm.

name: Hand Pie
description: Hand Pie from Dojo Seed Co. slices into the dessert lineage with a simple, mouthwatering recipe: Cherry Pie x Runtz. Selected from a batch the breeder called uniquely different, this photoperiod feminized line finishes in about nine weeks of bloom, stacking resin-glossed, medium-dense colas that carry a candy-shop bouquet. Crack a jar and the room pops with sweet-and-tart notes, backed by bright fruit and a faint kushy undercurrent. On the palate it mirrors that profile: sweet, sour, and fruity with a clean, sugary finish. The experience tracks hybrid and upbeat, opening with a buoyant, euphoric lift and easy laughter before settling into a smooth, relaxed body tone that stays functional. Typical phenotypes lean toward caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool in the terpene mix, echoing Runtz heritage while Cherry Pie lends the confectionary edge and colorful bag appeal. Indoors, its balanced structure responds well to topping and light training, keeping canopies tidy and uniform. THC and CBD levels vary by selection and environment; Hand Pie is bred for flavor-first enjoyment, aroma, and well-rounded, happy effects rather than sheer numbers. Crafted by Dojo Seed Co., it is a sweet-toothed showcase designed for growers and connoisseurs alike. Expect ripe-fruit jar appeal and photogenic, sugar-dusted flowers.

name: Candy College
description: Candy College from Dojo Seed Co. enrolls classic OG power in a sweet, modern curriculum by pairing Oaksterdam OG (also known as Marathon OG) with Runtz. The result is a hybrid that reads indica in posture but feels balanced in practice: aromas open with bright lemon and pine over a diesel baseline, then flip to a sugary fruit finish as the grinder warms the terps. Indoors, plants show OG Kush structure - upright frames, firm internodes, and heavy trichome coverage - with some phenos flashing lime-to-lavender hues late in bloom. Flowering typically wraps in 60-70 days (about nine weeks), and the feminized photoperiod release rewards dialed-in environments with dense, resin-caked tops. In the jar, dried buds carry brisk lemon, pine, and gas layered by candy sweetness from the Runtz side. On the palate, that profile translates cleanly, while effects arrive quickly: euphoric and uplifted on the front end, settling into a steady, relaxed cruise that keeps the mind clear. Lab numbers vary by cut and room, but Candy College's lineage is known for assertive potency. Bred by Dojo Seed Co., this cross is a flavorful study in old-school OG bite wrapped in a neon candy glow. Expect moderate difficulty and best results from consistent airflow, canopy control, and a thoughtful dry and cure.

name: Dark Saber
description: For Rare Dankness's 2024 new-release slate, Dark Saber is a mostly indica hybrid that fuses Starkiller OG with Luv Muffin. Medium-height plants with stout, resilient branching stack dense, frost-heavy colas that flash deep purples against forest greens, a nod to the Luv Muffin side, while the structure often reads OG. Indoors it finishes in 60-65 days and, under dialed conditions, returns high yields around 550 g per m2; outdoors, expect roughly 600 g per plant. The bouquet is unmistakably OG at first - pine and lemon over earth - braided with blueberry and cookie-dough sweetness and a whisper of Bubba spice. The flavor follows suit, shifting from sweet berry to earthy, pine-kissed exhale. Typical batches test in the 20-25% THC range with low CBD, and the terpene tilt reflects its pedigree, commonly led by caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. The effect profile lands warmly in the body while keeping mood buoyant - relaxed, happy, and gently euphoric - true to its indica-dominant nature. Crafted by Rare Dankness, Dark Saber also inherits the decorated heritage of Starkiller OG, bringing a modern, colorful finish to a reliable, grower-friendly frame. Phenotypes that lean to Luv Muffin may stretch a touch taller and throw darker hues, while OG-leaners stack squat, symmetrical spears ideal for trellis or light training.

name: F-Cut LR TK
description: F-Cut LR TK from Rare Dankness is a modern OG throwback that splices the rare F-Cut OG Kush with Lee Roy TK to sharpen structure and potency. In the garden, plants show a classic OG silhouette - medium height, firm laterals, and triangular, mint-green flowers that frost heavily - finishing in 57-65 days with medium or above average yields when dialed. The bouquet lands squarely in the OG lane: deep earthy and woody notes edged by fresh pine and a light herbal snap; on the palate it stays earthy-kushy with a clean, resinous finish. Expect an indica-leaning ride (about 70/30) that builds from a euphoric lift into full-body calm; many describe a happy, tranquil clarity rather than couchlock. Its terpene mix trends toward myrcene, caryophyllene, and pinene, amplifying the foresty profile, while THC potential is very high, with top cuts testing in the mid-to-upper 20s and CBD minimal. F-Cut LR TK rewards a proficient hand: strong light, airflow, and attentive feeding keep those dense colas stacking and the OG structure tidy.

name: Wham
description: As one of those rare hybrid genetically in perfect balance, Wham is ready to slap just about anybody with an incredible 37,54% measured THC content. This hard-to-find strain, bred by The Holding Company, is the result of crossbreeding Super Runtz with ADL, and both smoking and growing it is recommended for the more experienced consumer/grower. It’s difficult to grow, picky when it comes to environmental factors and needs meticulous management of nutrients to thrive. When cultivated correctly, growers are rewarded with abundant yields of extremely potent buds. The flavor is above all fruity and gassy, think of a potent mix of diesel, lemon, and mint. The aroma is almost similar, a bit sweeter maybe. The Wham high induces feelings of relaxed, euphoria, happiness, and – at the end of the experience – extreme hunger (read: the munchies), making it an ideal strain for medical users searching for relief from depression, anxiety, and lack of appetite – or for patients recovering from a long sickbed.

name: Muscadine
description: Muscadine from Rare Dankness distills the label’s grape-forward pedigree into a compact, fast-finishing photoperiod hybrid. Built from Rare Darkness and Pamelina, it carries a short, self-supporting structure with medium‑size, resin-heavy flowers that finish in 50–55 days. Indoors, plants typically reach 80–120 cm and respond well to modest training; expect medium to high production around 500 g/m², while well-sited outdoor plants can top 650 g per plant. The aroma leans tart berry and black grape with a subtle red‑wine note and a kushy OG echo; flavors match, layering berry sweetness over a faint earth tone. Lab and retailer reports place THC in the 20–26% band with low CBD, delivering a calm, balanced high that nudges mood without heavy sedation. Terpenes commonly reported include myrcene, caryophyllene, and alpha‑pinene, reinforcing the dark‑fruit profile and gentle physical ease. Thanks to its stability, manageable height, and quick turnaround, Muscadine suits tight indoor spaces or multi‑cycle rooms. Rare Dankness’s selection preserves the character of Rare Darkness while brightening it with Pamelina’s density and finish, yielding a grape‑driven cut that is both flavorful and efficient to run. An indica-leaning 60/40 genetic, it grows easily in soil or coco, keeps internodes tight, and finishes with dense, frosted colas that trim clean and cure to a wine‑and‑berry bouquet.

name: Purple Swish Haze
description: Purple Swish Haze from Rare Dankness Seeds bridges two beloved lineages, marrying Purple Swish (Purple Urkle x Rare Dankness #1) with Neville's Haze to deliver a color-soaked hybrid with classic haze character. Phenotypes split between inky, Urkle-leaning flowers and taller, spear-shaped, Neville's Haze green colas; both prefer trellising, strong light, and attentive nutrition. Aromas lead with sweet berry and citrus over a telltale metallic haze, finishing in pine; the flavor mirrors that bouquet. Reported THC sits in the mid-20s (often 24-26%), while CBD remains minimal. Effects arrive uplifting and euphoric with creative focus, settling into an airy, long-legged cruise that reflects its sativa tilt. Indoors, experienced growers can expect a 10-12 week flowering window, while yields run medium to high; benchmarks commonly cited are up to 650 g/m2 indoors and around 800 g per plant outdoors under ideal conditions. Structure is vigorous with robust branching and noticeable stretch in bloom; canopy control rewards with elongated, resinous spears. Bred by Rare Dankness Seeds, Purple Swish Haze is a modern mash-up that preserves the purple sweetness of its Swish parent and the shimmering, cathedral-like lift of Neville's Haze. Seasoned hands will find ample headroom for phenotype hunting.

name: Starkiller Haze
description: Starkiller Haze by Rare Dankness fuses the award laden heft of Starkiller OG with the soaring vigor of Neville's Haze, creating a hybrid that looks as assertive as it grows. In flower, golf-ball buds stack along sturdy branches, light green with occasional purple flashes and wrapped in thick trichomes; some phenos appreciate trellising as stretch kicks in, echoing its Haze parentage. The bouquet blends classic kush depth with old school haze high notes, while flavors lean earthy and lime forward with a spicy herbal finish. Expect a high yielding cycle that finishes in roughly 65 to 75 days, indoors or out, rewarding dialed in lighting and nutrition. Effects trend balanced yet pronounced: an uplifting, euphoric onset brings focus and creative lift before settling into a centered, contented calm. Typical reports note dry mouth or eyes in heavier sessions. While official lab ranges vary by grow, this is a decidedly THC forward cultivar with CBD generally minimal; terpene expression commonly highlights limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, with terpinolene surfacing in haze leaning selections. Bred and released by Rare Dankness, Starkiller Haze carries the pedigree of its parents, Starkiller OG's cup winning legacy and Neville's Haze's legendary lineage, into a contemporary, production friendly form.

name: Super Sour Space Candy
description: Super Sour Space Candy from Oregon CBD Seeds rockets the classic Sour profile into orbit. Built by crossing the pioneering CBD parent Sour Tsunami with Oregon CBD's GG#4 CBD Conversion, this sativa-leaning hybrid (about 70/30) is prized for its fast, reliable performance and exuberant aromas. Expect big, resin-frosted colas and a sturdy, medium-height frame that finishes in just 7-8 weeks, with production that consistently leans high. Cracking a jar releases a bright sour-green-apple snap over diesel and pepper, with terpinolene and beta-caryophyllene leading a terp lineup rounded by myrcene. Typical lab results place CBD in the mid-teens to high-teens (roughly 15-19% depending on lot) while delta-9 THC remains compliant and total THC usually stays below 1%, preserving clear, functional effects. On the palate, the sour-candy tang persists alongside apple skin and faint mint, and the smoke dries down to a clean, lightly earthy finish. The ride tends to be composed and upbeat, focused and uplifted without edge, making SSSC a favorite daytime Type III flower. Credit to Oregon CBD Seeds for the "Super" re-work: using a powerful GG#4 pollinator, they tightened bud structure, increased terpene output, and kept the signature sour sparkle that made this line a smokeable-flower staple. Outdoors, many phenos reach maturity by early to mid-September in temperate zones.

name: Sour Suver Haze
description: Bred by Oregon CBD Seeds, Sour Suver Haze splices the classic Suver8 to an improved GG#4 CBD Conversion pollinator, yielding a sativa-leaning hemp cultivar that balances field vigor with jar appeal. Its dense, lime-green colas build quickly on a stout, wind-resistant frame, finishing in roughly 7-9 weeks indoors (early to mid September outdoors) with consistently high flower output. Crack a cured bud and you will get bright aromas of sour lime, sweet apple, and fresh pine; on the palate those notes layer over a faint cinnamon-spice snap, a profile driven by myrcene, terpinolene, and beta-caryophyllene. In third-party lab results, CBD commonly lands in the mid to high teens with total THC around 0.7% and a CBD:THC ratio of roughly 26-28:1, keeping compliant while delivering robust resin. The experience trends uplifting and focused yet calm, making this cultivar a versatile daytime or early-evening choice. Growers value its mold and mildew resistance inherited from Suver8 and the added gassy vigor from GG#4's conversion, plus its tidy structure that trims easily. The variety's quality has been noticed, earning 3rd at the 2022 Oregon Growers Cup, and the triploid Seedless sister capturing 3rd at the 2023 High Times Hemp Cup. Suver8 x GG#4 CBD Conversion shows why Oregon breeders still lead hemp genetics.

name: Sour Hawaiian Haze
description: Born in Oregon breeding, Sour Hawaiian Haze threads the tropical lift of DCHaze "CC" with the fuelly bite of a GG#4 CBD Conversion. Sativa leaning in posture and effect, plants stretch vigorously and set lime-green, resin frosted colas with notably improved density; expect high yields indoors or out and a fast 7-8 week bloom. The nose blends sour grapefruit, ripe pineapple, and wildflower over a clean diesel backbeat, a profile driven by myrcene, terpinolene, alpha-pinene, and beta-caryophyllene. Typical finished flowers test around 14.5-18% CBD with about 0.10-0.28% delta-9 THC (roughly a 25:1 CBD:THC ratio), keeping this cultivar firmly in hemp territory while preserving loud, Haze-forward flavor. On the palate it opens sweet-tropical before turning zesty and gassy, finishing dry and bright. In the jar and in the field, Sour Hawaiian Haze has a bit of a resume: it earned 1st place at the 2021 Oregon Growers Cup, captured a Top Terpenes accolade at the 2022 Golden Grow Awards, and returned to take 1st again at the 2023 Oregon Growers Cup. Bred by Oregon CBD Seeds, this cultivar favors an energetic, uplifted, and focused vibe without heaviness - ideal for daytime creativity when you want vivid aromatics and efficient, reliable production.

name: Sour Special Sauce
description: Sour Special Sauce turns the beloved Special Sauce into a tangier, louder rendition by pairing it with GG#4 Conversion, an Oregon CBD Seeds pollinator selected to boost resin, aroma, and structure. The result is a CBD-rich, indica-leaning hybrid that opens with sweet berry and sour citrus, then settles into earthy, diesel depth. Dominant terpenes lead with myrcene, terpinolene, and beta-caryophyllene, with limonene adding a bright, gassy lift. In real-world crops this cultivar commonly posts a CBD:THC ratio near 28:1, with compliant delta-9 levels and CBD in the mid-teens, while the flowers themselves flash brilliant green and early pink pistils inherited from the Special Sauce mom. Growers value its vigor and field-ready uniformity; this line was selected to thrive in humid or coastal conditions and to stack dense, resinous colas with improved bud-to-leaf ratios. Indoors, expect a rapid 7-8 week finish; outdoors it typically wraps by early to mid-September in temperate latitudes. Breeders describe it as a high-yielding performer, making it just as comfortable in a smokable program as in terpene-forward extraction. On the palate, berry jam meets diesel and fresh soil. The experience trends calm, contented, and decidedly unwound without edge - more mellow than racy - true to its indica-style personality. Bred and released by Oregon CBD Seeds.

name: Sour Lifter
description: Sour Lifter kicks off with the citrus-and-grape pop its name promises, then deepens into a gassy sour-diesel finish that lingers on the tongue. Bred by Oregon CBD Seeds, this sativa-leaning hybrid pairs Suver Haze #50 with a CBD-dominant Gorilla Glue #4 conversion, delivering dense, resin-laden flowers that stack quickly and finish fast. Growers appreciate its early 7-8 week flowering window, minimal phenotypic drift, and reliably heavy yields; the sturdy, upright structure makes canopy management simple indoors and vigorous outdoors. Typical batches clock CBD in the mid-to-high teens (often 15-20% or higher) with compliant delta-9 THC below 0.3%, so you get a terpene-led experience without intoxication. Expect a bright, candy-sour nose driven by terpinolene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene, with supporting humulene and bisabolol adding spice, hop, and floral facets. Effects trend clear and upbeat: many fans describe a focused lift and easy motivation that settles into relaxed composure as the session unfolds. Morphologically, Sour Lifter forms elongated, lime-to-forest green colas braided with vivid orange pistils and a sugar-frost glaze of trichomes; cured buds break apart sticky and aromatic. Whether destined for top-shelf Type III flower or efficient extraction, Sour Lifter's fast finish, big bags, and loud, sour-citrus profile make it a field and jar favorite.

name: Sour G CBG
description: Forged by Oregon CBD, Sour G CBG carries the unmistakable DNA of its primary parent, Sour Diesel, reimagined into a Type IV (CBG-dominant) photoperiod flower built for vigor and compliance. Compact and easy to manage, plants stay short and squat, stacking lime-green, frost-laden colas that glint almost white at maturity. The nose leans refined rather than loud: a peppery-citrus top over woody earthy and a faint diesel echo. Dominant terpenes regularly reported include alpha-bisabolol and guaiol, with myrcene and occasional limonene/caryophyllene rounding the bouquet. Typical lab panels show total THC around 0.1% with CBD near or below LOQ, while CBG takes center stage; farmers and buyers commonly see 12–20% CBG depending on season and finish. In the bowl or jar, expect clean, lightly sour citrus and diesel with an earthy backbone. Effects skew bright and functional—clear-headed focus, uplift, and gentle energy—true to the sativa-leaning profile. In production, Sour G CBG finishes quickly in roughly 7–8 weeks of flower, allowing flexible rotations; yields are dependable and medium, with dense, trichome-heavy buds that cure evenly. For lineage sticklers: Sour G CBG descends from Sour Diesel crossed to an undisclosed CBG donor; credit to breeder Oregon CBD for the release. Plants thrive indoors or out and remain manageable in height, making training optional for most rooms.

name: Lemon Cherry Candy
description: Lemon Cherry Candy is a lively, sativa-leaning hybrid that does exactly what its name promises. Captain Seeds presents this photoperiod cultivar from Lemon Skunk x Cherry Pie, a pairing that stacks bright, zesty citrus over confectionary red-fruit sweetness. In the jar and on the grind, dominant limonene leads with caryophyllene and myrcene supporting, translating to lemon-candy top notes, a soft berry-pastry mid, and a clean, sugary finish. Plants grow with medium internodes and sturdy lateral branching, typically 80-160 cm indoors and up to 2-3 m outdoors when topped early. Expect a 56-70 day bloom and generous yields around 450-600 g/m2 inside or 600-900 g per plant outside, with dense, resinous flowers that trim quickly. Reported THC commonly lands in the 18-23% window while CBD stays around 0.5-1%, shaping an effect profile described as uplifted, focused, and pleasantly euphoric without heaviness. In short, Lemon Cherry Candy packages modern dessert terps into a straightforward, productive grow: easy training, medium difficulty overall, high returns, and a flavor that lives up to its label. If you chase lemon brightness with candy edges and want a plant that pays you back in both aroma and weight, this cross puts a bow on both. Balanced, glossy, and unmistakably sweet-citrus.

name: Peanut Butter Mintz
description: Peanut Butter Mintz is a dessert-leaning hybrid that delivers exactly what its name promises, blending the cool, herbal snap of mint with roasted‑nut richness and a bright citrus twist. This 70% indica, 30% sativa cross of Kush Mintz and Peanut Butter Breath typically tests in the mid‑to‑high 20s for THC (about 24–32%) with trace CBD, and expresses a terpene trio of beta‑caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. Dense, resin‑laden flowers range from forest green to deep violet, stacking into conical spears that glitter under a thick frost of trichomes. The aroma opens with sweet peanut butter and lemon peel over menthol and earthy cookie tones; on the palate, nutty creaminess gives way to mint and zesty citrus. Effects arrive quickly: a cheerful, euphoric lift washes into an easygoing, full‑body calm that keeps the mood elevated and the mind unhurried. In the garden, Peanut Butter Mintz grows with medium vigor and stout lateral branching, finishing in roughly 60–70 days of flower. Indoors expect around 600 g/m²; outdoors, well‑supported plants can push toward 900g per plant, with heights of about 100cm inside and up to 200cm outside.

name: GMOB
description: G-MOB is Biovortex’s savory, solventless-friendly hash monster bred by pairing GMO with Banana Valley Dog, a Banana OG line backed by SFV OG and Black D.O.G. genetics. Tall, fast-growing plants stack long spears of resin-drenched flowers, then settle into a roughly nine-week indoor bloom; outdoors, they run late into October where their notable resistance to mold helps finish clean. The nose leans pantry-salty rather than candy-sweet: garlic and diesel over sweet earth, with a piney flicker that lingers on the palate. Expect an indica-leaning experience that blends dreamy calm with buoyant euphoria and an easy, happy unwind. High resin output and hearty structure make G-MOB a favorite for ice water extraction, while farmers appreciate its vigor and generous yields. Limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene typically lead the terpene chorus, shaping the garlic-gas profile and giving the finish its citrus-bright lift. THC content trends high with CBD low, but what stands out most is the layered, evolving flavor—banana-tinged funk meeting garlic, gas, and forest spice—true to its GMO × Banana Valley Dog lineage. Credit to Biovortex for selecting and refining a cultivar that brings both production and personality to the garden and the press.

name: Trippin' Dots
description: Trippin’ Dots is a boutique, indica-leaning hybrid from Cipher Genetics that braids Honey Banana and Orange Mints into Blackberry Octane’s gassy backbone. Crack a jar and you’re met with sweet banana-smoothie aromatics, layered with zesty citrus and mixed-berry tones, then a cool mint finish and a whiff of petrol. Limonene leads the terpene chorus, with myrcene and beta‑caryophyllene adding creamy zest, plush body, and a faint peppery edge. Plants show vigorous, resin-forward morphology: elongated, arrowhead buds, dark olive leaves, and a heavy coat of milky trichomes. Expect moderate stretch, easy canopy management, and an 8–9 week bloom window. name: Applescotti

Lab results typically land in the mid‑20s for THC (about 24.4–27.4%) with trace CBD near 0.03–0.06%. A terpene trio of beta‑caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene shapes the profile - peppery warmth meets citrus lift and a subtle herbal backbone. The effect comes on upbeat and euphoric, often sharpening focus and conversation before easing into a smooth, relaxed finish. Well‑grown Applescotti shows tight, cookie‑style calyxes that trim clean and cure to a glossy, gassy sweetness, rewarding careful storage with a persistent, bakery‑meets‑fuel nose. For fans of fruit‑driven hybrids that still bring depth and structure, this cultivar captures the best of its lineage in a striking, flavorful expression from Preferred Gardens.

While formal cultivation specs are scarce for this pheno, growers familiar with its parents will recognize medium vigor and yields under controlled indoor or mixed‑light conditions. name: Guavaz
description: Guavaz is a standout hybrid strain bred and cultivated by Preferred Gardens, crossing Rainbow Sherbert with Pink Guava to deliver a tropical, crowd-pleasing profile. This balanced hybrid (roughly a 80/20 indica–sativa split) boasts high THC levels typically in the 25–27% range (with some batches testing at 26.9%), offering a blissful, soothing experience that begins with gentle euphoria before easing into deep body relaxation. It’s ideal for evening use without full sedation—well suited for stress relief, mental calm, or unwinding after a busy day. Flavor is a highlight, led by bright tropical sorbet and creamy guava, backed by a funky diesel edge that adds depth and pungency. Aromas mirror the palate, where sweet tropical fruit meets chem funk, making it a terpene-forward standout. Visually, expect dense, frost-covered buds with Preferred Gardens’ signature resin production and occasional colorful accents from its lineage. Cultivation is moderately challenging but rewarding, with an 8–9 week flowering period, medium plant height, and solid yields under optimized conditions. CBD content remains low (generally under 1%), making Guavaz best suited for experienced consumers seeking potent, flavor-driven effects. For fans of fruit-forward yet gassy modern hybrids, Guavaz is a reliable selection from a top-tier craft brand.

Bred from Gelato 41 x Kush Mints, Duces leans into both sides of its family tree, layering bright citrus and pine over a crisp mint finish while a soft floral sweetness rounds the exhale. The effect lands smoothly and builds: relaxed yet alert, mood-lifting and sociable, with enough clean energy for conversation or a creative session. Expect a tranquil, happy body feel without heavy drag, though potency can nudge veteran tolerance. Grown indoors or in mixed-light by Preferred Gardens, the buds show tight cookie-leaning structure and sticky trichome coverage, reflecting meticulous curing and hand-trim. While formal flowering data isn’t published for this cut, cultivators familiar with the lineage can anticipate compact stacking and vigorous aroma through late bloom. In 2026, this cultivar headlined a live-judged High Rollers bracket run, underscoring its consistency under pressure. name: 06 OG #67
description: 06 OG #67 by CopyCat Genetics distills the chest-thumping gas of mid‑2000s LA OGs into a modern, high-output seed line. Indoors, plants stretch tall with strong laterals, stacking greasy, frost‑heavy colas that finish around day 63 (allow 63–70 days for phenotype variance). The experience lands quickly: euphoric lift gives way to a calm, body‑forward relaxation while keeping mood buoyant and appetite primed. A true 50/50, Reba Jam tends to spark clear, upbeat focus and creative lift while keeping the body comfortably at ease — an energetic yet composed vibe that nods to its jam-band namesake. Frosted calyxes and tangled amber pistils hint at generous resin coverage and a polished cure. Reported THC typically lands in the upper teens to around 20%, with negligible CBD, delivering presence without heaviness when the terps lead. The effect profile lands exactly where the aroma points—buzzy, uplifting, and social—bringing happy-hour energy with a clear, upbeat head and an easy body glow. In the garden, Paloma shows vigorous, uniform growth and exceptional resin production, delivering high yields of dense, trichome-caked flowers that make trimming and hash work a pleasure. Part of GDL’s culinary-inspired lineup and following the fan-favorite A5 Wagyu, Otoro showcases the brand’s breeding ethos—exclusive in-house genetics tuned for bold aroma, dense structure, and exceptional resin production. Growers report generous yields and easy handling compared with many Z selections, while the structure makes training and trellising straightforward. Limonene, myrcene, linalool and caryophyllene frequently dominate the terpene print, shaping its confectionary punch and smooth exhale. THC performance depends on selection and dial-in, but CBD remains low, keeping the expression squarely in the modern flavor-chaser lane. Dense, resin-caked buds sparkle under a snowy coat, releasing notes of sweet vanilla, berries, and soft cream with a faint citrus-spice earth beneath. A terpene stack led by beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene steers a mood-lifting, happy onset that settles into an easy, body-light calm without heaviness. Typical lab results place THC in the low-to-high 20s (about 22-28%) with trace CBD (<1%). Growers can expect compact, branching plants and a forgiving, medium difficulty cultivation curve. Indoors, Cookie Runtz finishes in roughly 8-10 weeks, with well-run rooms pulling around 450 g/m2; outdoors, plants can reach taller stature with moderate yields by early autumn.

name: Jamaican Lion
description: Jamaican Lion is a CBD-forward, sativa-leaning cultivar bred by Shadrock, created by pairing Mountain Lion (Rock Bud x Lionheart) with a Jamaican landrace. Expect a sweet herbal nose that drifts into ripe tropical fruit with pineapple brightness over an earthy base, a profile often led by myrcene with supporting pinene and caryophyllene. Its balanced chemotype commonly lands in the CBD 8–16% and THC 4.5–18% window, delivering a clear, functional lift that feels focused, uplifted, and gently energetic without edge. In the garden, Jamaican Lion shows sturdy, sativa-structured plants that stay manageable in height and respond well to light training. Indoors most phenotypes finish in 56–63 days of flowering with medium yields around the mid-300 g/m² mark; outdoors, well-grown plants can return roughly 425 g per plant by mid‑October in temperate zones.

name: Grapefruit Diesel
description: Grapefruit Diesel blends citrus zip with classic fuel, uniting NYC Diesel and Grapefruit in a balanced hybrid selected by Next Generation Seed Company. Expect mid-sized, branching plants that stack dense, resin-frosted colas; indoors they typically reach about 120–150 cm and finish quickly, with most gardens harvesting near 60 days of bloom. Yields are generous when dialed in, commonly around 500–600 g/m2 inside and roughly 250–300 g per plant outdoors, with occasional pink highlights on the flowers. The nose opens with grapefruit zest and sweet citrus over a polished diesel base; flavors track the aroma with clean grapefruit, bright citrus, and lingering fuel. Typical potency sits around 18–21% THC with 0.2–0.5% CBD, translating to an upbeat, functional ride: the onset is clear and focused, often sociable and talkative, before settling into a steady, uplifting calm.

name: Starberry
description: Starberry brings together two icons — Paradise Seeds’ Sensi Star and DJ Short’s Blueberry — in a CannaVenture selection that leans indica while keeping a playful, fruit-forward edge. Dense, medium-sized flowers glisten with icy trichomes and release a tangy-sweet bouquet of berry, blueberry, and citrus, underpinned by a touch of pine. Typical batches test in the mid-teens to about 20% THC with very low CBD, translating to a clear initial lift that settles into deep, body-centered calm. Many fans describe a relaxed, happy, euphoric mood with an easy fade, while classic side notes like dry mouth or dry eyes may appear. Growers appreciate Starberry’s forgiving nature and stability. Indoors or out, plants stay medium in stature with compact internodes; training in SOG/SCROG boosts yields. Expect an 8–9 week bloom, roughly 60–66 days, with harvest windows in early to mid-October outside.

name: Alpha Dog
description: Alpha Dog, also known as Alphadawg, channels the classic Chemdawg family power into a polished hybrid crafted by Alphakronik Genes. Built from Chemdawg D and a Snowdawg backcross, this 60/40 sativa-leaning cultivar forms medium, pine-shaped bushes with sturdy lateral branching and a heavy dusting of resin. Expect pungent diesel and skunk on the nose with a chemical edge; underneath, bright citrus sweetness peeks through as the caryophyllene-forward terpene profile folds in limonene and humulene. Typical batches test in the mid-to-high teens for THC (around 15-20%) with trace CBD, delivering an upbeat, happy lift that segues into full-body ease and, for many, a hungry, contented finish. Indoors, Alpha Dog usually wraps in about 70 days of bloom (roughly 65-75), while outdoor plants color up for a mid-late October harvest. Yields are reliably medium, helped by the cultivar's willingness to stack dense, trichome-rich tops without excessive stretch.

name: Orange Herijuana
description: Orange Herijuana blends the dessert-shop zest of Orange Creamsicle with the old-school potency of Herijuana. Expect bright aromas of orange peel and creamy vanilla lifted by a peppery edge, a profile often driven by limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene. The effect skews tranquil and mood-brightening at first, settling into a deeply relaxed body feel that mirrors its 70/30 indica-to-sativa makeup and its balanced, CBD-rich chemotype (commonly near 1:1, with roughly 10–12% THC and 10–12% CBD). Gardeners appreciate its straightforward cultivation: medium stature plants (about 5–8 ft when untrained) with conical, emerald buds and vivid orange pistils finish in approximately 53–63 days indoors, or around mid-September outside. Yields land near 400 g/m² under lights and about 500 g per plant outdoors when well dialed.

name: Dream Cake
description: Dream Cake layers the dessert genetics of Wedding Cake and Sunset Sherbet into a slightly indica-leaning hybrid bred by Seed Junky Genetics, later brought to market by Foxy Cannabis in 2022. Open a jar and you get vanilla-frosted pastry and sweet cream, with buttery undertones and a faint savory cheese note; the palate follows through with a soft berry finish. Compact, calyx-stacked buds wear a sparkling jacket of trichomes over lime-to-forest greens and bright orange pistils, a morphology that makes for easy trimming and resin-rich yields. Dominant terpenes caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene frame the profile, while THC typically hovers near 20% (most batches 18-22%) with trace CBD below 1%. The effect arrives upbeat and clear, lifting mood and focus into a creative, euphoric headspace before settling into a relaxed, balanced body vibe that stays functional rather than sleepy. In the garden, Dream Cake favors a moderate approach: medium height (about 120 cm indoors, 180 cm outdoors), an 8-9 week flowering window, and steady ventilation to keep those dense colas happy. Expect medium yields around 500 g/m2 inside and up to 700 g per plant outside when dialed in. For growers and flavor chasers alike, Dream Cake delivers rich dessert notes with practical, predictable performance consistently.

name: Turpee Slurpee
description: Turpee Slurpee, also known as Terpee Slurpee, stitches the pungent depth of GMO with the citrus sherbet sparkle of Orange Zkittlez. Bred by Surfr Seeds, this indica leaning hybrid carries an aromatic tide of lemon, lime, and sweet orange over faint diesel and spice; on the palate, the citrus returns bright and candy like before a peppery finish. Typical lab results land in the mid 20s, roughly 22 to 28% THC, with only trace CBD, and its profile leans on caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene for the peppered citrus drive. Plants grow sturdy and resinous, remaining medium in height indoors but stretching taller outdoors; expect an 8 to 9 week bloom (about 56 to 63 days) and generous harvests that can reach around 700 g/m2 inside and up to 1,250 g per plant outside when conditions are dialed. The experience tends to lift first, tingly, energizing, and uplifted, then settles into a focused calm without muting the bright, candy citrus character that made its Orange Zkittlez parent famous.

name: Starduster
description: Starduster from Dynasty Genetics lights up rooms like its name suggests, a sativa-leaning hybrid born from the pre-’99 Sour Diesel and the Ms. Universe #10 male. In the garden it shows classic Diesel vigor—tall, branchy frames with a 1–2x stretch and dense, resin-caked colas—finishing in 60–70 days. Growers often see bountiful returns, around 650 g/m2 indoors and roughly 1.1 kg per plant outside, while robust structure and strong trichome coverage make trimming straightforward. The bouquet blends tropical pineapple and berry with caramel, hash, and a faint haze; on the palate expect blueberry and pineapple sweetness wrapped in earthy diesel tones. Reported THC typically lands between 22–26% with trace CBD, powering an energetic, creative onset that sharpens focus before easing into a euphoric, full-body glow. Terpenes frequently expressed include terpinolene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, echoing the strain’s bright fruit, herbal spice, and gentle fuel. Plants can reach substantial height outdoors—up to about ten feet—yet respond well to topping and training to stack chunky spears.

name: Honey Crisp
description: Honey Crisp from ALTVM is a fruit-forward hybrid that lives up to its name, born from the union of Forbidden Jelly (In House Genetics) and Gas Bugnes (Skunk House Genetics, Apple Fritter x Paris Larry). Its bouquet opens with crisp apple and wild honey over bright citrus, settling into a faint skunk-kissed sweetness. Medium in stature with sturdy, lateral branching, Honey Crisp builds glistening calyxes that ripen in roughly 61 days indoors. Expect medium yields of dry, dense blossoms that trim easily and showcase a heavy dusting of resin. With THC typically in the 19-24% range and negligible CBD, the experience starts with a lifted, cheerful clarity before easing into a calm, body-centered relaxation that stays functional. Fans describe a balanced, all-occasion temperament: happy and uplifted without jitter, relaxed without couchlock. The flavor mirrors the aroma-apple first, then honeyed citrus-lingering sweet on the finish. Growers report moderate difficulty; the cut appreciates consistent climate and airflow during late bloom to keep those sugar-coated colas pristine. Whether you chase fruity profiles or simply want a modern hybrid that checks quality and utility, Honey Crisp threads the needle beautifully while giving a respectful nod to its flavorful parents.

name: Banana Mango
description: Banana Mango ripples with beachy energy from its Humboldt roots, a sativa-dominant (75/25) hybrid selected by Humboldt Seed Company. The breeders blended Banana OG and Mango Trees, then refined the line with Blueberry Muffin to lock in a smoothie-sweet nose of mango, banana, and citrus. Terpinolene leads the bouquet with supporting limonene and ocimene, while the flavor tracks tropical and creamy with a bright citrus lift. Plants grow big and vigorous, often tall indoors, stacking lime-green colas that cure to high sparkle. In dialed rooms Banana Mango flowers in about 7-9 weeks (roughly 55-63 days) and can reward trained canopies with heavy yields around 500-600 g/m2; outdoors it finishes late September to early October. Potency typically lands around 20-25% THC with minimal CBD. The effect leans upbeat and creative without losing composure, leaving most users uplifted, happy, and ready to make or move. Known for good powdery-mildew resistance, it still appreciates airflow near harvest when the dense tops pack on weight. Credit Humboldt Seed Company for this tropical crowd-pleaser; they once toyed with the name "Humboldt Smoothie," but the ripe banana-and-mango profile won out, and so did the strain, frequently praised by growers for its vigor, bag appeal, and consistent fruit-forward phenotypes.

name: Cherry Vanilla Cookies
description: Cherry Vanilla Cookies, bred by Dynasty Seeds, stitches together Platinum Girl Scout Cookies and Ms. Universe into a dessert-centric hybrid with poise and punch. Compact, bushy plants stack dense, frosty calyxes and finish in 63-70 days indoors, while outdoor harvests land around mid-October in favorable climates. Despite the stocky posture, yields run high and uniform when light penetration is managed. True to its name, the bouquet blends sour cherry and vanilla over warm sugar-cookie dough; on the palate expect sweet vanilla and berry cream. A terpene ensemble led by beta-caryophyllene and limonene, with humulene and linalool supporting, frames the profile. Typical THC results hover between 19-25%, while CBD remains minimal. In the jar it often flashes pastel greens with cookie-crusted trichomes and apricot pistils, a visual cue to its cookie-forward heritage. Training responds well to topping and light defoliation, keeping internodes tight and colas uniform. The effect arrives smoothly: an upbeat, happy lift and relaxed clarity taper into a comfortable, appetite-stoking body feel.

name: Jack Herer Photos
description: Named for the famed author and advocate, Jack Herer from Sensi Seeds is a sativa-dominant hybrid that marries Haze with Northern Lights #5 and Shiva Skunk. Born in the 1990s, it quickly made its mark on competition stages, taking top honors multiple times and inspiring a generation of citrus-pine classics. In the garden, Jack Herer stretches with sativa vigor, building spear-like colas frosted in trichomes; indoors it finishes in about 50–70 days and, in capable hands, produces heavy yields around 500–600 g/m2, while outdoor plants can top 800–1000 g per plant. Terpinolene leads the nose, supported by pinene and caryophyllene, translating to brisk pine, zesty citrus and a peppery herbal snap on the palate. Typical batches test high in THC (roughly 18–27%) with minimal CBD. The effect profile is bright and creative, with an energetic, uplifting headspace balanced by calm physical ease. Expect medium-to-tall stature indoors and tall frames outside, with sturdy branching that responds well to training and airflow.

name: Oreo Mintz
description: Named for its cookie-and-cream vibe, Oreo Mintz fuses Animal Mintz with Oreoz to yield a frost-heavy hybrid that smells like mint chocolate over a creamy, pine-laced base. Often credited to Exotic Genetix, this 50/50 cultivar brings dense, calyx-forward flowers with caryophyllene leading the terpene profile and supporting notes of myrcene and limonene. Expect layered flavors of mint, sweet cream, and vanilla, while subtle earthy and woody undertones echo its Oreoz ancestry. Reported lab and vendor numbers commonly place THC between 25-28% with trace CBD, and the effect trajectory mirrors the chemistry: a brisk wave of euphoria and creative focus that settles into a smooth, full-body calm. Indoors, plants stay compact (about 1 m), respond well to topping and SCROG, and finish in 56-63 days; yields are solid for a dessert-leaning line, averaging around 500 g per m2 in dialed rooms. Outdoors in temperate climates, expect medium stature (to about 1.7 m) and roughly 450 g per plant by early fall. Phenotypes split between mint-forward and dessert-forward expressions, but the flagship cut balances both, with bright mint on the inhale and sweet cream and vanilla on the exhale, making Oreo Mintz a connoisseur-friendly cross that pairs modern bag appeal with classic cookie-mint charm. Medically, Oreo Mintz is often chosen to help manage stress, mood imbalance, and mild physical tension, offering mental ease and body comfort without heavy sedation when used in moderate doses. Growers note a high calyx-to-leaf ratio and sparkling trichome coverage that cures into pale, cookie-dusted nuggets.

name: Wakanda OG
description: Wakanda OG blends West Coast swagger with a regal pedigree. Bred in California by Hoosier Farms, it unites Original Glue (GG4), OG Kush, and Girl Scout Cookies to create a balanced 50/50 hybrid that hits quickly and decisively. Expect a skunky-sweet bouquet layered over earthy, spicy herbal notes, with a dense, resin-caked structure reminiscent of its powerhouse parents. The onset lifts mood and focus with a clean, euphoric spark before easing into a smooth, body-centering calm that lingers without couchlock, a hallmark of this lineage’s complementary traits. In the garden, Wakanda OG shows medium stature indoors and out, forming tight, heavy colas that finish in roughly 56–65 days. Yields are rewarding—around 400 g/m² under lights and up to roughly 550 g per outdoor plant—when provided strong light and steady nutrition. Reported THC commonly ranges from the high teens to low 30s, while CBD remains low, keeping the profile decidedly potent. With its skunk-kissed sweetness, grounded earth, and peppery finish, Wakanda OG channels the glue-like density of GG4, the classic kush backbone, and the cookie jar aromatics of GSC into a single, confident expression that wears its lineage proudly.

name: Maui Mango Diesel
description: Born of island sun and diesel-tinged sweetness, Maui Mango Diesel captures the spirit of Hawaii in a sativa-leaning profile. Commonly attributed to Pua Mana 1st Hawaiian Pakalōlō Seed Bank, the cultivar blends classic Maui Wowie genetics with Dr. Underground’s Brooklyn Mango, yielding an approximately 90% sativa known for bright, lime-green spears and loose, resin-dusted calyxes. Aromas open with ripe mango and tropical fruit before finishing in a clean diesel snap; myrcene leads the bouquet with supporting ocimene and caryophyllene, while THC typically lands between 16% and 20% with minimal CBD. The experience is brisk and buoyant - creative, energetic, and distinctly uplifting - ideal for projects and daylight hours. Medically, Maui Mango Diesel is often chosen to help boost energy, focus, and mood, while supporting mild relief from fatigue or low motivation without causing heavy sedation. Growers can expect vigorous vertical growth; indoors, maintain canopy control to keep heights manageable. Flowering finishes in roughly 70-77 days and returns around 400 g/m2, while sun-grown plants can reach taller statures and deliver about 480 g per plant at harvest. The cross's structural traits show clearly: Maui Wowie's lanky frame and speed marry Brooklyn Mango's dense tropical-diesel resin. If your hunt is for a zesty, mango-forward sativa that still carries a classic diesel edge, this cultivar delivers, honoring its parents while writing a flavorful chapter of its own.

name: Gas Berry
description: Gas Berry lives up to its name with a fragrant collision of petroleum and orchard fruit riding over ripe berries. Most commonly described as a three-way cross of OG Kush, Blueberry, and Sour Diesel, it leans indica at roughly 70/30 and grows dense, frosty flowers that can flash purple late in bloom. On the nose, expect a diesel-first bouquet laced with blueberry jam and a faint plum sweetness; the flavor echoes this with resinous fuel over berry candy and a peppery edge. Potency typically lands between 17–26% THC, averaging near 23%, with trace CBD around 0.4% (generally under 1%). Growers report a straightforward, medium-difficulty cultivar that stays medium in stature (about 5–8 feet), finishes in 56–63 days, and yields around 400 g/m2 indoors or roughly 550 g per outdoor plant. Its terpene ensemble is frequently led by limonene with support from myrcene and pinene, a combo that explains both the bright fruit tones and the heavy, soothing finish. In Canada, OGEN's Gas Berries #112 phenotype helped popularize this lineage for its signature gasoline-and-berries profile. Effects tend to open with uplift and euphoria before settling into calm, happy relaxation that suits unhurried evenings and laid-back creative sessions.

name: Rotten Rozay
description: Rotten Rozay walks a tightrope between funk and finesse, true to its parentage of GMO Cookies and Rozay F2. Bred by Relentless Genetics, this balanced hybrid marries GMO’s savory, gassy depth to Rozay’s fruit-and-flower perfume, landing on a nose of pungent dank layered with sweet berry, rose, and a cool minty snap. First impressions arrive as a bubbly, euphoric rush that can spark giggles and creative detours before the glide sets in—muscles unclench, attention softens, and a calm, relaxed glow takes over. Dense, heart-shaped nugs flash olive with purple flecks and bright orange threads beneath a frost of trichomes. Expect vigorous, medium-stature plants that finish in 8–10 weeks, with indoor growers pulling up to 600 g/m² and outdoor plants around 300 g each. Typical THC lands in the 21–24% pocket, with CBD usually trace-to-low (occasionally around 0.8%).

name: Electric Kool Aid
description: Electric Kool Aid by The Grateful Seeds is a one‑shot, indica‑leaning hybrid built from Calypso Fruit and the breeder’s Fruitjoy #20 cut selected by La Kalada. In the room it forms a medium, bushy frame with short internodes, stacking huge, resin‑frosted colas that wrap up fast in 55–60 days. Indoors, competent growers can expect about 500–600 g/m2; outdoors it reaches early October with generous yields around 400–1000 g per plant. True to its pedigree (Calypso Fruit is Pinepaya × Banana Gelee; Fruitjoy #20 comes from Papaya × Barbara Bud), the nose blasts an exotic fruit bowl - ripe papaya, banana candy and tropical sweetness over soft floral tones. Many phenos lean toward a myrcene‑, pinene‑ and caryophyllene‑forward profile. Effects arrive in a smooth arc: a bright, happy lift and easy focus that settles into a relaxed, content body feel, matching its roughly 60/40 indica‑sativa balance. Potency is typically high (about 15–25% THC) with negligible CBD, and the swollen gland heads and oily cuticles make it a standout for dry sift, ice water hash and rosin. Credited to The Grateful Seeds, Electric Kool Aid neatly hits the grower’s trifecta of speed, flavor and production while showcasing the tropical “fruit‑salad” signature of its parents.

name: Confetti Cake

In flower, plants stay bushy with short internodes and thick bract stacks, ripening in about 8–9 weeks into long, tightly packed colas that can flash deep blues and purples under cool nights. Indoor plants remain medium in stature, while sun-grown specimens can develop into sizeable shrubs, producing high yields in both environments. The nose and flavor lean vanilla and floral with a sugared edge, accented by peppery woody notes from caryophyllene; dominant terpenes typically include limonene, myrcene, and linalool, creating a bright, confectionary profile. Reported potency centers around the low 20s for THC, with CBD remaining trace. Recreationally, the effect opens social and chatty, often tipping into giggles and a buoyant, uplifted mood while the body eases without heavy sedation. Medically, Confetti Cake is often chosen to help alleviate stress, mild anxiety, and low mood, offering a clear-headed uplift while providing gentle physical relaxation. Resin coverage and bag appeal are standouts, making Confetti Cake a festive finish to any harvest and a photogenic jar-filler for connoisseurs.

name: Nu Diesel
description: Nů Diesel by Archive Seed Bank is a nostalgic, old-school diesel revival that channels deep, musky chem-fuel vibes with surprising modern polish. This rare hybrid brings back the raw, fumey East Coast diesel character - think pungent, greasy gas station skunk layered with sharp pine and a subtle sweet-z undertone - while delivering high THC (typically 22-26%+) and a potent, long-lasting high: it opens with clear, focused cerebral energy (perfect for shaking off fog or powering through tasks), then settles into a heavy, grounded body calm without full couch-lock - ideal for evening wind-downs, creative focus, or deep relaxation sessions. The terp profile is unmistakable: loud diesel and chem funk dominate upfront, backed by earthy pine, faint citrus rind, and a lingering dryer-sheet candy haze on the exhale, creating a smoke that's harsh yet addictive and unmistakably classic. Buds are dense, resin-drenched, and often show subtle purple flecks under the right conditions, showcasing Archive Seed Bank's mastery of preserving heirloom profiles. Feminized seeds (when available) make it accessible for growers (moderate difficulty, strong yields in 9-10 weeks indoors/outdoors), while flower remains a collector's favorite in select Cali and East Coast spots. Archive has not clearly revealed the exact parents, but based on their own description of a "light dryer sheet moonbow z-essence" and the 99 × 24 F2 #31 notation, we're guessing the lineage is Moonbow 99 crossed with a selected Moonbow #24 F2 (from their Zkittlez-heavy line) to recreate that legendary diesel funk with a modern candy-gas twist. If you're into authentic, no-frills diesel hybrids with elite terp depth and that Archive touch, Nů Diesel is a rare, potent throwback that hits hard in today's exotic scene.

Expect a medium yield and a finish around 63-70 days indoors. On effect, Sudachi Lime trends uplifting and focused, with a clean, energizing headspace that retains just enough body ease to feel smooth rather than racy. Fans of classic East Coast gas will recognize the Sour Diesel lineage immediately; the candy-citrus twist makes it feel new again. Bred by Bloom Seed Co, Sudachi Lime is a bright, modern nod to two cult favorites, crafted for gardens that want vivid aroma, brisk pacing, and memorable jar appeal.

name: Moonbow 112 IX

For potential medical effects, Moonbow 112 IX has effects that could help with lack of appetite, stress, anxiety, depression, and insomnia. Cultivation wise, this strain is difficult to grow. name: Chizu
description: Chizu is an Indica-dominant hybrid strain capable of seducing you with its unique flavor profile, an average THC content of 22%, and 1% CBD. It boast versatile effects and was achieved by crossbreeding UK Cheese with The Original Z (AKA Zkittlez). Following just under 60 days of flowering, growers with some experience are rewarded with yields that add up to 400g/m². They should expect medium-tall ladies that exude an intense aroma during flowering, necessitating measures for odor control. These plants prefer stable environmental conditons. When burned, the Chizu nugs release a captivating blend of fruitiness, sweet notes, and cheese, making for a complex but lingering sensory experience that begs for more. The Chizu high first causes euphoric thoughts and puts you in a talkative mindset. But don’t be mistaken, as the Indica genes start acting up soon enough, dragging you into a dazed but utterly relaxed state that invites sleepiness and offers thorough sedation. name: NFS

Cultivation is easy, with 50% of phenotypes displaying heavy purple coloring, and the other 50% with a mix of greens and purples. Flowering time is roughly 8-10 weeks, with rewarding yields of highly resinous flowers.

name: Rainbow Belts 2.0

With THC levels reaching up to 23%, the effects make it a great choice for daytime use thanks to its energetic effects, paired with an euphoric, uplifting effect that leaves you happy. Medicinally, this strain can be of help for medicinal users seeking relief from symptoms of nausea, anxiety, and depression.

name: Banana Smoothie
description: Banana Smoothie glides in like a tropical dessert, its resin-glossed colas stacking into chunky spears that finish in 8-9 weeks. Bred by Tastebudz Genetics from Banana Punch and Critical, this indica-leaning hybrid (70/30) blends old-school productivity with modern flavor. Crack a cured jar and you get ripe banana overtones threaded with citrus and pineapple, settling into a silky coconut-cream finish; limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene lead the bouquet. Under lights it stays manageable and bushy, rewarding basic training with up to 550 g/m2 indoors and heavy, end-of-September hauls outdoors that can touch 1000 g/plant. Potency lands around 25% THC with trace (~0.25%) CBD, translating to a mellow, body-forward stone that loosens the shoulders, lifts the mood, and gradually drifts toward drowsy calm. Expect the classic indica comforts - relaxed, happy, and sleepy - without losing the lush fruit character that made Banana Punch famous. Critical's influence shows in the robust frame and easygoing grow style, making this strain beginner-friendly yet still satisfying for experienced hands. Growers often note sturdy lateral branching, moderate stretch, and dense, trichome-frosted buds that trim clean and cure with exceptional bag appeal. If your idea of a perfect evening is sunshine in a glass and a sofa that feels like the shore, Banana Smoothie serves it chilled - creamy, tropical, and convincingly named.

name: Iron Triangle
description: Bred in Boulder by Colorado Seed Inc., Iron Triangle fuses White Triangle OG (Triangle OG white pheno) with Gupta Kush to create a muscular yet balanced hybrid. Expect a vivid nose of diesel and sour citrus over a loamy, earthy base, driven by a terpene trio of caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. Plants are vigorous and tall, often reaching around six feet with OG Kush-style, lime‑green colas and longer internodes. Indoors or out, this cultivar is known for high yields and a straightforward grow, finishing in about 56 to 63 days. The profile carries through to the palate with zesty lemon peel and fuel on the inhale and a clean, earthy finish. With THC typically between 24% and 28% and trace CBD under 1%, the effect opens with a focused, euphoric lift before settling into deep, body-centered calm that still keeps the mind bright. Iron Triangle’s even 50/50 indica-sativa split shows in its morphology and in its arc from alert to at-ease. Credit for this potent, production-ready cross goes to Colorado Seed Inc., whose selection locked in the dense OG structure and boosted resin coverage. Growers favor heavy topping to exploit its branching; consumers prize its diesel-citrus snap and modern potency wrapped in classic Kush character.

name: Princess
description: Princess is the fabled mother behind Cinderella 99, a clone born from a chance Jack Herer bagseed in Amsterdam and refined by MrSoul of Brothers Grimm Seeds. Despite her sativa-leaning ancestry, Princess grows short and compact with minimal stretch, stacking dense calyxes that frost early and hard. The bouquet is unmistakable: sweet tropical fruit and pineapple over a darker, feral undertone, drifting into floral incense as the buds cure. A terpinolene-forward profile with supporting limonene and myrcene suits the aromas, while the flavor holds bright, tropical and flowery notes on the exhale. The effect is famously fast and heady—psychedelic, euphoric and creatively uplifting—with a tingly intensity that can tip into racy or paranoid for some. THC is dominant and CBD typically trace. Indoors she finishes quickly at around 50 days of 12/12, rewarding attentive growers with a resin-heavy harvest; yields are moderate but prized for potency and character. Princess descends from Jack Herer on the maternal side; the pollinating male remains a mystery, adding to her legend. This compact vigor, fast bloom, and electric high made her a perfect foundation for later breeding work, and she remains a connoisseur cut for those seeking tropical perfume and crystalline, sativa-style power in a manageable frame.

name: Cherry Death Star

Well cured flowers show dense, grape shaped nugs freckled with orange pistils and a frosty sheen, often flashing hints of purple. Potency is formidable, with THC frequently landing around the low 30s and many lots testing from the high teens upward, while CBD remains minimal. Indoors, plants stay manageable at roughly 120 cm and can yield about 400 to 450 g per m2 with attentive training; outdoors, similar medium-to-high yields are typical in favorable climates. The profile translates cleanly to flavor: berry sweetness up front, a woody, diesel edge through the middle, and a gentle, spicy finish. The effect set mirrors its pedigree: a fast lift in mood and sense of ease, a steady body unwind, and a buoyant, uplifted calm rather than a full lights out.
