name: Concrete Jungle
description: Concrete Jungle carries its name with urban confidence and dessert-driven character. Lab results commonly fall in the 22–23% THC range with trace CBD, delivering a clear, upbeat onset that eases into steady body relaxation without excessive weight. The influence of LA Kush Cake shows in its creamy vanilla-mint softness, while Jungle Cake contributes sweetness, subtle fuel notes, and impressive resin coverage. Expect medium-sized, well-formed buds that trim neatly and cure to a glossy finish. Indoor growers generally report manageable structure and dependable medium yields when conditions are stable. Concrete Jungle reflects modern “cake” genetics at their most refined—sweet, resinous, and balanced—offering a relaxed yet gently uplifting experience crafted as much for flavor appreciation as for overall effect.

name: Snowman Cookies

Plants tend to stay small and branch upward, forming tight, frosted colas; indoors, flowering usually completes in about 56–63 days, and well-run rooms commonly return around 400 g/m², while sun-grown specimens can top roughly 500 g per plant by late October. However you encounter it, Snowman Cookies captures the confectionary core of the Cookies line, with classic OG depth in the spice and wood, making this a terp-rich, high-potency selection with flavor, color, and texture to match its name.

name: Rainbow Mints

Effects arrive in two acts: an early, upbeat lift and easy euphoria taper into lasting, full-body calm and contented stillness. Potency trends high, CBD low, in line with its pedigree. In the jar and the garden, Rainbow Mints lives up to its name - multicolored, mint-tinged, and unmistakably expressive - an indulgent hybrid that captures the best of dessert-leaning gelato and Z-forward funk. Expect striking bag appeal and a room-filling bouquet from start to cure.

Whether run in coco or living soil, this cut rewards consistent airflow, moderate EC, and a steady late-flower flush to showcase its glassy trichomes. name: Mac Rib

name: Candy Fuel
description: True to its name, Candy Fuel blends the sugary lift of Candyland with Chemdawg’s gassy punch. Keep airflow strong and VPD dialed to stack tight, sugar‑crusted colas with minimal larf. Phenohunters may spot chem‑leaning fuel noses versus candy‑forward dessert cuts; both carry the signature gloss. Whether trimmed for top‑shelf jars or pressed for rosin, Candy Fuel delivers modern candy‑meets‑gas character without sacrificing vigor or cycle time.

name: Albarino

Expect a 70/30 sativa-to-indica expression, bright aromatics that cure beautifully, and resin-rich buds that showcase the lineage's lively character in flower or extract. Outdoor runs typically finish by late October, and the favorable calyx-to-leaf ratio makes trimming straightforward.

name: Space Sasquatch
description: Space Sasquatch steps out of the treeline with a bright, zesty howl, a sativa-leaning hybrid said to descend from Thunderdome and Tangie. On the eye - and under a loupe - Space Sasquatch reads like a modern citrus hybrid built for bag appeal and resin density. If you prize clean citrus flavor, upbeat clarity, and photogenic frost, this Thunderdome x Tangie offspring earns its name: part myth, part meteor, and entirely memorable. Expect a sativa tilt at roughly 65/35, lively citrus on the palate, and a tidy, creative lift that lands smoothly.

name: Glass Apple

Its trophy case opens with a Best Hybrid win at the 2013 Rooster Classic, and its profile explains why: a tart green-apple nose is layered with juicy pineapple, citrus zest, and soft floral tones. Indoors it can deliver generous harvests near 500 g/m²; outdoors, well-cared plants can top 600 g apiece. Flowering finishes in about 55–70 days. Glass Apple blends legacy Colorado craftsmanship with everyday usability — a crisp, functional buzz wrapped in orchard-fresh flavor.

Potency typically sits in the 17-24% THC window with about 0-1% CBD, shaping an energetic, creative lift that remains cheerful and focused before easing into a gentle, relaxed cruise. The Cookies & Cream lineage famously earned a Denver Cannabis Cup in 2014, and that confectionary charm shows through here: think sweet, berry, and grape notes that linger on the palate. Dry finishes are rare; expect dense, frost-heavy trim-friendly structure.

The nose opens on classic OG pine and damp earth from Tahoe, quickly snapped awake by Toad Venom's sharp lime‑mint gas; on the palate, bright lemon peel and cool mint glide over a woody, resinous finish. Caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene lead the terpene chorus, and THC typically skews high - often in the mid‑20s - while CBD stays trace. The effect arrives in stages: a clean, uplifted focus warms into heavy‑lidded calm, appetite coaxed forward as shoulders drop and chatter fades. Expect dense, frosty flowers on medium‑stretch frames with sturdy OG branching; indoors, a trained, evenly canopied bush shines. Flowering generally wraps in 63–70 days, with dialed rooms returning high harvests around the 450–550 g/m² mark. Visually, buds stack tight and glint with sugary trichomes against deep forest greens, a reminder of Tahoe OG's West Coast pedigree, while Toad Venom stamps in its unmistakable mint‑and‑fuel punctuation. For growers and tastemakers alike, Rhino Breath captures the past and present of Kush: old‑school structure and grit, new‑school polish and punch - precisely the balance its lineage promises.

name: Gator Tears
description: Gator Tears by Zaba Cannabis marries the electric Durban Poison with the hyped Toad Venom, forging a sativa-leaning hybrid that drips with bright citrus and pine over a faint cookie-fuel undertow. Expect lean, vigorous plants that stretch early, then stack long, spearlike colas dusted in silver trichomes. In the jar, terpinolene and limonene lead with spritzy lemon-lime and forested pine, while a caryophyllene backbone hints at warm spice; sensitive noses may also catch a lick of skunk from the Toad Venom side. Potency lands solidly in the mid-20s THC with trace CBD, delivering a clean, uplifted focus and lively head buzz that stay lucid and functional rather than heavy. Indoors, Gator Tears typically finishes in about 60–70 days of flower, rewarding attentive training with medium to high yields around 400 g/m2; outdoors, specimens can push past 2.5 m with healthy, resinous tops that average roughly 700 g per plant in favorable conditions. Morphology skews sativa: narrow leaflets, strong apical dominance, and internodes that tighten as bloom progresses. Bred by Zaba Cannabis from Durban Poison x Toad Venom, Gator Tears captures the landrace zing and modern dessert-gas swagger in one vividly aromatic cross that feels fresh, fast, and unmistakably contemporary.

name: Pigeon Toad
description: Born from Chem 91 and Toad Venom, Pigeon Toad from Zaba Cannabis merges classic chem funk with mint-cookie gas. The nose jumps with sharp diesel and pine from Chem 91, then folds into lime zest, doughy mint, and a greasy fuel finish carried over from Toad Venom. Expect a THC-forward profile with little CBD and a terpene stack led by limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene, with a trace of terpinolene lending sparkle. Indoors it typically wraps in 56–63 days, forming medium-height bushes with tight internodes and fat, resin-heavy calyxes; yields land in the medium column but the trichome density rewards careful drying and a slow cure. The flavor mirrors the aroma: diesel and chemical snap up front, cooling mint-cookie sweetness through the mid-palate, and lingering citrus-gas on the exhale. Effects arrive fast and layered - clean cerebral lift, buoyant mood, and a relaxing body hum that avoids full sedation - making it a versatile hybrid for creative focus or winding down. Zaba's selection keeps the line's structural vigor while polishing bag appeal into frosty, well-formed buds that photograph like gemstones. If you love the storied Chem family but crave a modern twist, Pigeon Toad threads that lineage with contemporary depth and texture. Expect lasting flavor and consistent performance across phenos.

name: Z Cube
description: Z Cube distills the sensory fireworks of Z into a compact plant. Bred by Dying Breed Seeds, it pairs Zkittlez with OZ Kush (Zkittlez x OG Eddy Lepp) to cube up candy notes with OG gas. Expect crisp lemon and cool mint over a buttery backdrop; under the hood, a terpene trio of caryophyllene, humulene, and limonene pushes peppery zest and woody citrus. Plants start squat and bushy, then stack dense, frosty colas, finishing in roughly 49–63 days. Indoors, yields of about 450–600 g/m2 are common; outdoors, up to around 600 g per plant. Vigor is medium and the canopy is easy to train, though late-flower support helps once the tops swell. Lab results vary by cut, but THC often ranges from the mid-teens to the low 30s with only trace CBD.

name: Sour Ube
description: Sour Ube is a vivid collision of heritage and craft, pairing the racy East Coast spark of Sour Diesel with Blue Ube. From the first crack of the jar, sharp diesel and citrus leap out, quickly braided with Blue Ube's playful notes of grape and strawberry candy, a cooling menthol thread, and pinetree zest. The bouquet sets up a flavor that moves from tart and gassy to sweet and fruity on the exhale, with a clean, lingering finish. Expect a hybrid cadence that lifts the mind while settling the body: focused, upbeat, and chatty up top, cushioned by a calm, blue‑hued body ease. Growers can look for a medium yield and stature indoors with more stretch and mass outdoors, where the Sour side shows; tight, sugar‑dusted flowers and a sturdy frame hint at Blue Ube's influence. Terpene expression tends to skew toward myrcene and limonene with a caryophyllene snap, supporting its bright, fuel‑meets‑fruit profile. Crafted by Zaba Cannabis Co., Sour Ube honors its parents by delivering classic diesel energy wrapped in modern dessert‑style aromatics - a memorable, photogenic flower that feels both nostalgic and new.

name: Moode Knucklez
description: Moode Knucklez from Zaba Cannabis cuts a bold path by pairing Moose Tracks with the provocatively named Elephant Puzzy. The result is a lively, sativa-leaning hybrid that opens with foresty pinene and peppery caryophyllene over an earthy base, then trails into a sweet hint of blueberry inherited from its elephant side. Dense, spearlike colas pack tightly stacked bracts with a frost of bright trichomes and rust pistils, finishing on compact, medium-tall frames that are easy to manage indoors. Expect a focused, uplifted onset that steadies into calm body ease, a mood-forward profile that mirrors Moose Tracks when the pinene shines. Typical THC lands in the low to mid 20s with trace CBD, giving the nose-and-palate plenty of room to speak without harshness. Growers familiar with its pedigree can plan for an 8 to 9 week indoor cycle (about 56 to 63 days) and medium yields, with the best expressions showing conifer, spice, and faint berry on the dry pull. While no cups are yet attached to the name, the lineage carries proven chops: Thin Mint Cookies and Triple OG behind Moose Tracks, and the big-cola elephant line providing lift and swagger. Moode Knucklez rewards attentive topping and airflow with neatly sculpted, resinous spears.

name: Ammonia by Zaba Cannabis
description: Ammonia by Zaba Cannabis delivers exactly what its name promises: a sharp, nose prickle of funk riding over bright citrus. Built from Cheetah Piss x Skunk Piss, this modern hybrid marries old school roadkill notes with dessert gas polish. Caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene lead the terpene stack, pushing lemon, skunk, and a distinct ammonia edge with faint mint on the finish. The high lands fast and upbeat, often aroused, giggly, and keenly focused without losing composure. Expect compact, resin-caked colas with tight calyxes and minimal leaf, an average, manageable stature, and a flowering window of 56-63 days. Yields are medium indoors and outdoors, with chemistry that trends high-THC and very low CBD when grown to spec. Skunk Piss brings the classic room-filling funk; Cheetah Piss adds clarity, color, and a cleaner exhale. Grind releases lemon sour, solventy skunk, and dry fuel; the smoke settles to a tidy, peppery finish. Ammonia rewards steady late-flower conditions and a thoughtful trim, translating pungency into glassy bag appeal. A punchy, polished take on skunk lineage, Ammonia stands as a confident Zaba Cannabis signature for fans of loud aromas and focused, social momentum. Keep canopies even to stack dense spears and simplify trim.

name: New Candy
description: New Candy from Zaba Cannabis Co. tempers classic pastry sweetness with modern candy-gas sparkle. Bred by pairing Cherry Pie with Blue Gummiez, this hybrid stacks dense, sugar-frosted calyxes that flash lime and plum hues, orange threads, and a glassy resin sheen. The nose opens with cherry compote and berry gummies over citrus zest and soft dough; the palate follows with sweet-tart fruit, tropical candy, and a faint earthy echo from Cherry Pie. Effects tend to lift mood quickly and brighten focus before drifting into a smooth, contented body calm, a balanced arc ideal for creative afternoons or low-key evenings. In gardens, plants stay medium in stature with sturdy laterals and internodes that pack on weight late; expect 56-63 days of bloom, with indoor yields around 450 g/m2 and well-run outdoor plants commonly finishing near 400 g apiece. THC typically lands in the low-to-mid 20s with minimal CBD. Growers will recognize an easygoing temperament from the Cherry Pie side and vibrant bag appeal from the Blue Gummiez lineage, while a caryophyllene and limonene leaning profile keeps the aroma bright and confectionary. New Candy is Zaba's playful nod to dessert genetics - sweet, colorful, and confidently modern.

name: Sirenz by Zaba Cannabis
description: Sirenz by Zaba Cannabis stitches together Yellow Mermaid and Biscotti into a hybrid that smells like tropics meeting a bakery. Expect bright citrus, pineapple, and candy tones from Yellow Mermaid to glide over Biscotti's sweet dough, cocoa spice, and faint pine. On the nose, it leans fruit-candy and lemon zest first, then warms into cookie, cream, and pepper. The palate follows with tropical candy, sweet citrus, and a light minty-pine finish. Structure trends toward dense, resin-laden flowers with lime-to-lavender hues and tangerine pistils; plants typically finish in 63–70 days and can show medium indoor height alongside vigorous outdoor stretch. Yields land in the high column when dialed, with indoor canopies capable of roughly 650 g/m² and outdoor plants crossing the kilo mark. Effects balance uplift and focus with the calm, body-softening relaxation Biscotti is famous for; a cheerful, relaxed mood with a clean, uplifting edge is the usual arc. Caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene often headline the terpene mix, echoing its parents' profiles. While batch chemistry varies, pedigree points toward THC-dominant output with minimal CBD. Bred by Zaba Cannabis, STRAIN_NAME reads like a flavorful, modern hybrid that merges daytime brightness with dessert-forward depth.

name: Creme De La Ube
description: Creme De La Ube from Zaba Cannabis sweetens the purple lineage with a three-way cross of Blue Ube, CREAM, and Granddaddy Purple. The result leans indica, building compact, trichome-laden colas that can blush violet in cool nights while keeping a tidy, medium stature. Aromas lead with ripe grape and berry courtesy of the Granddaddy Purple heritage, layered over silky vanilla cream and a faint espresso-earth from CREAM, with a soft tropical ube echo in the finish. Caryophyllene, myrcene, and linalool commonly headline the terpene mix, shaping a dessert-forward bouquet with gentle herbal depth. On the palate it delivers grape gelato tones and whipped-vanilla sweetness before drifting into earth and spice. Effects arrive as a smooth, happy lift that melts into full-body ease and eventually a drowsy calm. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in about 56–65 days; yields trend high thanks to dense calyx stacks and a solid calyx-to-leaf ratio. Potency potential often sits in the mid-20s for THC with trace CBD, highlighting resin and flavor. Medium internodes and sturdy branches handle training, and plants respond well to balanced feeding. For growers and flavor-chasers alike, Creme De La Ube threads classic GDP richness through a modern creamy profile, honoring its parents while standing out as an indulgent, vividly colored cultivar.

name: Swamp Water
description: Swamp Water by Zaba Cannabis Co. blends the modern hype of Toad Venom with the old‑school mystique of Blue Fin, channeling both into a dense, resin‑heavy hybrid that smells like lime zest and mint‑cookie dough spattered with deep diesel and sweet berry undertones. The Toad Venom influence pushes loud gas and creamy mint across the palate, while Blue Fin contributes foresty pine, blueberry echoes, and that unmistakably heavy, ocean‑tinged funk. Expect compact, frosted colas in olive and midnight greens with occasional violet shadows and bright tangerine pistils. Indoors, plants stay manageable with medium stature and respond well to light defoliation and steady airflow; most phenotypes finish in 56–63 days with a solid, medium yield that washes well. Caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene typically lead the terpene cast, supporting a high that opens with buoyant euphoria before settling into a calm, limb‑loosening drift. While exact lab numbers vary by batch, Swamp Water is bred for high THC with trace CBD. If you have followed the story of its parents, you will recognize the synergy here: Toad Venom’s neon, candy‑gas personality grounded by Blue Fin’s classic West Coast depth.

name: Dragon Berry
description: Dragon Berry marries classic West Coast fuel to orchard-sweet nuance, a vivid tribute to its heritage from Cherry Bomb and Turbo Diesel. Brought to market by MTG Seeds, this sativa-leaning hybrid typically expresses a 70/30 profile, pushing dense, resin-glossed colas that prefer a bushy, medium stature. In the jar, expect upfront berry and cherry layered over clean diesel, with cool hints of vanilla and mint; on the palate, the same trio rides a slick of gas. Myrcene leads the terpene cast with caryophyllene and humulene in support, shaping a clear, high-spirited ride that trends energetic, uplifted, and euphoric. Lab results commonly land around 19-26% THC with trace-to-low CBD that seldom tops 2%. Growers report a straightforward run: indoors, heavy yields can touch 500 g/m2 with a 53-63 day bloom (many phenos settling near week nine); outdoors, expect comparable vigor and solid harvests when conditions stay dry and well-ventilated. Dragon Berry's structure takes well to topping and light training, responding with stacked flower sites and uniform light penetration. Whether admired for its frosted color play or its lively, modern-diesel bouquet, Dragon Berry delivers a crisp, purposeful hybrid experience that stays true to its lineage and to MTG Seeds' flavor-first breeding ethos.

name: Super Sour Skunk
description: Sour Skunk channels true East Coast energy, marrying East Coast Sour Diesel to the Super Sativa Seed Club’s Skunk #1 in Dominion Seed Company’s sativa-leaning hybrid. Open the jar and the room tilts toward classic funk: hard skunk layered with bright citrus peel and damp earth, a terpene blend led by caryophyllene, myrcene, and pinene. On the palate it leans tangy and skunky before finishing dry and clean. The high moves fast and buoyant—euphoric, uplifted, and creative—yet it settles the body enough to keep a steady tempo. Plants show a vigorous sativa posture with notable stretch, forming sturdy spears and golf‑ball satellites. Indoors or out, expect moderate yields and a pungency that demands good filtration. Flowering typically wraps in 63–70 days, with THC commonly in the 18–22% window and CBD present only in trace amounts. Dominion’s take preserves heritage flavor while sharpening resin production and bag appeal; it is a faithful homage to ECSD’s fuel-and-sour drive fused to Skunk’s booming nose.

name: Blueberry Mojito
description: Blueberry Mojito swirls together the dessert-like depth of Blueberry Cookies with the sparkling zest of Lime Mojito, landing squarely in balanced-hybrid territory. Expect a nose that opens on ripe blueberries before tipping into lime zest and a cool mint finish, a trio mirrored on the palate as sweet berry gives way to citrus and herbal freshness. Under lights it forms dense, resin-rich colas that can flash purple, finishing in roughly 56–63 days; outdoors it stretches to medium stature with tidy internodes and a cooperative trim. Typical batches test in the low-to-mid 20s for THC with trace CBD, and terpene leads often include limonene supported by myrcene and caryophyllene for that fruit-forward snap with a peppery undercurrent. Reported effects skew bright and buoyant—uplifted, energetic, and happy—before easing into a centered calm, making it a cheerful, any-hour companion. Origin stories point to Raw Garden popularizing this cross in California, while seed offerings such as Blueberry Mojito Feminized capture the same lineage for growers seeking a reliable, medium-height plant with high indoor yields around 500–550 g/m² and roughly 100–150 g per outdoor plant at harvest. All told, it is a vividly flavored hybrid that lives up to its cocktail name.

name: Grape Gary
description: Bred by Exotic Genetix as part of the Grape Jubilee release, Grape Gary marries the gas and polish of Gary Payton with Grape Jubilee’s candy-purple charm. In the garden it stretches to a medium–tall frame with sturdy laterals, stacking dense, frosted colas that ripen in 56–63 days. Expect resin-caked flowers flashing deep greens and violets, an omen of what is to come in the jar: a loud burst of ripe grape and mixed berries layered over diesel, rubber, and earthy spice. Caryophyllene leads the terpene chorus with myrcene and limonene supporting, translating to a bright, grapey inhale and a gassy, slightly peppered finish. Reported THC typically lands in the mid-to-high 20s with trace CBD, delivering a balanced, euphoric lift that settles into an easy, happy calm without knocking you out. Indoors, trained plants can return up to 700 g/m2; outdoors, well-fed bushes have the potential to push well over a kilo per plant by early October in mild climates.

name: Peach Fuzz
description: Peach Fuzz strolls in like summer in a jar, blending stone-fruit perfume with a cushy, kush-leaning backbone. Bred by Masonic Smoker for Masonic Seeds, this slightly indica-dominant hybrid pairs Triangle Kush 91 and Peach 02 with Wilson, a recipe that shows in its dense, popcorn-shaped buds: forest-green calyxes, copper pistils, and a fine golden frost. The nose leads with ripe peach and sugared cream over gentle earth and citrus zest; on the palate, sweet peach and candy tones linger above a faint herbal finish. Typical lab results land around 18-23% THC with trace CBD, and the terpene ensemble is often myrcene, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene. The effect profile opens bright and social - happy, relaxed, and surprisingly chatty - before settling into a cozy body calm that sidesteps heavy sedation. Plants display hybrid vigor and respond well to light training; indoors they flower in about nine weeks and yield respectably, with medium production and manageable height. In the garden, expect moderate internodal spacing and trichome-heavy flowers that trim clean. Peach Fuzz delivers vivid peach-forward flavor and a balanced, anytime mood, while quietly tipping its cap to its TK91, Peach 02, and Wilson lineage. Fans also note a faint vanilla accent, especially from well-cured batches under cool night temps.

name: Glass Slipper

A sativa-leaning hybrid (about 60% sativa/40% indica), it greets the nose with sweet pineapple over soft floral tones, then dries down to a gentle woody finish. Caryophyllene leads the terpene chorus with accents of limonene, myrcene, and humulene, amplifying a buoyant, clear-headed mood that many describe as euphoric, happy, and distinctly uplifted. Plants show slender sativa structure yet remain manageable, typically finishing around 1 m indoors and 1.4 m outdoors, with dense, resin-glossed colas that tip the scales generously. Expect 56–70 days of flowering, followed by yields near 400 g/m2 inside or roughly 550 g per outdoor plant when dialed in. Reported THC commonly ranges from 16–25% with trace CBD up to ~0.5%, translating to crisp potency without muddiness. Growers rate difficulty as moderate; stable environments and attentive training reward you with uniform spears and effortless trim.

name: Kong
description: Kong by Holy Smoke Seeds lives up to its name with hulking, resin-dripping colas and a roar of flavor. Bred from Motavation and a backcrossed White Russian, this mostly indica hybrid marries the sour-chemical sweetness and couch-ready calm of Motavation to White Russian’s fuel-tinged citrus and classic old‑school punch. Expect a limonene‑leaning terpene profile supported by myrcene and caryophyllene, translating to earthy diesel aromas with bright lemon accents and a creamy, skunky depth. Plants stay medium in stature yet branch vigorously, stacking thick bracts that finish fast: flowers can be taken as early as six weeks, with seven to eight weeks (42–56 days) bringing the heaviest, most balanced expressions. In capable hands Kong is a heavy yielder indoors or out, throwing dense, dark‑green buds frosted in thick trichomes. Potency is equally robust, typically in the mid‑teens to low‑twenties for THC (roughly 14–22%) with up to about 1% CBD reported, delivering a swift euphoric lift that settles into long‑lasting, body‑centered relaxation. The ride tends toward relaxed, happy, and sleepy rather than racy; sip the diesel‑lime flavor and let the noise fade. If you prize speed, weight, and that classic citrus‑fuel profile in a compact, forgiving plant, Kong brings it with authority.

name: Jelly Dulce
description: Jelly Dulce blends dessert-forward charm with balanced-hybrid poise. Bred by Crop King Seeds from Dulce de Leche x Jelly Breath, this cultivar marries creamy vanilla-blueberry sweetness with a faint brown-sugar spice on the nose. Expect compact, sugar-dusted flowers in forest green and occasional twilight purples, with bright orange threads and a thick blanket of trichomes. Its profile leans on caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene, translating into a candy-gelato palate of sweet, blueberry, and vanilla notes. Potency runs medium-high: most batches test around 20-23% THC with roughly 1-2% CBD. The effect lands smoothly, happy, lightly focused, and physically relaxed, ideal for unwinding without couchlock. Cultivators will appreciate straightforward behavior and short stature (under 120 cm), along with a quick 56-63-day bloom. Indoors, Jelly Dulce averages about 350 g/m2; outdoors, well-tended plants can return near 550 g per plant by September. The cross brings Jelly Breath’s resin output to Dulce de Leche’s confectionary bouquet, creating a versatile hash and flower candidate that trims easily and resists common pests. Credit to Crop King Seeds for packaging this sweet, social-leaning hybrid into a reliably productive, dessert-scented showcase.

name: Happy Hour
description: Happy Hour is a genetically balanced hybrid boasting a high THC content averaging 23%. The aroma is grassier and adds berries and strawberries to the blend, rounding things off perfectly. The high is motivating and energetic, leaving no place for bad thoughts or negativity. Expect happy, almost euphoric feelings with a sedating body buzz that relaxes you thoroughly but doesn’t lock you to the couch. You’ll feel creative and talkative for hours on end. name: Rollins
description: Rollins is a 90% sativa-dominant strain bred from a cross between the well-known Lemon Tree and Nigerian strains. Though it’s known for being a difficult plant to grow due to its towering growth, it tends to be quite resilient even in suboptimal growing environments. This strain produces a complex aroma profile, featuring sharp notes of citrus and earthy pine, accented by a subtle spicy pungency that remains gentle on the senses. The taste leans toward the sweeter side, offering a lemon-pine flavor that lingers pleasantly. Rollins’ effects contrast with its bright, citrusy flavor. It begins with an uplifting cerebral rush, enhancing mood and promoting a sense of joy and ease. However, the high gradually shifts, introducing a tingling body sensation that can lead to deep physical relaxation and even couch-lock. Users often experience mental haziness, drifting in and out of focus as the calming body effects take hold. With THC levels reaching up to 26% on average, Rollins is frequently recommended for individuals seeking relief from mood disorders such as depression, as well as chronic pain and migraines.

name: Super Cherry

The Super Cherry effects are known to come on fast, causing an energetic and euphoric head rush before things turn more relaxing towards the end of the experience. Medical use of Super Cherry is best aimed at alleviating anxiety-related conditions and arthritis. Dry eyes are common in high doses. Due to its impressive terpene profile, proper curing of the buds is crucial for optimal flavor and effects.

name: Nigerian Diesel
description: Nigerian Diesel is Aficionado Seeds’ razor-bright ode to classic East Coast energy, bred by Uncle Doobie by pairing Nigerian Haze with a Sour Diesel BX 4.5 male. The JJ’s Nigerian side (JJ’s Nigerian crossed to Original Haze) lends cathedral-like headroom, incense, and electric drive, while the Diesel backcross layers on solvent-slick fuel and a focused, steely core. Crack a jar and the room fills with sharp citrus over diesel, chased by a spicy haze note; on the palate it is clean gas and lemon peel with a lightly herbal finish. Expect a fast rise and a long, cerebral plateau that feels creative, energetic, and distinctly uplifting, with resin output that makes the flowers sparkle. Phenotypes tend to show a sativa-forward architecture with eager stretch and stacked calyxes; the terpene profile often trends toward terpinolene and limonene with caryophyllene in the background. Growers can expect medium stature, medium-to-high yields, and uniform, sugar-frosted flowers ideal for resin work. name: Mag Landrace

Dominant terpenes beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and alpha-humulene (with supporting myrcene) color the profile and steer the effect toward full-body calm: most users describe a relaxing, sleepy, sometimes gently arousing finish. THC typically ranges from 12.5% to 28.5% with CBD below 1%, so potency can swing from steady to stout depending on the batch. In the garden, Mag Landrace keeps a compact, bushy indica frame; expect a 49-63 day indoor flowering window and medium-to-high yields when dialed in. There are no documented parents; this cultivar is a pure Iranian landrace rather than a modern cross, so its appeal lies in unhybridized character and reliable structure. For heritage collectors and classic-indica fans alike, Mag Landrace delivers an old-world aroma wrapped in contemporary presentation without sacrificing its origin story. Short internodes and broadleaf morphology make canopy control simple, while stout branches carry the weight with ease.

name: Lemon Margy
description: Created by Cannarado Genetics, Lemon Margy fuses Lemon Jack and Frozen Margy into a citrus-charged, sativa-leaning hybrid with a brisk, modern edge. Its dense, spade-shaped flowers sparkle with a dusting of white trichomes and bright orange pistils, releasing a vivid nose of lemon and citrus over an earthy diesel undertone. Limonene leads the terpene chorus, backed by caryophyllene and myrcene, for an aroma and flavor that feels like zest and sunshine in equal measure. Expect a clean, upbeat profile: an energetic lift and creative clarity balanced by a quiet, relaxing body ease. In the garden, Lemon Margy stays manageable and compact for a sativa-dominant, typically finishing in 63–70 days with moderate yields of resin-heavy buds. Potency commonly lands in the 20–25% THC window with trace-to-low CBD (up to ~1%), giving the cultivar a lively but composed character. Fans of its parentage will recognize Lemon Jack’s zesty drive rounded by Frozen Margy’s smoother, weightier resin structure. Whether admired for its jar appeal or its fresh-squeezed flavor, Lemon Margy delivers a bright, polished expression of the Margy line that growers and connoisseurs appreciate for reliability, vigor, and that unmistakable lemon-forward finish.

name: Green Caffeine
description: Green Caffeine lives up to its name with a brisk, sativa-forward profile from Green Crack x Caffeine, developed by In The Flow. Its posture is upright and eager, stacking spear-shaped colas with a high calyx-to-leaf ratio that finish in a sparkling coat of trichomes. On the nose and palate, expect a lively duet of citrus zest and green mango over an earthy backbone, a flavor set often driven by myrcene, caryophyllene, and ocimene. Typical potency lands between 18–22% THC with low CBD, translating to a quick, lucid lift, crisp focus, and upbeat momentum supported by a light, steady body ease. Indoors, Green Caffeine is efficient and tidy, wrapping in 56–63 days and staying compact (roughly 0–4 ft). Outdoors it stretches to 5–8 ft in warm, sunny conditions. With good airflow, staking, and a consistent feed, yields are generous: about 400–500 g/m2 inside and 500–600 g per plant outside. Visually, buds show lime-to-forest greens with bright orange pistils and a frosted sheen, echoing the vigor of its Green Crack parentage while Caffeine lends a calm, composed finish.

name: Pine Tar
description: Pine Tar Kush distills the evergreen soul of Pakistan's mountains into a compact, resin-heavy indica preserved as an IBL. Credited to CSI Humboldt's Pine Tar Kush IBL release, and introduced to Northern California by breeder Tom Hill decades earlier, this line remains true to its landrace roots: squat, thick-stemmed plants that reek of forest sap and warm earth. Aromas of sharp pine and cured wood translate to a deep, tarry flavor supported by caryophyllene spice, with myrcene and alpha-pinene steering the terpene profile. Indoors the cultivar typically flowers in 49-63 days, finishing around 8 weeks, and rewards attentive growers with medium to high yields; expect roughly 450-550 g/m2 inside and sturdy, 550-gram plants outdoors. Most phenotypes stay medium in height (about 60-120 cm inside) with dense, rocklike colas that cure to an oily sheen. Potency is robust without excess, commonly testing 18-24% THC with trace CBD (approx 0.1-0.5%). The experience arrives as heavy body calm, gentle euphoria, and drowsy contentment that harkens back to classic hash-plant nights. While the line is an inbred landrace, its story nods to the mountains: think Pure Pakistani Kush refined through selection rather than modern hybridization - a nostalgic, pine-forward throwback for connoisseurs of old-school Kush. Growers note easy handling and stout branching, yet vigilant odor control is recommended late in bloom.

name: Caribbean Breeze
description: Caribbean Breeze is a sativa dominant hybrid with 23% THC and a bright uplifting high. Created from an Pineapple Fruz , Biscotti and Sunset Sherbert BX cross, this tropical tasting strain is a delightfully refreshing treat. It thrives cultivated both indoors and outdoors, with a short and compact size of 30-120cm (1-4ft) that makes it ideal for tight indoor setups. Flowering time is around 66 days, where it produces medium yields of dense and long diamond-shaped buds with a gorgeous emerald green color and bright orange hairs heavy with a thick chunky coat of sparkly white trichomes tinted with amber hues. With a sweet tropical fruity flavor that reflects the boozy cocktail it was named for, Caribbean Breeze has a captivating sweet and creamy taste that blends bright tropical citrus with papaya, berry, and orange. Its aroma is similar, delivering a sensory profile that’s as refreshing as an island breeze. With uplifting effects as enticing as its sweet creamy flavor, expect a rush of euphoric energy from the start, which soon becomes an uplifted happy head high. You’ll find yourself feeling super talkative and outgoing, making it an awesome strain for any social scene. This cerebral upliftment spreads throughout the body, inspiring a get up and go energy that will keep you motivated to stay moving. Adverse effects tend to be mild, and may include dry mouth, dry eyes, and dizziness. These refreshing effects make Caribbean Breeze a good option for medical cannabis patients interested in a strain that alleviates fatigue, anxiety,stress, and depression. It’s also reported to help with headaches, migraines, lack of appetite, and nausea.

name: Green Line OG
description: Green Line OG marries the zesty lift of Lime Skunk with the deep, classic calm of Ghost OG, a pairing first popularized by Cresco Labs. Its jar opens with bright lime and sugared citrus over a forest-floor backbone, sharpening to pine and a peppery OG sparkle as the flower warms. Compact, easily managed plants tend to stay under 75 cm and finish quickly; most phenotypes wrap in 45-48 days, yet stack dense, frosty colas that present in neon greens with rust pistils. Indoors, well-run rooms see moderate returns around 150 g/m2, while sun-grown specimens commonly yield about 300 g per plant. Typical lab profiles show elevated THC in the low-to-mid 20s with occasional lots approaching 29%, while CBD remains trace (roughly 0.44-0.7%). Expect an energizing, clear onset that keeps focus crisp and mood buoyant before easing into an even-keeled body calm; many describe feeling uplifted, happy, and centered, with only light OG heaviness at the edges. Limonene leads the terpene chorus, supported by beta-myrcene and beta-caryophyllene for citrus brightness, gentle depth, and a faint spicy warmth. True to its lineage, Green Line OG balances workday clarity with couch-friendly composure, a contemporary hybrid that tastes like lime soda fizz poured through pine. Easy to run, it rewards attentive trellising.

name: Monster Glue
description: Monster Glue is Monster Genetics balanced take on the Glue family, a 50/50 hybrid born from Chem's Sister and Chocolate Diesel. Expect dense, olive‑green buds caked in resin, carrying coffee and diesel aromatics with a gentle sweet edge. Caryophyllene leads the terpene chorus, joined by limonene and myrcene for a profile that swings from spicy and citrusy to warm, earthy depth. THC commonly sits in the low‑to‑mid 20s, with standout phenos reported around 26%, while CBD remains minimal. In effect, Monster Glue opens with a bright, euphoric lift that settles into a calm, contented body ease without sacrificing clarity. Growers will appreciate its straightforward, vigorous behavior: indoors it reaches roughly 120–160 cm and finishes in 8–9 weeks, delivering up to 550 g/m2; outdoors it can stretch to 180–250 cm and reward patient hands with about 700 g per plant. The plant’s heavy trichome coverage makes it a natural for hash and rosin work, staying true to the Glue reputation.

name: 3D
description: 3D by Swamp Boys Seeds channels the energy of its parents, White Fire 3 and Nigerian, into a sativa-leaning hybrid built for vivid aromatics and sparkling resin. Expect tall, eager stretch and stacked, spear-like colas that finish in roughly 63–70 days, with moderate yields that concentrate most of their weight in dense, frosty tops. The bouquet mingles bright citrus and lime peel with cool spearmint, a peppery spice, and a lick of fuel; on the palate, that profile settles into mint, spicy-herbal notes, and a diesel edge. Humulene, myrcene, and caryophyllene typically lead the terpene chorus, supporting THC levels that commonly land around 20–28%. The high arrives upbeat and crystalline — euphoric and uplifted — with a clean, forward momentum that reflects its Nigerian lineage while White Fire 3 tightens structure and adds intensity. Plants respond well to topping and light training to manage vertical push and open the canopy for even ripening. 3D captures a certain Florida-haze nostalgia in a more contemporary, resin-rich frame, making it a compelling hunt for growers who prize tall, aromatic sativas with modern frost and a heady, energetic drive credited to the Swamp Boys touch.

name: Kurple Fantasy
description: Kurple Fantasy walks a confident line between old-school Kush gas and royal purple sweetness. Bred by Imperial Genetics, this indica-leaning hybrid pairs the coveted '92 OG Kush with Old Man Purps, a match that yielded shimmering buds in deep violets and lime, stacked on a squat, bushy frame. The nose opens with ripe grape and berry layered over earthy diesel; on the palate, that fruit-and-fuel duet lingers as notes of spice and faint licorice flicker in the background. Typical lab results place THC from the high teens into the mid-20s, with trace CBD approaching 1%; myrcene, beta-caryophyllene, and limonene usually headline the terpene bill. Effects arrive as a gentle creeper pressure behind the eyes blooms into full-body calm, an easy euphoria that lifts mood while unwinding muscles. Indoors, expect a straightforward 56-63 day bloom and medium yields; plants tend to stay compact, making canopy control simple, while outdoor runs can push a bit taller with similar returns. Kurple Fantasy's pedigree showed early on the competition stage, scoring second in the Indica category at the 2012 High Times Denver Medical Cannabis Cup, and it remains a go-to for growers and tastemakers chasing grape-forward depth without sacrificing classic OG character.

name: Animal Blues
description: Animal Blues blends the cookie-crumb decadence of Animal Cookies with the berry-splashed depth of Platinum Blueberry Kush, and it shows. Bred by In House Genetics, this indica-leaning hybrid (about 80% indica/20% sativa) grows into compact, medium-height bushes that stack dense, frosty colas washed in dark green, violet, and midnight-blue hues with bright orange hairs. The nose opens on sweet-and-sour blueberries and ripe grape over an earthy, herbal base with subtle spice; the palate follows with berry and grape tones anchored by loam-like earthiness and a faint nutty echo. Potency typically lands between 17% and 23% THC with low CBD around 0-1%, delivering a rounded, calming experience that lifts mood, soothes the body, and leaves many users feeling relaxed, uplifted, and quietly euphoric. Indoors, flowering finishes in roughly 56-70 days; expect medium yields with careful canopy management and steady airflow during late bloom. Outdoors, plants prefer mild, dry finishes to preserve the thick trichome coat. Fans of its lineage will recognize the balance: Animal Cookies contributes structure and a cookies sweetness, while Platinum Blueberry Kush layers in fruit-forward terpenes and deep color.

name: Orange Tsunami
description: Orange Tsunami rolls in with sunlit citrus and a cool creative breeze. An indica‑leaning hybrid at roughly 60% indica and 40% sativa, it’s bred from Orange Crush and Blueberry, two classics that explain its bright peel‑and‑pulp aroma and soft berry undertow. Open a jar and you’ll meet sweet orange and vanilla tones; break a bud and sharper citrus oils surface. Caryophyllene leads the terpene lineup, with linalool and pinene rounding out a profile that smells as clean as it tastes. Potency sits in a friendly lane at around 14% THC with trace‑to‑zero CBD, so the experience tends to be clear, upbeat, and comfortably manageable. The high typically lifts first—energetic and happy—then steadies into focused creativity without much weight. Buds show dense, crystal‑flecked calyxes and lively tangerine pistils on compact, branching plants that fit well in limited spaces. Indoors or out, gardeners can expect medium yields and a flowering window near 7–9 weeks when dialed in. Orange Tsunami doesn’t chase extremes; instead it balances sparkle and composure with the kind of flavor that keeps you coming back.

name: Randy Watson
description: Randy Watson struts on stage like its namesake, blending Runtz (Zkittlez x Gelato) with Wedding Crasher (Wedding Cake x Purple Punch) into a modern candy-gas hybrid that flashes loud color and frosty resin. Grind the dense, medium-tall buds and a rush of tart-sweet fruit lands first, chased by pine and a streak of diesel over light earthy spice. Early sessions often lift the mood and spark a bright, happy clarity that eventually smooths into a cushioned calm, a hybrid arc many growers and makers — including 710 Labs’ Randy Watzon #13 phenotype — have leaned into. Indoors, expect a straightforward cycle of roughly 56–63 days and medium yields; trained outdoor plants can push higher numbers under long, warm seasons. Reported THC typically ranges from the high teens to the upper twenties, with very low CBD, so potency can feel assertive even in small jars. Morphology skews bag-appeal heavy: calyx-stacked colas, lively orange pistils, and a glassy trichome sheen that presses well. If your palate lives where dessert meets fuel, Randy Watson’s profile—sweet candy up front with diesel-pine edges—hits the note and holds it.

name: Pancake Ice
description: Pancake Ice serves up a bright, zesty stack of flavor before the effects even land: citrus peel and sweet vanilla swirl over an earthy backbone, with occasional piney lifts on the nose. Released by Houseplant, this sativa-leaning hybrid is a selected phenotype of Ethos' Crescendo strain. Pancake Ice blends Chemdog x I-95 with Mandarin Cookies, the latter a contest-tested cultivar whose lineage (Forum Cut Cookies x Mandarin Sunset) lends orange-forward terps and showpiece bag appeal. Expect a clean, get-up-and-go mood with sharp focus and a buoyant, uplifted energy, typical of its limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene trio, often rounded by nerolidol and farnesene. Batches commonly test in the mid-to-high 20s for THC (roughly 22–29% reported), with trace CBD under 0.2%, translating to potent but clear daytime momentum rather than couch-heavy weight. In the garden, Pancake Ice leans tall and lanky with sativa vigor, stacking dense, frost-tipped flowers; experienced growers note heavy yields when canopy management keeps light on the lower sites. Indoors, plan for about 65–75 days of flower to full color and aroma. The finish sticks to the palate like syrup: a citrus–cookie sweetness that lingers as productivity clicks into gear.

name: Snow Leopard
description: Snow Leopard prowls through the garden like its namesake, stealthy, frosted, and rare. Bred by Bodhi Seeds from Tigermelon and Snow Lotus, this indica-leaning hybrid (about 55% indica/45% sativa) stacks dense, resin-caked colas on a compact, branchy frame that finishes in roughly 8 to 10 weeks. Aromas open with sweet tropical wood and pine over an earthy kush base; the palate follows with earthy, pine, and softly sweet tones. Typical lab results place THC from the high teens into the upper 20s (often 17 to 30%), while CBD remains trace, keeping the experience decidedly potent. The high tends to creep, first a buoyant, euphoric lift and tunneled focus, then a deep, feline calm that settles the body without muting the mind. Growers often note small stature, strong lateral branching, and generous yields; indoors, harvests around 600 g per m2 are attainable, while outdoor plants can top 600 to 700 g apiece under good care. Myrcene, caryophyllene, and pinene commonly dominate the terpene bouquet, driving its relaxing, euphoric, and focused effects.

name: Dirty Little Secret
description: Dirty Little Secret lives up to its mischievous name, blending the gas-laden heft of Donkey Butter with the sherbet-mint dessert notes of Rainbow Chip. Bred by Exotic Genetix, this indica-leaning hybrid grows into medium-tall, resin-caked bushes with a strong calyx-to-leaf ratio and dark olive flowers that often flash purples under cool nights. Cracking a jar releases sweet berry and grape overtones laced with spicy-herbal pepper, then deeper earthy pine; beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene typically lead the terpene cast. Potency ranges widely—batches commonly test around 19–28% THC with trace CBD near 0–0.6%—delivering an upbeat, creative lift and clean focus that settles into calm, contented clarity without heaviness. Indoors, Dirty Little Secret finishes in roughly 56–63 days and rewards dialed-in rooms with high yields near 400–500 g/m²; outdoors, well-fed plants can push 500–600 g per plant by early October in temperate zones. The smoke carries a layered berry-grape sweetness balanced by spicy herbal bite and a faint mint-chocolate echo from the Rainbow Chip side. Growers rate difficulty as medium: it likes airflow, regular thinning, and moderate feeding.

name: Drago
description: Drago is a house hybrid from 14er Boulder that marries the candy-bright zest of Forbidden Fruit with the savory punch of GMO Cookies. In the jar, dense, conical buds flash lime-to-violet hues under a frosting of bulbous trichomes; break one open and waves of citrus and grape meet a diesel-tinged funk, a telltale trio driven by caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. Drago’s profile lands hybrid in spirit and indica-leaning in structure, offering a clean, energetic lift and narrowed focus that eventually smooths into an easy, upbeat calm. Typical batches land around 18–28% THC with trace CBD below 1%, translating that terpene color into vivid flavor without heaviness. Growers will find moderate demands and rewarding structure: medium-tall, well-branched plants that stack nicely indoors, finishing in roughly 63–77 days. Expect medium yields—around 500 g/m2 inside and solid outdoor production per plant—when kept dialed under strong light and steady, calcium-rich feed. The cut’s resin density and surface sheen also make it a natural fit for solventless work. Whether you taste sun-warmed citrus candy or a whisper of fuel beneath ripe fruit, Drago (14er) keeps its footwork nimble—bright, uplifted, and memorable—true to its lineage and the meticulous selection ethos of its Boulder-born creators. Structure skews indica while the overall effect stays balanced and purposeful.

name: Creme De Menthe
description: Creme De Menthe is an indulgent indica-leaning hybrid from Aficionado Seeds, born from Runtz x (Triangle Kush x Mendo Breath). The cross delivers a 70% indica, 30% sativa profile wrapped in a cool, confectionary bouquet: mint leaf over vanilla cream with earthy undertones, and a faint whisper of chocolate from the Mendo lineage. Expect dense, frost-stacked flowers with broad calyxes, lime to deep-olive hues, occasional purple flashes, and a sticky resin sheen that signals potency. Lab-friendly batches commonly test at 25-30% THC, while CBD remains minimal, so effects arrive quickly yet stay surprisingly composed—creative, uplifted, and focused before settling into calm body ease. Linalool, caryophyllene, and pinene lead the terpene chorus, shaping the strain's mint-sweet aroma and balancing bite. In the garden, Creme De Menthe finishes in roughly 63-70 days of flowering and rewards attentive cultivation with a moderate yield and boutique bag appeal. Plants stay manageable in stature and appreciate steady environmental control, making difficulty squarely medium for most growers. Credit to Aficionado Seeds for capturing Triangle Kush's classic structure and pushing Mendo Breath's dessert-leaning charm into a bright, refreshing mint profile that stands out on the tray and in the grinder. Indoor cultivators often see compact, well-stacked colas, while outdoor plants favor warm, dry air and consistent airflow. Expect mint, vanilla, and earth to linger on the palate.

name: Petrol Pine
description: Released by Cresco Labs, Petrol Pine marries MAC and Gelato #2 into a pungent, indica-leaning hybrid that lives up to its name. This 70/30 cut pushes a bold forest-pine and garage-fuel bouquet over a subtle chemical edge, with accents often linked to limonene, linalool, and caryophyllene. Dense, spade-shaped flowers glisten under amber-tinted trichomes and tangerine pistils, a bag appeal MAC fans will recognize. Reported effects lean calm and sleepy with a creative glimmer: a gentle lift blossoms into full-body ease and a quieted headspace, before settling into a heavy, unhurried finish. Typical potency lands in the high-teens to mid-20s for THC, while CBD remains trace, generally below 1%, reinforcing the strain's weighty relaxation. On the palate, expect the namesake profile first - pine, diesel, and a clean, almost solvent-like snap - then brighter suggestions of orange rind, lavender, basil, and hops from its terpene trio. Petrol Pine appears in Cresco's own flower line and its High Supply label, but the genetics remain the same: MAC x Gelato #2, selected for gas, bite, and composure. If you prize classic fuel wrapped around a serene, end-of-day tone without losing all mental color, this Cresco creation delivers with unmistakable character. Fans often note a lingering woody aftertaste. While batch results vary, the core profile stays consistent and unmistakably gassy.

name: Dynamite
description: Dynamite lives up to its name with a blast of pink-grapefruit aroma and a compact, production-minded structure refined by Next Generation Seed Company. Bred in British Columbia as an F4 backcross to the original Grapefruit clone, this indica-leaning hybrid (about 75% indica, 25% sativa) stacks short internodes into dense, resinous colas that often blush pink to purple as they ripen. Indoors it finishes fast in 50-55 days, with outdoor crops wrapping around October 1, and it is known for being easy to grow and remarkably efficient in grams per watt. Expect bright grapefruit and citrus-zest flavors layered over a candy-sweet finish, a profile often associated with limonene and supporting myrcene/caryophyllene. Potency centers around 21% THC with roughly 0.5% CBD, delivering a mood-lifting, body-loosening calm that trends happily relaxed and, by the tail end, pleasantly sleepy. Growers value its squat, SOG-friendly form and modest stretch of roughly 10-14 inches after flip; yields are consistently high when dialed in. Credited with local acclaim in the Pacific Northwest, Dynamite also appeared on podiums in the mid-2000s, a testament to its enduring, fruit-forward charm. With Grapefruit x Grapefruit heritage expressed through meticulous backcrossing, Dynamite remains a reliable staple for fans of sweet citrus and fast, compact harvests.

name: Street Tarts
description: Sweet Tarts is an indica-dominant hybrid strain with a sweetly tart taste created by crossing Guava Tart with Street Guru. Known for its gorgeous purple buds drenched in resinous trichomes, this sticky strain with eye-candy appeal has high THC levels that range from 25-30%. The flavor profile reflects its name, with a sweet and tart, candy-like taste with fruity tropical and citrus notes, along with pungent gassy diesel. The effects begin with an uplifted cerebral euphoria, with a positive and happy head high. This is followed by a super relaxed body high that gets heavy with time, causing a deeply sedating, couch-lock effect depending on the pheno. As far as medical effects, Street Tarts is a strain that could be helpful for relieving anxiety, depression, stress, chronic pain, and sleep issues like insomnia. This strain is easy to grow. Yields are high. Flowering time is around 8-9 weeks indoors. Outdoor plants are ready in late September or early October. Yields are high. Lower nighttime temperatures in the last few weeks of flower can help enhance its purple colors.

name: Guava Cava
description: Guava Cava marries sun-kissed islands to mountain lineage courtesy of Crockett Family Farms. This indica-leaning hybrid blends Guava Tartz with the classic Grape Ape x Afghani pairing, and the result opens with ripe guava and grape candy over peppery diesel and pine. Myrcene leads the terpene ensemble, with limonene and caryophyllene sharpening the fruit and spice while adding depth to the grape-jam sweetness. Plants typically stay medium in stature with stout lateral branching, tight internodes, and dense, resin-frosted calyxes that can wash to deep greens and occasional purple. Indoors, expect a straightforward, medium-difficulty run that finishes in about 56-63 days; trained canopies return around 500 g per m2, while outdoor specimens can top 800 g per plant in favorable sun. Potency sits in the modern sweet spot at roughly 18-24 percent THC with trace CBD under 0.5 percent. The high arrives bright and focused from the Guava Tartz side before settling into a tranquil, body-forward calm drawn from its Afghani heritage; users commonly describe a relaxed, uplifted mood with clearheaded focus. Guava Cava honors Crockett Family Farms roots in flavor-driven breeding - a fruit-first profile, classic structure, and reliable yields wrapped into one memorable, crowd-pleasing cultivar. Expect compact, frosty buds that grind sticky and cure with enduring aroma.

name: Caribbean Cookies
description: Caribbean Cookies is a potent hybrid that will seduce you with its enticing flavor profile and balanced genetics. This medical-grade cultivar packs an average THC content of 23% and CBD levels of 1%. It was created by crossbreeding OGKB bx1 with Guava Gelato. Growers must be aware that these moderately challenging ladies require quite some care and attention to thrive, so any prior experience will come in handy. Some pruning goes a long way with these medium-tall plants, and yields can range up to 450g/m² with a shorter-than-average flowering cycle lasting only 59 days. When burned, the Caribbean Cookies nugs release a delightful blend of sweet and tropical notes, finished off masterfully with a hint of earthy. The Caribbean Cookies high packs equally cerebral and physical effects, so prepare for only happy thoughts, euphoria, and limb-numbing relaxation without much lethargy. These balanced effects and its undeniable potency make Caribbean Cookies an already sought-after strain for treating anxiety, stress, and pain-related issues.

name: BK Satellite
description: BK Satellite by Alien Labs orbits the sweet spot between jet-fueled headspace and grounded composure. Bred from Legend of Nigeria and Milky Way, this sativa-dominant hybrid opens with bright lemon zest layered over earthy pine, then drifts into creamy citrus, cooling mint, and a faint spicy finish. Dense and sticky, its dark-green colas are frosted in a thick trichome shell and dotted with copper pistils, textbook bag appeal backed by substance. Batches commonly land in the 21-32% THC window with trace CBD up to about 0.1%, and its terpene trio beta-caryophyllene, D-limonene, and beta-myrcene explains both the zesty aroma and a clean, buoyant tempo. The onset launches attention and creativity, then steadier currents bring an uplifted, energetic mood without losing definition; expect a gentle body hum that never steals the spotlight. Alien Labs presents BK Satellite as a modern, high-octane expression of classic haze-leaning lineage, refined for consistency and character. Whether labeled sativa or simply hybrid by retailers, its personality reads unmistakably celestial: bright, focused, and flavorful, with enough depth to reward slow inspections of each dense calyx. Bred and selected in-house by Alien Labs, its structure forms compact, golf-ball clusters with minimal leaf. Expect sticky grinder teeth and jars perfumed like fresh lemon peel.

name: Area 41
description: Area 41 is one of those hybrids with perfectly balanced genetics: 50% Indica and 50% Sativa. This well-known strain, a crossbreeding project between Gelato #41 and Lemon Fuel OG, is rather difficult to grow because it requires quite some pruning, stable temperature and humidity levels during various phases of its growth, and a meticulous approach to the actual harvesting. These buds boast an enticing flavor full of sweet and lemony notes that fight to take the stage but happen to find a delicious balance. The aroma goes hand in hand with the flavor, further enriched by pine. Area 41 brings a high that will motivate you in no time, so expect a cerebral kick in the butt. It comes on almost immediately with a surge of mental energy, happiness, and even euphora. This strain will not sedate you or make you couch-locked for the next three hours but instead get you moving about and feel very talkative. It has a high average THC level hovering around 22% and is appreciated by medical users who seek relief from appetite loss, stress, and depression.

name: Permanent Shade
description: Permanent Shade from Alien Labs shines where the lights run low, fusing the award-winning depth of Permanent Marker with Connected’s mysterious Nightshade #40. Expect tree-shaped, dense colas washed in frost and streaked dark green to violet. The nose opens with sweet candy and creamy gas, flashes a sharp solvent-like snap, then settles into earthy-citrus echoes. Dominant terpenes often show limonene and caryophyllene with a touch of linalool, and terp totals commonly hover in the 2.7–3.1% range. An indica-leaning hybrid by design, its onset lifts the mood and focus before easing into a heavy, body-forward calm that can glue you to the sofa and trigger a legendary snack raid. Across batches, THC tends to land in the mid-20s, with verified lots measuring roughly 22–31% THC and negligible CBD. Growers can expect a manageable, medium stature and a bloom window of about 8–10 weeks; indoors, dialed-in environments return around 450–650 g/m2 with resin-drenched, bag-appeal buds. Flavor tracks the aroma—sweet, creamy, and gassy—with a lingering, slightly astringent finish. Crafted by Alien Labs, Permanent Shade distills two modern classics into a single, potent cut that balances connoisseur-grade flavor with unflinching, end-of-day weight. Expect appetite waves and a warm, loosening melt through shoulders and limbs, with a sleepy edge for some.

name: Guava Stardawg
description: Guava StarDawg is Top Dawg Seeds' tropical-leaning selection from the famed Stardawg line, a Chemdog #4-forward hybrid bred from Chemdog #4 and Tres Dawg. Nicknamed for its guava-kissed bouquet, this cut wraps classic diesel and earthy chemical tones in bright, fruit-laden top notes, with limonene leading a terpene trio of caryophyllene and myrcene. Expect dense, frosted calyxes that stack on an upright, Chem-style frame, throwing glittering trichomes that inspired the Stardawg name. Reported effects land quick and clear: an energized, uplifted headspace that sharpens focus and nudges creativity before easing into calm body composure; some users note occasional dryness of mouth and eyes or a racy edge in heavier doses. In the garden, Guava StarDawg mirrors its lineage with medium vigor and stretch, rewarding dialed-in cultivation with medium yields of intensely aromatic flowers. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in about 63–73 days, while outdoor harvests are cut-dependent. Potency commonly sits in the low-to-mid 20s for THC. Celebrated among Chem devotees, the Guava expression helped Stardawg capture Best Sativa at the 2012 Denver High Times Cannabis Cup, cementing JJ's Top Dawg Seeds as a modern Chem standard-bearer.

name: Grape Guava
description: Grape Guava by Bloom Seed Co brings together two fruit-powered standouts - Strawberry Guava and Grape Tallyman - into a hybrid that smells like a market stall piled high with ripe grapes, candied citrus, and sun-warmed berries. Selected by Bloom's team, this cut expresses dense, uniquely shaped, light-green to lavender flowers blanketed in a sparkling coat of trichomes and stitched with tangerine pistils. Terpene analysis consistently puts myrcene, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene up front, and the flavor tracks accordingly: grape soda and sweet tropical nectar over a faint zest of orange peel. The effect profile opens with a buoyant, mood-brightening lift and easy focus, then settles into a calm, body-led unwind without heavy couchlock - an arc that feels genuinely balanced. In most labs, potency lands in the mid-20s for THC with trace CBD. Gardeners report medium stature and internode spacing, moderate yields, and a reliable mid-season finish around 56-65 days of flowering; indoors, 450 g/m2 is a fair target, while well-sited outdoor plants can clear roughly 600 g each. Credit Bloom Seed Co for fusing Strawberry Guava's tropical candy with Grape Tallyman's purple-grape push into a single, resin-forward cultivar that washes well, trims clean, and leaves a sticky, fruit-toned halo in the room long after the jar snaps shut.

name: Grandi Guava
description: With two delicious parent strains (Gelato and Guava Gelato) and genetics in perfect balance, Grandi Guava is a hybrid bound to make a lasting impression on the scene. This is a difficult strain to grow due to its high demands, think of regular trimming and pruning, keeping all environmental factors stable, and choosing the exact moment to harvest. Do that and you can expect abundant rewards with high yields of top-notch buds. The taste is mouthwatering, to say the least, an indulgent blend of tropical fruit and creamy cheese, sensations that fill your mouth in no time and linger there for a long time. The aroma shows further layers of pepper and spices. The high comes on instantly with a rush of mental energy and clarity. Expect to feel fully focused and full of motivation to do whatever needs to be done. Another plus is that you’ll feel talkative and sociable, making this an ideal strain during the day. Do prepare for the munchies though. Many medical users hail this as a perfect strain for treating ADHD, depression, and fatigue.

name: Guava Gelato
description: Guava Gelato is a standout hybrid strain, celebrated for its distinctive sweet and tropical guava flavor with hints of pineapple. It's like a burst of exotic fruit in every puff, making it a truly memorable smoking experience. The effects are just as enjoyable, leaving users feeling relaxed and uplifted, with a pleasant buzz filling the body. With THC levels ranging from 13% to a potent 25%, this strain delivers a high that's suitable for both casual users and long-time medical patients. Medically, Guava Gelato is often used to alleviate pain, stress, and migraines. Its balanced hybrid nature (50% Indica, 50% Sativa) means it can provide relief without being overly sedating. This strain is a phenotype of the beloved Gelato, and it carries on the lineage's reputation for unique terpene profiles. Growers will appreciate Guava Gelato's balanced genetics, which make it adaptable to various cultivation environments, although only warm, sunny climates allow the buds to fully mature. The plant's structure is compact, with dense flowers that show off its frosty trichomes. Harvesting Guava Gelato reveals its full potential, with buds that are sticky and loaded with flavor. Whether you're growing for personal use or sharing with friends, this strain's unique profile is sure to impress.

name: Purple Guava
description: Purple Guava blends heirloom guava sweetness with figgy undertones from its parents Purple Fig and Guava, often attributed to Fig Farms. This balanced hybrid expresses dense, resin-frosted flowers with deep violet streaks and electric orange pistils. The nose leans tropical and tangy, and on the palate you will notice blueberry and crisp apple with a savory blue-cheese edge. Most batches land around 22–24% THC with trace CBD, and a linalool-led terpene stack supported by caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene. The experience tends to open clear and upbeat—euphoric, creative, and gently energetic—before easing into a smooth body calm that stays functional. Growers appreciate the cultivar’s cooperative structure and medium stature indoors (about 114 cm) and taller frames outdoors (around 178 cm). In dialed environments, flowering wraps in roughly 52–62 days with vigorous trichome development; yields can reach roughly 1–2 oz/ft² inside (around 450 g/m² average) and 10–15 oz per plant outside, ranking high indoors and medium outside. Expect tight, spade-shaped buds that trim quickly and cure to a glossy sheen. Whether you are chasing tropical flavor or an all-conditions hybrid with jar appeal, Purple Guava offers a modern, fruit-forward profile anchored by classic balance. Under lights, it rewards light training and steady feeding; outdoors, warm, dry sites showcase its color.

name: Guavanade
description: Guavanade from DNA Genetics pours into the room like a summer stand, fusing tropical guava flesh with fizzy citrus. Bred from Guava Gelato x Lemonade, this balanced hybrid leans sativa in spirit, with bright candy-citrus top notes over creamy tropical fruit and a faint herbal bite. Expect a profile led by juicy tropical fruit, zesty lemonade, and a sweet grapefruit edge, rounded by a soft cream finish. Plants stay medium in stature with a sturdy central cola and well-spaced laterals, stacking dense lime-green buds glazed in a frosty finish and threaded with amber pistils. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in 56–63 days, while resin production is generous and the trim stays straightforward thanks to a favorable leaf-to-calyx ratio. Reported potency lands around THCa 19%, delivering a crisp, upbeat onset that feels uplifted, energetic, and creative without heavy drag. Flavor holds true from grind to final puff, tart lemonade, sweet tropicals, and a subtle peppery echo on the exhale. A fresh take on fruit-forward genetics, Guavanade captures the zesty lift of Lemonade and the lush depth of Guava.

name: Guava Kush
description: Guava Kush leans sativa and wears a tropical grin from the moment you open the jar. Bred by Garden Of Green from Guava and OG Kush, this 75 percent sativa, 25 percent indica hybrid blends sun-splashed fruit with classic West Coast fuel. The bouquet pushes ripe guava and citrus up front, then threads in diesel and light pine; myrcene leads the terpene chorus, with bright limonene and peppery caryophyllene adding lift and bite. Plants stay manageable at roughly 130 to 160 cm and show lime green flowers tipped with amber trichomes. Indoors, expect a straightforward 56 to 63 day bloom and high yields around 450 g per square meter; outdoors, well-fed bushes can top 550 g per plant by late October. The profile hits the palate like tropical candy over a faint gas line, and the mood follows suit: a clear, happy rise that softens into an easy, relaxed cruise without heaviness. Average potency centers near 21 percent THC with about 1 percent CBD, giving Guava Kush a bright, all day capable character that still knows when to downshift. If you want a cultivar that smells like vacation yet behaves like a dependable workhorse, this Garden Of Green cross delivers.

name: Watermelon Rancher
description: Watermelon Rancher is a Sativa-driven hybrid strain that’s ideally suited for daytime use. Having the unknown lineage, this cultivar packs an amazing flavor profile consisting mainly of citrusy, floral, and sweet notes, infused with hints of eucalyptus and pine. The Watermelon Rancher high comes on fast and puts you in a focused and motivated mindset. Expect a surge of mental energy, the urge to get things done, and a happy mindset for hours on end. Medical use should be aimed at alleviating depression, chronic fatigue, and anxiety-related issues, although it’s also known to induce appetite. Growing these plants means you’ll need to provide plenty of vertical space. They flower for about 10 to 11 weeks, produce impressive yields, and are suited for both indoor and outdoor cultivation. They are considered moderately challenging to grow.

name: Chem Squeezy
description: Chem Squeezy slides in with the bright snap its name promises, a balanced hybrid from FreeWorld Genetics in Boulder built from a backcrossed Chemodo (Chem #4 x Gupta Kush) paired with Lemon Squeeze. Open the jar and a limonene-led blast of lemon peel leaps out, chased by pine cleaner and diesel fumes; break the buds and the gas deepens while a sweet citrus rind lingers. Most batches test around 25% THC, with some pushing to 28%, while CBD remains trace. Fluffy, mint-green flowers sparkle with amber trichomes and orange pistils, drying to dense, resinous nuggets that make extractors smile. The experience tends to launch with an energetic, euphoric lift and talkative mood before settling into a calm, happy cruise. Growers report medium stature and a cooperative temperament; expect roughly 8-9 weeks of flowering indoors and medium yields when dialed in. The Lemon Squeeze parent adds zesty brightness and OG/Chem/Diesel backbone to Chemodo's classic fuel, creating a profile that is at once nostalgic and modern.

name: Starfire Chem
description: Starfire Chem vaults out of the Chem lineage with a bright, fuel kissed snap and a citrusy glow. Bred by FreeWorld Genetics, this sativa dominant hybrid (about 70% sativa/30% indica) unites Stardawg and Chemodo, passing along the family chem traits: a loud lemon diesel bouquet with spicy, earthy edges. Caryophyllene leads the terpene lineup with limonene and myrcene in support, while typical THC hovers in the mid 20s (often 23-24%) and CBD stays low. Dense, elongated flowers stack into dark olive spears flashing orange hairs and glistening trichomes; many phenotypes swell enough in late bloom to appreciate a trellis. On the palate, expect tangy lemon, pine, and straight diesel, with a clean, resinous finish. The effect pattern is upbeat and precise: a swift, energetic lift sharpens focus and brightens mood as the body idles into an easy cruise - ideal for creative sprints or task driven days. Indoors, Starfire Chem usually finishes in 56-63 days and can reward attentive growers with medium to high yields; outdoors, tall, vigorous plants thrive in temperate conditions. Credit its punch and polish to its parents - Stardawg's sparkling drive and Chemodo's zesty thrust - harmonized into a modern, fast flowering Chem hybrid that smells like a fresh lemon wiped across a gas cap. Expect tall stature (5-8 feet).

name: Layer Cake
description: Layer Cake, created by Swamp Boys Seeds, is a delightful strain with an incredible high THC content (24% and reaching up to 32%). This strain was born from combining the genetics of Wedding Cake, GMO Cookies and Triangle Kush and Skunk 1. Slightly Indica dominant (60%), Layer Cake has all the features to create a balanced and relaxing high. This extremely tasty variety brings sweet and savory flavors of spicy diesel followed by rich cheese and fresh wood notes. As the buds keep burning, a skunky aroma with spicy overtones takes over. Layer Cake’s high is the right combo for social but chill nights with friends at home. The experience starts by giving you a boost of energy and enhancing your social skills while keeping the body relaxed. Users report feeling talkative and at ease to keep up with different topics of conversation. Next follows a strong body high that most likely will get you locked on the couch. Don’t forget to keep snacks at hand because this strain will make you hungry. Individuals suffering from symptoms associated with insomnia, cramps, chronic pain, mood disorders (stress, anxiety, depression) and muscle spasms noticed both physical and mental improvements. If you plan on growing Layer Cake, then expect beautiful oversized buds with nuances of green and amber undertones. Bright orange hairs and a coat of golden frosty trichomes cover the plant. Suitable for both indoor and outdoors, Layer Cake will grow to medium heights. Training techniques such as LST and topping will make it the perfect strain for growers with limited space.

name: Georgia Pine
description: Georgia Pine, a Florida-born hybrid from Swamp Boys Seeds, pairs Killer Queen x G13 with William’s Wonder to deliver a terpene-rich bouquet that’s as memorable as its name. The nose opens with gasoline and black licorice wrapped in hints of wild watermelon and fresh pine, while the palate adds flowery grape nuances before a clean, resinous finish. Balanced 50/50 in its indica/sativa split, Georgia Pine typically tests around 18–22% THC with low CBD, channeling its chemistry into an upbeat, giggly, and creative lift that brightens the mood without blurring focus. Under lights it shows vigorous branching, stacked calyxes, and a silvery frost; indoors expect medium stature and easy canopy control, while outdoor plants can stretch taller in warm, dry climates. Flowering completes in roughly 60–70 days and rewards experienced dialing with generous, high-appeal yields that trim into dense, sparkling buds. The strain’s lineage shows through in structure and punch: Killer Queen G13 lends drive and loud, candy-gas aromatics, while William’s Wonder deepens the body, density, and classic Afghani-style resin.

name: Grapefruit Runtz
description: Grapefruit Runtz from Pheno Addict Seeds marries the zesty, old-school Dirty Sprite Breath with the modern candy cream of Runtz to create a vivid, fruit-forward hybrid with polished bag appeal. Cracking a jar releases bright citrus peel layered over vanilla-sugar candy and faint floral spice; on the palate it stays tangy and sweet, with an easy finish that hints at confectioner’s cream. Limonene leads the terpene chorus, supported by caryophyllene and linalool, shaping an aroma that reads both fresh and dessert-like. Expect compact, resin-heavy blossoms with Gelato-style calyx stacking, medium height, and a cooperative, medium difficulty grow. Indoors or out, plants settle into a moderate production lane and finish in roughly 50–63 days of flower, making Grapefruit Runtz a timely choice for rotating harvests. The cannabinoid profile trends high in THC with low CBD, translating to a buoyant, euphoric lift, a clear, uplifted headspace, and an easygoing happiness that lingers before easing into calm. Fans will recognize how the Grapefruit side keeps the experience lively while the Runtz backbone smooths the edges.

name: Waffle Cone
description: Waffle Cone is a standout hybrid created by Jungle Boys, deriving from Sherb Cream Pie x Biscotti #19, which explains its creamy and dessert-forward profile. When you open a bud, the first scent is rich cake batter and vanilla, swirled with sweet cherries and a faint herbal doughiness. Break it apart and you’ll detect underlying wood, nutty tones, and a whisper of cookie spice. On the palate, the inhale leans creamy and sugary, cherry candy, frosted sugar, and gelato notes, all balanced by a soft earthy base. The exhale brings in baked dough, subtle spice, and an herbal finish that lingers warmly. The effects begin gently with uplifted mood and cerebral clarity, ideas flow and focus sharpens. As session time passes, Waffle Cone wraps the body in calm, easing tension without knocking the mind offline. It’s ideal when you want both brightness and ease, especially for mellow evening moments. Medically, many users turn to it for stress relief, mild pain, muscle tightness, mood support, or sleep aid in calmer doses. Growers describe it as moderate in difficulty, responsive plants with dense colas that benefit from good airflow and stable conditions.
