name: Black Squid
description: Black Squid is a new top-strain by The TenCo released in the first quarter of 2026. It was created by crossbreeding Black Zushi with a specific phenotype of Headbanger (#29), resulting in an Indica-leaning hybrid cultivar that packs quite a punch. The high comes on fast and strong, initially causing a focused and clear-headed mindset with fits of euphoria and a stream of happy thoughts. After a while, though, things turn more introspective and Indica-like, causing deepening physical and mental relaxation that won’t drag you down completely. On the medical side of things, Black Squid is a solid choice for people suffering from depression, chronic stress, and anxiety-related conditions. On the palate, Black Squid delivers a lingering and delicious sensory experience. Expect sour lemon, creaminess, sweet notes, and some gas. No cultivation data or details have been shared to date, but based on the parent strains and the name Black Squid, it’s quite safe to assume that these will be medium-tall plants with a distinctive visual appearance.

name: Zoapium
description: Zoapium distills Doja’s resin-obsessed selection into a compact, exotic hybrid that marries Zelium with the Washer phenotype of Zoap Sour. Indica-dominant in build, it forms stout, trichome-crusted colas that glisten as they cure, trading sheer volume for concentrated quality. Open a jar and the room tilts toward candy shop sweetness and citrus zest before a gassy diesel snap tightens the finish; on the tongue the profile turns creamy-sweet with bright lemon accents. Beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene steer the bouquet and underpin an effect that lifts the mood and primes the imagination, then settles into a deep, tranquil body calm without dimming the spark. Indoors or out, Zoapium keeps timelines friendly - most growers see a medium 56-65 day bloom - while yields run modest, a fair trade for exceptional resin density and washability. Expect potency to hit the high register, with many cuts testing north of 25% THC. Zelium contributes the modern Z-candy swagger; Zoap Sour adds structure and fuel, making Zoapium a natural pick for hash work and connoisseur flower alike. Bred and released by Doja, it reads like a love letter to loud terps and clean extractions, executed with meticulous selection.

The profile's fruit-dessert depth echoes its lineage: Grape Mochi contributes creamy gelato nuance and grape candy edges, while Papayamosa injects papaya, mango, and citrus zest brightness. Sapphire Solstice is released as a feminized, photoperiod line by Doja Seeds, rewarding dialed-in environments with showpiece color, heavy resin, and a euphoric-creative yet balanced finish that lands softly into relaxed contentment overall.

name: Jalapeño
description: Jalapeno from Green Dot Labs is a playful yet purposeful cross of Paloma and Boioioioioing!!!, bred in-house within the Selections program to showcase flavor first. From the first crack of the jar, it flashes a peppery, smoky bouquet that reads fresh jalapeno and mezcal, anchored by tart grapefruit inherited from Paloma (Pirate Milk x ROYGBIV Red). Boioioioioing!!! (Bourbon Street x F.A.F.O.) supplies the bounce: complex lychee-grape undertones, a whisper of gas, and a resin-forward structure that cures into glittering, sticky calyxes. Expect a balanced hybrid vibe with clear-headed focus and uplift to start, tapering into smooth, easy body calm without losing momentum. While potency varies by batch, THC commonly lands in the high teens to low 20s with negligible CBD, letting the terpene profile do the talking. Limonene and caryophyllene take center stage alongside supporting notes of ocimene and myrcene, translating to citrus-bright, spicy-herbal, and subtly floral flavors on a clean burn. Grown as an internal selection rather than a seed-lined release, Jalapeno rewards dialed-in cultivation with loud aroma and generous resin, making it a favorite feeder for future crosses. An expressive snapshot of GDL's flavor-obsessed breeding ethos, it delivers vivid character in both nose and effect.

name: Low Low

Aromatically it hits the throttle early: thick diesel and earthy tank notes lifted by a peppery spice and a squeeze of citrus, a profile driven by myrcene, beta-caryophyllene, and limonene. On the palate the fuel stays front and center while a kushy earth rounds off the edges. Plants stay compact with tight internodes and heavy resin coverage; late in bloom, mature flowers can darken from deep pine green toward dusky purple under cool nights. Expect a medium-short photoperiod of roughly 56-65 days and a modest yield; Low Low trades volume for loudness and frost. In the jar, buds cure into dense, silvery nugs that flake with sticky trichomes. Potency skews high; batches commonly clock above 25% THC while CBD remains trace, so its experience leans decidedly heady and body-soothing without veering sugary or floral. Credit for the cross goes to Jungle Boys, whose penchant for gassy, OG-leaning expressions shows through in the strain's unapologetic nose and tidy, efficient structure. If you track lineage, Chem D (as part of Motor Breath) contributes the solventy punch; the '06 OG side adds classic pine-lemon OG backbone and a clean, calming finish.

The structure responds well to canopy management and steady late-flower environment control. As a 10-regular-seed release, phenotype exploration is part of the fun—one more nod to Blockberry's celebrated lineage (its renowned "Super Boof" selection helped put the line on the map). Blouis Vuitton is equal parts confection and couture: flavorful, photogenic, and purpose-built for standout jars.

name: Maltese Tiger
description: Maltese Tiger prowls out of the Blockhead Buds stable with pedigree swagger, uniting Tiger Cake and Blueberry Frosting into a modern dessert-gas hybrid. Expect a loud nose where blueberry jam and vanilla icing ride over menthol-kissed diesel and earthy spice, then translate cleanly to a creamy, fuel-tinged finish. Plants stay medium in stature, stacking dense, resin-soaked colas that finish in roughly 60–70 days, and the breeder's cut is known for easy cloning and vigorous, hardy growth that pushes notably heavy yields. name: Medicine Man
description: Medicine Man carries the quiet power of an old-school champion. Its backbone blends Afghan with a Brazilian Sativa and a South Indian line, producing medium-height plants that stack thick, compact, highly resinous colas. Indoors, flowering completes in about 56-65 days; attentive gardeners routinely see up to 600 g/m2, while outdoor bushes finish by early October in temperate climates. The bouquet leans berry and sweet earth with skunky, woody undertones, and the flavor follows suit. A terpene ensemble typically led by myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene frames the experience: the onset brings a calm, happy lift that settles into a deeply relaxed, sleepy finish. Potency sits high, with THC commonly testing between 16-23% and CBD generally low (around 0-1%), so effects feel full and enveloping without losing clarity. True to its Widow family roots, Medicine Man shines as a dense, trichome-heavy selection that rewards simple, steady cultivation in soil or hydro.

Expect a high that opens with a cheerful lift and creative spark before settling into a centered OG calm; most report relaxed, happy vibes with occasional dry mouth or dry eyes if overindulged. THC commonly tests in the low-to-mid 20s, while CBD remains minimal. Gardeners will find a moderate challenge: Cinnamon Buddha OG appreciates warm, arid-to-Mediterranean climates, steady feeding, carbon filtration late in bloom, and low-stress training or a SCROG to support its weighty tops.

Caryophyllene leads a terpene trio with myrcene and linalool, shaping effects many describe as buoyant and social up top before uncoiling into a serene, body-forward calm. Growers report vigorous, medium-height plants and high yields, finishing in roughly 63-70 days indoors.

name: The Woah

Effects arrive quickly: relaxed body comfort and a smiley, upbeat headspace that often nudges creativity without heavy sedation. name: Dankarooz

Effects lean mellow yet buoyant, starting with a quick lift, easy happiness, and a sometimes-giggly social spark before settling into smooth, even-keeled relaxation. Growers report a compact, cookie-style structure with heavy trichome density and an approachable, medium yield; indoors it stays manageable and rewards careful dialing-in of light and nutrients. Dankarooz captures the modern candy wave without sacrificing depth - credit to Coool Beans for pairing two elite parents so harmoniously.

If you admire how Gelato’s polish meets GMO’s pungent swagger, Garlato captures that meeting point with balance, character, and unmistakable flavor. Flower structure is compact and frosty, with lime-green calyxes and amber pistils throughout.

Compact, mid-height plants form dense, frost-heavy colas; indoors they shine with a manageable stretch and a 49-56 day finish, rewarding attentive airflow and defoliation with moderate yields. Seed selection from Pacific NW Roots stabilized the Koffee line's roast-spice profile, and Koffee Cake carried that signature to competition: the cultivar placed third in the Indica category at The Karma Cup in 2019. Growers report small-to-medium stature with sturdy lateral branching, resin-coated calyxes, and an earthy-sweet aroma that intensifies through cure. Expect a flavor arc that starts with mocha-diesel, turns creamy-sweet at mid-palate, and lands on peppered pine. For collectors who appreciate classic Kush structure wrapped in patisserie aromatics, Koffee Cake neatly bridges old-school gas with pastry-case charm while keeping timelines tight and canopies easy to manage. Flowering outdoors typically wraps by early October in temperate zones.

name: Space Guava
description: Space Guava fuses Space Runtz with Guava'z 74 in a fruit-forward hybrid authored by Bloom Seed Co. True to its name, the bouquet leans tropical and vivid: ripe guava and sweet citrus glide over peppery sparks and a soft pine-candy finish. Caryophyllene often leads the terpene chorus, with limonene and myrcene adding bright lift and creamy roundness. Onset is quick and buoyant — energetic, happy, and lightly euphoric — cruising into a calm, centered equilibrium that preserves clarity rather than fog. Typical potency sits in the modern sweet spot (roughly 19–25% THC) with trace CBD, keeping the profile lively and expressive. Growers can expect a cooperative, medium-stature plant with moderate internodes, stacked calyxes, and sticky resin coverage. Indoors, Space Guava generally wraps in 60–70 days; outdoors it tends to finish by early October in temperate zones. Yields land squarely in the middle, rewarding attentive airflow and light management with photogenic flowers that glisten in the jar. The Space Runtz side brings color and bag appeal; Guava'z #74 injects tropical complexity and a lingering, candied aftertaste. Whether you see it listed as Space Guava, Space Guavaz, or Space Guava'z, this balanced 50/50 hybrid reads bright, buoyant, and unmistakably fruit-first.

name: Dank Schrader
description: Born in Vancouver, Dank Schrader was developed as the house strain of The Healing Center during the final season of Breaking Bad. A cross of Rockstar Kush and Bubba Kush, it leans indica at about 80/20 and often tests in the 23-27% THC range with trace CBD under 1%. Expect a classic kush bouquet where pine, sweet wood, and earthy spice dominate; myrcene, caryophyllene, and pinene are the likely terpene drivers. Plants grow compact and medium in height (roughly 3-4 feet) with dense, frosty colas and dark-emerald calyxes tipped by vivid pistils. Indoors, attentive growers can see up to roughly 550 g/m2; outdoors, about 450 g per plant is typical. Flowering wraps in 7-9 weeks. The experience opens with a wave of body ease and quiet euphoria, often brightening the mood and setting a relaxed, sociable tone before deep calm settles in; a sleepy, satiated finish is common, with the usual dry mouth and the occasional heady wobble in heavier sessions. Fans prize Dank Schrader for delivering a rich, resin-forward expression of its BC lineage while retaining unmistakable kush flavor cadence. Credit for the original cut goes to The Healing Center, whose team helped refine this potent, evening-leaning hybrid into a local favorite.

name: Couch Lock
description: Born from classic West Coast building blocks, Couchlock by British Columbia Seed Company blends Northern Lights #5 with Afghani #1 to deliver a compact, resin-loaded indica experience. Its morphology is unmistakably old-school: short, bushy plants with broad, dark leaves and tight internodes that thrive in Sea of Green and fit neatly into small spaces. Indoors, flowering wraps in just 40–49 days, and in dialed-in rooms the strain is known for generous yields that belie its size. Expect an earthy, skunky sweetness on the nose and palate, often underpinned by myrcene with hints of piney pinene and a dusting of caryophyllene. Effects arrive as a calm, euphoric exhale that softens into full-body relaxation and heavy eyelids — true to the name — with a typical potency around 17% THC (commonly seen between 14–19%) and minimal CBD. Growers appreciate its sturdy structure, pest and mold resistance, and forgiving nature, making it approachable for novices yet satisfying for veterans chasing dense, frosty colas. As a proudly indica‑dominant hybrid (approximately 85% indica/15% sativa), Couchlock carries forward the timeless character of its parents while trimming the calendar and maximizing space — ideal for anyone seeking a fast, fragrant run that finishes strong and authentic to its lineage. The cut rewards careful drying with dense, sugar-frosted buds and a lingering, earthy-sweet finish.

name: Crusher Claw
description: Crusher Claw by Cipher Genetics snaps together Mop Chopper and Blue Lobster into a muscular, candy-gas hybrid. Expect a bright ribbon of citrus over a diesel core, with sweet, fruit-candy echoes that betray its Blue Lobster parent, while Mop Chopper adds OG-leaning fuel and grip. Dense, resin-laden colas form on a medium-sized frame that responds well to training and finishes in 56–65 days indoors. In dialed rooms, yields can stack to around 700 g/m²; outdoors, vigorous plants can push toward roughly 1,250 g per plant by late September or early October. The nose typically leans on myrcene, beta-caryophyllene, and limonene, which together sketch the strain's citrus, diesel, and sugared-fruit profile. Potency trends high, with batches often reported above 25% THC, while CBD remains minimal. Effects tend to open euphoric and upbeat before settling into a smooth, body-forward calm that keeps the mood lifted rather than heavy. Blue Lobster's East Coast pedigree—famous for its Zalympix 2023 terp and gas accolades—shows in the jar appeal: frosted jade to deep violet flowers with a glassy sheen. Credit to Cipher Genetics for the pairing; Crusher Claw reads like a refined modern hybrid with easygoing cultivation, big-bag appeal, and a flavor arc that lands squarely between candy shop and pump handle.

name: Trapline
description: Trapline fuses Chemdog 91 with Blue Lobster in a cipher-stamped hybrid that smells like a fresh-opened fuel can spiked with zesty rind and clean earth. Bred by Cipher Genetics, this indica-leaning 70/30 shows rugged Chem vigor, stacking dense, resin-caked colas with short-to-moderate internodes and a confident lateral spread. Expect a terpene triad led by myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene that translates to pungent diesel, bright citrus, and loamy undertones; crack a jar and the room quickly follows. In the jar and on the grinder, the profile stays loud yet refined, finishing with a faint hashy echo. Typical lab results for this cultivar have been reported in the 25-30% THC range with negligible CBD. Indoors, plants generally finish in 8-9 weeks of flower and respond well to high light intensity and clean airflow; outdoor harvest tends to land in early October in temperate zones. The experience skews assertive but composed: fans note an early wave of euphoria and uplift that settles into a grounded body ease without murkiness. Aroma leans diesel first, with bright citrus peel and deep earthy base that lingers. If Chemdog 91 is the spark and Blue Lobster the polish, Trapline is the throughline - old-school gas modernized for contemporary resin hunters by Cipher Genetics.

name: Gold Lobster
description: Gold Lobster is a modern hybrid from Cipher Genetics that marries the bright candy-citrus of Gold Gummy-Lemon Tree crossed with White Gummy-with the frosty depth of Blue Lobster. The result leans into confectionary terpenes: sparkling citrus zest wrapped in sweet grape candy and a faint diesel twang, with aromas that open quickly from the jar and linger on the grind. Structure tends toward dense, heavily resin-coated flowers with vivid orange stigmas and cool green hues, echoing the Blue Lobster family's photogenic frost while preserving Lemon Tree's lemon-peel snap. On the palate, expect a clean, sweet-citrus entry that drifts into sugared fruit and soft gas. The experience typically starts upbeat and happy before easing into a calm, body-light composure that keeps the mood lifted and clear. Released in a 7‑feminized seed drop, Gold Lobster was designed for growers and hashmakers who chase bright, candy-forward profiles and trichome-rich buds. Parentage: Gold Gummy (Lemon Tree x White Gummy) x Blue Lobster. Breeder: Cipher Genetics.

name: Froot Loot
description: Froot Loot from Cipher Genetics stacks candy-forward pedigree on candy-forward pedigree, blending Fruit Stand by In House Genetics (Purple Punch x Allen Wrench) with the celebrated Blue Lobster selection (Apples & Bananas x Eye Candy) popularized by Maine Trees. The result leans indica in structure and feel, building compact, conical colas that glint with a heavy resin jacket and carry a nostalgic cereal-aisle bouquet: ripe fruit gummies and grape over bright citrus and a smooth ribbon of candy gas. In gardens, Froot Loot maintains a manageable, medium stature with sturdy lateral branching and thick calyxes, finishing in roughly 56-63 days. Under dialed conditions it shows real production potential, with indoor harvests reported around 700 g/m2 and outdoor plants capable of topping 1,250 g per plant. Expect high THC potential with minimal CBD and a terpene ensemble often led by limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, with occasional menthol-tinged sparkle inherited through Eye Candy. The experience opens cheerful and euphoric, settles into a calm, contented relaxation, and leaves a lingering sweet-grape finish on the palate. Blue Lobster's trophy pedigree (including 2023 East Coast Zalympix accolades) shines through here, while Fruit Stand anchors the profile with that unmistakable farmers-market fruit medley.

name: Roze Lobster
description: Roze Lobster from Cipher Genetics fuses two modern icons into a single, showpiece cultivar. Pink Certz (The Menthol x Grape Gas) lends its cool mint-and-candy-grape personality and tight, sparkling structure, while Blue Lobster contributes inky violet hues and a deeper candy-gas bassline. Expect a layered bouquet that opens with berry and citrus before a peppery, menthol-tinged finish; the dominant terpene trio of myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene explains the sweet fruit, bright lift, and spicy edge in the jar. Phenotypes typically test with high THC—around 25%—and only trace CBD. On the palate, the flavor mirrors the nose, mixing ripe berry with zesty citrus and a faint herbal spice. In the garden, Roze Lobster is a medium-height hybrid with tidy internodes and dense, resin-heavy colas that ripen in 56–65 days. Yields are intentionally modest, trading raw weight for eye-popping color and terpene intensity, but careful dialing-in rewards growers with top-shelf bag appeal. The experience leans euphoric and uplifted up front, settling into a calm, relaxed clarity rather than a full couchlock, making its hybrid nature easy to appreciate from first inhale to last exhale. If you enjoy the cleanliness of The Menthol and the candy-gas indulgence of Blue Lobster, this cross captures both in elegant balance.

name: Paint Stripper
description: Paint Stripper from Cipher Genetics scours the palate with high-octane intensity, pouring the caustic charm of Chem De Monaco (Chemdog D x Monaco Octane) over the blue-candy gloss of Blue Lobster. Pop a jar and you are met with fresh-poured fuel, lemon-lime rind, and an unmistakable lab-clean chemical top note, then softer streaks of berry taffy waft in as the flower opens. Plants grow like a modern chem hybrid—medium stature, sturdy laterals, dense, greasy calyx stacks—and finish in roughly 60–70 days with a resin glaze that makes trimming feel like handling wet paint. Expect medium yields that trade sheer weight for bag appeal and extract-friendly coverage. Caryophyllene leads the terp mix, with limonene and myrcene close behind, shaping a ride that opens euphoric and focused before settling into loose-limbed calm. THC dominance and only trace CBD keep the profile unapologetically loud. By pairing Chem De Monaco's diesel-and-citrus bite with Blue Lobster's confectionary gas, Cipher's Paint Stripper hits that coveted crossroads of raw, old-school chem funk and contemporary candy. It is an unabashed, high-clarity “gas” showcase from a breeder recognized for precision crosses and a curated Lobster lineage.

name: Blue Zangria
description: Blue Zangria threads the candy-coated lineage of Rainbow Zangria through the inky, gassy mystique of Blue Lobster, and Cipher Genetics stitches them together into a modern showcase hybrid. Expect a balanced 50/50 plant that stacks dense, resin-frosted colas with flashes of deep violet, a look borrowed from its Blue Lobster parent, which rose to prominence with multiple 2023 Zalympix East awards. Break a cured bud and it pushes out a fruit-punch bouquet—blueberry and grape over sweet tropical candy—underpinned by faint diesel-kush earth. In the jar, that profile translates to a smooth, vivid terp presence and a cheerful, steady ride in effect: uplifted and happy up top, relaxed in the body, consistent with THC that commonly tests around 20–22% and negligible CBD. Growers report straightforward cultivation and brisk bloom; indoor flower finishes right around 60 days, with vigorous branching and a productive canopy capable of heavy yields in optimized rooms. Feminized releases make pheno-hunting simpler, and the cross shows uniform structure while still offering playful color variation across cooler nights. Whether you are chasing bag appeal, candy-gas aromatics, or reliable turnaround, Blue Zangria delivers the Cipher touch while clearly tipping its hat to Rainbow Zangria and the much-lauded Blue Lobster heritage.

name: Red Reaper
description: Red Reaper stalks the garden with a candy-fueled snarl, a Cipher Genetics creation that pairs the juicy Grape Lyfe 51 (Y Life x Grape Gas) with the widely celebrated Blue Lobster. The result is an indica-leaning hybrid whose nose hits first with high-octane gas before unfurling layers of dark berries and peppered earth; on the palate expect dense syrupy berry, grape peel, and a diesel backbeat. Plants show stout, vigorous branching and stack rock-hard, resin-slick colas that frost early and heavy, finishing indoors in about 56-63 days. Growers report medium-to-high yields and a medium stature that takes well to topping, LST, and scrogging. Potency is uncompromising: THC commonly lands in the high 20s, with batches reaching up to about 30%, while CBD stays trace. Effects arrive fast and full, blending an enveloping body calm with a buoyant, heady lift - relaxed, euphoric, and nicely uplifted without muddiness. Its flavor-drive tracks to a terpene ensemble led by beta-caryophyllene, with myrcene and limonene rounding out the grape-candy-meets-gas profile. If you are chasing modern color, candy, and fuel in one reliable package, Red Reaper delivers the look and the loud, with parental pedigree and craft-first selection shining through every jar. Released as part of Cipher's Blue Lobster Vol. 2 lineup.

name: Blueberry Lobster
description: Blueberry Lobster from Cipher Genetics brings classic blueberry charm into the modern Lobster family. Bred by crossing DJ Short's Blueberry, reportedly a standout selection chosen by Nobody's Nursery, with Blue Lobster, the celebrated Apples & Bananas x Eye Candy cut popularized by Maine Trees, this indica-leaning hybrid (about 60/40) leans into candy-blue fruit with a gassy, earthy undertow. Expect a terpene trio led by myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene, delivering ripe blueberry and grape over sweet dough and a faint diesel snap. Plants show vigorous, bushy structure and moderate stretch, stacking dense, frosty colas that often flash violet hues. Indoors it finishes in roughly 56-65 days, with dialed gardens returning around 350-500 g/m2; outdoors, well-sited plants can push 400-1000 g each. THC potential tests high (commonly 25-30%), while CBD remains minimal; resin output suits solventless or hydrocarbon extraction. Effects trend upbeat then soothing-euphoric lift, gentle body ease, and a clean, uplifted afterglow. The Blue Lobster parent helped anchor multiple trophies at the 2023 Zalympix East Coast, and that pedigree shows here in loud aroma, saturated color, and shelf-stopping bag appeal. Blueberry Lobster is a vivid, modern rendition of berry-forward cannabis, crafted with precision by Cipher Genetics. Growers report medium difficulty and best results in SCROG or compact SOG canopies.

name: Black Lobster by Equilibrium Genetics
description: Black Lobster threads a rare lineage through two standouts: Maui Lobster and Black Widow. From the Maui side, expect a sun-splashed bouquet of citrus and tropical fruit over a ribbon of diesel; from the Widow, dense calyxes, glistening resin, and that earthy-floral backbone rooted in its Brazilian sativa x South Indian heritage, a line that notched a 1995 High Times Cannabis Cup. In the garden, Black Lobster typically builds a medium frame with sturdy laterals and elongated colas, finishing in roughly 60–70 days under standard photoperiods. The workflow is balanced—neither fussy nor completely hands‑off—and yields track to the medium column indoors or out. On the palate, bright lemon‑lime and pineapple roll forward first before peppered diesel and pine settle in, with occasional hints of sweet berry from certain phenos. Effects open with buoyant, creative energy and a clear, uplifted headspace, then ease into a calmer, centered relaxation that mirrors its hybrid roots. Lab results vary by cut and dial, but the chemotype trends THC‑led with negligible CBD. Seek phenotypes that hold Maui Lobster's lively nose while showing Black Widow's tight, sugar‑crusted buds and tidy finish—an expressive marriage of tropical spark and classic resin weight. Expect smooth grinding, sticky fingers, and glittering jars.

name: Lobster Wowie
description: Lobster Wowie brings Equilibrium Genetics' island obsession into the present, fusing the diesel-bright Maui Lobster with the storied 1979 "Cherry Bomb" Maui Wowie preserved by Mr. Greengenes. The result is a sativa-leaning hybrid that smells like a beachside fruit stand parked beside a gas pump: tropical pineapple and citrus up front, sweet cherry-metallic undertones, and a faint lick of fuel. Expect an upbeat, sparkling onset that feels energetic, creative, and clean, tapering into a breezy calm without heavy drag. Plants stretch with a tall, elegant frame and sturdy lateral branching, showing resin-heavy blooms that nod to Maui Lobster's Blue Lobster lineage while keeping the classic Maui airiness in check. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in about 56-67 days with medium yields around 400 g/m2; outdoors, well-sited plants can push into high returns near 700 g per plant. Terpene expression commonly centers on limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, coordinating flavors of citrus, tropical fruit, and a savory diesel edge. THC potential trends from the high teens to mid-20s depending on phenotype and environment, with negligible CBD. Bred by Equilibrium Genetics, Lobster Wowie reads like a postcard from old Hawaii written with modern ink - bright, nostalgic, and made for growers who love classic sativa character polished by contemporary resin.

name: Durban Starburst
description: Durban Starburst folds the time-tested clarity of a Durban Poison Legacy Cut into the candy-citrus charisma of Starburst 36 male #1 (KC Heavy). This sativa-leaning hybrid shows a quick indoor turnaround at 55-65 days and wraps outdoors from late September into mid-October, melding Durban's terpinolene-forward pine and anise with SB36's zesty orange, sugared tropicals, and clean sweetness. Flowers stack dense and glittering on an upright frame with lively branching, a morphology that stretches tall outside while staying trim-friendly in rooms. Open a jar and bright citrus leaps first, followed by resinous pine and a faint herbal spice; the flavor tracks closely—sweet and citrusy on the inhale with a crisp pine finish. The ride lands energetic, focused, and lifted, a clear Durban thread rounded by SB36's cheery body buzz. Expect high indoor yields with high outdoor potential when well sited and trained, plus hashmaker-grade resin. Bred and selected by HIGHER GROUND, Durban Starburst honors a classic lineage while carrying forward the modern candy profile that made Starburst 36 a connoisseur favorite. Phenotypes lean sativa-dominant, often showing long internodes and strong apical vigor, yet respond well to topping and trellising for light penetration and an even canopy. In hash or flower, the expression stays bright, candy-tinged, and engaging without muddiness.

name: Anti-Armor
description: Anti-Armor from EZ Genetics is a three-generation backcross built to harden Gelato 41's armor while polishing it with Zkittlez gloss. The path is precise: Gelato 41 reversed onto Triangle Kush created TK41; that selection met Zkittlez Bx1 to make Zookz; then Zookz was reversed back onto TK41, yielding Anti-Armor (TK41 R-Bx1). In the room, plants stay medium in stature with about a 2x stretch, piling on heavy yields that finish in 63–70 days. The nose layers old-school Kush and OG with creamy Gelato 41 and a late wave of Zkittlez candy; expect a caryophyllene-and-limonene drive with sweet, fruity and pine accents. Many phenotypes present a 60/40 indica/sativa balance, delivering a strong, heavy stone that settles into deep relaxation and a calm, euphoric mood. EZ Genetics verifies both parent lines HLVD-clean, and the line was designed for vigor, resin density and uniform structure. Indoors, growers commonly see around 450–500 g/m², while outdoor plants can top 600–700 g per plant when dialed. Anti-Armor credits TK41 and Zookz for its dessert-meets-gas profile: the Triangle Kush backbone keeps it grounded, Gelato 41 adds creamy body and bag appeal, and Zkittlez tightens the candy finish—an intentional, lineage-driven hybrid from EZ Genetics. Expect rock-hard, sugar-frosted colas and a satisfyingly clean trim finish.

name: Kuro
description: Kuro by EZ Genetics is the gas-heavy anchor of the Oishii NYZ line, built by pairing Oishii NYZ with NYZ Black Scotti. Expect a compact, squat frame with bubba-like internodes and minimal stretch, roughly 1 to 1.5x, finishing in 56 to 63 days. Flowers stack into dense, resin-laden colas that trade a little volume for intensity; yields land in the medium range when dialed. Aromas lean firmly into the fuel lane: hot diesel and solvent-clean gas over a biscotti-like nuttiness and pine, echoing classic headband and cookie tones. The effect arrives as a robust, heavy hybrid stone that settles you deeply without full couch lock, more calm focus than raciness, with a steady, satisfied mood. Oishii NYZ contributes an intricate candy-gas thread from its Oishii x NYZ backbone, while the NYZ Black Scotti mother tightens structure and deepens the biscotti character. For collectors working in low-ceiling spaces, Kuro's tidy morphology, brief flowering window, and consistent terp direction make it a reliable, gas-dominant selection that stays true to its brief. Bred and released by EZ Genetics as part of a carefully developed line, Kuro distills the savory side of modern candy-gas breeding into a focused, compact plant with undeniable punch and impact.

name: Oishii NYZ

In the garden, the cross shows the NYZ selection's beefy, easy-to-clone structure with vigorous branching and dense, resin-caked colas, typically finishing in 8-9 weeks (around 56-63 days). Expect medium stature but assertive lateral growth and a notably heavy yield that suits both dry flower and hash-focused runs. Aromatically, Oishii NYZ leans into candy-gas: bright citrus and sweet Zkittlez tones from Oishii layered over NYZ's 65/35 sour-to-Zkittlez balance, translating to skunky diesel and tart lemon on the grind. Caryophyllene, linalool, and limonene commonly dominate, giving the profile its peppery sparkle, floral lift, and citrus snap. On the effects side, most cuts deliver a quick, tingly lift that turns euphoric before settling into an easy, relaxed cruise. THC expression is typically high while CBD remains low, though exact potency varies by pheno and cultivation. EZ Genetics credits Oishii's solventless pedigree (its candy-forward resin has earned recent trophies) as part of the appeal, while NYZ contributes robust vigor and reliability. Both parents were HLVD-screened during the line's rollout. For growers seeking modern candy gas with practical performance, Oishii NYZ reads like a purposeful pairing authored by EZ Genetics.

name: LEM.R.E.
description: LEM.R.E. from EZ Genetics threads a modern citrus icon through the candy-gas backbone of the Zookz line. It joins the famed Lemon Tree clone (Lemon Skunk x Sour Diesel, a double Cannabis Cup winner in 2014) to Zookz, EZ's in-house parent built from TK41 ( Triangle Kush x Gelato 41) and Zkittlez Bx1. The result is a limonene-forward bouquet of candied lemon rinds over diesel and Zkittlez candy, with phenos shifting the ratio of citrus, gas, and sweet. Plants show a moderate 1.5x stretch, medium stature, and a tidy 56-63 day flowering window, finishing with medium-to-heavy yields and visibly boosted frost from the Zookz side. Expect tight, resin-laden flowers with improved bag appeal versus straight Lemon Tree, and a hybrid effect that trends functional and upbeat rather than couch-locking. Grow notes point to a manageable structure indoors or in greenhouses; height stays civilized while colas stack densely by late bloom. THC and CBD vary by cut and conditions, but LEM.R.E. reliably delivers expressive aroma and satisfying potency. Both parent lines are reported HLVD-clean via Tumi Genomics. Crafted by EZ Genetics, LEM.R.E. is the citrus flagship of the Zookz family, celebrating classic lemon with modern dessert-gas depth. Flower performance peaks under balanced feed and steady light across the 8-9 week run.

name: Zookz
description: Zookz from EZ Genetics stitches classic Florida OG character to modern candy terps, pairing TK41 (Triangle Kush x Gelato 41) with Zkittlez Bx1 (Zkittlez x NYZ). In the garden, this feminized photoperiod hybrid shows vigorous branching and stacks dense, frosty flowers, often finishing in the 8-10 week window with a medium yield. Expect a layered nose: bright Zkittlez-style sweet candy and tropical fruit glide over creamy Gelato notes before a Kushy, gassy push, sometimes flashing sharper Sour Diesel-like fumes. On the palate, those same candy and diesel contrasts carry through. Dominant terpenes commonly reported for this line include myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene, while potency trends high in THC with trace CBD. Plants tend to hold a manageable, medium stature indoors and respond well to training, rewarding dialed environments with heavy resin. Selected as a foundation line by EZ Genetics, Zookz has already powered follow-up projects while preserving TK41's structure and adding Z's unmistakable fruit-shell gloss. Whether you notice the lavender first or the citrus last, the takeaway is consistency: clean flavors, bright headspace, and a smooth taper that feels as balanced as its namesake fizz. Look for large, fluffy buds and a sparkling, fruit-forward finish.

name: Nightshade by Connected Cannabis Co

Dominant terpenes D-limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool shape the experience alongside those aromatics. Reported effects skew toward a calm, euphoric settle that drifts into sleepy contentment while still leaving room for a spark of arousal; some users also note classic dry mouth. Connected curates Nightshade as a true house-bred selection, dialing in a balanced, potent profile without the paralysis often associated with heavier indicas. For collectors of modern indoor exotics, Nightshade offers an elegant, cohesive package: striking bag appeal, layered gas-meets-sweet flavor, and an effect arc that feels deliberate and composed across successive batches. Bred and released by Connected Cannabis Co., it has become a quiet staple of the brand's California menus.

Crafted for connoisseurs who appreciate modern candy terps refined by old-world kush, Midnight Bubba reads like a love letter to California breeding: contemporary sweetness, timeless structure, and unapologetically heavy vibes, all anchored by clearly stated lineage and in-house selection. Expect compact, resin-caked nugs and a chill, unhurried cadence from first whiff to final exhale, a signature of this indica-leaning cross of Blue Runtz and Bubba Kush #20.

name: 10 Bandz

While cannabinoid numbers vary by batch and CBD typically stays low, the cultivar's expression leans toward potency and punchy flavor rather than sheer metrics. Born in California's connoisseur scene, 10 Bandz carries Connected's stamp as breeder and curator, channeling classic Headband swagger through Z's kaleidoscopic sweetness into a crisp, modern high. Expect lime, fruit, and diesel to linger long after the jar is closed.

Indoors the plants stretch to a tall finish yet remain well-behaved with topping and light training, producing chunky, calyx-led colas that cure to a frosty lime-green with amber threads. The palate leans sweet citrus and tropical candy underpinned by peppery spice and a faint chem-pine gas, a profile consistent with dominant myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. Typical test ranges place THC around 22-25% with minimal CBD, so expect clear, upbeat onset that sharpens focus before melting into a relaxed, cheerful cruise. Flowering wraps in roughly 60-65 days and yields land in the average range, with the best phenotypes showing easy resin wash potential and consistent jar appeal. Credit to Cannarado Genetics for the thoughtful selection work: Rainbow Puzzy feels like a distillation of their dessert-forward catalog, blending color, flavor, and structure without fuss. If you are chasing a fruit-gas hybrid that works as hard on the tray as it does on the press, this cross hits the brief.

name: Z and C
description: Z and C by Cannarado Genetics stitches together the candy-gas decadence of (CookiesNCream x Spritzer x MotorValleyChem) with the zingy lime-diesel of Zawtz bx1, yielding a modern hybrid built for resin and aroma. Expect dense, frosted colas that stack with medium internodes and sturdy lateral branching, finishing in roughly 60–67 days indoors. The nose hits first: bright citrus and grape candy over deep chem-diesel and a creamy cookie undertow, a profile that hints at limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene. Flavors follow suit — sweet, citrusy, and fuelly — coating the palate while the effect lifts into a happy, euphoric clarity before settling into a calm, body-light relaxation. Plants stay medium in height and respond well to light training; yields are medium to high when dialed, with a notable wash potential thanks to heavy trichome coverage. CBD remains low, while THC leans high in typical phenos, reflecting the lineage’s contemporary potency. By uniting an award-winning dessert parent in Cookies and Cream with Spritzer’s candy-gas and a Motor Valley Chem backbone, then keying it to a Zawtz bx1 pollination, Cannarado delivers a vivid, modern expression of “candy fuel” that satisfies both the jar test and the grinder. Breeder: Cannarado Genetics. Gardeners can expect robust aromas in late flower and excellent bag appeal after a slow cure.

name: YeeZee
description: YeeZee is Cannarado Genetics at its playful peak: a 50/50 hybrid that fuses Yacht Rock (Lava Cake x Butterscotch) with Zawtz Bx1 for a candy-gas meets dessert profile that begs a second sniff. Chunky, OG-leaning plants stack tight calyxes and sparkle with trichomes, delivering resin that presses well and keeps hash makers smiling. The nose opens with sweet butterscotch and citrus zest before a soft undercurrent of diesel-chem peeks through; on the palate, those layers resolve into bright candy notes wrapped in a creamy, confection-like finish. Caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene typically lead the terp mix. Indoors, YeeZee flowers in about 60–65 days, with many phenotypes happy to run 8–10 weeks; height trends medium to tall, and yields land from average to high once the canopy is managed. Expect a quick, uplifting onset that lifts mood and focus, then a smooth, body-centered glide that settles into a relaxed, content groove. Potency lives in the modern lane, with THC commonly in the mid to high 20s and CBD usually under 1%. Credit to Cannarado Genetics for a layered cross that satisfies both jar appeal and performance in the room.

name: Fruity Durban
description: Fruity Durban by Serious Seeds races from veg to finish like a sprinter, yet lands with polish. This mostly sativa F1 springs from African Durban Poison and a selected Mimosa, a pairing that explains its citrus-bright bouquet: zesty lemon and sweet orange peel over a ripe-fruit core that shifts as the flowers mature. Indoors it keeps a compact start, then surges into long, cat-tail colas with very few leaves and an almost early haze of milky trichomes; resin collectors will appreciate how well it washes. Expect an energetic, uplifted, focused headspace that arrives clean and quick. Under lights Fruity Durban typically ripens in just 6 weeks, with dense, fast-stacking calyxes and an indoor performance around 350-500 g/m2; outside it finishes from mid-September into early October. Tall by nature in the garden (2-2.5 m when started in June), it brings sturdy vigor and notable resistance to mildew and fungi. Lab-friendly potency sits in the 18-20% THC window with negligible CBD. The flavor arcs from Mimosa-like tangerine when taken early to a spicier Durban accent later, letting growers dial the expression they prefer. Precision-bred and refreshingly swift, Fruity Durban showcases Serious Seeds' trademark stability and speed. From tent to terrace, this cultivar rewards uncomplicated care with crisp, fruit-forward jars. If speed, clarity, and consistency are your benchmarks, this cultivar delivers.

name: Zeven Up
description: Zeven Up fizzes with the bright, lemon-lime sparkle its name promises, a sweet citrus bouquet layered over a light petrol snap that evokes a fresh-cracked soda. Bred by Sexual Chocolate Factory from Sour Dubb and Rick Jamez #28, this cultivar marries Dubb's tart, fizzy diesel with Rick Jamez's candy-berry zest for an aroma that is both nostalgic and modern. On the palate it opens with citrus - lemon and lime - then drifts into gentle gas and soft sweetness, suggesting a terpene ensemble led by limonene with supporting beta-caryophyllene and pinene. The effect profile trends uplifting and happy yet comfortably euphoric, with a clear, buoyant head that suits creative sessions without sacrificing balance. In the garden, Zeven Up grows into dense, trichome-heavy flowers with light-green calyxes and occasional lavender washes; under competent hands it finishes in roughly 8 to 10 weeks and produces a solid, medium yield. Expect THC to test on the higher side while CBD remains minimal, accentuating its sparkling, upbeat character. For fans of citrus-forward hybrids with a clean gas finish, Zeven Up feels like a classic rebottled for today - true to its lineage and unmistakably shaped by Sexual Chocolate Factory's breeding touch. Nugs cure into chunky, conical spears that grind sticky and fragrant, a nod to resin-rich ancestry and hash-friendly trichome density.

name: Rick Jamez
description: Rick Jamez is Sexual Chocolate Factory's playful homage to candy-laden modern exotics, born from Runtz crossed with Jealousy. Expect confectionary fruit on the nose and palate - berry jam and tropical sweetness with that unmistakable Z-candy sparkle and a whisper of herbal gas. Typical expressions lean indica at around 70/30 and test high, with THC often reported in the 29-34% range while CBD remains trace. The blossoms stack into medium-dense, purple-flecked nugs that glisten under trichomes, and they finish reliably in 60-70 days with a steady, medium yield. In effect, Rick Jamez tends to brighten the mood before easing the body into a calm, contented quiet; many tasters note happy, relaxed vibes that taper toward sleepy as the session deepens. The lineage shows in the morphology - Runtz contributes candy-forward terps and bag appeal, while Jealousy adds color, structure, and a creamy-berry depth - making this cultivar a photogenic standout once cured. Bred by Sexual Chocolate Factory, Rick Jamez distills two of the decade's defining dessert profiles into a single, expressive hybrid with consistent resin and flavor. Whether from seed or a dialed-in cut, its character stays unmistakable: sweet, fruity, and unapologetically loud.

name: Candifornia
description: Candifornia splices the candy-gas lineage of Runtz and Fun Dip with the chem-citrus pulse of Z Money, then wraps it all in Fiya Farmer's selection work. Expect a sweet first impression that blends berry syrup, sugared citrus peel, and vanilla cream over a faint petro haze, before Z Money's "Z x The Money" backbone nudges in notes of lemon cleaner and earth. Frosted calyxes stack into chunky, lime-and-lavender spears with bright orange pistils; the plant stays medium in stature with a cooperative frame that responds well to trellising. Indoors most phenos finish in roughly 8-10 weeks, producing moderate yields that glisten under the trim light. Typical batches skew THC-forward with minimal CBD, and the terpene balance often leans caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene, amplifying the strain's fruit-candy core while preserving a light gas finish. The ride opens upbeat and euphoric, loosening tension into an easy, happy calm without muting the palate; as the session deepens, body comfort settles in for a relaxed, sociable cruise. Dry mouth and dry eyes can appear at higher servings, and a head-rush wobble is possible for the uninitiated. Built from Runtz x Fun Dip, then hit with Dying Breed's Z Money, Candifornia reads like modern California in a jar - loud, glossy, and unmistakably sweet.

name: Bluscotti
description: Bluscotti by Fig Farms marries Blue Face with Biscotti x Shady Apples, spinning a dessert-leaning hybrid that stays true to the farm's award pedigree. Blue Face, the Fig Farms pheno that won Emerald Cup 2023 Indoor Flower and Best in Show, donates its saturated blue-lavender tones and assertive, pine-and-ginger character; Biscotti contributes creamy cookie richness; Shady Apples adds a gassy mint-and-apple pastry snap. Crack a jar and you'll meet layered aromatics of sweet apple, diesel, and cool mint over woodsy redwood and a faint chemical-clean sparkle. The flavor tracks the nose: apple-sweet up front, biscotti-cream mid-palate, and a mint-diesel finish. Expect a caryophyllene-forward profile with bright limonene lift and grounding myrcene, translating to an upbeat, euphoric calm that keeps the mood happy while the body unwinds. Potency trends high in THC with minimal measured CBD, and dense resin heads make this cut attractive for connoisseur extractions. Plants stack dense, frosty colas with sturdy, medium stature; yields trend moderate when dialed, and cultivation leans challenging thanks to Blue Face's famously finicky nature. Most cuts finish in a familiar indoor window, rewarding patience with boutique bag appeal and a terpene signature that stands apart. Parents: Blue Face x (Biscotti x Shady Apples). Created and selected by Fig Farms.

name: Rodney Mullen
description: Named after the skateboarding icon, Rodney Mullen by Cannarado spins flavor and form with the same technical flair its namesake brought to flatground. This modern hybrid pairs Spritzer with Zkittlez/Zawtz, blending citrus zest and grape-jam sweetness over a faint diesel-and-pepper backbone. Expect dense, sugar-crusted calyxes that can blush with purples, a moderately vigorous stretch, and a resin output that makes trimming sticky and satisfying. In the jar and grinder, limonene and myrcene take the lead, nudged by linalool and caryophyllene, for an aroma that toggles between bright fruit chews and petrol-laced rind. On effect, it opens upbeat and social before easing into a contented, body-light calm - happy, uplifted, and relaxed without losing focus. Indoor growers typically see medium yields and a tidy, medium stature; most phenotypes finish in about 63-70 days of flower, with consistent bag appeal and terp intensity. While actual potency depends on selection, the parentage suggests high-THC potential with minimal CBD. Bred and released by Cannarado Genetics, Rodney Mullen captures the brand's Z-driven "candy gas" work in a cultivar that balances flavor, structure, and finish - an expressive cross for connoisseurs and pheno-hunters who prize both color and cadence.

name: Jungle Juice by Seed Junky
description: Jungle Juice from Seed Junky Genetics is a dessert-leaning hybrid that doubles down on coastal sweetness. Built from Malibu crossed to a Lemon Cherry Gelato x Malibu selection, it layers bright citrus and creamy cookie notes over a light fuel edge, with dense, frost-caked calyxes and tight internodal spacing that stack into tidy colas. Growers report a medium-height frame that's easy to train and quick to finish, wrapping up in 56-63 days indoors. The double dose of Malibu adds structure and resin, while the LCG side pushes candy-lemon aromatics and color; together they deliver above-average yields and bags that sparkle. Expect an upfront burst of euphoria and mood lift that settles into a calm, happy relaxation without couchlock, a profile consistent with terpene dominance often led by limonene and beta-caryophyllene, supported by myrcene. Jungle Juice is decidedly THC-forward with only trace CBD in most cuts, yet it remains surprisingly user-friendly in the garden thanks to its sturdy branching and even canopy. In the jar, the bouquet reads citrus, sweet cream, and a whisper of cookie-dough gas; on the palate, those flavors translate cleanly and linger. For fans of modern candy-gas hybrids, this Seed Junky original offers precision, polish, and plenty of sparkle.

name: Papaya Drizzle
description: Papaya Drizzle from Cannarado Genetics braids Papaya’s island-ripe fruit with Rainbow Drizzle’s candy-gas sparkle, yielding a hybrid bred for sheen and sweet aroma. In the garden, it grows with medium stature and strong lateral branching, then races to a tidy 60–65 day finish, stacking lime-to-olive colas that frost up early and trim easily. The nose blends tropical mango and papaya pulp with creamy confection notes and a peppery-citrus snap; on the palate, expect mango-forward tropicals rounded by a light creaminess. Resin production is a highlight, and with a sensible feed the line returns moderate, reliable yields. Typical lab work on Papaya parents points to myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene as frequent drivers, which tracks with the cultivar’s relaxed, happy, and gently uplifting profile. Papaya Drizzle’s cross — Papaya x Rainbow Drizzle — is part of Cannarado’s dessert program; aficionados may recognize Rainbow Drizzle’s Snowman-and-Z lineage in the gloss and bag appeal. Expect 6+ feminized seeds per pack and phenotypes that toggle between creamy gelato nuance and Z-candy brightness, always anchored by tropical fruit.

name: Peach Beach
description: Peach Beach by Cannarado Genetics chases summer in a peach-candy wave. Built from Peach Bum crossed with Zkittlez/Zawtz, it blends the ripe stone-fruit funk Cannarado hunted in Peach Bum with the candied lemon-lime gas and fruit-salad notes that made the Z line famous. Crack a jar and expect a rush of peach nectar, tropical candy, and citrus zest over a light diesel thread; the taste follows with peach up front, sugary fruit mid-palate, and a clean sweet finish. The high opens bright and happy, tipping moods upward and sharpening the senses before settling into an easy, relaxed cruise that keeps spirits lifted. Plants usually show medium stature with sturdy branching, colorful calyxes, and heavy resin coverage; indoors, most phenotypes finish in about 60 to 70 days, returning medium yields that cure into dense, glossy buds. Terpene expression commonly centers on limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene, while THC tends to run high and CBD remains minimal, echoing its Zawtz and Zkittlez heritage. Credited to Cannarado Genetics, Peach Beach is a vivid, fruit-forward showcase of their candy-gas breeding, carrying the unmistakable peach roundness from Peach Bum and the sparkling confectionery edge from the Z side for a balanced, feel-good profile growers and tasters remember.

name: Pound Puppy
description: Pound Puppy by Cannarado Genetics marries dessert pedigree with candy-gas intensity, blending LPC75 (London Pound Cake #75) with Zkittlez/Zawtz. Expect dense, bulbous flowers with a heavy sugar-coat and a medium, easily managed stature that stacks well indoors. The nose opens with bright citrus and grape over sweet berry, then deepens into OG-fueled gas and a faint herbal earth, a terpene blend typically led by caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. Flavor tracks the aroma closely: berry-citrus candy on the inhale, grape and diesel echoing on the finish. In the jar and on the grinder, Pound Puppy carries the award DNA of Zkittlez - famed for multiple Cup wins - tempered by LPC75's showpiece structure. The effect profile skews relaxing and euphoric without losing mood lift; many tasters report happy, centered calm with creative headroom before a soft fade. Indoors, flowering wraps in roughly 60-65 days, with medium yields from compact, resin-caked colas; outdoor performers finish early to mid-autumn in temperate zones. Chemically it trends high in THC with low CBD, emphasizing saturated flavor and a modern hybrid punch. Breeder: Cannarado Genetics. Parents: LPC75 x Zkittlez/Zawtz. For growers seeking a reliable candy-gas hybrid that cures into glossy, colorful nugs and presses well, Pound Puppy delivers pedigree, polish, and plenty of bag appeal.

name: Candy Styx
description: Candy Styx by Cannarado Genetics braids three candy-forward powerhouses into one modern hybrid: Pyxy Styx, Zkittlez, and Zawtz. In the jar it suggests grape gummies, mixed berries, and a faint citrus-fuel flicker inherited from Zawtz, then settles into a sugar-dusted bouquet as the grind releases more perfume. Medium-stature plants stack dense, heavily frosted colas with occasional purple flashes, reaching harvest in roughly 56-63 days. Growers report a cooperative, medium-difficulty run with balanced internoding and a medium yield indoors around 450 g/m2, while outdoor plants can push to chest height and reward near 600 g each when dialed. Caryophyllene leads the terp chorus with limonene and linalool supporting, translating to a sweet, fruity, grape-leaning flavor over a soft gas exhale. Typical lots test in the mid-20s THC with trace CBD, delivering a cheerful, euphoric lift that smooths into calm, happy relaxation without heavy sedation. Credit goes to Cannarado, whose Pyxy Styx selection (a Wedding Pie phenotype influenced by Zawtz) and signature Zawtz line add structure and candy-gas depth to Zkittlez' iconic fruit rainbow. Fans seeking a confectionery profile with modern resin production will find Candy Styx both flavorful and photogenic from dry room to grinder. Expect smooth trimming, loud terps, and impeccable bag appeal throughout.

name: Flip Flops
description: Flip Flops from Cannarado Genetics strolls in with beachy, candy-sweet swagger. Built from Yacht Rock and Zkittlez/Zawtz, this hybrid leans into the modern Z-terp craze, throwing bright lime-candy and tropical fruit over a creamy, dessert-toned backdrop. Expect a nose that opens with citrus zest and sweet, tangy tropicals before a soft, confectionery finish; on the palate, those layers resolve into citrus, tropical and sugary notes framed by a faint gas. Plants are medium in stature with sturdy branching and eye-catching frost, typically finishing in about 60–67 days. Yields land in the dependable medium zone indoors or out. Dominant terpenes often tilt toward limonene and beta-caryophyllene with a linalool accent, supporting a THC-forward profile with only trace CBD. The effect arc starts upbeat and happy, easing into relaxed, clear-bodied calm without dulling momentum — an easy, uplifted cruise that fits the strain’s easygoing name. Flip Flops also showcases Cannarado’s signature blend of flavor work and garden practicality: resin-rich flowers, tidy morphology, and a finish window growers can actually plan around. Whether you chase citrus-candy jars or collect Z-influenced hybrids, this Yacht Rock x Zkittlez/Zawtz mash-up delivers a cheerful, modern profile that feels both familiar and freshly tuned, true to its Colorado-bred pedigree.

name: Baby Heady

Plants tend to stack evenly with open internodes, a trait inherited from the Heady side that makes canopy training straightforward; swollen calyxes frost up hard by late flower. Indoors expect a bloom window around 56–63 days, with medium yields of dense, white-washed buds; outdoors it shows rugged vigor bred for the Emerald Triangle’s demands. Effects land quickly behind the eyes with an uplifted, euphoric spark before settling into a happy, tranquil body calm — an evening companion that still keeps the mood bright. Most phenos lean high-THC with trace CBD and a terp profile frequently anchored by caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. Bred by the Mendo Dope crew to carry their Heady torch forward, Baby Heady feels both classic and fresh: old-school kush attitude tuned for today’s mint-and-gas connoisseurs. Expect strong bag appeal and crisp, glistening trichomes that photograph beautifully on a white backdrop.

name: Heady Sherbet

Expect a buoyant, euphoric start that settles into a relaxed, uplifted cruise, guided by a terpene trio commonly led by caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene. Indoors, expect a moderate feed and medium yields; outdoors or in larger spaces the stretch can be harnessed for more canopy and heavier sets. Flowering typically finishes in 56-63 days. THC potential trends high while CBD remains trace, varying by phenotype and dialing. Bred by the Emerald Triangle team at Mendo Dope Farms, Heady Sherbet captures their sun-grown swagger in a versatile hybrid aimed at growers seeking vivid bag appeal, candy-gas complexity, and reliable resin.

name: Coral Fang

Expect a longer bloom - typically 60 to 65 days - and yields rated medium-to-high when light, airflow, and nutrition are dialed. Potency is a focus of the line, with selections aimed at high THC expression and minimal CBD, while maintaining a polished, fruit-forward profile. The pedigree adds cachet: the Blue Lobster parent, selected by Maine Trees, earned high-profile accolades for terps and gas, and that pedigree depth is evident here. Released as feminized seed, Coral Fang carries Cipher's signature of vivid flavor, strong resin, and modern bag appeal - an exotic, uplifting cross designed for both connoisseur enjoyment and production runs.

name: Koshu Grape

In the garden it shows off color-splashed flowers that can flush violet late in bloom, with bright orange pistils and a thick, crystalline coat; expect a typical 55-60 day flowering window and plenty of resin for hash work. The high arrives in layers: an upbeat rush of euphoria, a lift in creativity and focus, then an easy, grounded calm that steers clear of couchlock while smoothing the edges. Fans of modern candy-and-gas profiles will find Koshu Grape's bag appeal hard to resist, and the cultivar's balanced structure responds well to topping and airflow. Zikigai Garden's influence sharpens the Z-style sweetness, while Apples n Bananas contributes that telltale grape-candy complexity. Named for Japan's signature grape, Koshu Grape reads like a polished, contemporary take on fruit-driven California genetics — flashy in the jar, flavorful on the palate, and composed in effect — true to the meticulous breeding Raw Genetics is known for.

name: Lilikoi

Effects arrive as an easy, euphoric uplift that smooths into relaxed, unhurried clarity without heaviness, a temperament Lilikoi inherits from both parents. In the garden, plants stay medium in stature with cooperative internode spacing and a moderate stretch, rewarding attentive dialing with a medium yield. Indoors, most phenotypes finish in about 8–10 weeks (56–70 days). With Zitz x Twerkquake as its backbone — and Twerkquake’s celebrated lineage that produced the famed Verzace/Black Magic cut — Lilikoi is bred to deliver modern candy-citrus terps with balanced, reliable performance.

name: Tropicana Cherry by Barneys Farm

Growers find it straightforward: 60-65 days of flower indoors, 100-140 cm in height, and 550-650 g/m2 under dialed conditions; outdoors she reaches 120-180 cm and can return up to 1000 g per plant by late September to early October. The plant responds eagerly to LST and SCROG, rewarding training with stacked tops and exceptional resin for hashmakers. Tropicana Cherry distills the citrus fizz of Tropicana Cookies and the candy-cherry allure of Tropicanna Cherry into a modern, high-terp showcase by Barney's Farm.

name: Diabeetus X Devil Driver
description: Blockhead Buds’ Diabeetus x Devil Driver fuses candy-sweet dessert genetics with an energetic modern classic. On one side, Diabeetus stacks Berry Bonds with Blueberry Sugar, throwing phenos that purple early and smell like sugared grape and tropical punch. On the other, Devil Driver (Sundae Driver x Melonade) brings sparkling resin, fruit-candy perfume, and a lively, uplifting edge born from citrus-forward terpenes. Grown indoors or under mixed light, plants build a sturdy, well-branched frame with dense, well-stacked flowers that frost heavily; colorful phenotypes are common. Expect a loud aroma that blends sweet berry syrup and creamy pastry with flashes of citrus, tropical fruit, and a light fuel finish. The experience leans euphoric and relaxed with a calm center, ideal for creative sessions or winding down without losing clarity. Flowering finishes in about 60–65 days, with medium to high yields and a medium stretch that makes canopy management straightforward. While potency varies by selection, this cross trends high-THC with typically low CBD, and it washes well thanks to its thick trichome coverage. Credit to Blockhead Buds for pairing Diabeetus’ confectionary depth with Devil Driver’s award-winning sparkle, delivering a hybrid that shines equally in jars and in solventless or hydrocarbon extraction.

name: Cap Junky X Devil Driver
description: Cap Junky x Devil Driver from Blockhead Buds marries two modern heavyweights into a racy yet polished hybrid. The Cap Junky side brings its signature frost and dense, golf-ball calyxes, while Devil Driver adds leaner, sativa structure and vivid color, meeting in medium-tall plants with strong lateral branching and a resin coat that looks sugared. Expect bright citrus and mint on the first pull, quickly layered with diesel, pepper, and a candy-lean tropical edge that lingers; caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene commonly lead the terpene stack. Reported effects trend euphoric and uplifted but precise, with a focused, clear headed top note that settles into calm body composure rather than couchlock. Growers can anticipate a 60-70 day indoor bloom, finishing with firm, trichome-heavy flowers that press and wash well; this cut typically rewards attentive feeding and canopy management with medium-high to high yields. THC potential is high with trace CBD. Credited to Blockhead Buds, the cross pairs Cap Junky with Devil Driver (often worked from S1 stock) to capture gassy-dough notes and add sundae-sweet sparkle. For cultivators and connoisseurs alike, it is a dialed-in balance of sheen, punch, and flavor-forward clarity. Expect vigorous rooting and stress tolerance under dialed environments.

name: Bananzaa
description: Bananzaa by Lumpy's Flowers pairs Zoap with a hand-selected Banana Bread 150-3 cut to blend floral-candy brightness with warm bakery depth. The Zoap influence adds a sweet, perfumed lift and a hint of creamy gas, while Banana Bread (Banana OG x Oreoz) brings ripe banana-bread dough, cocoa-cookie tones, and a smooth earthy finish. Expect dense, resin-heavy colas with dark violet highlights and striking frost, trimmed to showcase Lumpy's signature craft aesthetic. In the grinder, aromas open from sugary blossom to toasted pastry and subtle spice; the finish stays clean and softly creamy. Batch chemistry varies, but Bananzaa leans into terpene-forward expression over sheer numbers. As a cultivar, it reflects a grower-led ethos: tight internodes, meticulous handwork, and standout bag appeal anchored by the unmistakable character of Zoap and the pastry-forward charm of Banana Bread. name: Sherbacio Warhead
description: Sherbacio Warhead from Grow More Fire Genetics fuses Sherbacio Sweet Tea with Galactic Warheadz, blending dessert-gas and candy-sour lineages into a modern hybrid built for resin and flavor. In the jar, aromas open with nutty sweet sherbet and vanilla cream before pivoting to lime zest, tropical candy, and a clean diesel finish. Limonene and beta caryophyllene lead the terpene profile, with supporting linalool and humulene shaping the sweet citrus snap over a faint woody backbone. Expect a lively onset that lifts mood and loosens conversation, then settles into a smooth, body-easing calm; users commonly describe talkative, euphoric, and uplifted effects with minimal fog. Vigorous, medium stature plants stack dense, trichome-heavy colas that can express deep greens and occasional purples under cool nights. Indoors, flowering typically wraps in 8-9 weeks, rewarding dialed-in canopies with medium yields and standout bag appeal. Buds cure to a glossy frost, ideal for both top shelf flower and solventless work. Potency varies by phenotype; batches often test in the high teens to upper 20s THC with trace CBD, while maintaining a balanced head to body arc that reflects its hybrid pedigree. Anchored by Alien Labs' Sherbacio heritage (Sunset Sherbert x Gelato 41, an Oregon Growers Cup greenhouse winner via The Plant) and supercharged by craft bred Galactic Warheadz, this cross delivers unforgettable flavor and modern performance.

name: Toucan’s Kush
description: Toucan's Kush takes flight from Mendo Dope Farms with a compact, indica-leaning frame and a tempo set to finish in just eight weeks. Bred by brothers Old E and Bleezy, this cultivar pairs a hand-selected Fruit Loopz cut from James Loud with the house anchor Heady OG BX1. In the garden it stacks stout, self-supporting branches and dense, frosted flowers, one of the shortest and quickest in the 2.0 lineup. Crack a cured jar and the nose lands squarely on kush: thick, creamy fuel layered over deep funk, with a faint fruit-cereal echo from the Fruit Loopz side. The flavor follows suit — cream and pine over a pungent OG base — before settling into heavy, couch-ready power from the Heady OG lineage. Expect solid production for the size, easy handling, and resilient, no-fuss structure tuned for outdoor or controlled rooms alike. Effects skew relaxing and euphoric with a sleepy edge, a classic end-of-day unwind. While lab numbers vary by batch and grower, Toucan's Kush is built for potency with minimal CBD, expressing a kush-forward terpene stack typical of caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene. A compact, fast finisher with thick resin and unmistakable gas-and-cream character, Toucan's Kush is Mendo Dope genetics distilled to a quick, sturdy, flavor-first experience.

name: Tiki Zombie
description: Tiki Zombie stalks the jar with an island grin, a modern hybrid from Tiki Madman that splices Tropical Runtz with Banana Acai Mints. The aroma sails in on tropical fruit and candy sweetness before a creamy, mint-cool finish, a profile consistent with limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene at the helm. Broken up, the resinous buds flash sugared-orange pistils and a frosty sheen; the flavor tracks the nose, trading pineapple sherbet brightness for a gentle herbal chill on exhale. The onset rolls in steadily: muscles loosen, chatter slows, and a feel-good lift settles without heavy sedation. Lab-labeled batches often post THC in the mid-20s; around 24% is common, while CBD remains minimal. Morphology trends toward compact, calyx-stacked flowers that echo Runtz structure with Mints polish. Indoors, it follows a standard hybrid timetable with dependable, photo-ready yields when environmental balance favors terpene retention. Credit to Tiki Madman for a cross that tastes like a tiki cart and cruises like a well-tuned daily driver: relaxed, happy, and quietly uplifted, with tropical candy up front and mint cream in the rearview. Expect a familiar hybrid finish window and medium-to-high returns from dialed-in runs, with standout bag appeal driven by the cross's generous trichome density and vivid, citrus-lime hues.

name: Buckhead Betty
description: Buckhead Betty by High Grade Selections threads Atlanta heritage through modern hype: a careful pairing of Toad Venom and Irene Kush BX. Toad Venom - widely associated with Animal Face x Sin Mintz - brings dense, frosty colas, a greasy kush fuel backbone and cool mint zest; Irene's OG leaning backcross layers bright sour diesel pine and that clean, city slicked structure locals revere. In most gardens Buckhead Betty shows medium tall stature with firm stacking and heavy trichome coverage, thriving under steady light and airflow. Expect a terpene trio led by caryophyllene, limonene and myrcene, translating to citrus and mint over diesel, with earthy undertones on the dry pull. Effects open upbeat and clear, then settle into an easy, content body glow - balanced enough for creative focus yet relaxed at the edges. Typical potency runs 24 28% THC with trace to negligible CBD. Indoors, trained canopies finish in roughly 56 63 days and return high yields around 450 g/m2; outdoors, well sited plants can top 600 g per plant by early fall. This cross was selected to fold Toad Venom's vivid flavor and resin into Irene's unmistakable drive, landing a hybrid that smokes like an old friend with a new passport stamp.

name: Atliens
description: With a name that nods to Atlanta’s extraterrestrial mystique, ATLiens by High Grade Selections merges the revered Irene Kush BX with Alien OG to deliver a hybrid that balances clarity and weight in equal measure. Expect a nose that opens with diesel and lemon rind, folds into fresh pine and earthy spice, and lingers with a fuelly OG echo; the palate mirrors that citrus-diesel drive over a woody finish. Typical batches test in the mid-20s for THC with trace-to-zero CBD, and the dominant terpene trio of myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene steers the experience: a quick, euphoric headlift and sharpened focus that gradually settle into an even-keeled, body-calming glide. Plants show medium stature and OG-style spears with tighter Irene stacking; they respond well to topping and trellis work, prefer steady feeding, and finish in 63–70 days indoors. Yields land around 450 g/m² inside and roughly 600 g per plant outdoors when dialed, with dense, resinous colas and bright orange pistils under a frosty jacket. Growers rate difficulty as medium and keep late bloom on the drier side to preserve that citrus-gas shine. Credit High Grade Selections for pairing two modern classics and bottling Atlanta grit with out-of-this-world polish.

name: The Hooch
description: Named for the prohibition-era slang that hints at its punch, The Hooch from High Grade Selections marries Tahoe OG with Irene Kush BX to bottle the purest old-school OG character. The bouquet opens with bright lemon zest over deep pine and a streak of diesel, then dries down to earthy, peppery undertones typical of a myrcene-limonene-caryophyllene stack. Expect resin-glazed calyxes on a classic OG frame — long internodes, narrow leaflets, and a 2x stretch that benefits from trellising. Indoors, attentive training and moderate feeding return medium-to-high yields around 450 g/m2; outdoor plants in full sun can top 700 g each. Most phenos finish in 60–70 days of flower, flushing to lime with occasional purples. Potency sits in the OG sweet spot: THC commonly lands in the low-to-mid 20s, with CBD under 1%, translating to a fast-onset, euphoric lift that settles into a calm, body-forward ease without muting the mind. Fans of heritage gas will recognize Tahoe's dense, soothing weight braided to Irene's cleaner, more uplifting clarity. Whether you hunt for the lemon-fuel spear or the pine-forward kush cone, The Hooch rewards careful growers and flavor chasers alike while staying true to its lineage and to High Grade Selections' eye for choice keeper cuts.

name: Z Cut Rbx2
description: ETHOS Genetics takes its celebrated Z line a step further with Z Cut Rbx2, a precise retooling of the original "Zkittlez" clone (Z Cut) crossed with The Wrank (Wrank R2), then steered back to Z Cut. The result is a compact, strong plant that stacks spongy, resin-slick colas while staying easy to manage in any room. In flower, a fruit-bomb nose announces itself: ripe grape and citrus candy over earthy spice and faint florals. On the palate those candy terps dominate, bright yet rounded, finishing clean. Expect a powerful, long-lasting, deeply relaxing experience that eases into a drowsy calm, often preceded by a cheerful mood lift. Bloom time runs 56-63 days, and yields land above average; structure stays compact, ideal for dense spacing or trellised SOG runs. Expect compact internodes, sturdy branching, and easy training in small spaces. Potency targets roughly 25% total cannabinoids led by THC, with only trace CBD. As a nod to heritage, the Z Cut parent hails from the Cup-winning Zkittlez line that helped define modern fruit-forward profiles. Bred by ETHOS Genetics, Z Cut Rbx2 rewards both production growers and flavor hunters with pungent extract potential and consistent, candy-forward resin that honors the Z lineage while streamlining it for today's production.

name: Big Fat n' Fruity R1
description: Big Fat n' Fruity R1 lives up to its nickname BFF: your bright, candy-scented companion from seed to jar. Plants keep a medium stature but branch assertively and love an aggressive defoliation, quickly reclaiming space as they bulk. Indoors, most phenotypes finish in roughly 56 days and reward that patience with high yields of boutique-grade buds. Expect effects that ease the body while lifting the mood—relaxed, social, and happily talkative—true to the parentage that helped define modern candy terps. The Original Z lineage brings its award-proven loudness and syrupy fruit, while Big Grapefruit contributes vigor and a bright citrus snap. With THC potential in the mid-20s and a terp profile built for both flower and extracts, Big Fat n' Fruity R1 is a flavorful, anytime crowd-pleaser for gardens that prize aroma, structure, and consistency without fussy demands.

name: Pineway
description: Pineway threads a modern highway through old-school evergreens, and it shows in every greasy, frost-packed calyx. The result is a room-filling bouquet of creamy pine and sweet gas cut by a cool menthol-cleaner snap; expect pinene out front with myrcene and caryophyllene rounding the edges. Plants stretch just enough to stack full, conical flowers, and selected phenos have shown above-average production without sacrificing resin density. Indoors, Pineway typically wraps in 56-65 days, finishing in glistening lime to deep forest hues with orange filaments and thick trichome armor. On the palate, sharp pine and diesel glide into a smooth, slightly creamy finish. The ride is steady and composed: relaxed, euphoric, and quietly happy, trending toward evening calm rather than morning buzz. Growers report a cooperative temperament and medium stature that slot easily into mixed canopies, with a terp profile that washes well. Credit to Capulator for fusing Highway 30's crisp drive with Pine Cone Jones' evergreen heft into a cultivar that smells like a cold night in the woods and smokes like a warm fire.

name: Dank Diggler

Expect a medium, normal-stretch frame with large nodal spacing that fills quickly during its 56-63 day flower, finishing with above-average yields of glistening, lime-green colas. The nose swings two ways: one pheno leans dank and savory, funky garlic and body-odor notes glazed with orange zest, while the other shows more of the Topanga Pure Kush influence, trading in zesty lime, petrol and classic kush gas. On the palate those citrus-diesel cues carry through cleanly. The experience starts assertive and calms into a steady, couch-optional cruise, typically relaxed, happy and a touch euphoric, without the instant lights-out some heavy indicas bring. Although untested outdoors, indoor runs report above-average resistance to pests, mold and temperature swings, making the cultivar friendly for dialed-in home gardens and commercial rooms alike. A THC-forward, CBD-light profile and a terpene set often led by caryophyllene and limonene underline its end-of-day appeal. Dank Diggler registers as 95% indica and 5% sativa, medium in stature. Indoors across 8-9 weeks, airflow helps stack resinous, lime-and-orange-scented spears into above-average jars.

name: Fuji

Open a jar and you get a layered nose of crisp apple, berry candy, and grapefruit zest over sweet dough. Tall internodes settle late as the buds tighten and silver over with trichomes, making it friendly for hash work and showy in a bag. On the palate, Fuji keeps the tart-sweet theme, leading with apple and berry before a citrusy bite and gentle gas round things out. The experience trends upbeat and sociable at first, turning calm and comfortable without muddling focus; many describe it as happy, uplifted, and pleasantly relaxed. While chemistry varies by phenotype and grower, Fuji commonly leans on a terpene trio of limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene that supports its fruit-candy brightness and soft spice. Lineage: Georgia Apple Pie x Zikigai by Raw Genetics.

name: Jack London
