In the tent it forms a vigorous, medium-frame hybrid that stretches politely and stacks dense, sugar-frosted colas; outdoors it reaches for the sun, flashing deep greens and the occasional inky purple from its Runtz side. Aromas open with zesty citrus and pine, then slide into candied grape, cream, and gentle gas, a terpene chorus led by caryophyllene, terpinolene, limonene, and myrcene. The flavor tracks the nose—bright and herbal on the inhale, sweeter and confectionary on the finish. Expect uplifting, creative focus to land first, settling into a calm, happy ease without couchlock. Flowering wraps in roughly 56–63 days, with capable growers pulling medium indoor yields around 400 g/m² and larger outdoor plants pushing high per-plant weights. Potency rides in the low-to-mid 20s for THC, while CBD remains trace. Jack Herer's storied cup pedigree brings crackling clarity; Richmond Runtz contributes color, resin, and that modern candy gas. Named for the writer whose name marks the East Bay waterfront, Jack London feels old‑school and current at once—a polished, production‑ready hybrid with character.

name: Blue Slushie F2

Many growers eye this one for solventless work thanks to its notably "washable" resin. Effects land smooth but assertive, blending euphoric lift with a deeply relaxed body feel ideal for off-clock unwinding. Under the hood, Blue Slushie F2 still wears its celebrated parent with pride: the original Blue Slushie came from Blue Cookies x Georgia Pie, and those cookie-dough-and-gas traits remain front and center here. If you chase dark-hued candy gas with a creamy twist, Creme Noir belongs on your short list.

Expect a 60 indica, 40 sativa structure with sturdy lateral branching and colorful late-flower hues. On the nose and palate, Big Z leans into bright tropical candy layered with apple and creamy sweetness, making each jar crack a little fruit-salad moment. Typical lab reports put THC in the mid 20s, often around 25 percent, with CBD staying low. The high mirrors its lineage: an upbeat start that leaves many users feeling focused and happy, settling smoothly into relaxed, limber body vibes without heavy couch-lock. Resin output is notable, rewarding hashmakers with sticky, fragrant returns. Compared with finicky Z cuts, Big Z is more forgiving and notably quicker, yet keeps the signature flavor that made its parents modern classics. For growers and flavor-chasers alike, it is a vivid, candy-forward showcase of contemporary genetics.

name: Kerosene Candy
description: Kerosene Candy is where Growing Pains lets the candy-gas dial hit red. Built from Burnout OG and Zyrup, this indica-leaning hybrid marries cookie-kush petrol from Cherry Pie, GSC, and Biker Kush ancestry with Gelato-and-Zkittlez syrup tones. Crack the jar and a ribbon of sweet candy rides over clean diesel and a pinch of earthy spice; the flavor follows with glossy gas on the inhale and a candied finish. Dense, frosted calyxes stack on medium plants that stay tidy under training, throwing resin-heavy colas with a polished bag appeal. In the garden, SCROG or gentle LST keeps canopies even; buds finish with a silvered resin sheen and lime-to-violet flecks when nights run cool. Expect a 63-70 day indoor flower and moderate yields once the feed and climate are dialed. Typical lots test in the mid-to-high 20s for THC, with some releases cresting the 30s, while CBD stays trace; a caryophyllene-limonene-myrcene trio often leads the terp map. On the effects side, it starts calm and cheerful before settling into a cushioned, full-body ease — relaxed, happy, and gently euphoric rather than outright sleepy. Kerosene Candy showcases the GP house style: dessert-forward flavor draped in classic OG vapor, delivered with small-batch precision. Bred and cultivated in Michigan, it performs reliably in tuned indoor rooms.

name: Northern Lights 99
description: Northern Lights 99 channels classic pedigree into modern performance. Bred by Seedsman in collaboration with Brothers Grimm, this sativa-leaning hybrid fuses a selected Northern Lights Haze (from Nevil's NL5 x Haze F2 stock) with the legendary Cinderella 99. Expect a head-turning bouquet where tropical fruit and candy sweetness glide over diesel notes, earthy spice, and old-school Haze funk. Compact, medium-sized plants stretch moderately and pack on long, resin-frosted colas that glint silver at maturity. Indoors, Northern Lights 99 is built for efficiency, typically finishing in about 8-10 weeks of bloom and rewarding attentive growers with high yields; outdoors, it thrives in warm, dry climates and can stack impressively heavy flowers by October. The experience skews bright and cerebral: energetic and uplifting with a euphoric edge, reflecting THC potential that can test around the mid-20s. Flavor follows aroma — fruity, sweet, and lightly gassy — leaving a clean, modern finish on the palate. Northern Lights 99 preserves the best of its parents - clarity and speed from Cinderella 99, depth and drive from Northern Lights Haze - while trimming the Haze flowering window to a far more manageable cycle. It is an elegant tribute to two icons, refined for today's gardens by Seedsman and Brothers Grimm. Expect medium stature, sturdy internodes, and easy training potential across phenos that lean sativa.

name: Triple Z
description: Triple Z by Doja distills the modern Z family into a single, resin-soaked statement. Bred by Doja Seeds as a purpose-built washer, it pairs the legendary parent Zkittlez with ZBX2, a selected backcross of The Original Z, to stack trichomes and sweet-candy aromatics without sacrificing vigor. In the garden, Triple Z grows compact to medium in height with tight nodal spacing and chunky, golf-ball flowers that frost over late in bloom; most phenos finish in 56-65 days with modest yields that reward a dialed canopy. Expect a bright terpene trio - beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene - pushing a layered flavor of sweet berries and tropical fruit with a faint gassy snap on the exhale. Reported lab ranges place THC in the 15-25% window while CBD remains minimal, making the profile all about expressive terps and clean, buoyant power. The effect arrives happy and euphoric up top before easing into a relaxed, limbs-light calm that fits creative sessions, social nights, or winding down without heaviness. Built on the award-winning Z pedigree that redefined dessert aromatics, Triple Z channels that cult history into a refined, hash-friendly cultivar that shines equally well as cured flower or concentrated resin. Breeder credit: Doja Seeds curated this line for connoisseurs chasing clarity, candy, and solventless returns.

name: London Bubbly
description: Born in Amsterdam, London Bubbly by T.H.Seeds bubbles with nostalgia and new-school polish. The cross of London Mint Cake and Original Bubblegum pours out blueberry-cream and candy-sweet aromatics, anchored by caryophyllene with myrcene and limonene rounding the glaze. Indoors, yields routinely land around 500-600 g/m2 while the buds sparkle with a sugar-dust sheen that hints at the strain's solventless potential. The profile tastes like a minty bakery treat chased by classic pink gum, sweet, creamy and persistent. The effect mirrors its 55% sativa / 45% indica split: a buoyant, euphoric lift that settles into calm, even relaxation without blur. Typical lots test around 20-25% THC with low CBD. Breeder T.H.Seeds nods to house history here, as the Bubblegum backbone that helped define 1990s Amsterdam is alive beneath London Bubbly's dessert gloss, while its limited 2026 run gave collectors an early shot at the candy wave. For growers, the recipe is approachable: medium difficulty, responsive to light topping, SCROG-friendly, generous resin and an excellent flower-to-leaf ratio. For connoisseurs, it is sweet city made modern, equal parts comfort and fizz.

name: White Silk
description: White Silk stitches together the cream-laced thrust of Jet Fuel Gelato with the candy-forward punch of Richmond Runtz in a photogenic hybrid from Xeno Seed Company. In the garden it builds a sturdy, balanced frame with great structure, then finishes in about 8.5-9.5 weeks (roughly 60-67 days). Breeder notes call it "whiteout frost," and that shows: tight, dark-purple flowers stack up under long trichome stalks until every calyx looks dusted in snow, delivering serious bag appeal. The nose leans rich and dessert-like, heavy cream at the front, layered with softer peppery, floral, and lavender tones and a subtle lick of gas; certain phenos tilt more toward bright candy. Expect a THC-forward chemotype with minimal CBD, but exact lab values will depend on cut and conditions. On the palate, creamy sweetness meets a faint diesel twang and gentle botanicals. Reported effects cluster around euphoric lift, relaxed body comfort, and upbeat, happy clarity, making this a lively yet even-keeled experience for many. While yield depends on environment, the Richmond Runtz parent is renowned for generous production, a trait this feminized cross often echoes. For growers and photographers alike, White Silk is bred to stand out - gleaming, aromatic, and unmistakably modern. Expect medium internodal spacing and vigorous branching that welcome careful training.

name: Stonefish
description: Stonefish swims out of the Ronin Seeds vault as a purposeful clash between Amarelo and Zuyaqui, fusing tropical sun with creamy gas swagger. In the jar, first notes drive from Zuyaqui's Dawg Walker x Horchata backbone - diesel, a hint of chemical edge, and faint spice - before Amarelo lifts the bouquet with bright citrus and tropical candy. Expect a medium-stature hybrid with moderate stretch, stacking dense, resinous calyxes and finishing in roughly fifty-six to sixty-three days. Yields land in the dependable middle, about 400 g per square meter indoors and near 400 g per outdoor plant when dialed, and the grow sits comfortably at a medium difficulty. Limonene and beta-caryophyllene tend to steer the profile, with myrcene riding shotgun, translating to a palate of diesel, citrus peel, and sun-ripened fruit. Potency leans modern: THC commonly falls in the low-to-mid twenties with low CBD. On the nose and tongue Stonefish starts brisk and gassy, then rounds into a soft, creamy-dough echo; on the mind it moves from uplifted and energetic to sociable, giggly composure without blotting focus. Crafted by Ronin Seeds to bottle Amarelo's color and Zuyaqui's composure in one balanced cut, Stonefish glints like its name - sleek, vivid, and quietly dangerous in the best possible way.

name: Sharpiez
description: Sharpiez from Lit Farms fuses the indelible funk of Permanent Marker with the candy-soap flair of Zoap, creating a modern hybrid that lives up to its name. Crack the jar and an inky, chemical top note rushes out first, quickly met by bright citrus and a soft, floral lather; on the palate, the profile deepens into earthy pepper and a whisper of diesel before a creamy, clean finish. The onset is fast and upbeat—often giggly and euphoric—then settles into a deep, body-centered calm that reflects its indica-leaning 60/40 split. Growers appreciate its medium stature, dense, frost-heavy colas, and a dependable 56–63 day flowering window that wraps cleanly around eight to nine weeks. Expect medium yields with exceptional resin coverage and bag appeal. Typical batches test in the mid-20s for THC with negligible CBD, and the expression is commonly led by caryophyllene and limonene with a linalool accent, mirroring its parentage. Bred by Lit Farms (Lost In Translation), Sharpiez honors both sides of its lineage: the unmistakable marker-funk and gas from Permanent Marker and the confectionery, soapy bloom from Zoap. Whether you are chasing a loud, complex nose or a balanced ride from cerebral lift to tranquil unwind, Sharpiez leaves an unmistakable signature.

Shaved Ice typically tests high in THC with low CBD, and often expresses a terpene triad led by limonene and caryophyllene with a linalool accent. Yields are moderate indoors or out, especially when given even canopy management and steady feed. Buds cure to a shimmering lime-and-violet mosaic under a thick frosting, delivering the dessert-gas profile many growers chase today. For fans of flavor-first genetics and balanced hybrids, Shaved Ice showcases LIT Farms at its playful best while staying true to the character of its celebrated parents.

name: Pink Zoap
description: Bred by Sure Fire Select, Pink Zoap pairs the modern cult classic Zoap with the candy-fruit leaning Pink Silky to bottle clean florals and ripe berry sparkle into a single hybrid. Under ideal conditions yields reach the high tier, often up to 600 g/m2 inside and around 1000 g per plant outside. On the nose and palate, Pink Zoap fuses Zoap's soapy-citrus brightness with Pink Silky's strawberry-sweet push: think strawberry and citrus over a creamy base. Dominant terpenes lean caryophyllene and limonene with accents of linalool and humulene, shaping an effect profile reported as relaxed, giggly, and a touch hungry, with occasional dry mouth or dry eyes in heavier sessions. THC commonly lands in the mid-20s (roughly 21-28%), with trace CBD. Gardeners will find a cooperative, medium-difficulty cultivar that likes moderate defoliation, steady airflow in dense late flowers, and light training to keep a flat, light-hungry canopy. Credit to Sure Fire Select for a cheerful, dessert-clean expression of two crowd-pleasing parents, Zoap and Pink Silky.

High-THC potential and typically low CBD keep the effects assertive: a swift, euphoric lift that warms into a contented, body-forward calm, with plenty of happy, relaxed headspace. Myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene commonly headline the terpene mix, reinforcing the strain’s pine-citrus spice and grounded OG finish. name: Lemon Mascorpone

Carefully selected and released by LIT Farms, Lemon Mascorpone captures modern connoisseur genetics in a flavor-forward hybrid that is as polished in the garden as it is striking in the bag. Growers note tidy internodes, robust trichome density, and an easy-to-manage canopy.

If your hunt calls for short turnaround and candy-citrus charisma, this cross writes a sweet ending. Built from Sugar Tab x Black Runtz, its author is LIT Farms.
